patterns.context: Occurs in public health abstracts discussing low-income and lower-middle-income countries

patterns.name: The word benefits
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence comparing the advantages of antiangiogenic therapy with traditional chemotherapy

8_387.concept: none
8_387.description: 最强触发分散：Sl- 词首、若干被拆分的词片段，以及 middle 和 benefits；除 Sl- 外，各片段缺少共同语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: Sl- 开头的词或词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Sl 开头的词首或词首片段，不同后缀均可；其中有的词后跟换行、重复标题或句子延续
patterns.domain: 词条标题、网页文本、科学术语

patterns.name: 分词后的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的词或词串片段；片段可能是词首、词中，也可能跨大小写与拼写片段，语义并不一致
patterns.domain: 百科、论文页面或其他文本

patterns.name: middle income 短语
patterns.context: 出现在讨论低收入及中低收入国家的公共卫生摘要中

patterns.name: benefits 一词
patterns.context: 出现在比较抗血管生成疗法与传统化疗优点的句子中

en.description: Activation covers words and proper nouns beginning with Al, two types of code patterns, energy terminology, and two types of medical terminology. No clear shared semantics are apparent, and code and specialized-text triggers differ.

patterns.name: Names or words beginning with “Al”
patterns.context: A word or proper noun begins with Al; what follows may be a hyphenated compound name or an ordinary name or word. Activation focuses on Al and the characters immediately following it.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles, proper nouns, and words

patterns.name: someline in angle-bracket tags
patterns.context: The code contains someline in double quotes inside an XML-style <occurrence> tag; one instance is used in a conditional and another in an assignment.

patterns.name: Empty string in a validate condition
patterns.context: The code uses an if statement to check whether a variable's validate property equals an empty string.

patterns.name: Cross-token combination in a specific term
patterns.context: The term Energy security is followed by the abbreviation or name Nabucco in parentheses; activation centers on character fragments after tokenization.

patterns.name: Instrumental analysis terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title about measurement methods and refers to the analytical technique synchronous spectrofluorimetry.

patterns.name: Hypoxia-related medical terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes hypoxia-induced hypothermia and goes on to mention GABA.

8_387.concept: none
8_387.description: 激活覆盖以 Al 开头的词项与专名、两类代码模式，以及能源术语和两类医学术语；尚无明显共同语义，且代码与专业文本的触发条件各异。

patterns.name: “Al”开头的名称或词项
patterns.context: 词或专名以 Al 开头；后续可能是连字符复合名，也可能是普通姓名或单词。激活重点落在 Al 及紧随其后的字符。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题、专名及词项

patterns.name: 尖括号标签中的 someline
patterns.context: 代码中出现以双引号包裹的 someline，位于 XML 风格的 <occurrence> 标签内；一处用于条件判断，另一处用于赋值。

patterns.name: validate 条件中的空字符串
patterns.context: 代码以 if 判断变量的 validate 属性是否等于空字符串。

patterns.name: 特定术语中的跨词元组合
patterns.context: 术语 Energy security 后跟括号中的缩写或名称 Nabucco；激活集中在分词后的字符片段。

patterns.name: 仪器分析术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于测定方法的论文标题中，指向 synchronous spectrofluorimetry 这一分析技术。

patterns.name: 缺氧相关医学术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述 hypoxia-induced hypothermia，并继续提及 GABA。

en.concept: Locally salient fragments in mathematical text
en.description: Activation samples are primarily mathematical text: they cover random selection, proof discussion, formula formatting, author affiliations, and research reviews. There are also two encyclopedia name and line-break fragments. These triggers do not share a clear narrow semantic theme.

patterns.name: Random selection
patterns.context: Describes vectors or graph edges being randomly selected; the wording is explicit only here

patterns.name: Name and proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: A name is split into multiple subword tokens, followed by a line break and repetition of the name's beginning

patterns.name: Address and institution names
patterns.context: Address/institution information in a paper; activation falls on name words such as “Applied”

patterns.name: Mathematical relations and proof wording
patterns.context: Mathematical arguments describe making a choice, a proof objective, or seeking a criterion; the words occur in different fragments

patterns.name: Formula formatting and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Dense LaTeX mathematical expressions containing integrals, fractions, subscripts or superscripts, or alignment environments

patterns.name: Rectangular tilings and recent research review
patterns.context: Lists researchers and references and summarizes results related to rectangular tilings

8_387.concept: 数学文本中的局部显著片段
8_387.description: 激活样本以数学文本为主：涵盖随机选取、证明论述、公式排版、作者地址与研究综述；另有两段百科人名及换行片段。未见这些触发项共享明确的窄语义。

patterns.name: 随机选取
patterns.context: 描述向量或网络边被随机选择、选取；仅此处措辞明确
patterns.domain: 数学论文，有限域向量空间

patterns.name: 人名及专名片段
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词 token，后接换行及姓名开头重复

patterns.name: 地址与机构名称
patterns.context: 论文中的地址/机构信息；激活落在“Applied”等名称词上

patterns.name: 数学关系与证明措辞
patterns.context: 数学论证中描述选择、证明目标或寻求判据；各词分别出现在不同片段

patterns.name: 公式排版与数学符号
patterns.context: 密集 LaTeX 数学表达式，包含积分、分式、上下标或对齐环境

patterns.name: 矩形铺砌与近期研究综述
patterns.trigger: “tilings of rectangles by small one-dimensional tiles”及“More recently”
patterns.context: 列举研究者与文献，概述矩形铺砌相关结果

en.concept: Mathematical formula markers and text-structure symbols
en.description: Responds most strongly to the conditional marker if and the limit notation lim in mathematical contexts; also responds more weakly and locally to vertical bars, slashes, and number arrangements used for formatting or separation in plain-text tree diagrams and tables.

patterns.name: if in mathematical conditions
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas, LaTeX commands, or variable subscripts, typically introducing a condition or definition; not if in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Limit symbol
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical limit expressions about a variable tending to infinity or approaching a value.

patterns.name: Vertical bars and slashes in tree diagrams
patterns.context: Characters are column-aligned to represent a tree structure and its branches; activation is distributed around diagram symbols and whitespace.

patterns.name: Vertical bars and number arrangements in tables
patterns.context: A plain-text table with line breaks, where vertical bars mark column boundaries.

8_387.concept: 数学公式标记及文本结构符号
8_387.description: 主要对数学语境中条件标记 if 和极限记号 lim 强烈响应；另对纯文本树图、表格中用于排版或分隔的竖线、斜线及数字排列有较弱且局部的响应。

patterns.name: 数学条件中的 if
patterns.trigger: «if»10、«if»10（位于 \mbox{if 中）、«if»10（位于 \If 中）、«if»10（位于下标 _if_ 中），以及 «if»10
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式、LaTeX 命令或变量下标中，通常引出条件或定义；不是普通散文中的 if。

patterns.name: 极限符号
patterns.context: 出现在关于变量趋于无穷或趋近某值的数学极限表达式中。

patterns.name: 树形图中的竖线和斜线
patterns.trigger: «|»、«\»、«/»，伴随空格与换行组成树形图
patterns.context: 字符按列对齐，表示树结构及其分支；激活分布在图形符号和空白附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答中的纯文本示意图

patterns.name: 表格中的竖线与数字排列
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «|»，以及竖线间按列排列的数字
patterns.context: 带换行的纯文本表格，竖线作为列边界。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on angle brackets, vertical bars, variable subscripts, and greater-than-zero conditions in mathematical formulas; it also covers epsilon-delta limit definitions. Other isolated technical patterns include weak_ptr, category-theoretic composition, and leap-second discussions, which do not fit one semantic category.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and vertical bars in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially near notation for quantum states, inner products, sets, or quotient rings; components of these mathematical symbols are marked across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Epsilon-delta and convergence definitions
patterns.context: Mathematical analysis definitions or proofs include epsilon greater than zero and formal statements of sequence convergence or limits.

patterns.name: Strict positivity condition
patterns.context: Positivity is expressed as greater than zero in a mathematical proposition or condition; this pattern overlaps with epsilon-delta definitions but also occurs in conditions involving matrices.

patterns.name: Subscripts, variables, and formula fragments
patterns.context: Variables and their subscripts are embedded in LaTeX formulas or technical expressions; these common symbols alone do not identify a more specific shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: weak_ptr identifier
patterns.context: Boost C++ documentation or discussion about assignment, copying, and observation behavior involving weak_ptr.

patterns.name: Composition in category theory
patterns.context: Discusses how category theory describes the composition of multiple methods and notes that this is not merely ordinary composition of functions.

patterns.name: Leap seconds and future dates
patterns.context: Discusses design issues involving calculations for future dates and leap seconds announced afterward.

8_387.concept: 公式与技术符号片段
8_387.description: 激活最集中于数学公式中的角括号、竖线、变量下标及大于零条件；也覆盖ε-δ极限定义。另有weak_ptr、范畴论组合和闰秒讨论等孤立技术模式，未能归入同一语义。

patterns.name: 数学式中的角括号与竖线符号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式中，尤其是量子态、内积、集合或商环等记号附近；多个段落中这些数学符号的组成部分被标记。

patterns.name: ε-δ与收敛定义
patterns.context: 在数学分析的定义或证明中，出现 ε 大于零，以及序列收敛或极限的形式化表述。

patterns.name: 严格正值条件
patterns.context: 在数学命题或条件中，以大于零表达正性；本模式与 ε-δ 定义有重叠，但也出现在矩阵相关条件中。

patterns.name: 下标、变量与公式片段
patterns.context: 变量及其下标嵌在 LaTeX 公式或技术表达式中；仅凭这些常见符号无法确定更具体的共同语义。

patterns.name: weak_ptr标识符
patterns.context: C++ Boost 文档或讨论中，围绕 weak_ptr 的赋值、复制与观察行为。

patterns.name: 范畴论中的组合
patterns.context: 讨论范畴论如何描述多种方法的组合，并指出这不只是函数的普通组合。

patterns.name: 闰秒与未来日期
patterns.context: 讨论未来日期计算与之后宣布的闰秒之间的设计问题。

en.description: Activation spans several text types: structure and groups, tutorial recommendations, legal footers, personal experience, code, statistical sample sizes, algorithm explanations, business performance, licensing, and practice output. Local triggers vary, with no unified lexical pattern observed.

patterns.name: Structure, groups, or categories
patterns.context: Discusses graph clustering, group formation, and the underlying structure or categories; activation words are dispersed across adjacent semantic fragments.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, graph theory, and machine learning

patterns.name: Tutorials and resource recommendations
patterns.context: Forum posts introduce or recommend documentation, books, and online tutorials, typically followed by a link.

patterns.name: Document footers and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Formatting instructions at the end of a legal document page emphasize indentation, line breaks, and software needed to view or print the opinion.

patterns.name: Personal experience and action advice
patterns.context: A forum reply draws on personal experience to suggest that handling matters oneself can save money; high activation falls on completion verbs in the account of experience.

patterns.name: Blocks and array allocation in code
patterns.context: Loops over sections, checks for null values and skips them, then allocates a character array to store block identifiers.

patterns.name: Statistical sample size
patterns.context: Explains that sample size depends on the number of response categories and the significance level, and gives a sample-size example.

patterns.name: Naming and shared properties in an algorithm explanation
patterns.context: Explains how a set-intersection algorithm works and clarifies that, apart from the name, it has nothing in common with the Python function of the same name.

patterns.name: Performance and business groups
patterns.context: A business email evaluates a business group and its recent stock performance; activation involves group performance and wording about completing or performing well.

patterns.name: Authorization in license terms
patterns.context: A software license lists actions that licensees and assignees may perform, with do so referring to the preceding actions.

patterns.name: Repeated practice and accumulated output
patterns.context: Discusses drawing ability and suggests that consistent practice and completing more illustrations are related to becoming a good illustrator.

8_387.concept: 无统一抽象概念
8_387.description: 激活分布于多类文本：结构与群组、教程推荐、法律页脚、个人经验、代码、统计样本量、算法解释、商业表现、许可授权及练习产出；局部触发各异，未见统一词面。

patterns.name: 结构、群组或类别
patterns.context: 讨论图的聚类、群组形成及其背后的结构或类别；激活词分散在相邻语义片段中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、图论与机器学习

patterns.name: 教程与资源推荐
patterns.context: 在论坛帖子中介绍或推荐文档、书籍和在线教程，通常接链接。

patterns.name: 文档页脚与换行版式
patterns.context: 法律文件页面末尾的格式化提示，强调缩进、换行及查看/打印意见书所需的软件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、网页转录文本

patterns.name: 个人经验与行动建议
patterns.context: 论坛回复以个人经历为依据，提出自行处理事务可省钱等建议；高激活落在经验陈述的完成动词上。

patterns.name: 代码中的块与数组分配
patterns.context: 循环遍历区段、检查空值并跳过，随后分配字符数组以存储块标识。

patterns.name: 统计样本量
patterns.context: 说明样本量取决于响应类别数及显著性水平，并举例解释样本量。

patterns.name: 算法说明中的命名与共同点
patterns.context: 解释集合交集算法如何运行，并澄清它与 Python 同名功能除名称外并无共同之处。

patterns.name: 业绩表现与商业群组
patterns.context: 企业邮件评价某业务群组及其股票近期表现；激活涉及群组表现和完成/表现良好的表述。

patterns.name: 许可条款中的授权行为
patterns.trigger: «do»10 «so»；«use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute»；«under» the terms
patterns.context: 软件许可证列出被许可人及受让者可执行的行为，并由 do so 指代前述行为。

patterns.name: 反复练习与产出积累
patterns.context: 谈论绘画能力，认为持续练习、完成更多插画与成为优秀插画家相关。
patterns.domain: 论坛引述、艺术创作建议

en.concept: Expressions of function, form, and action
en.description: Activation is dispersed across registers: it highlights explanations introduced by “One function/form of” and “do” in conversational action contexts; it also responds to technical expressions involving receptor complexes, research parameters, formula variables, and hardware functions.

patterns.name: “One function” explanation or classification
patterns.context: Introduces an object's properties, purpose, or algorithm, then gives one of its functions or forms

patterns.name: do in commands or action steps
patterns.context: In dialogue or first-person narration, indicates doing or continuing to do something; also occurs in legal courtroom dialogue

patterns.name: Technical term functions
patterns.context: Discusses a set of functions that can be implemented or called, near computing hardware or programming content

patterns.name: Receptor complex terminology
patterns.context: Describes receptor subunits, chains, and signal transduction

patterns.name: Research results and parameter descriptions
patterns.context: States the model's robustness to parameter changes and gives astrophysical parameters

patterns.name: Variable ranges and formula descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces the variable range covered by a formula and the objects to which it applies

8_387.concept: 功能、形式与行动表述
8_387.description: 激活分散于多种语域：突出“One function/form of”引出的说明，以及口语行动语境中的“do”；另对受体复合物、科研参数、公式变量和硬件功能等技术表述有响应。

patterns.name: “One function”解释或分类
patterns.context: 先介绍某对象的性质、用途或算法，再给出其一种功能或形式
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、技术问答

patterns.name: 命令或行动步骤中的 do
patterns.context: 对话或第一人称叙述中表示要做、继续做某件事；也出现在法律庭审对话

patterns.name: 技术术语 functions
patterns.context: 谈论可实现或调用的一组功能，邻近计算硬件或编程内容

patterns.name: 受体复合物术语
patterns.context: 描述受体亚基、链及信号传导

patterns.name: 科研结果与参数描述
patterns.context: 陈述模型对参数变化的稳健性，并给出天体物理参数

patterns.name: 变量范围与公式描述
patterns.context: 介绍公式涵盖变量范围及适用对象
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的技术性引文

en.description: Activation often occurs in singular nouns and their determiner constructions, especially one/only/first with thing, team, or person; there are also isolated triggers such as key ally and pratfalls, so the patterns are not fully uniform.

patterns.name: Singular thing constructions
patterns.context: thing often follows one or first and is followed by complements such as that, we, or to; it serves as the sentence focus, introducing a specific matter or explanation
patterns.domain: Online comments, emails, and general narration

patterns.name: Singular team and related reference
patterns.context: Discusses a candidate or comparison team; team can occur with determiners such as one, another, or that

patterns.name: Singular reference to a person
patterns.context: A determiner modifies person to refer to one person or another

patterns.name: Emphasis and selection with one/only
patterns.context: Emphasizes a sole object, a particular item, or one selected from a group; it does not always co-occur with thing, team, or person
patterns.domain: General narration and patent technical text

patterns.name: first thing opening a quotation
patterns.context: Uses first thing we said to introduce a previous statement or argument
patterns.domain: Quotation in a financial risk email

patterns.name: first thing introducing an action
patterns.context: Uses first thing + subject + did to describe the first action taken by a party

patterns.name: key ally
patterns.context: key modifies a political figure's supporter; this is not a singular noun construction with one/thing/team/person

patterns.name: Disaster-related word-ending trigger
patterns.context: Appears when listing what a news website does or does not cover; it is not clearly related to the singular noun patterns in other passages

8_387.concept: 限定词与单数名词结构
8_387.description: 激活多见于单数名词及其限定结构，尤其 one/only/first 与 thing、team、person 搭配；另有 key ally 和 pratfalls 等孤立触发，模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: thing 单数结构
patterns.context: thing 常位于 one 或 first 之后，后接 that、we、to 等补足内容；作为句子焦点引出具体事项或说明
patterns.domain: 网络评论、邮件及一般叙述

patterns.name: team 单数及相关指代
patterns.context: 讨论候选或对照的球队，team 可与 one、another、that 等限定词搭配

patterns.name: person 单数指称
patterns.context: 以限定词修饰 person，指一个或另一个人

patterns.name: one/only 强调与选择
patterns.context: 强调唯一对象、某一项或从一组中选出一个；不总与 thing、team 或 person 同现
patterns.domain: 一般叙述及专利技术文本

patterns.name: first thing 引述开场
patterns.context: 以 first thing we said 引出此前的陈述或论点
patterns.domain: 金融风险邮件中的引述

patterns.name: first thing 引出动作
patterns.context: 以 first thing + 主语 + did 描述某方首先采取的行动

patterns.name: key ally
patterns.context: key 修饰政治人物的支持者；不是单数名词 one/thing/team/person 结构

patterns.name: disaster 类词尾触发
patterns.context: 出现在列举新闻网站报道或不报道的内容时；与其他段落的单数名词模式不明显相关

en.concept: Emphasis on a single object or matter
en.description: Activation centers on one/only emphasizing a single object, the sole option, or a “one thing(s)” matter; it also appears in sports contexts involving team comparisons and one game. The trigger may fall on a following numeral, noun, or phrase component.

patterns.name: “one thing” introducing a focus
patterns.context: In narration or argument, shifts from multiple topics to one matter that is particularly noteworthy, worth knowing, or shared; common forms include “one thing in particular,” “one thing to know,” and “one thing in common.”
patterns.domain: Online comments, forum discussions, personal narration

patterns.name: Sole object / single option
patterns.context: Specifies the only object in a set that meets a condition, or emphasizes a particular person, team, or medication; “thing” need not appear.
patterns.domain: Patent medical text, entertainment reviews, sports, and sports narration

patterns.name: Quantifier one thing(s)
patterns.context: Uses thing(s) to refer to abstract factors, practices, or matters; one may occur in a “one of two” construction or alongside a plural quantity word.

patterns.name: Comparison and negation involving a generic team
patterns.context: Compares teams in a sports context or states in a negative sentence that no other team meets a condition; no clear one/thing construction is present.

patterns.name: one in a single-game record
patterns.context: In a sports-record account, one specifies the number of games; activation falls near the following “player.”

8_387.concept: 单一对象或事项的凸显
8_387.description: 激活集中于 one/only 对单一对象、唯一选项或“one thing(s)”事项的强调，也见体育语境的 team 比较及 one game；触发位置可落在其后数词、名词或短语成分上。

patterns.name: “one thing”焦点引出
patterns.context: 在叙述或论证中从多个话题转向一个特别值得注意、需要知道或共同拥有的事项；常见形式为 “one thing in particular”“one thing to know”“one thing in common”。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、论坛讨论、个人叙述

patterns.name: 唯一对象／单一选项
patterns.context: 限定某个集合中唯一符合条件的对象，或强调一个特定人、队伍、药物；不要求出现“thing”。
patterns.domain: 专利医学文本、娱乐评论、体育及体育叙述

patterns.name: 量词 one thing(s)
patterns.context: 以 thing(s) 指代抽象的因素、做法或事项；one 可处于“one of two”结构，也可与复数数量词并列出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术／人际建议及评论

patterns.name: 泛指团队的比较与否定
patterns.context: 体育语境中比较队伍，或在否定句中指出没有其他队伍符合某条件；没有明显的 one/thing 结构。

patterns.name: 单场纪录中的 one
patterns.context: 体育纪录叙述中用 one 限定比赛场次，激活落在后续“player”附近。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions where “one thing” introduces a point or question, especially thing; also activates on circumstance in legal texts, only factor as a limitation, and something else when asking about additional omissions.

patterns.name: “one thing” lead-in
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, “One thing …” introduces a point, question, complaint, suggestion, or commonality; possessives or elements such as that’s may occur in between.

patterns.name: circumstance in legal contexts
patterns.context: Discusses case facts and circumstances in legal decisions and their role in review or inference.

patterns.name: Only relevant factor
patterns.context: Uses “only” to limit a factor and describe its association with an outcome, coverage, or other variables.

patterns.name: Omitted addition introduced by else
patterns.context: Asks whether anything else is present or has been omitted; else receives the strongest activation.

8_387.concept: 特定词组与限定表达
8_387.description: 主要响应“one thing”引出观点或疑问的表达，尤其是 thing；另对法律文本中的 circumstance、限定的 only factor，以及询问补充遗漏的 something else 有激活。

patterns.name: “one thing”提示语
patterns.context: 在句首或从句中以“One thing …”引出某个观点、疑问、抱怨、建议或共同点；中间可夹入所有格或 that’s 等成分。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、邮件、一般叙述

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 circumstance
patterns.context: 法律判决中讨论案件事实、情节及其对审查或推论的作用。

patterns.name: 唯一相关因素
patterns.context: 以“only”限定某个因素，说明其与结果、覆盖情况或其他变量的关联。

patterns.name: else 引出的补充遗漏项
patterns.context: 询问是否还有别的内容或遗漏，else 获得最强激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to superlative evaluations and their ranking or scope complements, especially greatest/highest/best/most and the “of the …” structure; also covers quoted list titles and a few adjacent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluations
patterns.context: Uses superlatives or near-superlatives to describe people, works, songs, or rankings in evaluative, comparative, or ranking contexts; strong activation often falls on the noun being evaluated and words in the “of the …” structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, promotional copy, and Q&A

patterns.name: “of the …” superlative complement
patterns.context: A superlative or “one of the …” expression is followed by a scope, period, or award category; “of,” “the,” and scope nouns in these complements can also activate.

patterns.name: “the” and nouns in a general category
patterns.context: A generalized title template is quoted in a question seeking a resource list; the superlative ranking pattern is weaker, but “the” and category nouns still appear.

patterns.name: Segmentation anomaly in “makings”
patterns.context: The idiom “the makings of” occurs before a superlative evaluation; activation is scattered across the subword fragments of “makings,” and it is unclear whether this constitutes an independent trigger.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与榜单表达
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级评价及其排名、范围补语，尤其是 greatest/highest/best/most 与“of the …”结构；也覆盖引用榜单标题和少量相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 最高级评价
patterns.trigger: “greatest”“highest”“best”“most”“top”及其后接的名词或排名，如“greatest chef”“highest selling”“best 50 albums”“top 3”
patterns.context: 在评价、比较或排名语境中，用最高级或近似最高级描述人物、作品、歌曲或名次；较强激活常落在评价对象名词及“of the …”结构中的词上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、评论、宣传文案及问答

patterns.name: “of the …”最高级补语
patterns.trigger: “of the century”“of the past 50 years”“of the contest”“of all time”“of the Month”
patterns.context: 最高级或“one of the …”表达后接范围、时期或评选类别；这些补语中的“of”“the”及范围名词也可激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、榜单、宣传文案

patterns.name: 泛指类别中的“the”及名词
patterns.trigger: “the common ‘n best linux laptops of YYYY’ articles”
patterns.context: 在寻求资源列表的问题中，引用泛化的标题模板；最高级榜单模式较弱，但仍出现“the”及类别名词。

patterns.name: 分词切分异常的“makings”
patterns.trigger: “the mak|ings of one of the greatest pitchers”
patterns.context: 最高级评价前出现“the makings of”这一习语；激活散布在被切分的“makings”词片段上，具体是否构成独立触发因素不确定。
patterns.domain: 个人书信或叙述性文字

en.description: Primarily responds to superlative evaluations, list rankings, and their “of” scope structures: describing people, works, albums, and competitions as the best, greatest, or highest, including yearly, century, and historical rankings; also responds to explicit ordinal rankings and awards.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluations and rankings
patterns.context: Uses superlative or ranking-style wording to evaluate people, works, competitions, or products, especially with scope qualifiers such as “of the year/century/all time”; evaluative words and nouns are often marked across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, promotional copy, and news

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and list positions
patterns.context: An explicit ranking, annual award, or list position appears, often alongside a category of person or work; the expression need not include greatest/best of all time.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, sports honors, competition coverage

patterns.name: of-structures in evaluative collocations
patterns.context: “one of” or a superlative followed by “of” introduces a set, year, or scope, expressing an entity’s prominence within a group.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级评价、榜单名次及其“of”范围结构：称人物、作品、专辑、赛事等为最佳、最伟大或最高，并涉及年度、世纪、历史排名；也响应明确序数名次与奖项。

patterns.name: 最高级评价与排名
patterns.trigger: “the greatest … of the …”“the best … of …”“highest … of …”，以及“the … full 5 stars”
patterns.context: 在对人物、作品、赛事或产品作评价时，用最高级或排名式措辞，尤其是“of the year/century/all time”等限定范围；评价词与名词常被分散标记。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、宣传文案及新闻

patterns.name: 序数排名及榜单名次
patterns.context: 出现明确名次、年度奖项或榜单位置，常与人物/作品类别相连；不一定包含 greatest/best of all time 的表达。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、体育荣誉、竞赛报道

patterns.name: 评价性搭配中的 of-结构
patterns.trigger: “one of the best …”“one of the greatest …”“highest … of 2011”
patterns.context: 以“one of”或最高级加“of”引出集合、年份或范围，表达某对象在一组对象中的突出地位。

en.description: Primarily responds to “of the + ranking/superlative + noun” and “one of the …” evaluative structures used to describe list positions, historical bests, or relative quality across music, sports, film, and other genres. A separate question about lists of Ubuntu-compatible laptops does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: “of the …” ranking/superlative expressions
patterns.context: In lists, awards, or evaluative statements, marks a work, person, or thing’s ranking, quality, or representativeness within a group or period; also includes structures such as “one of the greatest/better …”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, and spoken quotations about music, cooking, comics, sports, film, science-fiction characters, and other topics

patterns.name: Question about lists of Ubuntu-compatible devices
patterns.context: Asks whether a list of compatible devices exists; the main superlative or ranking structure is absent.

8_387.concept: 排名与最高级评价结构
8_387.description: 主要响应“of the + 排名/最高级 + 名词”及“one of the …”评价结构，用于描述榜单名次、历史最佳或相对优劣，跨音乐、体育、影视等文体。另有一段询问Ubuntu兼容笔记本清单，无法纳入该模式。

patterns.name: “of the …”排名/最高级表达
patterns.trigger: “of”后接“the”及序数或最高级排名，如“of the 10 greatest bands”“of the 500 greatest albums of all time”“of the 21st best Starfleet character”
patterns.context: 在榜单、评选或评价语句中，标出某项作品、人物或事物在一组对象或某个时期中的排名、优劣或代表性；也包括“one of the greatest/better …”等结构。
patterns.domain: 音乐、厨艺、漫画、体育、影视、科幻角色等百科条目、评论和口语引述

patterns.name: Ubuntu兼容设备清单提问
patterns.trigger: “Is there a list of Ubuntu-compatible laptops?”及“updated list of current laptops”
patterns.context: 询问是否存在列出兼容设备的清单；没有出现主模式的最高级或排名结构。

en.description: Activation is concentrated around superlatives or evaluative words combined with nouns, and ranking or achievement expressions formed with of + time/scope. It also involves list positions, competition results, and album sales certifications. The specific entities and genres vary, and activation falls across multiple words in the phrase.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluation followed by a category noun
patterns.context: Statements about an entity’s ranking, quality, achievement, or historical standing often use the + superlative/evaluative word + noun + of + time or scope; activation is distributed across multiple words in the phrase rather than limited to a single token.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, music and sports reviews, entertainment promotion, and quotations

patterns.name: Rankings and list positions
patterns.context: Describes list rankings, positions, or competition results, often adjacent to the ranked entity and a ranking number.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries about people, albums, and competitions

patterns.name: Album sales and certifications
patterns.context: Describes regional album sales, certifications, or annual sales performance; partially overlaps with superlative ranking expressions.

patterns.name: Local collocations of entity categories and evaluative words
patterns.context: Evaluates specific entity categories (athletes, competitions, comics, etc.) and completes the evaluation with a comparative scope or time period; some examples are quotations.
patterns.domain: Sports reviews, entertainment content, and quotations

patterns.name: Competition statements involving achievements or rankings
patterns.context: A competition result describes the relative performance of an entry; the sentence contains a superlative and a ranking word but is not a typical best/greatest expression.

patterns.name: Other rankings in biographies and character introductions
patterns.context: A biographical entry relays a ranking of a character by the media; this trigger form is relatively isolated compared with the more common evaluations of works or athletic performance.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation not explained by ranking evaluations
patterns.context: These common words serve varied functions in context, so the fragments alone do not establish an independent trigger pattern; they may be components of a ranking or evaluative structure.

8_387.concept: 排名与最高级评价表达
8_387.description: 激活主要集中在最高级或评价词与名词、of+时间/范围构成的排名和成就表达，也涉及榜单名次、赛事成绩及专辑销量认证。具体对象和文体多样，且激活落在短语多个词上。

patterns.name: 最高级评价后接分类名词
patterns.trigger: “the greatest … of all time”、 “the best … of the year / a generation”、 “the highest …”等评价或排名表达中的 the、of、序数及相关名词
patterns.context: 在关于对象排名、质量、成就或历史地位的陈述中，常见结构为 the + 最高级/评价词 + 名词 + of + 时间或范围；激活分布在短语中的多个词，而非仅限单一 token。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐与体育评论、娱乐宣传及引语

patterns.name: 名次与榜单表述
patterns.trigger: “ranked … 21st best”、 “ranked the album at number 483”、 “top 3”、 “1st”及“highest placing”
patterns.context: 描述榜单排名、名次或比赛结果，常与排名对象和名次数字相邻。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物、专辑与赛事条目

patterns.name: 专辑销量与认证
patterns.trigger: “Gold in Germany”、 “certified Gold in New Zealand”、 “highest selling NZ rock album”
patterns.context: 描述专辑的地区销量、认证或年度销售表现；与最高级排名表述部分重叠。

patterns.name: 对象类别与评价词的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “best boxers of a generation”、“best skate contests of the year”、“greatest comic strip of all time”、“greatest pitchers of all time”
patterns.context: 评价对象具体类别（运动员、赛事、漫画等），并以比较范围或时间补足评价；个别例子是引语。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、娱乐内容及引语

patterns.name: 涉及成就或名次的赛事陈述
patterns.trigger: “highest placing non-English song of the contest”
patterns.context: 在比赛结果叙述中说明参赛作品的相对成绩；该句含最高级与名次词，但不属于典型的最佳/最伟大表述。

patterns.name: 人物与角色介绍中的其他排名
patterns.context: 人物条目转述媒体给出的角色排名；与更常见的作品或运动表现评价相比，触发形式较孤立。

patterns.name: 无法由排名评价解释的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些常见词在上下文中的作用不一，不能仅凭片段确定是独立触发模式；可能是排名或评价结构中的组成部分。

en.description: Several strong activations fall on “of …” phrases that introduce the comparison scope after a superlative, ranking, or title, especially “of the year” and “of all time”; one other passage is triggered by an album category label.

patterns.name: “of the year” superlatives
patterns.context: An “of …” phrase at the end of a ranking or evaluative sentence about a superlative or best entry, such as “greatest … of 2011” or “best … of the year”; the year or phrase defines the evaluation scope.
patterns.domain: Promotional or encyclopedia entries about albums, games, comics, and other popular culture

patterns.name: “of all time” historical rankings
patterns.context: A work or person is described as the greatest, best, or second-greatest of all time, often in quotations, rankings, and reviews.
patterns.domain: Cultural reviews and encyclopedias about music, comics, photography books, and other topics

patterns.name: “of the …” superlative evaluations
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a comparison scope after a superlative or ranking expression; the scope may be a competition, era, or category and need not indicate a year or historical ranking.
patterns.domain: Competition coverage, evaluations of people, and natural science encyclopedias

patterns.name: Album categories and producer categories
patterns.context: Category labels contain words such as Album(s), producer, or music genre; a nearby superlative or of-phrase is not required.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价的比较范围标记
8_387.description: 多段强激活落在最高级、排名或称号后引入比较范围的“of …”短语，尤其是“of the year”“of all time”；另有一段触发于专辑分类标签。

patterns.name: “of the year”最高级
patterns.context: 最高级或最佳项目的排名/评价句末，如“greatest … of 2011”“best … of the year”；年份或短语是评价范围。
patterns.domain: 专辑、游戏、漫画等流行文化宣传或百科条目

patterns.name: “of all time”历史排名
patterns.context: 作品或人物被称作历史上最伟大、最佳或第二伟大的对象，常见于引语、榜单和评论。
patterns.domain: 音乐、漫画、摄影书等文化评论与百科

patterns.name: “of the …”最高级评价
patterns.trigger: «of»9/10 后接范围名词，如“the contest”“the century”“any vertebrate”
patterns.context: 最高级或名次表达后用 of 引入比较范围；范围可以是赛事、时代或类别，并不一定表示年份或历史排名。
patterns.domain: 赛事报道、人物评价及自然科学百科

patterns.name: 专辑分类与产出者类别
patterns.context: 分类标签中出现 Album(s)、制作人或音乐流派等词；附近不要求有最高级或 of 短语。

en.concept: Scope or possession relations introduced by of
en.description: All passages show activation on “of,” with the strongest tokens often occurring in “of + scope/category” structures, commonly following superlative rankings; ordinary possession, partitive relations, and other prepositional uses also occur.

patterns.name: of in superlative/ranking expressions
patterns.context: Activation is strongest on “of,” commonly in expressions of superlatives, rankings, or category scope, followed by a time, category, or comparison scope; the phrase need not be the fixed expression “of all time”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music and sports materials, popular science, and general narration

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “all time”
patterns.context: A superlative adjective or noun is followed by “of all time” to indicate historical scope, as in “greatest comic strip of all time,” “greatest pitchers of all time,” and “greatest albums of all time”.
patterns.domain: Reviews, biographies, sports, and music rankings

patterns.name: of in nominal category or possession relations
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a period, category, group, or competition as an affiliation or comparison scope; some examples are not “of + superlative”.
patterns.domain: Biographical encyclopedias, sports, scientific descriptions, and competition coverage

patterns.name: Sporadic ordinary preposition of
patterns.context: “Of” also activates in ordinary quantity, partitive, list, or work attribution structures, but usually more weakly and not necessarily with a superlative meaning.
patterns.domain: Dialogue quotations, encyclopedias, and music materials

8_387.concept: of引出的范围或所属关系
8_387.description: 所有段落都在“of”上有激活，强度最高的 token 多处于“of + 范围/类别”结构，常接最高级排名；也见普通所属、部分关系及其他介词用法。

patterns.name: 最高级/排名表达中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of»9”后接“all time”“2011”“abuse”“any vertebrate”“the contest”等；也包括“of»10”后接“all time”
patterns.context: “of”处激活最强，常见于最高级、排名或类别范围表达中，后接时间、类别或比较范围；不要求短语固定为“of all time”
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐与体育资料、科普及一般叙述

patterns.name: all time固定搭配
patterns.context: 形容词或名词最高级后以“of all time”引出历史范围，如“greatest comic strip of all time”“greatest pitchers of all time”“greatest albums of all time”
patterns.domain: 评论、人物传记、体育及音乐排名

patterns.name: 名词性类别或所属关系中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of his time”“of the century”“of the year”“of any vertebrate”“of the contest”
patterns.context: “of”引出某个时期、类别、群体或赛事作为归属/比较范围；有些例子并非“of + 最高级”
patterns.domain: 百科传记、体育、科学描述及赛事报道

patterns.name: 零散的普通介词 of
patterns.trigger: “a few of them”“one of the greatest”“list of the 500 greatest”“album of 2011”
patterns.context: 在普通数量、部分关系、列表或作品归属结构中的“of”也会激活，但强度通常较弱，且不一定表达最高级
patterns.domain: 对话引文、百科及音乐资料

en.description: The most consistent trigger is of and its scope, category, or time complements, often in superlative, record, and ranking statements; it also responds to superlative evaluations and a satirical annual-award phrase, and includes a passage describing planetary size.

patterns.name: Scope or attribution complement introduced by of
patterns.context: Often follows a superlative, record, evaluation, or category noun, adding a comparison scope, affiliated set, or time; may also occur in ordinary noun phrases.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news or review narratives, and email copy

patterns.name: Superlative and best/record evaluations
patterns.context: Describes an entity as leading, most prominent, or greatest in degree within a scope; often combines with an of-complement but is not limited to the fixed phrase “of all time”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, sports correspondence, and popular science reporting

patterns.name: Derisive annual-award wording
patterns.context: Uses an exaggerated, disparaging “most … of the year” format to award a mock prize to a person or group; activation here also covers split spellings, not just an of-phrase.
patterns.domain: Politically partisan promotional emails or satirical copy

patterns.name: Comparative descriptions of size and quantity
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of the size, number, and compactness of planetary systems; “most compact system of planets” also fits the superlative and of-complement pattern.

8_387.concept: 最高级及范围补语
8_387.description: 最稳定的触发是 of 及其范围、类别或时间补语，常见于最高级、纪录与排名表述；另对最高级评价和一段讽刺性年度评选措辞有反应，并涉及一段行星尺寸描述。

patterns.name: of 引出的范围或归属补语
patterns.trigger: «of»，尤其是后接限定范围、类别或时间的结构，如 «of» the time、«of» all time、«of» the century、«of» any vertebrate、«of» 2001、«of» 2011、«of» the Slavine School、«of» planets
patterns.context: 常出现在最高级、纪录、评价或类别名词之后，补充说明比较范围、所属集合或时间；也可出现在一般名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻或评论叙述、邮件文案

patterns.name: 最高级与最佳/纪录评价
patterns.context: 描述某实体在一个范围内居首、最突出或程度最高；常与 of 补语连用，但并非只限于固定短语“of all time”。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、体育书信及科普报道

patterns.name: 贬讽式年度评选措辞
patterns.context: 以夸张、带攻击性的“年度最……”形式给人物或群体颁发戏仿奖项；这里的激活还覆盖拆分拼写的词，不只是 of 短语。
patterns.domain: 政治立场鲜明的宣传式邮件/讽刺文案

patterns.name: 尺寸与数量的比较描述
patterns.context: 在描述行星系统的大小、数量及紧凑程度时出现；其中“most compact system of planets”同时符合最高级及 of 补语模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to superlatives or extreme evaluations and their scope phrases, especially time, category, or comparison scopes introduced by “of”; also occurs in the positive “one of the” structure. The statistical table markers in passage 9 do not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Phrases with “of” followed by 9
patterns.context: “Of” appears in an evaluative, ranking, or superlative expression, followed by a time, scope, or category, forming phrases such as “greatest … of all time” and “album of 2011”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, and promotional copy

patterns.name: Superlative evaluative words
patterns.context: Describes people, works, bands, organs, or performances in the highest degree, often linked to an “of” phrase; this pattern also covers “shortest adult,” “highest selling,” and “best-selling” when not adjacent to of.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music reviews and promotion, sports anecdotes, and natural science descriptions

patterns.name: “one of the” evaluative structure
patterns.context: Uses “one of the” to introduce an excellent or important member of a category, followed by a superlative or positive evaluation; may cross token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Music reviews and promotion, sports anecdotes

patterns.name: Table and statistical markers
patterns.context: Occurs in tables, statistical tests, or footnote markers in medical papers; there is no clear superlative or evaluative “of” structure.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级或极值评价及其范围短语，尤其是“of”引出的时间、类别或比较范围；也见于“one of the”褒义结构。第9段的统计表格标记不符合这些模式。

patterns.name: “of” 后接 9 的短语
patterns.context: “of”出现在评价、排名或最高级表达中，后接时间、范围或类别，构成如“greatest … of all time”“album of 2011”等短语。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、评论、宣传文案

patterns.name: 最高级评价词
patterns.context: 对人物、作品、乐队、器官或表演作最高程度的描述，常与“of”短语相连；该模式也覆盖不与 of 紧邻的“shortest adult”“highest selling”“best-selling”。
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐评论与宣传、体育轶事、自然科学描述

patterns.name: “one of the”评价结构
patterns.context: 用“one of the”引出某类别中的优秀或重要成员，后接最高级或褒义评价；可能跨 token 边界。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论与宣传、体育轶事

patterns.name: 表格与统计标记
patterns.context: 出现在医学论文的表格、统计检验或脚注标记中；缺少清楚的最高级或“of”评价结构。

en.description: Most passages activate near superlative evaluations, rankings, records, or honors, covering works, people, animals, and planetary systems; other cases involve at followed by a number or institution, and of in a film-list title, which is difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinals and superlatives in rankings, titles, or records
patterns.context: In evaluations, rankings, records, or honors, a superlative or title word and nearby category, quantity, and scope words are activated; forms vary and commonly include “greatest,” “largest,” “longest,” “shortest,” “highest,” “most,” or “of the …” ranking structures.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, and introductions to people or works

patterns.name: Preposition at followed by a number
patterns.context: The preposition “at” is followed by a ranking number or a place/institution name; these two uses differ and may simply be triggered by the same local word form.

patterns.name: Entry-number structure in film lists
patterns.context: In “See also” lists at the end of film entries and year-category headings, activation falls near “of”; this does not fit the clear superlative evaluation pattern in the other passages.
patterns.domain: Film encyclopedia entries and list headings

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名表述
8_387.description: 多数段落在最高级评价、排名、纪录或荣誉称号附近激活，涵盖作品、人物、动物和行星系统；另有 at 后接数字或机构，以及电影列表标题中的 of，后者难以与主模式对应。

patterns.name: 排名、称号或纪录中的序数与最高级
patterns.trigger: “ranked the album at number 483 in its list of the 500 greatest albums of all time”；“shortest adult human”；“the greatest comic strip of all time”；“greatest bands”；“highest selling”；“largest … longest”；“most compact system”；“Athlete of the Year”；“the greatest chef”
patterns.context: 在评价、排名、纪录或荣誉表述中，最高级或称号词及其邻近的类别、数量和范围词受到激活；形式并不固定，常见 “greatest”“largest”“longest”“shortest”“highest”“most” 或 “of the …” 排名结构。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、新闻与人物/作品介绍

patterns.name: 数字后接介词 at
patterns.context: 出现介词 “at” 后接排名数字，或地点/机构名称；两处用法不同，可能只是同一局部词形触发。

patterns.name: 电影列表中的条目编号结构
patterns.context: 电影条目末尾的“See also”列表及年份分类标题中，激活落在 “of” 附近；不符合其他段的明显最高级评价模式。
patterns.domain: 电影百科条目、列表标题

en.concept: therapeutic suffix fragments and sporadic word-form fragments
en.description: The most stable trigger is a suffix fragment of therapeutic, appearing across medical, research, and massage texts. There is also activation on internal word or proper-name fragments such as Lens, Resuscitating, PAMPs, and Wah Mee, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: therapeutic suffix
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the latter part of therapeutic; the prefix may cross token boundaries and occur inside a word rather than at its beginning.

patterns.name: Local fragments within word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal token fragments of longer words; not all strong activations correspond to therapeutic.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on tokenized fragments of the proper name Wah Mee, with no apparent medical or semantic connection.

patterns.name: PAMPs abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Strong activation is concentrated on an internal letter fragment of the immunology abbreviation PAMPs; the same passage also contains innate immunity terms such as Toll-like receptors.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in an organization name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a massage-brand name, in the context of recruiting massage therapists.

patterns.name: General spelling fragment
patterns.context: Appears in Morgan Lens in a passage on the history of ophthalmology; apart from the internal word fragment, the context has no clear therapeutic meaning.

8_948.concept: therapeutic 词尾片段及零散词形片段
8_948.description: 最稳定的触发是 therapeutic 的词尾片段，横跨医学、科研与按摩文本；另对 Lens、Resuscitating、PAMPs及 Wah Mee 等词内或专名分词片段有激活，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词尾 therapeutic
patterns.trigger: «rapeutic»9（与前文拼接时形成 therapeutic，如 The«rapeutic»、neuro«the»1«rapeutic»）
patterns.context: 激活集中在 therapeutic 的后半部分；前缀可能跨 token 边界，出现在单词中间而非独立词首。

patterns.name: 词形内部的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词的内部 token 片段；并非所有强激活都对应 therapeutic。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名 Wah Mee 的分词片段中，未见明显的医学或词义联系。

patterns.name: PAMPs 缩写片段
patterns.context: 强激活集中于免疫学缩写 PAMPs 的中间字母片段；同段还有 Toll-like receptors 等先天免疫术语。

patterns.name: 机构名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 作为按摩品牌名称的一部分出现；与句中按摩治疗师招聘语境相连。

patterns.name: 一般拼写片段
patterns.context: 眼科史段落中出现于 Morgan Lens；除词内片段外，语境没有明确的治疗性含义。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on partial spellings of English words, often in medical terminology, but also in encyclopedia proper names, place names, forestry terms, and commercial copy. Cross-domain consistency is weak; the author-name fragments are difficult to explain using these patterns.

patterns.name: Word-initial or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on initial or internal subword fragments of English words, often combining with subsequent characters to form complete words. Examples include Wade, Wah, Neoplastic, Neopolyptychus, Asthma, and forestry.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including medical abstracts, encyclopedias, and NIH project text

patterns.name: Medical terms and morphemes
patterns.context: In biomedical contexts, activation falls on initial or internal fragments of medical terms related to resuscitation, premature infants, immunoglobulin gene rearrangement, neoplastic transformation, and asthma.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Similar W-/Ne- initial fragments occur in encyclopedia titles, names of people or events, species names, and author names; these examples are not the same proper name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and encyclopedia entries, journal author information

patterns.name: Massage-industry promotional terms
patterns.context: Recruitment or marketing copy describes massage therapist teams, work environments, and chain brands; activation is scattered across common promotional phrases.

patterns.name: Percentage and oxygen-therapy expressions
patterns.context: Describes administering 100% oxygen to premature infants; related to resuscitation and infants in the same sentence.

patterns.name: Historical population and forestry terms
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the word for forestry activates in an encyclopedia account of the population and employment of a historical region.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在英文词的部分拼写，常见于医学术语，也见于百科专名、地名林业词及商业宣传词。跨领域一致性较弱；作者姓名片段难以由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: 词首或词中片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文单词的开头或内部子词片段，常与后续字符共同构成完整词；包括 Wade、Wah、Neoplastic、Neopolyptychus、Asthma、forestry。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，包括医学摘要、百科和 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 医学术语及词素
patterns.trigger: «Res»3«us»10«cit»5«ating»6、« preterm»2« infants»6、« tumor»3« specific»4« immunoglobulin»6« gene»5« rearrangement»4、«Ne»3«oplastic»9« transformation»5、«Ast»9«hma»3
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中，激活落在医学词汇的词首或词内片段，涉及复苏、早产儿、免疫球蛋白基因重排、肿瘤转化和哮喘。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的片段
patterns.context: 百科标题、人物或事件名称、物种名，以及作者姓名中出现相似拼写的 W-/Ne- 开头片段；这些例子并非同一专名。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题与百科条目、期刊作者信息

patterns.name: 按摩行业宣传词
patterns.trigger: « professional»2、« friendly»5« environment»1、« dedicated»1« massage»2« therapists»، « working»3、« fastest»3« growing»5
patterns.context: 招聘或营销文案中描述按摩治疗师团队、工作环境及连锁品牌；激活分散在常见宣传用语中。

patterns.name: 百分比与氧疗表达
patterns.context: 描述给早产儿使用 100% 氧气；与同句中的复苏和婴儿相关。

patterns.name: 历史人口与林业词
patterns.context: 历史地区人口与就业状况的百科叙述中，林业一词内部片段激活。

en.description: Strong activation falls on several unrelated words or subwords: it, Sl, us, text, short, forest, and Test. Contexts span medicine, e-books, websites, law, and code data; there is no stable shared semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: Pronoun it
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone pronoun in a question, technical explanation, or email phrase; the annotation falls on it itself

patterns.name: Sl subword fragment
patterns.context: Appears inside a proper name or a citation-like legal case number, followed by ack or ip

patterns.name: Medical phrase about premature infants
patterns.context: Appears in words from a medical abstract about premature infants and 100% oxygen

patterns.name: E-book format instructions
patterns.context: Appears in date lines, asterisk dividers, and electronic-text production notes resembling a copyright page

patterns.name: shortTitle field
patterns.context: Located within the field name shortTitle in JSON-like data

patterns.name: Forest description
patterns.context: Appears in a translated quotation whose surrounding text describes sitting alone under a bush and admiring the beauty of the forest

patterns.name: REST test title
patterns.context: Located in the notebook markdown heading “Perform A/B Test using REST Endpoints”

8_948.description: 强激活落在多种互不相同的词或子词上：it、Sl、us、text、short、forest、Test。上下文横跨医学、电子书、网页、法律及代码数据；没有稳定的共同语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 代词 it
patterns.context: 作为独立代词出现在疑问句、技术说明或邮件短语中；标注落在 it 本身
patterns.domain: 网页文章、技术文章、邮件

patterns.name: Sl 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名或引文式法律案件编号的词内，后接 ack 或 ip

patterns.name: 早产儿医疗短语
patterns.context: 出现在关于早产儿及 100% 氧气的医学摘要词语中

patterns.name: 电子书格式说明
patterns.context: 出现在版权页式的日期、星号分隔线及电子文本制作说明中

patterns.name: shortTitle 字段
patterns.context: 位于 JSON 类数据中的字段名 shortTitle 之内

patterns.name: 森林描写
patterns.context: 出现在翻译引文中，周围描写独自坐在灌木下并赞叹森林之美

patterns.name: REST 测试标题
patterns.context: 位于 notebook markdown 标题“Perform A/B Test using REST Endpoints”中
patterns.domain: 代码笔记本 / 技术文档

en.description: Activation is scattered across internal subwords, proper names, and formatting markers, especially ab-initial fragments, German, line breaks, and separators. Text topics span programming, Germany, promotion, clothing, fiction, and encyclopedias; no single semantic theme explains the pattern.

patterns.name: English internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on one or more subword tokens within complete words or proper names; the words vary, including common words, brands, demonyms, and technical terms.
patterns.domain: Mixed text from HackerNews, Pile-CC, Gutenberg, and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Often appears near blank lines or dividers between comments, quotations, or code snippets; may reflect formatting structure rather than semantics.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, web text, code discussions

patterns.name: Text related to Germany
patterns.context: Contexts involve the German government, history, nationality, or people; German activates strongly in both passages.

patterns.name: ab-word fragments
patterns.context: Several unrelated words happen to begin with ab, and the ab subword fragment activates prominently; subsequent word meanings and contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Software reviews, classical narratives, programming-language introductions

patterns.name: Brand or proper-name strings
patterns.context: Individual subwords in proper-name or brand strings activate strongly; there is no common theme, and rare spelling or tokenization may be involved.
patterns.domain: Commercial promotion, social media posts, forum text

patterns.name: Programming and software discussions
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of career changes, language performance, or programming-language design; activation is scattered across technical words and their subwords.

patterns.name: Clothing and bodily descriptions
patterns.context: One passage describes undressing and bathing; another discusses shirt collars and ties. The topics are related, but the evidence consists of only two passages.

patterns.name: Advertising or promotional copy
patterns.context: Promotes products in exaggerated terms or encourages social-media engagement, using marketing language.

patterns.name: List and entry-style formatting
patterns.context: Structured web content such as encyclopedia references, category labels, or article summaries.

patterns.name: Terrorism and SIM card policy
patterns.context: A policy summary about the German government planning to require SIM card sellers to take measures; appears in this passage alone.

patterns.name: Bathing and archaic narrative language
patterns.context: A narrative in which a character undresses and bathes, using somewhat archaic or literary wording; appears in this passage alone.

patterns.name: Sports-person biography categories
patterns.context: A biographical page’s birth and death dates, nationality, and racing-driver category; not a general German political context.

8_948.description: 激活分散于词内子词、专名及格式标记，尤其常见于 ab 开头片段、German、换行和分隔符。文本主题横跨编程、德国、宣传、服饰、小说与百科；难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在完整词或专名的一个或多个子词 token 上；词本身并不固定，既有普通词，也有品牌、国籍词和技术词。
patterns.domain: 跨 HackerNews、Pile-CC、Gutenberg 与 Wikipedia 的混合文本

patterns.name: 换行与分隔符
patterns.context: 多处出现在评论、引用或代码片段之间的空行、分隔线附近；可能反映格式结构而非语义。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、网页文本、代码讨论

patterns.name: 德国相关文字
patterns.context: 德国政府、历史、国籍或人物条目语境；German 在两段中均有强激活。

patterns.name: ab-词片段
patterns.context: 多个不相关词恰以 ab 开头，且 ab 子词片段显著激活；后续词义和语境各异。
patterns.domain: 软件评论、古典叙事、编程语言介绍

patterns.name: 品牌或专名字符串
patterns.context: 专名或品牌字符串中个别子词强激活；没有共同主题，可能与罕见拼写或分词有关。
patterns.domain: 商业宣传、社交媒体信息、论坛文本

patterns.name: 编程与软件讨论
patterns.context: 讨论职业转向、语言性能或编程语言设计时出现；激活分散在技术词及其中的子词。

patterns.name: 服饰与身体描写
patterns.context: 一段描写脱衣、洗浴，另一段讨论衬衫领子与领带；主题相近但证据仅两段。

patterns.name: 广告或促销文案
patterns.context: 夸张推介产品或引导关注社交媒体，措辞带有营销色彩。

patterns.name: 列表及条目式格式
patterns.context: 百科参考资料、分类标签或文章摘要等结构化网页内容。

patterns.name: 恐怖主义与 SIM 卡政策
patterns.context: 德国政府拟要求 SIM 卡销售者采取措施的政策摘要；仅此段出现。

patterns.name: 洗浴与古旧叙事用语
patterns.context: 人物脱衣并洗浴的叙事，使用较古旧或文学化措辞；仅此段出现。

patterns.name: 体育人物百科分类
patterns.context: 人物传记页的生卒年、国籍与赛车手分类；不是一般德国政治语境。

en.description: In most passages, strong activation is concentrated on subword tokens containing the letter sequence “ur,” spanning place names, personal names, and common words. Several other name or word fragments also activate strongly without an apparent ur, so the pattern is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: ur substring affix
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple subword tokens, the token containing ur activates prominently; following tokens often complete a proper name or common word.

patterns.name: ur in proper names
patterns.context: ur occurs inside personal or historical names, usually adjacent to other subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: ur in place names
patterns.context: ur occurs near the beginning of a place name, inside a proper name in a news passage.

patterns.name: ur in common words
patterns.context: ur is part of a longer common word; these examples occur in narrative text or encyclopedia subheadings.

patterns.name: Local-name component
patterns.context: ur occurs in the French administrative-region name Meurthe-et-Moselle, which is repeated in the main text and navigation heading.

patterns.name: Place-name component in Somalia
patterns.context: ur occurs in the Somali place name Guriel in an economic overview paragraph.

patterns.name: Incidental match within a word
patterns.context: The word has no apparent ur substring, so the activation location may not match the observed pattern; the surrounding text discusses a galaxy.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names without clear ur
patterns.context: The fragments contain prominent activation, but the positions themselves do not show a stable ur string; the context is a heading or celebrity news.

8_948.description: 多数片段的强激活集中在含字母序列“ur”的子词 token，覆盖地名、人名及普通词；另有若干姓名或词段强激活而无明显 ur，规律并不完全一致。

patterns.name: ur 子串词缀
patterns.trigger: 跨 token 的「ur」，尤其是紧接在词首或词中并续接字母的片段，如 «Th»«ur»、«fig»«ur»、«L»«ur»、«He»«ur»、«A»«yt»«im»«ur»
patterns.context: 词语被分成多个子词 token 时，ur 所在 token 激活突出；后续常继续拼成完整专名或普通词。

patterns.name: 专名内的 ur
patterns.context: ur 出现在人物姓氏或历史人物姓名的内部，通常紧邻姓名的其他子词片段。

patterns.name: 地名中的 ur
patterns.context: ur 位于地名开头附近，处在新闻片段中的专名内部。
patterns.domain: 地方新闻、自然保护区介绍

patterns.name: 普通词中的 ur
patterns.context: ur 是较长普通词的一部分；这些例子分别出现在叙述或百科小标题中。

patterns.name: 地方名称成分
patterns.context: ur 位于法国行政区名称 Meurthe-et-Moselle 中，名称在正文及导航标题重复出现。

patterns.name: Somalia 地名成分
patterns.context: ur 位于索马里地名 Guriel 中，出现在经济概述段落。

patterns.name: 词内偶然匹配
patterns.context: 该词没有明显 ur 子串，激活位置可能与所见规律不符；附近谈论星系。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中无明显 ur 的片段
patterns.context: 片段含显著激活，但这些位置本身未呈现稳定的 ur 字符串；上下文是标题或名人新闻。

en.concept: el/ell spelling fragments in proper names
en.description: Activation in the passages mainly falls on letter fragments inside various proper names, especially spellings such as el/ell. There are also title formatting, school-grade markers, and email-address fragments, with no unified semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: el/ell letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: The fragments are embedded in proper names, and activation often falls on an internal word or syllable rather than a fixed meaning; no consistent capitalization, position, or word-boundary condition is apparent
patterns.domain: Proper names including people, places, organizations, and restaurants; news, encyclopedias, email, and educational text

patterns.name: Book titles and title formatting
patterns.context: Appears in document-opening titles, section headers, or subject lines; some titles use title case and tokenized forms

patterns.name: Numeric ratings and grade terms
patterns.context: Grade and subject-level markers in school positions or course information

patterns.name: Email-address fragments
patterns.context: Contact addresses at the end of forwarded email, with activation concentrated on fragments of the email username and domain

8_948.concept: 专名中的 el/ell 拼写片段
8_948.description: 各段激活主要落在多种专有名称内部的字母片段，尤见 el/ell 一类拼写；另见标题格式、学校年级标记和邮箱地址片段，缺少统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段 el/ell
patterns.trigger: 姓名或地名中的「el」及相邻拼写片段，如 «R»«uck»«des»«chel», «Ch»«or»«ale», «St»«uck»«ton», «Sk»«el»«ton», «Mand»«el», «Hem»«el», «E»«gon», «Kim»«eth»«a»
patterns.context: 片段嵌在专有名称中，激活常落在名字内部的词片或音节，而非固定词义；未见一致的大小写、位置或词界条件
patterns.domain: 人物、地名、机构、餐馆等专名；新闻、百科、邮件及教育文本

patterns.name: 书名及标题格式
patterns.context: 出现在文档开头的标题、栏目或主题行，部分标题采用首字母大写及分词形式
patterns.domain: 网页文档、教育材料标题

patterns.name: 数字评分与等级词
patterns.context: 学校职位或课程信息中的年级、学科等级标记

patterns.name: 邮件地址片段
patterns.context: 转发邮件末尾的联系人地址，激活集中于邮箱用户名及域名片段

en.description: Activation often falls on local fragments within proper names, especially personal names, place names, work titles, or organization names in lists, biographies, and bylines. A few other contexts include paper citations, email attachments, and section headings; there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on specific fragments inside proper names (personal names, place names, organization names, work titles, or section headings). They often appear in itemized lists, biographies, or titles, but do not form a consistent semantic category.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia people and awards entries, bibliographies, academic text, forum titles, email signatures, etc.

patterns.name: Lists and entry-style enumeration
patterns.context: Lists or entry-style text contain many proper names; activation falls on specific name fragments in the entries rather than on stable list markers.

patterns.name: Biographies and bylines
patterns.context: Personal names appear alongside roles, positions, or career histories in biographies, author bylines, or researcher profiles.

patterns.name: Technical terms and citations in scientific papers
patterns.context: The paper discusses active galactic nuclei and accretion-disk models, citing references by author and year; activation mainly falls on fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Email attachments and financial sections
patterns.context: An email lists attachment filenames, followed by futures-related sections and addresses resembling a table or signature; a name fragment also activates at the end.

8_948.description: 激活多落在专名内部的局部词片，尤其是名录、传记和署名中的人名、地名、作品名或机构名；另见论文引文、邮件附件与栏目等少数语境，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的局部词片
patterns.context: 激活集中在专有名称（人名、地名、机构名、作品名或栏目名）内部的特定词片；常处于逐词列举、传记或标题语境，但这些词片未形成一个一致的语义类别。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物与奖项条目、书目、学术文本、论坛标题、邮件签名等

patterns.name: 名录与条目式列举
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«album of the year»及连续的姓名、作品名和年份条目
patterns.context: 列表或条目式文本中，专名密集出现；激活落在条目里的特定名称片段，而非稳定的列表标记。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、奖项名录、电影书目

patterns.name: 人物简介与署名
patterns.trigger: «was born»、«co-founder»、«Chairman»、«by Donna»及其附近姓名片段
patterns.context: 传记简介、作者署名或研究人员资历介绍中，人物姓名与身份、职位或履历并列。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、研究资助资料

patterns.name: 科学论文中的技术术语与引文
patterns.context: 论文讨论活动星系核与吸积盘模型，并以作者姓名及年份引出文献；激活主要落在作者名片段。

patterns.name: 邮件附件与财务栏目
patterns.context: 邮件中列出附件文件名，随后出现类似表格或签名的期货栏目与地址；末尾姓名片段也有激活。

en.concept: et/ett letter fragments in proper names
en.description: Most strong activations fall within personal or proper names containing et/ett, across names, places, and various genres. There are also scattered internal word fragments and weak markers; some passages do not fit a stable spelling pattern.

patterns.name: et/ett syllables in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Activation often falls on internal fragments of proper names; adjacent fragments may be distributed across different subwords of a name.
patterns.domain: Names, literary and historical entries, web headings, email, and other genres

patterns.name: et within Italian words
patterns.context: In Italian contexts, an internal letter fragment may activate without corresponding to an independent morpheme; the same passage also contains the name «Corb»«ett».
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary text, academic journal descriptions

patterns.name: Bassett in a name or place name
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across tokenized fragments of Bassett in a proper-name entry or place-name heading.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in common words or news text
patterns.context: The passage contains a news headline or body text; strong activation falls near a proper name or word ending. A few annotations show no clear relation to et/ett.
patterns.domain: News clippings, literary quotations, business email

patterns.name: Internal fragments in reports, organizations, and compound proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on tokenized fragments of proper names such as report titles and political figures; no unified spelling trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Italian academic bibliographies

8_948.concept: 专名中的 et/ett 字符片段
8_948.description: 多数强激活落在含 et/ett 的人名或专名内部，跨姓名、地名及多种文体；另有若干分散的词内片段和弱标记，部分段落无法用稳定拼写模式解释。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的 et/ett 音节
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名的词内片段；相邻片段可分散在名字的不同子词中。
patterns.domain: 姓名、文学与历史条目、网页标题、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾或词内 et
patterns.trigger: «et» 出现在 «Soci»«et»«à» 中；«Corb»«ett» 等则为人名
patterns.context: 意大利语语境中可命中词内字母片段，不一定对应独立词素；同段另有 «Corb»«ett» 人名。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本、学术刊物描述

patterns.name: 名字或地名中的 Bassett
patterns.context: 专名条目或地名标题中，激活分布在 Bassett 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 普通词或新闻文本中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 段落包含新闻标题或正文，强激活落在专名/词尾附近；少数标记未显出与 et/ett 的明确关系。
patterns.domain: 新闻剪报、文学引文、商务邮件

patterns.name: 报告、机构与复合专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在报告名称、政治人物姓名等专名的分词片段上，未见统一的拼写触发串。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、意大利学术书目

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on internal character fragments of proper names such as personal names, organizations, companies, and places, often across subword boundaries. Some examples occur in fixed formats such as legal decisions or addresses, but no single domain or syntactic condition explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Internal suffixes or fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside name spellings, which may be split into multiple subwords; sometimes the names belong to parties or judges in legal decisions, and sometimes they are blog authors, historical figures, or address contacts.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, forum posts, blogs, academic addresses, and other genres

patterns.name: Word-form fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on continuous character fragments inside proper names or organization names, often across subword boundaries; it is not limited to personal names.
patterns.domain: Company, product, or community names; place names and French organization names

patterns.name: Prominent compounds or proper-name phrases
patterns.context: When a long name consists of multiple words or morphemes, activation may fall on a particular component; this overlaps with internal fragments in names, but a shared semantic trigger cannot be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Event or organization names, company names, organization names

patterns.name: Byline or speaker markers after sentence or paragraph starts
patterns.context: A name appears after a colon or near the start of a paragraph as a speaker, person involved in a decision, or quotation byline; fragments inside the name also activate.
patterns.domain: Traffic discussions, legal decisions, Q&A text

patterns.name: Legal citations and decision formatting
patterns.context: Case citations, judicial titles, party names, and legal-document formatting occur together; current evidence cannot determine whether the activation is caused by the citation format itself.

patterns.name: French place and organization names in addresses
patterns.context: Addresses or institutional contact information contain French personal names, observatory names, city names, and postal codes; activation falls on character fragments in the names.

8_948.description: 激活最稳定地落在姓名、机构、公司、地名等专名的词内字符片段上，常跨子词边界；部分例子处于法律判决或地址等固定格式中，但未见单一领域或句法条件能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 人名的词内后缀或片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名拼写内部，姓名可能被拆成多个子词；有时出现在法律判决中的当事人或法官姓名，有时是博客作者姓名、历史人物或地址联系人。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛帖子、博客、学术地址等多种文体

patterns.name: 专名内部的词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或机构名内部的连续字符片段，常见于跨子词边界的拼写；不限于人名。
patterns.domain: 公司、产品或社区名称，地名及法语机构名称

patterns.name: 名称中的显著复合或专名短语
patterns.context: 长名称由多个词或词素组成时，激活可能落在名称中的特定组成部分；本模式与名称内部片段重叠，但无法确认共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 活动或组织名称、企业名称、机构名称

patterns.name: 句首或段落边界后的署名/发言人标记
patterns.context: 姓名出现在冒号后或段落起始附近，作为发言人、判决相关人物或引文署名；姓名内部片段也有激活。
patterns.domain: 交通讨论、法律判决、问答文本

patterns.name: 法律引证与判决版式
patterns.context: 判例引证、法官称谓、当事人姓名以及法律文书排版共同出现；当前证据不能确定激活是否由引证格式本身引起。

patterns.name: 地址中的法语地名与机构名称
patterns.context: 地址或单位通讯信息中出现法语人名、天文台名称、城市名及邮编；激活落在名称字符片段上。

en.concept: proper names and internal subword fragments
en.description: Activation primarily occurs inside tokenized proper names or foreign-language words, especially strings containing rot/rotter. There are also various place-name, personal-name, and common-word fragments, with no unified semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: rot/rotter strings
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, or name fragments contain the continuous letters rot; activation often falls on rot after tokenization, with varying neighboring fragments

patterns.name: French/Italian place-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in French or Italian place names and personal names, especially spellings containing d'Italia or -ot

patterns.name: Italian event name
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the It string within the name Giro d'Italia

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Polish words
patterns.context: When a continuous Polish word is split into subwords, strong activation falls on an internal fragment of Tra kt atem; there is no apparent shared trigger with neighboring word forms

patterns.name: Internal fragments in personal or place names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subwords, with activation distributed across different internal positions; no stable shared letter sequence is apparent

patterns.name: English common-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of common words or personal names; local meanings and word forms vary

8_948.description: 激活主要出现在被子词切分的专名或外语词内部，尤以 rot/rotter 字符串突出；另有多种地名、人名及普通词片段，未显示统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: rot/rotter 字符串
patterns.context: 含有连续字母 rot 的人名、地名或名称片段；激活常落在分词后的 rot 上，左右片段各异

patterns.name: 法语/意大利语地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语或意大利语地名、人名中，尤其含 d'Italia、-ot 等拼写片段

patterns.name: 意大利赛事名称
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Giro d'Italia 名称内部的 It 字符串

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语连续词被切分为子词时，强激活落在 Tra kt atem 的词内片段；与邻近词形无明显共同触发条件

patterns.name: 人名或地名内部片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆分成多个子词，激活分布在名称内部不同位置，未见稳定共享的具体字母片段

patterns.name: 英语普通词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词或人名的子词片段中，局部句义和词形彼此不同

en.description: Activations primarily fall on within-word fragments of proper names, personal names, place names, brands, and technical identifiers, especially in legal citations. They also occur in uppercase book credits and directories, uppercase company abbreviations, and a few common words and paragraph numbers; no single semantic condition explains them.

patterns.name: Local subwords in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of proper nouns or compound words, often surnames, place names, institution names, or brand names. Fragment positions vary and cannot be reduced to a single root.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, emails, biographies, news, forum discussions

patterns.name: Legal citations and decision formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in decision text, case citations, or legal proper nouns; numbers also activate, in addition to name fragments.

patterns.name: Book directories and typographic credits
patterns.context: In all-caps typographic text such as credits and directories at the beginning or end of books, activations are distributed across fragments of uppercase words.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and product names
patterns.context: Programming type names or technical product names in forum text; activations cover multiple fragments within identifiers.

patterns.name: Uppercase abbreviation fragments in institution names
patterns.context: Multiple within-word fragments are marked when company names are set in uppercase or abbreviation-style typography.

patterns.name: Common words in fixed expressions
patterns.context: Besides proper nouns, a few common words activate in sentences. Their contexts are a book-review-style assertion and a forum comment, with no shared semantic condition.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在专名、姓名、地名、品牌及技术标识符的词内片段，尤见于法律引证；另有书籍大写署名与目录、公司大写缩写，以及少数普通词和段落编号，无法由单一语义条件解释。

patterns.name: 姓名、专名中的局部子词
patterns.trigger: 分段标记的词内片段，如 «G»«urt»«man»、«Rot»«to»、«Cab»«ot»、«Funt»、«Kob»«es»、«Pin»«ot»、«Tatar»«stan»、«Nicar»«agua»、«K»«not»«t»
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合词的一部分，常为姓氏、地名、机构名或品牌名；片段位置不固定，不能归结为单一词根。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、邮件、人物传记、新闻、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 法律引证与判决格式
patterns.trigger: «United» States v. F«unt»、v. «G»«urt»«man»、v. «Cab»«ot»，以及段落编号 «3»
patterns.context: 出现在判决正文、案件引证或法律专名中；除专名片段外，编号也有激活。

patterns.name: 书籍目录与排印式署名
patterns.context: 书末或书前的署名、目录等全大写排印文本中，激活分布在大写词的片段。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与产品名
patterns.context: 论坛文本中的编程类型名或技术产品名称；激活覆盖标识符内部多个片段。

patterns.name: 机构名中的大写缩写片段
patterns.context: 公司名称以大写或缩写式排印时，多个词内片段被标记。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的普通词
patterns.trigger: « can» be no question that «it»；«this» to encourage
patterns.context: 除专名外，少数常用词在句中被激活；上下文分别是书评式断言和论坛评论，缺乏共同语义条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of multiword proper names split into subwords, including personal names, companies and institutions, shipping brands, products, and place names. Common in legal texts, but also found in encyclopedias, emails, and code. There is also a weak response to legal heading formats and a few common-word fragments.

patterns.name: Segmented spellings within words in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper nouns or brand names split into multiple subword fragments. These are often English personal names, companies, products, places, or institutions; fragments may be adjacent to punctuation.
patterns.domain: Proper names across various genres, including legal documents, encyclopedias, and emails

patterns.name: Names of parties in legal cases
patterns.context: Personal names and litigation roles appear in legal case captions, decision citations, or complaint narratives; in segment 4, line breaks and case-caption formatting also occur before and after the name.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, court records, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Personal names and list entries
patterns.context: Personal names appear as names, or forms of address and date words in emails are marked as segmented; not all such activations occur in legal contexts.

patterns.name: Institution names and Line, Transit, Construction, etc. in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names consist of multiple words and often refer to companies, shipping companies, or public transit agencies. Component words sometimes activate individually and sometimes only partially.

patterns.name: Code filenames and copyright author names
patterns.context: In code comments, filenames, implementation notes, and copyright lines, activations concentrate on filename fragments and author-name fragments.

patterns.name: Typographic and structural markers
patterns.context: Line breaks in legal case-caption areas, calendar-column headings, or connectors between opposing parties; these activations are weak and may be related to nearby case names and document formatting.

8_948.description: 主要响应被拆分的多词专名片段，涵盖人名、公司与机构、船运品牌、产品及地名；常见于法律文本，也见百科、邮件和代码。另对法律标题格式、少量普通词片段有弱响应。

patterns.name: 词内分段的专名拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个子词片段的专名或品牌名中；常是英文姓名、公司、产品、地点或机构名，且这些片段可能紧邻标点。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科、邮件等多种文体中的专名

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人姓名
patterns.context: 法律案件标题、判决引述或诉状事实叙述中，出现当事人姓名及诉讼角色；第4段还在姓名前后有换行和案件标题格式。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、法院案卷与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 人名与名单条目
patterns.context: 人名以姓名形式出现，或邮件中的称谓、日期词被分段标记；并非所有此类激活都处于法律语境。
patterns.domain: 百科人物名单与商务邮件

patterns.name: 机构名及专名中的 Line、Transit、Construction 等
patterns.context: 专名由多个词构成，常指公司、航运公司或公共交通机构；成分词有时单独激活，有时只部分激活。

patterns.name: 代码文件名与版权作者名
patterns.context: 代码注释中的文件名、实现说明及版权行，激活集中在文件名片段和作者姓名片段。

patterns.name: 排版与结构标记
patterns.context: 法律案件标题区域的换行、日历栏标题或对阵/诉讼双方连接词；这些激活较弱，可能与邻近案件名及文书格式相关。

en.concept: Legal proper names and case-name fragments
en.description: Activations primarily occur in case names, party identities, and company names in U.S. legal documents, often on subword fragments of proper names or company suffixes. A few non-legal texts also activate on proper names and compound-word fragments. Some legal terms and case names in legal text also trigger activations.

patterns.name: Names and corporate entity markers in U.S. court case captions
patterns.context: Near case names, parties, appellate status, or case citations in legal documents; activations sometimes fall on proper-name fragments in case names.

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations cover segmented fragments of names or words, possibly associated with companies, place names, surnames, or common compounds; some occur in non-legal narratives.
patterns.domain: News/narratives, biographies, emails, and other texts

patterns.name: Terms or case names in legal discussion
patterns.context: Occurs in legal discussion or case citations, not necessarily in case-caption format.

8_948.description: 主要激活于美国法律文书的案名、当事人身份和公司名称，且常落在专名或公司后缀的子词片段；少数非法律文本也激活于专名、复合词片段。部分法律正文中的术语和判例名亦触发。

patterns.name: 美国法院案名中的名称及公司实体标记
patterns.trigger: «Plaintiff»、«Appellant»、«v»、公司/机构名称及后缀，如« INC.», « CO.», « LLC», « L.C.»；名称内部的字母或词片段也常被标记
patterns.context: 法律文书中案名、当事方、上诉身份或判例引文附近；激活有时落在案名中的专名片段

patterns.name: 专名中的词片段
patterns.trigger: «bulld»«oz»«er»、«McC»«r»«ory»、«G»«rot»«to»等专名或复合词的内部片段；另有«Brown»«stone»、«Pow»«der»等
patterns.context: 激活覆盖被拆分的名称或词语片段，可能与公司、地名、姓氏或普通复合词有关；部分出现在非法律叙述中
patterns.domain: 新闻/叙述、人物传记、邮件及其他文本

patterns.name: 法律论述中的术语或判例名称
patterns.context: 法律论述或引述判例时出现，未必处于案名标题格式

en.concept: Name fragments in proper nouns and legal texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on proper-name fragments split across tokens, including personal names, institutions, place names, products, and parties to cases. Also found in legal citations, litigation labels, statutory terminology, place names in local history, and sporadic function words.

patterns.name: Internal fragments and spelling boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on personal names, company names, place names, institution names, product names, or components of proper names split across tokens. Many examples involve repeated names or rare spellings.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia biographies, and place-name entries

patterns.name: Case names in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case citations or legal argument, especially party names before and after “v.”, insurance companies, and corporate litigants.

patterns.name: Case and court-jurisdiction labels
patterns.context: Occurs in decision headers, litigation captions, or statements of court origin; activations involve both litigation roles and court or school-district names.

patterns.name: Statutory terms and names of legal materials
patterns.context: The former occurs when sentencing guidelines specify drug categories; the latter appears in decisions as case names or cited legal materials.
patterns.domain: Criminal sentencing and California legal decisions

patterns.name: Institutional and geographic proper names in ordinary narratives
patterns.context: In narratives about local history or community origins, especially those involving immigration, canals, county names, roads, and intersections.

patterns.name: Common function words and syntactic connectors
patterns.context: Scattered across ordinary syntactic contexts in legal discussion, case summaries, and encyclopedia narratives; these words do not form a stable, unified semantic field.

8_948.concept: 专名及法律文本中的名称片段
8_948.description: 激活主要集中在跨 token 切分的专名片段，涵盖人名、机构、地名、产品及案件当事方；另见法律引证、诉讼标签、法规术语、地方史地名，以及零散虚词。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段与拼写边界
patterns.trigger: 专名中的子词、字母组合或词缀，如 «R» «.» «K» «.» « Low» «ry»、«F» «-» «F» «alling» « Creek»、«C» «ab» «ot»、«Fran» « C» «ib» «or» «owski»、«Con» «du» «it» «Road»、«Pe» «re» «gr» «ine»、«B» «ede»
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的人名、公司名、地名、机构名、产品名或专名组成部分；不少例子是名称重复出现或含罕见拼写。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与百科传记、地名条目

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名称
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证或法律论证中，尤其是“v.”前后的当事方名称、保险公司及企业诉讼方名称。

patterns.name: 法律案件及法院辖区标签
patterns.context: 出现在判决页眉或诉讼标题、法院来源说明中；激活既涉及诉讼角色，也涉及法院或学区名称。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决版式

patterns.name: 法规术语与法律材料名称
patterns.context: 前者在量刑指南对毒品类别作限定，后者在判决中作为判例名称或法律材料引用。
patterns.domain: 刑事量刑与加州法律判决

patterns.name: 普通叙述中的建制与地理专名
patterns.context: 地名历史或社区起源叙述中，尤其涉及移民、运河、县名、道路及十字路口。

patterns.name: 常见虚词与句法连接词
patterns.context: 散见于法律论述、判例摘要和百科叙述的普通句法环境；这些词自身并未形成稳定的单一语义场。

en.description: Primarily responds to subword fragments of English proper names, including personal names, place names, street addresses, company and institution names, and legal citations; repeated names also activate. A few common words and line-break markers activate weakly, with an unstable pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenization in English proper names
