patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords or consecutive subwords of proper names, commonly personal names, place names, institution names, and company names; the name need not occur in any particular sentence position.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies and place entries, legal decisions, academic paper bylines

patterns.name: Common surnames and name fragments
patterns.context: When names are split into multiple subwords, some consecutive subwords activate; repeated occurrences of the same name also activate.

patterns.name: Proper names in place names and addresses
patterns.context: Place, street, or address names occur as proper nouns in a narrative; sometimes only part of the name activates.
patterns.domain: Biographies, real-estate listings, legal factual background, plot summaries

patterns.name: Institution, company, and organization names
patterns.context: Multiple words or within-word subwords in entity names are marked, especially organization-type terms (e.g., School District, Products, Co-Packing).

patterns.name: Proper names in legal citations
patterns.context: Case names or insurance organizations occur in legal argument citation formats; name fragments and abbreviations in citations activate.

patterns.name: Repeated names or place names
patterns.context: The same proper name occurs repeatedly within a short window, and internal fragments of each repetition activate; Konopka also repeats in segment 4.
patterns.domain: Real-estate descriptions in encyclopedia entries, biographical entries

patterns.name: Common words and formatting markers near proper names
patterns.context: A few common words or line-break markers are also marked, but usually weakly and adjacent to legal boilerplate, proper names, or document structure; it is unclear whether they have a distinct, stable trigger condition.

8_948.description: 主要响应英文专名的子词片段，涵盖人名、地名、街道地址、公司与机构名及法律引证；重复名称也会激活。少量普通词和换行标记弱激活，模式不稳定。

patterns.name: 英文专名中的分词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的内部子词或连续子词上，常见于人名、地名、机构名、公司名；并不要求专名出现在句中特定位置。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物与地点条目、法律判决、学术论文署名

patterns.name: 高频姓氏与姓名片段
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词时，部分连续子词获得激活；同一姓名重复出现时也有激活。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、法律材料、剧情简介

patterns.name: 地名及地址中的专名
patterns.context: 地点、街道或地址名称作为叙述中的专名出现；有时只激活名称内部的一部分。
patterns.domain: 传记、房产条目、法律事实背景、剧情简介

patterns.name: 机构、公司及组织名称
patterns.trigger: «Cam»6«as»9« School»3« District»1、«Prime»3« Wine»3« Products»4、«Kon»4«op»5«ka»9« Co»4«-»3«P»4«acking»6、«Cab»7«ot»9« School»3« District»1
patterns.context: 实体名称中多个词或词内子词被标记，尤其包括组织类型词（如 School District、Products、Co-Packing）。
patterns.domain: 破产或诉讼判决、人物传记

patterns.name: 法律引证中的专名
patterns.trigger: « Quad»4«rant»9 Corp«.»1 v.« Am»4«.»1« States»3 Ins
patterns.context: 判例或保险机构名称出现在法律论证的引证格式中；引证里的名称片段和缩写获得激活。

patterns.name: 反复出现的名称或地名
patterns.context: 同一专名在短窗口内重复出现，重复项的内部片段均有激活；此外第4段的 Konopka 也重复出现。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的房产描述、人物条目

patterns.name: 专名附近的普通词及格式性标记
patterns.trigger: « we»1、« Debtors»1、« by»1、« and»1、« to»1、« house»1、« they»3、«↵»2
patterns.context: 少量普通词或换行标记也被标记，但通常强度较弱，且紧邻法律套语、专名或文档结构；无法确定是否有独立稳定触发条件。

en.concept: Proper-name entities, especially in legal citations
en.description: Primarily activates on segmented fragments of case names, personal names, and company proper names in U.S. legal citation texts. Also found on brands, place names, and personal names in non-legal contexts, and on lawyers' and law firms' names in emails.

patterns.name: Names and citations in U.S. case law
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or litigation texts, especially “X v. Y” case citations, citation lists, or company/party names; activations often fall on segmented fragments of personal names, proper names, and company names.

patterns.name: Commercial proper names and brand entities
patterns.context: In biographies or everyday narratives, proper names appear as names of people, places, or shops; there is no legal citation framework here.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, personal life, and food blogs

patterns.name: Litigation lawyers and law-firm names
patterns.context: When emails discuss litigation representation or legal business, lawyer and law-firm names activate; contexts include “litigation lawyer” and “representing.”

8_948.concept: 专名实体，尤以法律引注为主
8_948.description: 主要对美国法律文本中判例引注的案件、人名及公司专名分词片段激活；也见于非法律语境中的品牌、地名和人物专名，以及邮件中的律师与律所名称。

patterns.name: 美国判例引用中的姓名与引注
patterns.trigger: 判例引注中的人名、机构名或案件名片段，如« Quad»«rant»« Corp»、« Hahn»、« P»« &»« T»、« Tor»«r»、« P»«ry»«or»、« Auto»« Drive»«away»；常伴随“v.”、“Inc.”、“LLC”及卷页信息
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或诉讼文本中，尤其是“X v. Y”案件引用、引注列表或公司/当事人名称处；激活常落在人名、专名和公司名称的分词片段上

patterns.name: 商业专名与品牌实体
patterns.context: 人物传记或生活叙述中，专名处于人物、地点或商店名称位置；此处没有法律引注框架
patterns.domain: 百科传记、个人生活与食品博客

patterns.name: 诉讼律师与律师事务所名称
patterns.context: 邮件讨论诉讼代理或法律业务时，激活律师姓名和事务所名称；语境中出现“litigation lawyer”“representing”等

en.description: Primarily responds to segmented fragments in proper names, covering personal names, place names, institutions, companies, and case names. Legal texts predominate, but activations also appear in encyclopedia entries and energy news. Activations usually fall within names rather than ordinary narrative words.

patterns.name: Consecutive subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate within proper names, especially surnames, place names, or institution names split by tokenization; fragments are often the final or middle part of a name.
patterns.domain: Legal cases and personal/institutional names, Wikipedia place names and radio station names

patterns.name: Legal citations and case names
patterns.context: Occurs in case citations, court opinions, or discussions of cases; activations fall on proper names such as company and party names in citations.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Company names and legal-entity suffixes
patterns.context: Activations occur in formal names of companies, law firms, or other legal entities; they may also be adjacent to abbreviations or suffixes in entity names.
patterns.domain: Parties, law firms, and company names in legal documents

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in institution names
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of school or school-district names; the context is debtor employment information.
patterns.domain: Employment and institutional information in bankruptcy decisions

patterns.name: Energy companies and oil-and-gas project names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on company names, oil and gas field names, or project names rather than the surrounding ordinary energy-industry narrative.

8_948.description: 主要响应专名中的分词片段，覆盖人名、地名、机构、公司和案件名称；法律文本占多数，也出现在百科条目及能源新闻中。激活通常落在名称内部，而非普通叙述词。

patterns.name: 专名中的连续子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名内部，尤其是被分词切开的姓氏、地名或机构名；片段本身常是名称的末尾或中间部分。
patterns.domain: 法律案件与人物/机构名、维基百科地名和广播站名

patterns.name: 法律引证与案件名称
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、法院意见或案件讨论中，激活落在引证中的公司名、当事人名等专名上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 公司名及法律实体后缀
patterns.context: 激活出现在公司、律所或其他法律实体的正式名称中；也可能与实体名称中的缩写或后缀相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的当事方、律师事务所及公司名称

patterns.name: 机构名称中的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在学校或学区名称的一部分；上下文是债务人就业信息。
patterns.domain: 破产判决中的就业及机构信息

patterns.name: 能源公司与油气项目名称
patterns.context: 激活集中在公司名、油气田名或项目名，而非周围的普通能源行业叙述。

en.concept: Proper names and their segmented fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on proper names and their segmented fragments, especially personal and institution names and formatting in legal case citations; also found on aircraft, racehorses, and place names in encyclopedias, and on proper names and word fragments in recipes. Some legal procedural words are also marked, so the pattern cannot be reduced to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Continuation of segmented proper names or words
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within proper names, often company, personal, place, institution, or product names; multiple adjacent fragments may form a name, but activations do not always cover the whole name.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, encyclopedia entries, and general narratives

patterns.name: Case names and citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs near case citations, court names, or corporate litigant names; some activations fall on abbreviations, punctuation, or cited personal names.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in place or institution names
patterns.context: In narratives about a person's background, employment, or institutional context, as part of a place name, club, or government agency name.

patterns.name: Horse pedigrees and racehorse proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous narratives about racehorse owners, horse pedigrees, sires, and race names.

patterns.name: Ingredient and flavor fragments in recipes
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of making cookies, sugar, mint julep flavor, and alternative flavors; activations fall on within-word fragments of common words and on product names.

patterns.name: Aircraft manufacturers and model names
patterns.context: In descriptions of aircraft engine configurations, activations fall on proper-name fragments of engine manufacturers and models.

patterns.name: Community, school, and debtor-related institution names
patterns.context: In statements about bankruptcy debts and employment information, institution names are marked in segments.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal terminology appears in discussions of ambiguity in insurance provisions or appellate procedure; however, only individual words in phrases are marked, with no consistent morphological pattern.

8_948.description: 激活多落在专名及其分词片段，尤其是法律案件引证中的人名、机构名和格式；也见于百科中的飞机、赛马、地名，以及食谱专名和词片段。部分法律程序词也被标记，无法归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名或词语的分词续接
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的子词片段上，常是公司、人名、地名、机构或产品名；多个相邻片段可共同构成名称，但激活并不总覆盖整个名称。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、百科条目及一般叙述

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、«.»、«Cir»、«Inc»，以及被拆分标记的引证姓名，如 «Quad»«rant»、«Ele»«azer»、«D»«enny»
patterns.context: 处于判例引证、法院名称或公司诉讼方名称附近；部分激活落在缩写、标点或引证姓名上。

patterns.name: 地名或机构名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 位于人物经历、任职或机构背景的叙述中，作为地名、俱乐部或政府机构名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 马匹血统与赛马专名
patterns.context: 出现在赛马所有者、马匹血统、种马及赛事名称的连续叙述中。

patterns.name: 食谱中的食材与风味词片段
patterns.context: 出现在饼干制作、糖、薄荷 julep 风味及可替代口味的说明中；激活落在普通词内部片段和产品名上。

patterns.name: 飞机制造商与型号名称
patterns.context: 飞机动力配置的说明中，激活落在发动机制造商和型号的专名片段上。

patterns.name: 社群、学校及债务人相关机构名
patterns.context: 破产债务与雇佣信息陈述中，机构名称被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序性术语
patterns.context: 在保险条款歧义或上诉审理程序的论述中，出现法律术语；但标记只覆盖短语中的个别词，缺少统一的词形模式。

en.concept: Subword fragments in proper names and identifiers
en.description: Activations often occur on segmented proper names, especially party names and “v.” citation formats in legal cases; also found on aircraft engine models, model numbers or identifiers in forums, and names of people in news. The common trigger feature is uncertain.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names, often personal or organization names split into multiple tokens; names vary widely, so it is unclear which name or morphological feature is responsible.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, legal cases, news reports

patterns.name: Case names and citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case names or legal citations, commonly in the format party name + v. + opposing party name, alongside court, volume, and page information; activations do not occur only on v. or punctuation.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Specific morphological fragments in case names
patterns.context: Found only in some legal litigants' names or case names; the fragments have no obvious shared meaning and may reflect subword segmentation within names.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric model numbers or identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur in a computer model number and on a standalone line containing a possible username, code, or identifier; the contexts differ, so a shared trigger condition is uncertain.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric strings in aircraft engine models
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative about an aircraft powered by two engines, adjacent to the manufacturer's name; may respond to the model string or an aviation proper name.

patterns.name: Surname and first-name initial combinations
patterns.context: Occurs in a news report, followed by a real-estate agency role; it is a segmented personal name that includes a middle initial.

8_948.concept: 专名与编号中的子词片段
8_948.description: 激活多见于被切分的专有名称，尤其是法律判例中的当事人名及“v.”引证格式；另见航空发动机型号、论坛中的型号或编号，以及新闻人物姓名。共同触发特征不确定。

patterns.name: 专名内部的切分片段
patterns.trigger: 人名、公司名、地名或机构名中被标记的子串，如 «Fox»«borough»、«Am»«ade»«us»、«F»«ossier»、«Marian»«na»、«Debie»«c»、«W»«af»«ra»
patterns.context: 激活落在专有名称内部，常是被拆分成多个 token 的姓名或组织名；各名称差异很大，不能确定是哪一种名称或词形特征在起作用。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律判例、新闻报道

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: «v»、«.»以及案件当事人名称片段，如 «Is»«er»« Electric»« Co»«.» «v»«.» «F»«ossier»；另见 «First»« Bank»…«v»«.» «Pin»… 和 «Thomas»…«v»«.»
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称或法律引证中，常见格式为当事人名 + v. + 对方名称，并伴随法院、卷册和页码信息；但激活并非只落在 v. 或标点上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见及判例引证

patterns.name: 判例名称中的特定词形片段
patterns.context: 仅见于若干法律案例当事人姓名或案件名称；这些片段彼此并无明显共同词义，可能反映名称内部的子词切分。

patterns.name: 数字与字母混合的型号或编号
patterns.context: 激活出现在电脑型号和单独一行的疑似用户名、代号或编号中；两处语境不同，不能确定是否有共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、用户生成内容

patterns.name: 航空器发动机型号中的字母数字串
patterns.context: 出现在飞机由两台发动机提供动力的叙述中，紧邻制造商名称；可能响应型号串或航空专名。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、航空事故叙述

patterns.name: 姓氏与名字首字母的组合
patterns.context: 出现在新闻报道中，后接房地产机构职务；表现为被切分的人名，形式上包含中间名首字母。

en.description: Primarily activates on segmented spellings of proper-name entities, especially names in U.S. case citations and company, institution, and case-party names; contexts are mostly legal documents, but also include encyclopedias and reviews. Proper names such as Amadeus in the aviation accident narrative in segment 3 are not fully explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: Ending or internal fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activates on fragments in personal names, company names, or place names; highlights often fall on segmented surname portions or within names. No stable meaning or fixed fragment is apparent in isolation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and company profiles, court case citations, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or decisions, especially citation strings composed of party names, v., court reporter volume and page, or docket number; activations do not uniformly cover the entire format and often concentrate on proper names.

patterns.name: Companies, institutions, and brands in entity names
patterns.context: Triggers are internal fragments of proper entity names, involving companies, brands, schools, and institutions; some names are split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia profiles, aviation accident narratives, bankruptcy legal documents, socioeconomic commentary

patterns.name: Party designations and case captions in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in bankruptcy narratives or party/respondent captions on decision title pages; activations concentrate on role designations and caption entities composed of company and place names.
patterns.domain: U.S. court documents, bankruptcy records, and civil litigation case files

patterns.name: Repeated or segmented spellings in proper names
patterns.context: Names or caption entities in documents may span tokens, vary in capitalization, or be connected to adjacent characters; there are only a few examples, so no stable spelling rule can be inferred.
patterns.domain: Civil-rights litigation narratives and court case captions

8_948.description: 主要对专名实体的分段拼写激活，尤其是美国判例引注中的姓名，以及公司、机构和案卷当事人名称；上下文多为法律文书，但也见百科与评论。第3段航空事故叙述中的 Amadeus 等专名无法完全解释其模式。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾或内部片段
patterns.context: 对姓名、公司名或地名中的片段激活；高亮常落在拆分后的姓氏部分或名称内部。单独看不出稳定的词义或固定片段。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与公司简介、法院判例引注及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 判例引注格式
patterns.trigger: «v»1«.»4、«Matter»1« of»2、« WL»1、«AD3d»以及引注中的逗号、数字和法院名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或判决中，尤其是由当事人姓名、v.、法院报告卷页或案号构成的引用串；激活并非均匀覆盖整段格式，而常集中在专名。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、判例引注

patterns.name: 实体名称中的公司、机构与品牌
patterns.context: 触发点是专有实体名称的内部片段，涉及公司、品牌、学校机构等；部分名称被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 百科简介、航空事故叙述、破产法律文书、经济社会评论

patterns.name: 法律文书中的当事人称谓与案卷标题
patterns.context: 出现在破产案叙述或判决首页的当事人/答辩人标题；激活集中于身份称谓及公司、地名构成的标题实体。
patterns.domain: 美国法院文件、破产记录和民事诉讼案卷

patterns.name: 专名中的重复或分段拼写
patterns.context: 文书中的姓名或标题实体可能跨 token、大小写不一或与邻接字符相连；仅有少量例子，无法归纳为稳定拼写规则。
patterns.domain: 民权诉讼叙述与法院案卷标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across various subword fragments, proper nouns, mathematical options, line breaks, and numeric units; clearer local triggers include combustion, Vein Thrombosis, Attached, laboratory, Bond strength, and QCompleter, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: combustion engine phrase
patterns.context: “Internal combustion” immediately precedes and modifies engines; in the third paragraph it is followed by the abbreviation “(ICE)”.

patterns.name: split medical term
patterns.context: Subword fragments form “Vein Thrombosis” within a disease name.

patterns.name: Attached split within a word
patterns.context: An email body says an attachment is included with the email; the word is split into consecutive fragments.

patterns.name: mathematical option label
patterns.context: Parenthesized letter options in a question or expression; activation for a is clearly stronger than for b.

patterns.name: laboratory spelling fragment
patterns.context: Appears in abstracts describing sources of HBV research data and electronic laboratory data; other research terms in the same paragraph, such as serological and distribution, are not marked.

patterns.name: Bond strength phrase
patterns.context: “Bond strength” is a material property in research related to fiber posts; only the ending fragment of Bond is marked.

patterns.name: line-initial newline
patterns.context: Context begins with a newline, followed by a StackExchange technical answer.

patterns.name: decimal and inch unit
patterns.context: Decimal dimensions in chart or layout data, with unit in, accompanied by a newline.

patterns.name: initial fragment of a proper noun
patterns.context: A sentence-initial proper noun is followed by “uses an amazing array of enzymes”; a single instance, with no clear shared context.

patterns.name: QCompleter fragment within a word
patterns.context: In a Qt technical answer, QCompleter is split into QComple and ter; the same paragraph also contains related words such as editable and completion, but they are not marked.

8_962.description: 激活分散在多种词片段、专名、数学选项、换行和数字单位上；较明显的局部触发包括 combustion、Vein Thrombosis、Attached、laboratory、Bond strength 与 QCompleter，尚无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: combustion 引擎短语
patterns.context: “Internal combustion”紧邻并修饰 engines；在第 3 段后接缩写 “(ICE)”。

patterns.name: 拆分的医学术语
patterns.context: 词片段拼成 “Vein Thrombosis”，出现在疾病名称中。

patterns.name: 词内 Attached 拆分
patterns.context: 邮件正文中称附件随邮件附上，词语被拆成连续片段。

patterns.name: 数学选项标签
patterns.context: 问题或表达式中的括号字母选项，a 的激活明显强于 b。

patterns.name: laboratory 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述 HBV 研究数据来源和电子实验室数据的摘要中；同段还有 serological、distribution 等研究用语，但未标记。

patterns.name: Bond strength 词组
patterns.context: “Bond strength”作为纤维桩相关研究中的材料性质；Bond 仅标出词尾片段。

patterns.name: 行首换行
patterns.context: 上下文以换行符开始，后接 StackExchange 技术回答。

patterns.name: 小数及英寸单位
patterns.context: 图表或版面数据中的小数尺寸，单位为 in，伴随换行。

patterns.name: 专名词首片段
patterns.context: 句首专名，后接 “uses an amazing array of enzymes”；单例，未见明确共同语境。

patterns.name: QCompleter 词内片段
patterns.context: Qt 技术回答中，QCompleter 被拆分为 QComple、ter；同段还出现 editable、completion 等相关词，但未标记。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical/biological proper nouns and terms, “combustion engines” in patents, the heading abbreviation “MA,” and ordinary words in emails. Aside from the internal-combustion-engine phrase, there is no unified lexical or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: capitalized proper nouns/terms in split fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on initial or internal fragments of proper nouns or medical and biological terms, often with subsequent subword completion; not all neighboring words activate.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, encyclopedia, and web text

patterns.name: internal-combustion-engine terminology
patterns.context: The phrase “Internal combustion engines” appears as a sentence subject, followed by a general explanation; the wording differs across two passages, but the term is shared.

patterns.name: sentence-initial Nature
patterns.context: The proper noun Nature begins a sentence followed by uses, describing the use of enzymes to make small molecules; the trigger may also relate to the proper noun or sentence-initial position.
patterns.domain: Biochemical or natural-science phrasing in a biomedical abstract

patterns.name: heading-style abbreviation MA
patterns.context: The capitalized abbreviation appears at the beginning of a title or list-like text, followed by a number, date, or section content.
patterns.domain: Web headings, question banks, or archival text

patterns.name: ordinary words and phrases
patterns.context: An email thanks the recipient for forwarding a message and mentions being away last week; activations are scattered across ordinary narrative words, with no clear shared trigger with the other passages.

8_962.description: 激活分散于医学/生物专名与术语、专利中的“combustion engines”、题头缩写“MA”，以及邮件普通词；除内燃机短语外，尚无统一的词义或文体规律。

patterns.name: 分词片段中的大写专名/术语
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或医学、生物术语的词首、词内片段，常伴随后续子词补全；并非所有相邻词都激活
patterns.domain: 医学、生物、百科及网页文本

patterns.name: 内燃机术语
patterns.context: 短语“Internal combustion engines”作为句子主语出现，后接一般性说明；两段措辞不同但共享该术语

patterns.name: 句首 Nature
patterns.context: 句首专名Nature后接uses，谈及利用酶制造小分子；触发也可能与专名或句首位置有关

patterns.name: 题头式缩写 MA
patterns.context: 大写缩写位于题目或条目式文本开头，后接编号、日期或栏目内容
patterns.domain: 网页题头、题库或档案文本

patterns.name: 普通词及短语
patterns.context: 邮件感谢转发邮件并提到上周不在；激活分散在普通叙述词上，缺少与其他段落明确相同的触发条件

en.description: Except for paragraph 6, activations center on “determining” and its research-objective context; its objects range across oxygen content, mechanisms, cell sources, redox properties, prediction, spectra, and efficacy, so the domains are not uniform. Paragraph 6 instead activates on “Nature uses”.

patterns.name: determining followed by a research object or property
patterns.context: Often appears in descriptions of research goals, methods, or proposed work; the word itself is the main trigger, while what follows spans measurement, mechanisms, cell sources, performance, spectra, and efficacy.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH research plans; also linguistic research abstracts

patterns.name: Nature uses
patterns.context: The opening of a sentence with Nature as subject, describing its use of enzymes to make small molecules; no clear determining pattern.
patterns.domain: Biochemical or natural-science phrasing in an NIH research-plan excerpt

8_962.description: 除第6段外，激活集中在“determining”及其研究目标语境；宾语跨越氧含量、机制、细胞来源、氧化还原性质、预测、光谱和疗效，领域并不单一。第6段则激活于“Nature uses”。

patterns.name: determining 后接研究对象或性质
patterns.trigger: “determining”及其后紧接的宾语或补语，如 “determining the oxygen content”“determining in greater mechanistic detail”“determining the efficacy”
patterns.context: 常出现在研究目标、方法或拟议工作描述中；该词本身是主要触发点，后续内容涵盖测量、机制、细胞来源、性能、光谱和疗效等
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及 NIH 研究计划；另见语言学研究摘要

patterns.name: Nature uses
patterns.context: 以 Nature 为主语、描述其使用酶制造小分子的句子开头；没有明显的 determining 模式
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划片段中的生物化学或自然科学表述

en.concept: English just and local word forms/collocations
en.description: Activations mostly center on English just (as emphasis, to limit frequency/time/location, or in comparisons), but also include web phrases, Portuguese enorme(s), and Spanish justificación word forms or local collocations, which cannot be captured by a single meaning.

patterns.name: just + evaluative or emphatic content
patterns.context: Functions as an emphatic or limiting adverb in a sentence, modifying a noun, verb, or following phrase; often followed by an explanation or a time, place, or frequency limit.
patterns.domain: News, popular science, academic writing, and web text

patterns.name: Portuguese enorm(es)
patterns.context: The stem and ending of the Portuguese adjective enorme/enormes are split and marked, modifying falta and desafios.

patterns.name: specific English phrase uses cookies
patterns.context: A website privacy notice states that the site uses cookies; activation centers on uses.

patterns.name: just over 18 in an adult website title
patterns.context: Adult promotional text describes young adults who have just turned 18; trigger word: just.

patterns.name: local just once in sports reporting
patterns.context: Describes a pitcher allowing an opponent to reach base only once; just limits the frequency.

patterns.name: just a matter in an academic paragraph
patterns.context: A philosophy abstract proposes that moral judgment is merely a matter of factors such as emotion.

patterns.name: just like in physics papers
patterns.context: In an explanation of supernova terminology, just modifies a point in time; another quantum passage compares a state to a catalyst, but activation is on just.

patterns.name: Spanish justificación
patterns.context: The internal substring just overlaps with the Spanish word justificación (justification); the context discusses arguments and reasons, and may not involve the English adverb.

patterns.name: just north in a location description
patterns.context: Limits a location in a hurricane-path account, meaning not far north of a place.

8_962.concept: 英文 just 及局部词形/搭配
8_962.description: 激活多集中于英文 just（强调、限制次数/时间/位置或作比较），但也有网页短语、葡语 enorme(s)及西语 justificación 等词形或局部搭配，无法用单一语义覆盖。

patterns.name: just + 评价或强调内容
patterns.context: 在句中作强调或限制副词，修饰名词、动词或后续短语；后面常跟解释、时间/地点或次数限制
patterns.domain: 新闻、科普、学术论述及网页文本

patterns.name: 葡语 enorm(es)
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中形容词 enorme/enormes 的词干与词尾被切分标注，修饰 falta、desafios

patterns.name: 特定英文词组 uses cookies
patterns.context: 网页隐私提示中说明网站使用 cookies；激活集中在 uses

patterns.name: 色情网页标题中的 just over 18
patterns.context: 色情宣传语中描述刚满18岁的年轻成人；触发词 just

patterns.name: 体育报道中的局部 just once
patterns.context: 叙述投手仅有一次让对手上垒，just 限定次数

patterns.name: 学术段落中的 just a matter
patterns.context: 哲学摘要中提出道德判断只是情感等因素的问题

patterns.name: 量子物理论文中的 just like
patterns.context: 超新星术语解释中 just 修饰时间点；另有量子段落将状态比作催化剂，但激活在 just
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文；量子物理论文

patterns.name: 西班牙语 justificación
patterns.context: 词内子串 just 与西语词 justificación（正当理由）重合；上下文谈论论证与理由，未必是英文副词

patterns.name: 地点描述中的 just north
patterns.context: 飓风路径叙述中限定登陆/经过位置，表示在某地点以北不远处
patterns.domain: 百科全书式气象历史条目

en.concept: Iberian-language word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations broadly cover Portuguese and Spanish internal word fragments, function words, and common word forms; academic citations, philosophical proper nouns, book discussions, payment cards, and parliamentary attribution/policy contexts also occur. Most patterns may reflect multilingual subword or word-form features; triggers from proper nouns and subject matter remain uncertain.

patterns.name: Portuguese morphological ending fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on syllable/subword fragments within Portuguese words and common function words, appearing in sentences, Q&A, and other positions; they are not limited to a particular meaning.
patterns.domain: Portuguese academic abstracts, StackExchange Q&A, and other text

patterns.name: Spanish function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Spanish syntactic and lexical fragments appear in discussion or speeches; high-frequency words such as 「que」 also appear in passages in other languages, so they cannot explain all activations on their own.
patterns.domain: Spanish philosophical writing, EU parliamentary text

patterns.name: numbers and punctuation in citations and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Years, identifiers, citation abbreviations, and punctuation appear in academic discussion or reference material; the shared pattern with other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: parliamentary speaker attribution format
patterns.context: A speech or statement is followed by an attribution format containing a name, title, or parliamentary designation.

patterns.name: philosophical proper nouns and historical commentary
patterns.context: Philosophers’ names and vocabulary related to commentary and intellectual history are embedded in Spanish discussion.

patterns.name: payment cards and Brazilian-context vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses payment cards or card networks available in Brazil; activations also cover many Portuguese words in the same passage, so it is unclear whether they are triggered by proper-noun semantics.

patterns.name: EU policy and international trade vocabulary
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches concern EU decisions, peace and security, or trade; the listed fragments span different topics, with no more specific shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Spanish discussion of books and titles
patterns.context: Continuous discussion introducing books, titles, and source materials.

8_962.concept: 伊比利亚语词形与子词片段
8_962.description: 激活广泛覆盖葡萄牙语与西班牙语的词内片段、功能词及常见词形；另见学术引文、哲学专名、书籍论述、支付卡和议会署名/政策语境。多数模式可能反映多语种子词或词形特征，专名与题材触发尚不确定。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语形态词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于葡萄牙语词内的音节/子词片段及常见功能词，出现在句子、问答等不同位置；并不局限于某个特定词义。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语学术摘要、StackExchange 问答及其他文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语功能词与词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句法和词汇片段在论述或发言中出现；「que」等高频词也在其他语言段落里出现，不能单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学论述、欧盟议会文本

patterns.name: 引文与书目信息中的数字标点
patterns.context: 年份、编号、引文缩写与标点出现在学术论述或参考性内容中；与其他段落的共同模式不明确。

patterns.name: 议会发言人署名格式
patterns.trigger: 「Silvia-Adriana Ţicău」「ponente. - (RO) Señora Presidenta」「Catherine Ashton」「Miembro de la Comisión. -」
patterns.context: 发言内容后接姓名、职务或议会称谓的署名/发言格式。

patterns.name: 哲学专名及历史评论语境
patterns.context: 哲学家姓名及评论、思想史相关词汇，嵌在西班牙语论述中。

patterns.name: 支付卡与巴西语境词汇
patterns.context: 讨论巴西可用的支付卡或卡组织；激活还覆盖同段大量葡萄牙语词，故无法确定是否由专名语义触发。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 欧盟政策与国际贸易词汇
patterns.context: 涉及欧盟决策、和平安全或贸易的议会发言；所列片段分属不同议题，未见更具体的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语书籍与标题论述
patterns.context: 介绍书籍、标题及材料来源的连续论述。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术或出版类文本

en.concept: English been and present-perfect passive constructions
en.description: All passages strongly activate been; many form has/have been + past participle present-perfect passive constructions, primarily reporting experiments, research, or observations in scientific abstracts, and also in species-range entries.

patterns.name: English present-perfect passive construction
patterns.context: The trigger is been; common forms are has/have been + past participle, or been followed by a description of a state or location.
patterns.domain: Primarily biomedical abstracts, also encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: research actions in scientific abstracts
patterns.context: Describes experimental, preparatory, observational, or reporting actions performed on research subjects; often uses the present-perfect passive.

patterns.name: reported locations of species or objects
patterns.context: In an encyclopedia species entry, been is followed by reported to describe where the species was found or reported; the same passage also contains was described from.
patterns.domain: Animal taxonomy and distribution encyclopedia entries

8_962.concept: 英文 been 与完成时被动结构
8_962.description: 所有片段均强烈激活 been；多处构成 has/have been + 过去分词的完成时被动结构，主要用于科研摘要报告实验、研究或观察，也见物种分布条目。

patterns.name: 英文完成时被动结构
patterns.context: 触发词是 been；常见句型为 has/have been + 过去分词，或 been 后接描述状态、地点的成分。
patterns.domain: 主要是生物医学摘要，也见百科条目

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的研究动作
patterns.context: 描述研究对象受到的实验、制备、观察或报告动作；常见被动完成时。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学研究摘要

patterns.name: 物种或对象的报告地点
patterns.trigger: «was»8« described»2« from»2 Japan«»5；«has»4« been»10« reported»2« from»2
patterns.context: 百科物种条目中，been 后接 reported，说明物种的发现或报告地点；同段也出现 was described from。
patterns.domain: 动物分类与分布类百科条目

en.description: Strong activations often occur near the predicate and its complements, after a clause introducer or subject, especially in relative clauses introduced by who/que; they also occur on predicates after pronominal subjects, the present-perfect form been, and clauses in technical explanations. Across languages and styles, local syntactic position is more consistent than topic.

patterns.name: who in relative clauses
patterns.context: A relative pronoun or Portuguese relative word links a person, thing, or group to a following predicate; the trigger is usually at the clause subject.
patterns.domain: Multilingual news, encyclopedias, forums, and general expository writing

patterns.name: predicate after a sentence-initial subject
patterns.context: A subject at the start of a sentence or quotation is followed by a predicate; the subject may be a pronoun, and activation falls on the subject or immediately adjacent predicate.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic writing and narratives such as quotations and interviews

patterns.name: English present-perfect auxiliary been
patterns.context: In passive or perfect constructions, been occurs after an auxiliary and before a participle; this example is has been reported.

patterns.name: Portuguese question with a forum code snippet
patterns.context: In a Portuguese question, que introduces a relative clause meaning “that I found,” immediately followed by PHP code.

patterns.name: that in table or item descriptions
patterns.context: In a technical paper, that introduces a relative or supplementary clause about an algorithm.

8_962.description: 强激活多出现在从句引导词或主语之后、谓语及其补语附近，尤其是 who/que 引出的关系从句；也见于代词主语后的谓语、完成时 been 及技术说明从句。跨语种、跨文体，局部句法位置比主题更一致。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 who
patterns.trigger: who 及其邻近的谓语，如 «que»10« ret»5、«who»10« was»、«who»10« knows»、«who»10« are»
patterns.context: 关系代词或葡语关系词连接人物、事物或群体与后续谓语；触发位置通常在从句主语处。
patterns.domain: 多语种新闻、百科、论坛及一般说明文

patterns.name: 句首主语后的谓语
patterns.context: 句首或引语中的主语后接谓语；主语可为代词，激活落在主语或紧邻谓语处。
patterns.domain: 百科与引语、访谈等叙述

patterns.name: 英语完成时助动词 been
patterns.context: 被动或完成结构中，been 位于助动词之后、分词之前；本例为 has been reported。

patterns.name: 葡语疑问式论坛代码片段
patterns.context: 葡语提问中 que 引出“我找到的”关系从句，紧接 PHP 代码。

patterns.name: 表格或项目说明中的 that
patterns.context: 技术论文中 that 引出算法的关系或补充说明从句。

en.description: High activations fall on function words within sentences or at discourse openings in several languages, especially which, We, que, and customer-service thank-you phrases; other triggers are sporadic, with no consistent semantics or style.

patterns.name: which in relative clauses
patterns.context: which occurs in a longer statement, referring back to a fact, noun, or entire proposition and introducing further information; the two examples describe the meaning of an agreement and Allied dissatisfaction with US dominance, respectively.

patterns.name: We in direct quotations or emails
patterns.context: First-person plural We opens a statement, often in business proposals, formal letters, or customer-service responses; contexts include introductions, progress updates, promises to reply, and order processing.
patterns.domain: Business communication, customer-service templates, and parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: and in the present perfect
patterns.context: and connects prior experiences or health information, followed by have had; this example reports when a diagnosis was made and the preceding duration of symptoms.
patterns.domain: Personal account on a medical forum

patterns.name: que in Portuguese technical writing
patterns.context: Portuguese que appears in clauses or relative constructions in technical Q&A; one instance introduces a property usable for a purpose, and another is embedded in an account of a PHP code question.

patterns.name: polite English email opening
patterns.context: A thank-you phrase follows an email-style salutation or customer-service context, then explains order processing or response arrangements.
patterns.domain: Customer-service emails and automatic web-form replies

patterns.name: Portuguese que in a merged token
patterns.context: que introduces a clause expressing the belief that the recipient is already familiar with a technology; the text is a Portuguese MVC technical explanation.

8_962.description: 高激活落在多种语言的句内功能词或话语起始处，尤其是 which、We、que，以及客服感谢语；其余片段触发点零散，语义和文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 which
patterns.context: which 位于较长陈述中，承接前文的事实、名词或整个命题，引出后续说明；两个实例分别描述协议的含义和盟军对美国主导地位的不满。

patterns.name: 直接引语或邮件中的 We
patterns.context: 第一人称复数 We 开启陈述，常出现在商务提案、正式信件或客服回复中；具体语境包括自我介绍、进展汇报、承诺回复和订单处理。
patterns.domain: 商务沟通、客服模板与议会发言

patterns.name: 完成时中的 and
patterns.context: and 连接前后经历或病情信息，后接 have had；本例报告确诊时间及此前持续的症状。

patterns.name: 葡语技术文中的 que
patterns.context: 葡语 que 出现在技术问答的从句或关系结构中；一例引出可用于某目的的属性，另一例嵌在 PHP 代码问题的叙述里。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 英文邮件客套开场
patterns.trigger: «Thank»3« you»4« for»1« your order»（7）；«Thank»2« you»5« for»1« your inquiry»（3）
patterns.context: 感谢语紧接邮件式称呼或客服场景，随后说明订单处理或答复安排。
patterns.domain: 客服邮件与网页表单自动回复

patterns.name: 合并 token 中的葡语 que
patterns.context: que 引出相信对方已经熟悉某项技术的从句；文本是葡语 MVC 技术说明。

en.concept: person reference and statement markers in discourse
en.description: The most prominent pattern is first-person pronouns and following statements in emails, especially greetings, team voice, and polite requests in business emails. Activations also occur on several word sequences in game-console commentary, company registration status, and Portuguese parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: greetings and introductions in business emails
patterns.context: Activates in email openings with a salutation, small talk, and subsequent explanation of the purpose or the sender’s situation.

patterns.name: plural first-person statements in emails
patterns.context: The email body states a position, arrangement, need, or action in the voice of a team or organization; it need not be sentence-initial.

patterns.name: polite requests or responses in formal emails
patterns.context: When expressing thanks, requesting a copy, or confirming the recipient’s proposal, the first-person subject and nearby function words activate.

patterns.name: calls to action and arrangements in organizational announcements
patterns.context: Activates near pronouns and announcement-style wording when announcements, event information, or work updates are shared with organization members.
patterns.domain: Internal corporate announcements or mass emails

patterns.name: game consoles and brand topics
patterns.context: Brand and product names and nearby words activate in discussions of console launches, market performance, or later developments.

patterns.name: business status in company registration descriptions
patterns.context: A company’s activities and status are reported in a descriptive, database-like format in company registrations or business records.

patterns.name: polite expressions in Portuguese parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A speech is introduced with a formal form of address and uses polite expressions or negative constructions.

8_962.concept: 语篇中的人称与陈述标记
8_962.description: 最突出模式是邮件中的第一人称代词及其后续陈述，尤其商务邮件的问候、团队口吻和礼貌请求。另对游戏主机评论、公司登记状态和葡语议会发言中的若干词串激活。

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的问候与自我介绍
patterns.context: 邮件开头的称呼、寒暄，以及随后介绍来意或自身情况时激活。

patterns.name: 邮件中的复数第一人称陈述
patterns.context: 邮件正文以团队或组织口吻说明立场、安排、需求或行动时；并不要求句首。

patterns.name: 正式邮件中的礼貌请求或回应
patterns.context: 邮件中表达感谢、请求副本或确认对方提议时，第一人称主语及邻近功能词激活。

patterns.name: 组织公告中的号召与安排
patterns.context: 面向组织成员发布公告、活动信息或工作进展时，代词和公告式措辞附近激活。
patterns.domain: 企业内部公告或群发邮件

patterns.name: 游戏主机及品牌话题
patterns.context: 讨论游戏主机发布、市场表现或后续发展时，品牌和产品名及邻近词激活。

patterns.name: 公司登记描述中的经营状态
patterns.context: 公司登记或商业资料以描述性、数据库式格式报告公司活动和状态时。

patterns.name: 葡语议会发言中的礼貌表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中以正式称谓引入发言，并使用礼貌表达或否定结构时。

en.description: Activations often occur in supplementary or result clauses introduced by connectives, and also in email politeness requests, greetings asking after someone, formal Polish emphasis, and advertising-style self-introductions; line-break boundaries also activate. The grammatical or formatting regularities shared across these settings are not entirely clear.

patterns.name: relative clause or supplementary explanation after a noun
patterns.context: Highlights often fall on a connective or the beginning of the clause that follows; a person, thing, or situation is introduced first, then elaborated, qualified, or followed by a result.
patterns.domain: News, sports commentary, product reviews, personal introductions, and other prose

patterns.name: polite phrasing in emails
patterns.context: In the body of a business email, after a salutation or subject, the writer expresses thanks, makes a request, or states a courteous follow-up action.

patterns.name: email greeting and asking after someone
patterns.context: An informal email opens by greeting the recipient and then describing the sender’s recent situation.

patterns.name: expressing a personal position in Polish
patterns.context: In formal Polish writing, an expression equivalent to “I would like to emphasize ..., that is ...” occurs; activation centers on the verb ending and following connective structure.

patterns.name: personal-profile statement after a question
patterns.context: In a personal or social advertisement, a title-style question is followed by a first-person introduction of identity and social goals.

patterns.name: paragraph or item boundaries
patterns.context: A newline or blank line marks boundaries between paragraphs, email bodies, headings, or list items; it may contribute to activation, but is not consistent across every passage.

8_962.description: 激活常见于连接词引出的补充或结果从句，也出现在邮件的礼貌请求、问候近况、波兰语正式强调及广告式自我介绍；换行边界亦有激活。各场景共享的语法或格式规律不完全明确。

patterns.name: 名词后接关系从句或补充说明
patterns.trigger: « who»10« have»6« already»3；« that»5« week»3« so»10；« that»5« had»5；« with»2；« so»9
patterns.context: 高亮常落在连接词或其后的从句开头；前面先给出人物、事物或情境，随后补充说明、限定或交代结果。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育评论、产品评测、个人介绍和其他散文

patterns.name: 邮件中的礼貌句式
patterns.trigger: «I»6« enjoyed»2 your presentation ...«.»10«↵»4«I»6« would»1 appreciate；«Can»3 you please provide me with
patterns.context: 商务邮件正文中，称呼或主题之后表达感谢、请求或客气的后续动作。

patterns.name: 邮件问候与近况
patterns.trigger: «Hi»3« Kay»3« how»5« are»2« you»2«!»7« I»6« have»4« been»5；« I»7« just»4 started
patterns.context: 非正式邮件开头先问候收件人，再介绍自己的近况。

patterns.name: 波兰语句中强调个人立场
patterns.context: 波兰语正式论述中出现相当于“我想强调……，即/那……”的表达；激活集中在动词词尾及后续连接结构。

patterns.name: 问句后的个人资料陈述
patterns.trigger: «Just»2 looking for some good times«?»2«↵»1«↵»1«I»4« am»3 23 year old
patterns.context: 个人交友或社交广告中，标题式问句后转入第一人称身份和交友需求介绍。

patterns.name: 段落或条目边界
patterns.context: 换行或空行标记出现在段落、邮件正文、标题或列表条目之间；本身可能贡献激活，但并非每段都一致。

en.concept: Discourse organization and turn initiation at sentence/paragraph openings
en.description: Strongly responds to first-person expressions such as Polish parliamentary «chciałbym»; also sensitive to email salutations, fields, polite thanks, and English sentence-initial personal pronouns. It also covers news relative clauses, business self-introductions, and work reports.

patterns.name: Polish first-person speech formula
patterns.context: In Polish sentences, the speaker uses the first person to express “I would like to…”, often at the beginning of a parliamentary speech paragraph or at a transition; activation concentrates on «-bym» and nearby words.

patterns.name: Email greetings and salutations
patterns.context: At the head of an email or beginning of its body, a salutation is followed by a line break and then a polite greeting, thanks, or request.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and business email text

patterns.name: English sentence-initial personal pronouns
patterns.context: Personal pronouns at the beginning of a sentence or clause; seen in email bodies and in clauses introduced by relative pronouns in news sentences.

patterns.name: Email headers and field formatting
patterns.context: Structured separation between email metadata and body, often immediately following the recipient’s salutation or preceding the body.

patterns.name: English politeness, gratitude, or positive evaluation
patterns.context: Expressing thanks, appreciation, or a positive attitude in business correspondence; often at the beginning of an email body or in a reply.

patterns.name: Relative clauses in news narration
patterns.context: In a news sentence, who introduces supplementary information about a previously mentioned team or organization.

patterns.name: Self-introduction in business pitches
patterns.context: In a business proposal or service introduction, a sentence beginning with We describes the team’s identity or expertise; preceding text discusses services, the company, or a quote.

patterns.name: Completed tasks in English business narration
patterns.context: Using the first person to report a negotiation or work task just completed.

8_962.concept: 句首／段首的话语组织与发言启动
8_962.description: 强烈响应波兰议会发言中「chciałbym」式第一人称表达；另对邮件称呼、字段、礼貌致谢及英语句首人称代词等结构敏感，也覆盖新闻关系从句和商务自我介绍、工作汇报。

patterns.name: 波兰语第一人称发言公式
patterns.trigger: 「chciałbym」及其分词形式（如「chciałbym podkreślić」「chciałbym powiedzieć」「chciałbym zwrócić uwagę」「chciałbym podziękować」）
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，发言者以第一人称表达“我想……”，常出现在议会演讲的段落开头或转折处；激活集中在「-bym」及邻近词语。

patterns.name: 邮件问候与称呼
patterns.context: 邮件头部或正文开头，称呼后换行，再进入礼貌问候、致谢或请求。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及商业邮件文本

patterns.name: 英语句首人称代词
patterns.context: 句子或从句开头的人称代词；可见于邮件正文，也见于新闻句中关系代词引出的从句。
patterns.domain: 英语邮件与新闻／网页文本

patterns.name: 邮件头部与字段格式
patterns.context: 邮件元数据与正文之间的结构化分隔，常紧接收件人称呼或正文。

patterns.name: 英语礼貌、感谢或正面评价
patterns.trigger: 「Thanks for your help」「I enjoyed your presentation」「I am delighted and thankful」
patterns.context: 商务往来中表达感谢、赞赏或积极态度；常处于邮件正文开头或回应处。

patterns.name: 新闻叙述中的关系从句
patterns.context: 新闻句中以 who 引出关于前述球队或组织的补充说明。

patterns.name: 商务推介中的自我介绍
patterns.context: 商业提案或服务介绍中以 We 开头，说明团队身份或专长；前文谈及服务、公司或报价。

patterns.name: 英语商务叙述中的完成事项
patterns.context: 以第一人称报告刚完成的谈判或工作事项。

en.description: The most stable trigger pattern is the Polish conditional first-person “chciałbym” (“I would like”) in formal speeches, often introducing a statement, emphasis, thanks, or address. Other paragraphs sporadically contain English first-person contractions, personal pronouns, and forum greetings, with no consistent word form.

patterns.name: Polish conditional first-person polite speech
patterns.context: In formal Polish speeches, often followed by verbs such as “podkreślić”, “zwrócić uwagę”, “powiedzieć”, “powitać”, or “podziękować”; means “I would like to…” and often occurs at the beginning or conclusion of a speech.

patterns.name: English conditional first-person contraction
patterns.context: A first-person contraction appears in conversational English statements; paragraph 3 is a personal description of golf performance, and paragraph 7 is a chat about getting help with Ubuntu.

patterns.name: Pronouns and narration in English emails
patterns.context: The email body uses first and second person to narrate communications or business matters; it does not show the specific word form found in the Polish pattern.

patterns.name: Forum greeting
patterns.context: The body of a technical forum post opens with a greeting to the community; its specific trigger word differs from those in other paragraphs.

8_962.description: 最稳定的触发模式是波兰语正式讲话中的第一人称条件式“chciałbym”（我想），常引出发言、强调、致谢或致辞。其他段落零散出现英语第一人称缩写、人称代词及论坛问候，未见统一词形。

patterns.name: 波兰语条件式第一人称礼貌发言
patterns.context: 在波兰语正式发言中，常接“podkreślić”“zwrócić uwagę”“powiedzieć”“powitać”“podziękować”等动词；表示“我想……”，且多位于讲话开头或总结处。

patterns.name: 英语条件式第一人称缩写
patterns.context: 英语口语式陈述中出现第一人称缩写；第3段是对高尔夫球表现的个人描述，第7段是聊天中的 Ubuntu 求助对话。
patterns.domain: 论坛/在线聊天及个人经验叙述

patterns.name: 英语邮件中的人称与叙述语
patterns.context: 邮件正文中以第一、第二人称叙述联络或商业事项；不呈现与波兰语模式相同的具体词形。

patterns.name: 论坛问候语
patterns.context: 技术论坛帖子正文以面向社区的问候开场；与其他段落的具体触发词不同。

en.concept: Syntactic cohesion and common function words
en.description: Activations are distributed across languages and genres, involving inter-sentence linking, first-person statements, punctuation, and a few modal expressions, email instructions, and subword fragments within words; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Judgment following a concessive or causal connector
patterns.context: Connects preceding and following clauses, often in sentences expressing cause, contrast, or result; typically involves a connector near the marked token and the judgment that follows.
patterns.domain: English web pages, reviews, or blogs

patterns.name: First-person pronoun and following verb
patterns.context: An opinion, experience, plan, or judgment follows a first-person subject; in some cases, «it» also appears in a result or prediction sentence.
patterns.domain: English web pages and informal blogs

patterns.name: Punctuation at the end of a sentence or phrase
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at the end of a sentence or heading; it may also co-occur with a preceding connector and sentence boundary.
patterns.domain: English web pages, formal writing, and email

patterns.name: German modal judgment
patterns.context: Expresses the speaker’s opinion or possibility, appearing after “Meiner Ansicht nach”.

patterns.name: German explanatory clause connector
patterns.context: Introduces a cause or explanation, following an evaluation of the European model.

patterns.name: Portuguese stance and claim expression
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences expressing a political stance, commitment, or personal opinion.

patterns.name: Polite request language in email
patterns.context: Introduces an instruction asking the recipient to take action in an approval notification email.

patterns.name: Speaker tag after quoted content
patterns.context: A quotation mark opens a direct quote, followed by a statement about a product’s popularity.

patterns.name: Non-English subword fragments within words
patterns.context: These are internal fragments of Portuguese and German words, respectively; the word meanings where they activate are not consistent, and they lack a shared local context.

8_962.concept: 句法衔接与常见功能词
8_962.description: 激活分散在多种语言和文体中，涉及句间连接、第一人称陈述、标点及少数情态、邮件指令和词内子词片段；未见稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 让步或因果连接后的判断
patterns.context: 连接前后分句，常出现在表达原因、转折或结果的句子中；多为被标记 token 附近的连接词及其后续判断。

patterns.name: 第一人称代词及后续动词
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后接观点、经历、计划或判断；个别情况下 «it» 也出现在结果或预测句中。
patterns.domain: 英语网页及非正式博客

patterns.name: 句末或短语末的标点
patterns.context: 标点位于句子或标题末尾；也可能与前面的连接词、句子边界共同出现。
patterns.domain: 英语网页、正式文体及邮件

patterns.name: 德语情态判断
patterns.context: 表达说话者观点或可能性，出现在“Meiner Ansicht nach”之后。

patterns.name: 德语解释性从句连接
patterns.context: 引出原因或解释，前接对欧洲模式的评价。

patterns.name: 葡语立场与主张表达
patterns.context: 处于表达政治立场、承诺或个人观点的句子中。

patterns.name: 邮件请求礼貌用语
patterns.context: 审批通知邮件中，引出要求收件人采取操作的指令。
patterns.domain: 企业内部自动通知邮件

patterns.name: 引述内容后的说话人标记
patterns.context: 引号开启直接引述，后接关于产品受欢迎程度的说法。

patterns.name: 非英语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 分别是葡语、德语词的内部切分片段；激活所在词义并不统一，缺少共同局部语境。

en.description: Across multilingual examples, activations often involve finite verbs, auxiliaries, or copulas: German hat/muss, English had/are, and Portuguese é, among others. There is also I and several within-word fragments, with triggers that are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: English past-perfect have
patterns.context: In English, have functions as an auxiliary to form the past perfect or express having already owned or experienced something; it is followed by a past participle or object.

patterns.name: German third-person singular present perfect
patterns.context: In German sentences, the verb occurs in a finite clause or main clause; several instances are sentence-initial or in subordinate clauses with “hat”, and there is also the modal verb “muss”.

patterns.name: Portuguese third-person/plural verb forms
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activation falls on verb forms licensed by the subject or clause structure; these may be “é” or a within-word fragment of “estou”.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese speech and StackExchange code discussion

patterns.name: English copula be
patterns.context: The copula follows the English plural subject “They” and is followed by an identity description.

patterns.name: English first-person subject
patterns.context: Occurs in first-person statements or questions, in structures such as “I am” and “I was”.

patterns.name: Verb fragments within tokenized words
patterns.context: Activation may cover internal fragments of verbs split by tokenization rather than whole words; the observed fragments belong to Portuguese “permanece” and “estou” and German “bereits”, the latter not clearly being a verb.

8_962.description: 多语种样例中常激活有限动词、助动词或系词：德语hat/muss，英语had/are及葡语é等；另有I和若干词内片段，触发并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 英语过去完成式 have
patterns.trigger: "had"；特别是 “it seemed … so it …” 附近的 “had”
patterns.context: 英语中 have 作助动词，构成过去完成式或表达已经拥有、经历；词后接过去分词或宾语。

patterns.name: 德语第三人称单数现在完成式
patterns.context: 德语句中动词位于有限从句或主句中；多处是句首或从句结构中的“hat”，也有情态动词“muss”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语第三人称/复数动词形式
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句中，激活落在由主语或从句结构许可的动词形式上；可能是“é”或“estou”的词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语发言及 StackExchange 代码讨论

patterns.name: 英语系词 be
patterns.context: 英语复数主语 “They” 后的系词，后接身份描述。

patterns.name: 英语第一人称主语
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述或提问中，出现在 “I am”“I was”等结构里。

patterns.name: 切分后落在词内的动词片段
patterns.context: 激活可能覆盖经过分词切分的动词内部片段，而非完整词；可见片段分别属于葡萄牙语“permanece”“estou”和德语“bereits”，其中后者并非明确的动词。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本与论坛文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across different languages and contexts: German “hat” recurs, alongside Portuguese “que”, English “so” and “and”, and occasional content words. Apart from “hat”, no stable shared trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: German auxiliary “hat”
patterns.context: Occurs in German declarative sentences, followed by a subject or other sentence elements; in the examples shown, it is a perfect auxiliary or a verb meaning “have/aim at”.

patterns.name: Portuguese clause connector “que”
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese parliamentary speech, linking clauses; here it appears in the structure “penso que te…”.

patterns.name: “so” and its surrounding context
patterns.context: Used to indicate degree or result in English narration; the strong activation position is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Coordinating conjunction “and”
patterns.context: Connects two noun phrases in English narration, followed by “the car industry”.

patterns.name: Other locally high-activation words
patterns.context: These occur respectively in an email sentence about a holiday and a Portuguese parliamentary speech sentence about a stance; no shared syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Enron emails; EuroParl Portuguese parliamentary speech

8_962.description: 激活分散在不同语言和语境：德语“hat”反复出现，另有葡语“que”、英语“so”“and”及个别内容词；除“hat”外未见稳定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语助动词“hat”
patterns.context: 出现在德语陈述句中，后接主语或其他句子成分；在所示句子里是完成时助动词或表示“有/以……为目标”的动词。

patterns.name: 葡语从句连接词“que”
patterns.context: 出现在葡语议会发言中，连接前后分句；此处位于“penso que te…”结构中。

patterns.name: “so”及其邻近语境
patterns.context: 英语叙述中的程度或结果用法；强激活位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 并列连词“and”
patterns.context: 英语叙述中连接两个名词短语，后接“the car industry”。

patterns.name: 其他局部高激活词
patterns.context: 分别出现在邮件中关于节日的句子、葡语议会发言中关于立场的句子；看不出共同句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件；EuroParl 葡语议会发言

en.description: Activations most consistently cluster around positions that introduce supplementary information, explanations, or clauses in multilingual formal speeches, especially near que and German und/dass. They also accompany local patterns involving first-person speech, turn boundaries, and numerical explanations. Paragraph 9 is a Portuguese comment after webpage code; its local word-position similarity does not establish a shared cause with the parliamentary pattern.

patterns.name: Result-introducing “que” in conditional or causal explanations
patterns.context: Activation often falls on a clause introducer or an adjacent phrase; in Portuguese, it commonly occurs in parliamentary speech structures such as “gostaria de salientar ... que existe” and “porque tive ...”; German passages also show it near “und ich ...” and “dass mir ...”.
patterns.domain: Primarily formal multilingual European Parliament speeches, with some StackExchange Portuguese text

patterns.name: First-person expression in parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Occurs when a speaker expresses intent, views, thanks, or personal circumstances, often near a first-person pronoun, modal verb, or verb phrase.
patterns.domain: Formal debates and chair’s remarks in EuroParl

patterns.name: Turn-taking, chair address, and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Near parliamentary speaker salutations, chair responses, or the beginning of a new turn; some activations fall on line breaks or sentence-initial formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Numerical and monetary statistics
patterns.context: After a numerical comparison involving amounts and years, “Querer isto dizer que...” introduces an explanation or summary of a trend.

patterns.name: Portuguese comments near code strings and webpage markup
patterns.context: A Portuguese comment, “observe bem o meu código-fonte”, appears after webpage code or HTML; strong activation falls on “que” and nearby positions, with a local token form different from the parliamentary passages.
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions and answers with mixed code/HTML

patterns.name: Local word-form fragments in multilingual parliamentary text
patterns.context: Tokenized fragments from different languages are scattered across Portuguese, Italian, and German speeches; apart from occurring in formal speech, they show no consistent word-form or semantic trigger condition.

8_962.concept: 正式文本中的从句衔接
8_962.description: 激活最稳定地集中在多语种正式发言里引出补充、解释或从句的连接位置，尤其是que及德语und/dass附近；还伴随第一人称发言、轮次边界、数字说明等局部模式。第9段是网页代码后的葡语评论，只有局部词位相似，无法确定与议会模式同因。

patterns.name: 条件句或原因说明中的结果引出词“que”
patterns.context: 激活常落在从句引导词或相邻短语上；在葡萄牙语中常见于“gostaria de salientar ... que existe”“porque tive ...”等议会发言句式；德语段也出现在“und ich ...”“dass mir ...”附近。
patterns.domain: 以欧洲议会多语种正式发言为主，另有 StackExchange 葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 议会发言中的第一人称表达
patterns.trigger: « ich»7、« mir»3、« möchte»6、« gostaria»6、« quero»4、« penso»3
patterns.context: 发言者表达意愿、看法、感谢或说明自身处境时出现，常位于第一人称代词、情态动词或动词短语附近。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的正式辩论与主席发言

patterns.name: 发言轮次、主席称呼及换行边界
patterns.context: 议会发言者称呼、主席回应或新发言轮次起始附近；部分激活落在换行或句首格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 数字与金额统计表述
patterns.context: 金额和年份构成的数值比较后，接“Querer isto dizer que...”引出解释或趋势总结。

patterns.name: 口袋代码字符串及网页标记附近的葡语评论
patterns.context: 网页代码或 HTML 片段之后出现葡语评论“observe bem o meu código-fonte”；强激活落在“que”及其邻近位置，局部 token 形态与议会段落不同。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答及代码/HTML 混排

patterns.name: 多语种议会文本中的局部词形碎片
patterns.context: 不同语言的分词片段散布在葡语、意大利语、德语发言中；除同处于正式发言语境外，未见统一的词形或语义触发条件。

en.concept: Parliamentary speech boundaries and polite interaction
en.description: Activations occur in multilingual European Parliament transcripts, especially around chair titles, direct responses, polite first-person stances, and sentence/paragraph boundaries. There are also scattered subword fragments and several specific policy topics, with no confirmed shared trigger mechanism.

patterns.name: Parliamentary chair/member titles
patterns.context: Addressing the chair, naming a member, or directly responding to a member in parliamentary speech, commonly at the sentence opening or after a line break
patterns.domain: European Parliament oral debates and minutes

patterns.name: Polite responses and stance expression in parliamentary speech
patterns.context: First-person statements, thanks, agreement, or an introduction of a personal view, often adjacent to direct address to a member

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation and subsequent speech boundaries
patterns.context: Marks the end of a sentence, a change of speaker, or a new paragraph; activation often falls on punctuation, a following connector, or a sentence-initial word

patterns.name: Subword fragments within German words
patterns.context: Complex German words or words are split into multiple tokens; it is unclear whether activation is triggered by a specific word form, subword boundary, or nearby syntax

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Portuguese words are split into subwords, occurring in contexts of statements, thanks, or event reporting

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: Spanish words are split into multiple tokens, involving past tense, conditional, or verb inflection

patterns.name: Policy arguments and contrastive connectors
patterns.context: Connects arguments, supplementary explanations, or contrasts in continuous policy statements; trigger tokens are scattered, with no stable single lexical item

patterns.name: Voting procedures and roll-call records
patterns.context: Describes whether a member is on the list, participates in a vote, or how their vote is handled

patterns.name: Airline markets and competition
patterns.context: Discusses competition in the airline market and its effects on consumers

patterns.name: International agreements and market access
patterns.context: Discusses agreements related to Canada, restrictions, and market access

patterns.name: Media pluralism
patterns.context: Raises media pluralism as a topic or argument

patterns.name: Regional price/industry changes
patterns.context: Narrates increases across different industries or regions

patterns.name: Topic fragments that do not fit a stable pattern
patterns.context: Content concerns the Macedonia report, oral questions, nuclear issues, and complacency and follow-up work; a shared trigger is unclear

8_962.concept: 议会发言边界与礼貌互动
8_962.description: 激活出现在多语种欧洲议会逐字记录中，尤其是主席称谓、直接回应、第一人称礼貌立场表达及句末/段落边界；另有分散的子词片段与若干特定政策议题，无法确认是否共享触发机制。

patterns.name: 议会主席/议员称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言中的主席称呼、点名或直接回应议员，常见于句首/换行后
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口头辩论及会议记录

patterns.name: 议会发言中的礼貌回应与立场表达
patterns.trigger: «ich»« habe»；«Mein»；«begrüße»；«gostaria»；«Me»« encantaría»；«estoy»« completamente de acuerdo»；«es»« evidente»
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述、感谢、赞同或引出个人观点，常与直接对议员讲话相邻

patterns.name: 句末标点及其后的发言边界
patterns.context: 标记句子结束、发言转换或新段落；激活常落在标点、紧随其后的连接词或句首词上

patterns.name: 德语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 德语形态复杂词或词被分成多个 token；无法确定激活是由具体词形、子词边界还是邻近句法触发

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词被拆分成子词，出现于陈述、感谢或记录事件的语境

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语词被切分为多个 token，涉及过去时、条件式或动词变位

patterns.name: 政策论述及转折连接语
patterns.context: 连接论据、补充说明或转折，出现在连续的政策陈述中；触发 token 分散，未见稳定单一词项

patterns.name: 投票程序及点名记录
patterns.trigger: «Stimmerklärun»；«nicht auf der Liste»；«nicht»；«an der Abstimmung teilnehmen»；«tomado en cuenta»
patterns.context: 说明议员是否列入名单、参与投票或其投票情况如何处理

patterns.name: 航空市场与竞争
patterns.context: 讨论航空市场竞争及其对消费者的影响

patterns.name: 国际协议与市场准入
patterns.context: 讨论与加拿大相关的协议、限制及市场准入

patterns.name: 媒体多元主义
patterns.context: 提出媒体多元主义作为议题或论点

patterns.name: 区域价格/应用行业变化
patterns.trigger: «os aumentos variaram»；«sector de aplicação»；«Registou-se um aumento»
patterns.context: 叙述不同应用行业或区域中出现的增幅
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语政策或经济陈述

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的议题片段
patterns.context: 内容分别涉及马其顿报告、口头质询、核问题及自满与后续工作；共同触发因素不明确

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual text and commonly occur at sentence boundaries, clause introducers, and subwords split from words; there are also parliamentary forms of address, stance expressions, and sporadic morphological fragments, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: “que” after a sentence ending and the following clause
patterns.context: Occurs near the middle or end of a sentence, followed by a declarative, causal, purposive, or supplementary clause; typically in continuation contexts after a comma or period.
patterns.domain: Multilingual political speeches, parliamentary debates, and Spanish academic writing

patterns.name: Inter-sentence cohesion in German parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: At a transition between sentences or clause introduction in a parliamentary speech; nearby highlighted words often include periods, line breaks, and first-person or audience-directed expressions.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: A period is followed by a line break or a new sentence; punctuation activation is clear, but not all punctuation boundaries trigger it.
patterns.domain: European Parliament records and dialogue text

patterns.name: Portuguese conjunctions and verb-morphology fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activation occurs on contrastive conjunctions, verb endings, or participial forms; semantic and syntactic positions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Portuguese Q&A and Portuguese European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: Spanish words are split into subword tokens, with activation on the stem or suffix; surrounding content includes oral speeches, political commentary, and academic philosophy texts.
patterns.domain: Spanish parliamentary speeches and academic texts

patterns.name: Parliamentary polite address or speech markers
patterns.context: Parliamentary speech includes an address to the chair, a form of address for a member, or a reference to a committee.

patterns.name: Expressions of personal stance and evaluation
patterns.context: Speakers express welcome, evaluation, or condemnation, followed by a judgment about an event or action.

patterns.name: Other isolated word fragments
patterns.context: Local subword activations within words do not show a stable shared syntactic or semantic condition; paragraph 1 in particular is from a technical Q&A, while the rest are parliamentary contexts.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and European Parliament speeches

8_962.concept: 句际衔接与多语种子词
8_962.description: 激活分布于多语种文本，常见于句际边界、从句引入词及被拆分的词内子词；另有议会称呼、立场表达和零散形态片段，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 句末后的“que”及后续从句
patterns.context: 出现在句中或句末附近，后接陈述、因果、目的或补充说明从句；通常处于逗号或句号之后的延续语境。
patterns.domain: 多语种政治演讲、议会辩论及西班牙语学术论述

patterns.name: 德语议会发言中的句际衔接
patterns.context: 议会演讲的句际过渡或从句引入位置；高亮词附近常有句号、换行及第一人称或面向听众的表达。

patterns.name: 句末标点与换行边界
patterns.context: 句号后接换行或新句；标点激活明显，但并非所有标点边界都会触发。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录及对话文本

patterns.name: 葡语连词与动词形态片段
patterns.context: 葡语句中，转折连词、动词词尾或分词形态处出现激活；语义与句法位置不统一。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 葡语问答、葡语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 西语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 西语词被拆分为子词 token，激活落在词干或词尾；周边内容包括口语发言、政治评论和哲学学术文本。
patterns.domain: 西语议会发言与学术文本

patterns.name: 议会礼貌称呼或发言标记
patterns.context: 议会发言中出现主席称呼、对议员的称谓或委员会相关表达。

patterns.name: 人物立场与评价表达
patterns.trigger: « be»2«gr»2ü«ße»3 es；« Consider»3«o»5 verdadeiramente escandaloso；« me»1 parece inadequad
patterns.context: 发言者表达欢迎、评价或谴责，后接对事件或行为的判断。

patterns.name: 其他孤立词片段
patterns.context: 局部词内子词激活，未显示稳定的共同句法或语义条件；尤其第1段来自技术问答，其余为议会语境。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与欧洲议会发言

en.concept: Sentence-boundary markers and continuation after sentences
en.description: All paragraphs share the period as a sentence-boundary marker, often introducing a new sentence; some paragraphs also activate line breaks and sentence-initial transitions, parliamentary forms of address, or narrative expressions. Languages and topics differ substantially, while other word-fragment patterns are more local.

patterns.name: Period at sentence end or within a sentence
patterns.context: A period ends a declarative sentence, often followed by a sentence-initial contrastive word or a new sentence; the trigger is the punctuation itself and is not limited to paragraph-final positions
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including papers and parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Line break after a period
patterns.context: A line break follows a period, often introducing a new speaker or turn in parliamentary speech
patterns.domain: Parliamentary records; paragraph 1 also contains a line break in technical Q&A text

patterns.name: Sentence-initial contrast or continuation words
patterns.context: After a period or paragraph boundary, a new sentence begins with a contrastive, continuative, or discourse-progressing word; the specific words differ across examples

patterns.name: Spanish forms of address and polite expressions
patterns.context: In parliamentary speech, directly addresses another person or explains an action the speaker previously took

patterns.name: Addressing the chair in German
patterns.context: After a line break, names the chair and opens with a polite greeting

patterns.name: Italian emphasis or contrastive transitions
patterns.context: In a parliamentary sentence, introduces a contrast with “but” or uses “I must” to introduce a reminder

patterns.name: Portuguese evaluation and inference expressions
patterns.context: Evaluates project management performance and introduces a judgment with “it can be said”

patterns.name: German plural past-tense verbs
patterns.context: Describes attendance and decisions in parliamentary speech; activation falls on split word fragments

8_962.description: 各段共同出现句号这一句界标记，且句号常引出新句；部分段落还激活换行及句首衔接、议会称呼或叙述用语。多语种与主题差异显著，其他词片段模式较局部。

patterns.name: 句末或句中句号
patterns.context: 句号结束一个陈述句，常紧接句首转折词或新句；触发的是标点本身，不限于句末段落
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，包括论文和议会发言

patterns.name: 句号后换行
patterns.context: 句号后出现换行，常在议会发言中引入新的发言者或话轮
patterns.domain: 议会记录；第1段亦有技术问答文本中的换行

patterns.name: 句首转折或承接词
patterns.context: 句号或段落边界后出现新句的转折、承接或论述推进词；各处具体词汇不同
patterns.domain: 葡语问答、英语数学论文

patterns.name: 西语说话者称呼及礼貌表达
patterns.context: 议会发言中直接向他人表达或说明发言者曾采取的行动

patterns.name: 德语称呼主席
patterns.context: 换行后点名主席并以礼貌问候开场

patterns.name: 意大利语强调或转折衔接
patterns.context: 议会句中以“但是”转折，或以“我必须”引出提醒

patterns.name: 葡语评价及推断表达
patterns.context: 评价项目管理表现，并引出“可以说”的判断

patterns.name: 德语复数过去式动词
patterns.context: 议会发言中叙述出席情况及作出决定，激活标记落在被拆分的词片段上

en.description: Activations are distributed across sentence boundaries, paragraph boundaries, and points where an argument progresses, often accompanied by contrastive, additive, or explanatory function words. They also cover text adjacent to mathematical formulas, Spanish political speeches, and forum questions, with no single stable word or theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial contrastive or additive connectors
patterns.context: Connects preceding text to the following argument, often near a comma or period; examples occur in both English and Spanish

patterns.name: Discourse progression after sentence boundaries
patterns.context: Introduces the next explanation, definition, or method after a sentence or paragraph boundary

patterns.name: Punctuation and layout boundaries
patterns.context: These markers are adjacent to or co-occur with activated words; some examples occur at formula, quotation, or paragraph boundaries

patterns.name: English function words and phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in explanatory or argumentative sentences and may be jointly triggered by surrounding sentence structure and cohesion

patterns.name: Local Spanish vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in Spanish parliamentary speeches, with activations scattered across in-sentence words and no clear English counterpart

patterns.name: Text adjacent to formulas and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, formulas, or LaTeX markup are adjacent to body text and sentence boundaries

patterns.name: Forum questions and subjective judgments
patterns.context: A forum question follows a separator, then comments on the question’s subjectivity and related dogma

8_962.description: 激活分布在句界、段落边界及论述推进处，常伴随转折、递进或解释性功能词；也覆盖数学公式邻接文本、西班牙语政治发言和论坛提问，未见单一稳定词项或主题。

patterns.name: 句首转折或递进连接词
patterns.trigger: 句首或句中表示转折、递进的连接词，如 “Since”、“However”、“More recently”、“Further”、“Justo ayer”
patterns.context: 连接前文与后续论述，常位于逗号或句号附近；英文与西班牙文均有例子

patterns.name: 句界后的篇章推进
patterns.trigger: 句号后的 “From now on”、“Taking”、“Let”、“A proof”、“Numerical approaches”等
patterns.context: 句界或段落边界后引出下一步说明、定义或方法

patterns.name: 标点及排版边界
patterns.context: 这些标记紧邻或伴随激活词；部分例子处于公式、引用或段落边界

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语
patterns.context: 出现在解释或论证句中，可能与前后句式和连接关系共同触发

patterns.name: 西班牙语局部词汇
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语议会发言中，激活分散在句中词语，缺乏明显的英语对应
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语政治发言

patterns.name: 公式与数学文本邻接
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或 LaTeX 标记邻接正文和句界

patterns.name: 论坛提问与主观判断
patterns.context: 由分隔线引出论坛提问，随后评论问题的主观性及相关 dogma

en.description: The most stable trigger is County in geographic proper names, especially when a county name is followed by a comma and state name. It also activates on a few split place names, institution names, disease names, title words, and legal typographic fragments, with no unified condition apparent.

patterns.name: County names and following punctuation
patterns.context: A place or region name precedes County, often followed by a comma and a state, country, or geographic description. This occurs in news and research texts as well as encyclopedia entries.
patterns.domain: Place names, encyclopedias, news, research abstracts

patterns.name: Del- in a post office name
patterns.context: Appears in “Delhi,” the name of a historic post office in Delaware County, New York; it occurs in both the title and body text.

patterns.name: Court name typography
patterns.context: Activation falls on split letter fragments in uppercase, spaced-out names of U.S. appellate courts.

patterns.name: Sexually transmitted infection word fragments
patterns.context: In parallel mentions of gonorrhea and chlamydia infections, activation corresponds to fragments of the split disease names; County also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Split fragments of the place name Namyangju
patterns.context: Activates on multiple occurrences of the Korean place name Namyangju, including modern place names, a massacre title, and county-name contexts.

patterns.name: Isolated title-word fragment
patterns.context: Appears on the word Oil at the start of a news headline. It co-occurs with the County pattern in the same passage, but it is unclear whether it constitutes an independent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated case-number symbol
patterns.context: In the case number “17‐18,” activation falls on the hyphen connecting the digits; other activations cluster around court-name typography.

patterns.name: Isolated word-final or internal fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the film title Game of Pawns, with no clear connection to County or other major patterns.

patterns.name: Isolated phrase “Kentucky Writers”
patterns.context: The headline describes induction into the Kentucky Writers Hall of Fame, and the body later mentions Knot(t) County. It is uncertain whether the activation pattern is triggered solely by place-name structure.

8_1165.description: 最稳定的触发点是地理专名中的 County，尤其县名后接逗号和州名；此外还激活少数拆分地名、机构名、疾病名、标题词及法律排印片段，未见统一条件。

patterns.name: County 名称及其后的标点
patterns.context: County 前接地名或地区名，后常接逗号并继续给出州、国家或地理说明；不仅出现在百科条目，也出现在新闻及科研文本中。
patterns.domain: 地名、百科、新闻、科研摘要

patterns.name: 邮局名称中的 Del-
patterns.context: 出现在纽约州 Delaware County 的历史邮局名称“Delhi”中，标题和正文都出现。

patterns.name: 法院名称排版
patterns.context: 大写、分隔排印的美国上诉法院名称中，激活落在拆分的机构名称字母片段上。

patterns.name: 性传播感染词语片段
patterns.context: 在淋病和衣原体感染的并列表述中，激活对应被拆分的疾病名称片段；同段也有 County。

patterns.name: 地名 Namyangju 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 在韩国地名 Namyangju 的多次出现中激活，包括现代地名、屠杀标题和县名语境。

patterns.name: 孤立的标题词片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题开头的 Oil 一词中；与同段的 County 模式并存，是否构成独立触发规律不明。

patterns.name: 孤立的法院案号符号
patterns.context: 案号“17‐18”中，激活落在连接数字的连字符上；其余激活集中于法院名称排版。

patterns.name: 孤立的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在电影名 Game of Pawns 中，未见与 County 或其他主要模式的明显联系。

patterns.name: 孤立的 Kentucky Writers 词组
patterns.context: 标题叙述入选肯塔基作家名人堂，随后正文提及 Knot(t) County；激活模式是否仅由地名结构触发不确定。

en.concept: Word and proper-name fragments at the beginning
en.description: Activations occur at the beginnings of various words, proper names, or code fragments, and in titles: Be, Peace Fellowship, Ma, Platinum, Adv, and Python import statements. The surface triggers vary, with little apparent common semantics beyond local spelling or formatting.

patterns.name: Word-initial proper-name or fragment “Be”
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or entry title, activation is concentrated on the beginning of a place name; the context is an airport entry title and its repetition.

patterns.name: “Peace Fellowship” in an organization name
patterns.context: Appears in the name of a Jewish peace group, in the title and again in the body text.

patterns.name: Names or words beginning with Ma
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning of proper names or words, which continue into different names or phrases; the contexts vary across examples.

patterns.name: Python import statements
patterns.context: Python code imports multiple modules, with module names separated by commas.

patterns.name: Proper names beginning with “Pl”
patterns.context: A company name appears in an entry title, followed by a description field.

patterns.name: Words beginning with “Adv”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a title or phrase across varied fields and contexts.
patterns.domain: Academic publishing information, Wikipedia entries, PubMed patent abstracts

8_1165.concept: 词语与专名片段的开头
8_1165.description: 激活出现在多种词语、专名或代码片段的开头及标题位置：Be、Peace Fellowship、Ma、Platinum、Adv，以及 Python 的 import 语句。表面触发形式多样，除局部拼写或格式外难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 专名或词首片段“Be”
patterns.context: 句首或条目标题中，激活集中于地名开头；上下文为机场条目标题及其重复

patterns.name: 组织名称中的“Peace Fellowship”
patterns.context: 犹太和平团体名称中，位于标题并在后续正文中重现

patterns.name: 以 Ma 开头的名称或词
patterns.context: 激活位于专名或词语开头，后续拼接成不同名称或短语；各例上下文不同

patterns.name: Python 导入语句
patterns.context: Python 代码中导入多个模块，逗号分隔模块名

patterns.name: 以“Pl”开头的专名
patterns.context: 公司名位于条目标题，后接描述字段

patterns.name: 以“Adv”开头的词
patterns.context: 位于标题或短语开头，所处领域与语境不一
patterns.domain: 学术出版信息、Wikipedia 条目、PubMed 专利摘要

en.concept: Lexical cues at the beginning of fragments
en.description: Activations cluster on «Ma» at the beginning of fragments (a shared word-initial sequence across different words and names) or «What» (a shared opening across various questions, titles, and incomplete phrases). One other example activates on an email table containing numbers, amounts, and tab-separated fields.

patterns.name: Word-initial subword token Ma
patterns.context: Ma appears at the beginning of a fragment and continues into different words or names; it is sometimes followed by a proper name, a newline, or other text.

patterns.name: Question word What
patterns.context: The fragment begins with What, followed by a question, title, or incomplete phrase; the content and style vary.
patterns.domain: Web, medical literature, email, and other text

patterns.name: Numbers and tabs in a table
patterns.context: Appears in tab-separated table rows containing numbers and amounts; the same passage also includes a place name.

8_1165.description: 激活集中于片段开头的 «Ma»（不同词与名称的共同词首）或 «What»（多种疑问、标题及残缺短语的共同开头）；另有一例激活于数字、金额和制表符分隔的邮件表格。

patterns.name: 词首 Ma 子词元
patterns.context: Ma 位于片段开头，后续组成不同单词或名称；有时接专名、换行或其他文本。

patterns.name: 疑问词 What
patterns.context: 片段以 What 开始，后续可接疑问句、标题或不完整短语；覆盖内容和文体多样。
patterns.domain: 网页、医学文献、邮件及其他文本

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与制表符
patterns.context: 数字、金额及制表符分隔的表格行中出现；同段还含地点名。

en.concept: What introducing questions at sentence beginnings
en.description: All ten passages begin with What, which has the strongest activation. What is usually followed by a question, title, or truncated query, across varied topics and registers. A few examples also involve hypothetical clauses, title contexts, or emphatic punctuation.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial What
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a passage, followed by a question or question-like title; this activation occurs in every passage.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: web text, email, medical literature, etc.

patterns.name: Questions introduced by What
patterns.context: Begins with What and asks about evidence, current developments, possibilities, identity, content, needs, or mental processes. The sentence may be complete or just a title or truncated fragment.
