patterns.context: The sentence is semantically and structurally anomalous, resembling noise, concatenation, or corrupted text; it is unclear whether the markers form a stable independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common function words
patterns.context: Distributed across different structures and semantic contexts in the passages; apart from syntactic combinations with be, there is no clear consistent trigger.

8_1316.concept: 英语 be 的句法功能
8_1316.description: 主要响应情态动词后或句中作助动词、系动词的 be，尤其连接被动、形容词及进行体成分；另有一段足球比分数字激活，以及博客、噪声文本和其他功能词的零散激活。

patterns.name: be 在不定式或系表结构中
patterns.trigger: «be»（[1]“would a Sailor be”，[2]“shall be taken”，[5]“let a man be placed”，[8]“would be willing”，[9]“would be separated”；另有 [10]“will be helping”）
patterns.context: be 作助动词或系动词，常位于情态动词后，连接被动分词、形容词或进行体成分；不限定具体语义领域。
patterns.domain: 多种文体中的一般英语句法

patterns.name: 比分中的数字 token
patterns.context: 足球淘汰赛比分与 aggregate、second leg 等比赛叙述相邻；激活落在拆分后的数字 token 上。

patterns.name: 第一人称复数代词
patterns.context: 个人叙述中说到母亲为孩子筹办周岁庆祝；孤立的一处标记，是否与主模式有关不明。
patterns.domain: 个人博客／宗教感恩叙述

patterns.name: 异常拼接文本中的功能词
patterns.trigger: «to»、«be»及多个零散词（如 [4]“to be you”“culmination for the human”）
patterns.context: 句子语义与结构异常，像噪声、拼接或损坏文本；无法确认这些标记构成稳定的独立模式。

patterns.name: 常见功能词的零散激活
patterns.context: 各段中分布于不同结构和语义环境；除与 be 的句法搭配外，没有明确一致的触发条件。

en.description: Most passages activate on noun phrases following the indefinite article a, covering a wide range of content. A few involve state expressions after be, while others show isolated activations on for, to, and Euro; the overall pattern is weak.

patterns.name: Entity nouns or noun phrases following the indefinite article a
patterns.context: Activation falls on a, followed by a noun phrase; the phrases refer to victories, funerals, competitions, ratings, poses, game areas, or cinemas, with no consistent semantics.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, novel dialogue, news, parenting, game descriptions, etc.

patterns.name: Past participles or adjectives following be
patterns.context: Be is followed by a state, participle, or prepositional phrase; the local structures are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Academic titles, literary poetry, parenting narratives

patterns.name: Sporadic high activations outside a/be
patterns.context: Activations fall on different function words or within-word fragments, with no nearby trigger condition that can be explained by a single local syntactic pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, literary poetry, Wikipedia entries

8_1316.description: 多数段落在不定冠词 a 后的名词短语上激活，内容跨度很大；少数涉及 be 后的状态表达，另有 for、to、Euro 等孤立激活，整体规律较弱。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 后接实体名词或名词短语
patterns.trigger: «a»10 victory；«a»10 funeral；«a»9 tournament；«a»9 nearly perfect passer rating；«a»9 stooped position；«a»9 safe zone；«a»9 theater
patterns.context: 激活落在 a 上，后面接名词短语；名词短语涉及胜利、葬礼、赛事、评分、姿势、游戏区域或影院等，语义不统一。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、小说对白、新闻、育儿、游戏介绍等

patterns.name: be 后接过去分词或形容词
patterns.context: be 后接状态、分词或介词短语；局部结构不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术标题、文学诗句、育儿叙述

patterns.name: 非 a/be 的零散高激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不同功能词或词内片段，附近没有可由同一局部句法模式解释的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、文学诗句、维基百科条目

en.concept: English to and expressions of progression
en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple contexts; a relatively stable cue is English to in infinitive and directional uses. In sports-event texts, it often co-occurs with expressions of advancement, ranking, and results. One passage contains a Polish within-word fragment whose relation to the other patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: General infinitive marker
patterns.context: Often occurs after the preposition or auxiliary to, especially in “to a successful career”, “to the top 10”, “to perform”, and “to the final”; also appears in “towards a larger buy order”.

patterns.name: Progression and rankings in sporting events
patterns.context: Describes competitors or teams advancing in a competition, reaching a ranking, or contending for the title; often accompanied by to, numbers, and ordinal numbers.
patterns.domain: Sports, pageants, and competition results reporting

patterns.name: Subsequent development or result
patterns.context: An infinitive or related structure links a preceding event to a subsequent action, purpose, or state; not necessarily related to competitions.
patterns.domain: Biographies, plot summaries, and general narration

patterns.name: Financial transaction direction
patterns.context: Discusses positions on both sides of a market and using sell orders to lure trading bots toward a larger buy order.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Polish sentence at the end thanking the committee and council for their flexibility during negotiations; activation markers are distributed within words.

8_1316.concept: 英语 to 及后续发展表达
8_1316.description: 激活分散于多语境，较稳定的线索是英语 to 及其不定式/方向用法；体育赛事文本中常与晋级、名次和结果表达并现。另有一段波兰语词内片段，难与其余模式确定关联。

patterns.name: 通用不定式标记
patterns.context: 多处在介词或助动词 to 后，尤其是“to a successful career”“to the top 10”“to perform”“to the final”等；也出现于“towards a larger buy order”。

patterns.name: 运动赛事进阶与名次
patterns.trigger: “to the top 10”“advanced to the final”“came 8th”“in the top 3”“5th”“into a playoff”
patterns.context: 描述选手或队伍在比赛中晋级、进入名次或争夺冠军；常伴随 to、数字和序数词。
patterns.domain: 体育、选美及比赛结果报道

patterns.name: 后续发展或结果
patterns.trigger: “go on to”“leads to”“in order to”“would be”“to save”
patterns.context: 用不定式或相关结构连接前述事件与后续行动、目的或状态；不一定与比赛有关。
patterns.domain: 传记、剧情梗概及一般叙述

patterns.name: 金融交易方向
patterns.context: 讨论市场两侧的仓位以及用卖单诱导交易机器人靠近较大的买单。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在句末感谢委员会与理事会在谈判中展现灵活性的波兰语句子中；激活标记分布在词内片段。

en.description: Activation is broadly distributed: multiple sports texts involve rankings, points, scores, season results, and numbers; isolated words also occur in corporate emails, email feedback, fiction, reviews, and Polish parliamentary speeches. No single stable semantic pattern explains all high activations.

patterns.name: Rank and ranking expressions
patterns.context: Ordinal rank words and nearby terms such as place, points, match, or season results; ordinal suffixes and terms near place are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Numbers and scoring in match results
patterns.context: Outcome-related numbers such as wins and losses, scores, points, and ranks appear together in sports events or season records.

patterns.name: Outcome narratives following numbers
patterns.context: Subsequent outcomes describing matches, seasons, or personal experiences; often adjacent to dates, ranks, or achievements.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, sports reporting, and narrative text

patterns.name: Activation near emphatic to
patterns.context: Infinitival or directional to occurs in a phrase; these instances vary considerably, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Emails, sports text, and literary narrative

patterns.name: Numbers with dates or years
patterns.context: Dates, years, or record numbers occur in event and historical narratives; these alone are not sufficient conditions.

patterns.name: Award expressions in recognition contexts
patterns.context: Corporate emails describing employee awards, recipients, and award arrangements.

patterns.name: Feedback language in emails
patterns.context: Short email replies expressing praise and introducing a personal view.

patterns.name: Leaving home and career choices in fiction
patterns.context: Direct character quotations about leaving home, work, and future choices.

patterns.name: Evaluations and quantity expressions in reviews
patterns.context: Reviews of fantasy works using exaggerated quantities to describe characters and plots.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary expressions of thanks and negotiation
patterns.context: Polish sentences thanking the European Commission and Council and mentioning the negotiation process.

8_1316.description: 激活分布较散：多段体育文本涉及名次、积分、比分、赛季结果及数字；另有企业邮件、邮件反馈、小说、评论和波兰语议会发言中的局部词语。无法由单一稳定语义模式解释所有高激活。

patterns.name: 名次与排名表述
patterns.context: 名次序数词及其附近的 place、points、比赛或赛季结果；序数后缀和 place 附近尤其显著。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事结果、排名或统计文字

patterns.name: 比赛结果中的数字与计分
patterns.trigger: “141 points”“47 points”“20–14 overall”“one match”“one game drawn”
patterns.context: 体育赛事或赛季记录中，胜负、比分、积分与名次等结果性数字并列出现。

patterns.name: 数字之后的结果叙述
patterns.context: 描述比赛、赛季或个人经历的后续结果；常与日期、名次或成就相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道及叙事文字

patterns.name: 强调词 to 附近的激活
patterns.trigger: “cuts right to the”“enough to guide”“went on to”“to be a cowboy”
patterns.context: 不定式或方向性 to 出现在短语中；这些用例差异较大，未见一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、体育文字与文学叙事

patterns.name: 数字与日期或年份
patterns.context: 日期、年份或记录数字出现在赛事和历史叙述中；单独看并非充分条件。

patterns.name: 奖励项目中的授予表达
patterns.trigger: “will be presented with the Chairman’s Award”“Roundtable”
patterns.context: 描述员工奖励、获奖者与颁奖安排的公司邮件。

patterns.name: 邮件中的反馈用语
patterns.context: 简短邮件回复中表达赞许并引出个人看法。

patterns.name: 小说中的离家与职业选择
patterns.trigger: “run away from home”“go off to be a cowboy”
patterns.context: 人物直接引语中谈论离家、工作与未来选择。

patterns.name: 作品评论中的评价与数量表达
patterns.trigger: “vital to a fantasy’s success”“by the dozen”“by the metric ton”
patterns.context: 对奇幻作品的评论，以数量夸张描述角色和情节。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会致谢与谈判用语
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中致谢欧盟委员会和理事会，并提及谈判过程。

en.description: Activations are distributed across rankings, places, and statistical numbers, and also occur in award recognition, election victories, ceremony preparation, cricket careers, and candidate ordering; they often occur near outcome, level, or assessment expressions, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Placings and ranks
patterns.context: Describes a place, ranking, or final result, often with ordinal words or top N

patterns.name: Rank-related numbers and scores
patterns.context: Statistics, scores, results, ordinals, or group values appear in narration or tables

patterns.name: Easy election victory
patterns.context: A person runs in an election and wins easily

patterns.name: Honors named Award
patterns.context: Introducing someone who will receive an award in an employee-recognition context

patterns.name: Ceremonial items must be washed
patterns.context: Listing items used in a religious ceremony and their preparation steps

patterns.name: Cricket career
patterns.context: After introducing a cricket match, mentioning a player's career

patterns.name: Candidate evaluations and rank predictions
patterns.context: Comparing film-award candidates in the first person and estimating their rankings

8_1316.description: 激活分散于排名、名次与统计数字，也见于获奖、选举获胜、仪式准备、板球生涯及候选人排序；常邻近结果、等级或评定表达，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 排位与名次
patterns.trigger: «the»10« top»7« 3»6« (»5«and»6« even»5« came»4« 1»2«st»6；«a»10« 15»5«th»7« place»8« finish；«7»7«th»9« place
patterns.context: 描述名次、排名或最终成绩，常见序数词或 top N
patterns.domain: 体育、比赛结果、投票排名

patterns.name: 名次相关数字与比分
patterns.context: 统计数字、得分、比分、序数或分组值出现在叙述或表格中
patterns.domain: 赛事、体育赛季、医学统计

patterns.name: 选举中轻松获胜
patterns.context: 人物在选举中竞选并轻松获胜

patterns.name: 名为 Award 的荣誉表彰
patterns.context: 员工表彰语境中介绍某人将获奖

patterns.name: 仪式用品须清洗
patterns.context: 列出宗教仪式所用物品及其准备步骤

patterns.name: 板球职业生涯
patterns.context: 介绍板球比赛后，提及球员职业生涯

patterns.name: 候选人评价与名次预测
patterns.context: 以第一人称比较电影奖项候选人并估计排名

en.description: Primarily responds to rankings, season records, points, and qualification standings in competition contexts, and also to ordering from high to low or best to worst; an additional forum phrase has truncated context and a localized trigger.

patterns.name: Placings and season records
patterns.context: Placings, season records, and rankings often occur together in accounts of teams, clubs, or individual competition results; activation also covers rank terms themselves, their numbers, ordinal suffixes, and surrounding function words
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, including football, basketball, American football, and volleyball

patterns.name: Competition stages and qualification standings
patterns.context: Rules describing group stages, qualification rounds, points, or match results; ranking terms occur in explanations of competition structure

patterns.name: Voting rankings and points
patterns.context: In accounts of competition or voting results, ranks and scores appear together, with mention of having been near the top during the process

patterns.name: Rating order and extremes
patterns.context: A task asks for objects to be ranked from one extreme to the other by quality

patterns.name: Ratings determine points and tier sequence
patterns.context: Explaining how event ratings affect points and explicitly listing tiers from highest to lowest

patterns.name: Localized common phrase or formatting residue
patterns.context: The phrase “cuts right to the ...” in a forum reply; truncated context is insufficient to determine its relation to ranking or sports standings

8_1316.description: 主要响应竞赛语境中的名次、赛季成绩、积分与晋级排名，也响应从高到低或最好到最差的排序表达；另有一条上下文截断的论坛短语，触发词较局部。

patterns.name: 名次与赛季成绩
patterns.trigger: «finished»、«in»、«the»、序数名次如«9»«th»、«7»«th»、«fourth»、«seventh»，以及得分/胜场数据
patterns.context: 在球队、俱乐部或个人竞赛结果叙述中，名次、赛季战绩和排名常紧邻出现；触发也覆盖名次词本身及其数字、序数后缀和周围功能词
patterns.domain: 体育百科，足球、篮球、美式橄榄球、排球等

patterns.name: 赛事阶段与晋级排名
patterns.context: 描述分组赛、晋级阶段、积分或比赛结果的规则；排名词处于赛事结构说明中

patterns.name: 投票排名与积分
patterns.context: 比赛或投票结果叙述中，名次与得分并列，且提及过程中曾处于前列

patterns.name: 评分排序与高低端点
patterns.context: 提出将对象按优劣从一端排到另一端的排序任务

patterns.name: 评级决定得分及等级序列
patterns.context: 说明赛事评级影响得分，并明确列出从最高到最低的等级顺序

patterns.name: 局部常见词或格式残留
patterns.context: 论坛回复片段中的短语“cuts right to the ...”，截断上下文不足以确定其与排序或体育排名的关系

en.description: Primarily responds to rankings and ordinal places (th, st, ranks, and position), and also to competition stages, qualification, and season results; additional contexts include copular evaluation, directional expressions, statistical numbers, and a few isolated topics, so the triggers are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and place suffixes
patterns.context: In descriptions of rankings, tables, or places, ordinal words and adjacent place units are prominent; sometimes only part of a rank is marked.

patterns.name: Rank changes and competition for position
patterns.context: Describes a team, country, or object holding a position or competing for the same position; activation may extend to surrounding words.

patterns.name: Competition stages, qualification, and season results
patterns.context: Sports reports describe group stages, qualification, season records, or final rankings; prominent ordinal words are not always present.

patterns.name: Copula followed by an evaluation of a person or object
patterns.context: The copula is is followed by an evaluation, identity, or preference judgment about a person or thing; strong activation in this passage centers on is.

patterns.name: Direction or goal expressions
patterns.context: to, towards, etc. express a subsequent action or direction toward a goal; this trigger appears in only a few passages.
patterns.domain: Competition narratives, religious or philosophical text

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or clause-linking and
patterns.context: The coordinating element and is marked, but activation is weak and spans different topics, possibly as a concomitant effect.

patterns.name: Numbers and statistical results
patterns.context: Scores, season records, points, or championship counts appear in sports or competition texts; activation is sporadic near numbers.

patterns.name: Descriptions of bird preferences
patterns.context: A person’s personal preference for birds is described; there is no obvious shared trigger with the other ranking and competition passages.

patterns.name: Directional phrases in reviews
patterns.context: A forum review contains a directional or approach expression introduced by to; an isolated instance with no stable shared pattern.

8_1316.description: 主要响应排名与序数名次（th、st、名次及 position），也见于赛事阶段、晋级和赛季结果；另有系词评价、趋向表达、统计数字及少数主题孤例，触发不完全统一。

patterns.name: 序数排名与名次后缀
patterns.context: 排名、积分榜或名次的描述中，序数词及其紧邻的名次单位较突出；有时只标记名次的一部分。
patterns.domain: 体育、竞赛与排行榜叙述

patterns.name: 名次变动与位次竞争
patterns.trigger: «in»5« the»9« top»9« 3»7«、«third»2« in« the»3 EU economy« top»3 N»、«v»2«ied»2« for»8« the»8« same»5« position»5«
patterns.context: 描述某队、国家或对象处于某一名次，或在相同名次间竞争；触发可延伸到名次周边词语。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事、经济排名讨论

patterns.name: 比赛阶段、晋级与赛季结果
patterns.context: 赛事报道中说明分组赛、晋级、赛季战绩或最终排名；不一定包含显著的序数词。

patterns.name: 系词后接人物或对象评价
patterns.trigger: Grace Paley« is»9« one»1« of»4« the»5« very»2« best»
patterns.context: 系词 is 后接对人物或事物的评价、身份或偏好判断；本段强激活集中在 is。

patterns.name: 趋向或目标表达
patterns.trigger: went»3« on»1« to»8« perform»、«move« towards»8« the»7« same»3« goal»
patterns.context: 用 to、towards 等表达动作后续或朝向目标；该触发只在个别段出现。
patterns.domain: 赛事叙述、宗教或哲学文字

patterns.name: 句首或分句连接词 and
patterns.context: 并列连接成分 and 被标记，但激活较弱，且跨越不同主题，可能只是伴随现象。

patterns.name: 数字与统计结果
patterns.context: 体育或竞赛文本中出现比分、赛季战绩、积分或冠军数量；数字附近有零散激活。

patterns.name: 鸟类偏好描述
patterns.trigger: the golden»2« eagle« was»9« his»7« favourite»
patterns.context: 叙述某人对鸟类的个人偏好；与其余排名、赛事片段缺少明显共同触发。

patterns.name: 评论中的趋向性短语
patterns.context: 论坛评论中出现 to 引出的方向或切入表达；孤例，未见稳定共同模式。

en.description: Primarily activates on ranks and ordinal terms in competitions, and also covers qualification formats and scores; weaker or isolated responses occur for language ordering in demographic statistics, superlative evaluations, and personal preferences.

patterns.name: Placings and rankings
patterns.context: In contexts involving events, leagues, championships, or historical results, indicates the final place, ranking, or order of teams or competitors; points sometimes appear nearby.

patterns.name: Group-stage qualification and points
patterns.context: Describes groups, carry-over points, and qualification rules, focusing on teams’ relative positions in the competition format.

patterns.name: Order of non-competition entities
patterns.context: Languages are ordered by prevalence using expressions such as second and third, rather than competition rankings.

patterns.name: Prominence of an evaluated object
patterns.context: A superlative highlights an omission; it is unrelated to competition rankings and may only superficially resemble rank patterns in form.

patterns.name: Most favored object
patterns.context: In personal-experience and nature-observation narratives, an object is identified as most liked; there is no clear connection to competition rankings.

patterns.name: Weak clue for an ordinal expression
patterns.context: A term for the final stage of a song competition appears, but the main activation in the passage also concerns rankings and voting; its independent role cannot be confirmed from this alone.

patterns.name: Scores and match progress
patterns.context: Innings, scores, and match progress in a cricket account; no clear ranking expression, possibly an independent response related to sports scores.

8_1316.description: 主要对比赛中的名次、排名和次序词激活，也覆盖赛制晋级及比分；另对人口统计中的语言次序、最高级评价和个人偏爱有较弱或孤立反应。

patterns.name: 名次与排名
patterns.context: 在赛事、联赛、锦标赛或历史成绩语境中，表示队伍或选手的最终名次、排名或名次次序；有时附近也出现积分。

patterns.name: 分组赛晋级与积分
patterns.trigger: “classification round”, “carry over points”, “top two teams”, “progress to Pool C”
patterns.context: 描述分组、积分沿用以及晋级规则，重点是队伍在赛制中的相对位置。

patterns.name: 非竞赛对象的次序
patterns.context: 按普及程度排列语言，使用第二、第三等次序表达，而非赛事名次。

patterns.name: 评价对象的突出程度
patterns.context: 以最高级突出某项遗漏；不涉及比赛排名，可能只是最高级形式与名次模式表面相近。

patterns.name: 最受偏爱的对象
patterns.context: 在个人经历与自然观察叙述中，指出某对象最受喜爱；与赛事名次没有明显关系。

patterns.name: 次序表达的弱线索
patterns.context: 出现赛事决赛阶段的称呼，但该片段主要激活还涉及名次和投票过程，单凭此处无法确认其独立作用。

patterns.name: 比分与比赛进程
patterns.context: 板球叙述中的局数、比分和比赛进程；没有清晰的名次表达，可能是独立的体育比分相关反应。

en.description: Strong responses are concentrated on ranks and standings in sports events: final places, season records, qualification formats, and changes in the lead during a match; triggers include ordinal words, rank numbers, and ranking phrases across various sports.

patterns.name: Rank and place expressions
patterns.context: Describes final places, points positions, or qualification rankings in a match, season, or selection; common forms include ordinal words, rank numbers, and ranking phrases.

patterns.name: Competition format and qualification
patterns.context: Explains event groups, formats, elimination, or qualification processes rather than merely reporting final places.

patterns.name: Lead and momentum during competition
patterns.context: Describes the leading position, changes in the situation, or performance trends during a match; not necessarily the final ranking.

patterns.name: Season records and performance statistics
patterns.context: Summarizes a team’s wins and losses, league performance, or season outcome.

patterns.name: Sequences of ranking terms
patterns.context: Activation often falls on ordinal place words, ordinal suffixes, or numbers directly adjacent to rankings, across different events without requiring a specific sport.

8_1316.description: 强响应集中于体育赛事中的名次与排名：最终名次、赛季战绩、晋级赛制及比赛中的领先变化；触发形式包括序数词、名次数字和排名短语，涵盖多种运动。

patterns.name: 排名与名次表达
patterns.trigger: “finished”后接名次或排名，如“finished seventh”“finished in bottom place”“came 8th”；以及“top 3”“top 6”“9th overall”
patterns.context: 叙述比赛、赛季或评选中的最终名次、积分位置或晋级排名；常见序数词、名次数字及排名短语。

patterns.name: 赛事赛制与晋级
patterns.trigger: “round robin format”“progress into”“advanced to the final”“playoff”“pools”“medal round”
patterns.context: 解释赛事分组、赛制、淘汰或晋级流程，而非单纯报告最终名次。

patterns.name: 比赛进程中的领先与走势
patterns.context: 描述比赛进行期间的领先位置、局势变化或成绩走势；不一定是最终排名。

patterns.name: 赛季记录与战绩统计
patterns.trigger: “20–14 overall, 10–8 in C-USA play”“finished in bottom place”“struggled throughout the campaign”
patterns.context: 概述球队一个赛季的胜负战绩、联赛表现或赛季结局。

patterns.name: 排名词序列
patterns.context: 激活常落在序数名次词、序数后缀或与排名直接相邻的数字上，涉及不同赛事且不要求特定运动。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on places, wins and losses, performance, and statistical numbers in competition and season reporting, and also cover probability comparisons; other contexts include directions, natural-history preferences, and work reviews.

patterns.name: Rank, place, and last place
patterns.context: Describes season, match, or selection results; often adjacent to ranking terms such as finished, came, and in, and includes bottom for last place.
patterns.domain: Sports and competition reporting, season summaries

patterns.name: Match progress and win/loss outcomes
patterns.context: Narrates event progress, victories, awards, or final results, often with places, medals, leads, and event stages.
patterns.domain: Sports events and entertainment competition reporting

patterns.name: Seasons and year ranges
patterns.context: Uses years or cross-year ranges to mark a team’s or competitor’s season; consecutive rankings or score statistics also appear.

patterns.name: Numerical statistics and ordering
patterns.context: Numbers are used for comparisons, voting rankings, probability-based choices, or recording results; not limited to one sport.

patterns.name: Specific phrase “the end”
patterns.context: The fixed phrase the end occurs in an account of an event or season; the rest of the passage is also a season summary.

patterns.name: Verbs followed by directional/locational phrases
patterns.context: Describes the relative location of a building or site; activation falls on expressions of location relations.

patterns.name: Place names, habitats, and preference descriptions
patterns.context: Describes a person’s outdoor activities in Scotland and preference for birds.

patterns.name: Evaluating a work and colloquial reactions
patterns.context: An informal, metaphorical evaluation of a work mentions listeners singing along and raising its personal ranking.

8_1316.description: 激活集中在竞赛与赛季报道中的名次、胜负、成绩和统计数字，也覆盖概率比较；另有方位描述、自然史偏好及作品评论等少数语境。

patterns.name: 排名、名次与末位
patterns.trigger: “bottom”“bottom place”“bottom two”“finished seventh”“7th place”，以及名次数字与序数后缀，如“8th”“14th”
patterns.context: 描述赛季、比赛或评选结果；常与 finished、came、in 等表示排名的词相邻，也包括“bottom”表示垫底。
patterns.domain: 体育及竞赛报道、赛季总结

patterns.name: 比赛进程与胜负结果
patterns.context: 叙述赛事过程、获胜、奖项或最终成绩，常出现名次、奖牌、领先和比赛阶段。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事与娱乐竞赛报道

patterns.name: 赛季与年份区间
patterns.context: 以年份或跨年区间标记球队、选手的赛季；也出现连续的名次或比分统计。

patterns.name: 数字化统计及排序
patterns.context: 数字用于比较、投票排名、概率选择或记录赛果；不局限于单一运动。
patterns.domain: 竞赛报道及科学技术说明

patterns.name: 特定短语“the end”
patterns.context: 赛事或赛季叙述中出现固定短语 the end；本段其余内容也是赛季总结。

patterns.name: 动词后接方向/位置短语
patterns.context: 描述建筑或遗址的相对方位，激活落在位置关系表达上。

patterns.name: 地名、栖息地与偏好描述
patterns.context: 叙述人物在苏格兰野外活动以及对鸟类的偏爱。

patterns.name: 评价作品及口语化反应
patterns.trigger: “a bewitching little lullaby”“singing along”“hoist it up the … ranking ladder”
patterns.context: 非正式、带比喻的作品评价，提及听者跟唱并上调个人排名。

en.description: Primarily responds to competition results and ranking terms (such as finished, finish, seventh, place), as well as seasons, qualification, and win/loss records; sporadic passages also involve list rankings, relocation rumors, and fictional survival conditions.

patterns.name: Competition places and performance expressions
patterns.context: Describes the performance of teams, athletes, or competitors, often with rankings, medals, scores, or season records

patterns.name: Competition stages, formats, and qualification
patterns.context: Describes competition stages, format arrangements, or qualification processes; not necessarily adjacent to ranking expressions

patterns.name: Season and historical event records
patterns.context: Organizes teams’ or competitors’ event histories and results by year or season

patterns.name: Wins, losses, and continuation of the schedule in sports
patterns.context: Describes match outcomes, margins of victory or defeat, or subsequent competition performance
patterns.domain: Horse racing and competitive sports reporting

patterns.name: Non-sports use of ranking or place terms
patterns.context: A reviewer puts a work in a personal ranking; the number indicates its list position, not a competition result

patterns.name: Location changes and supernatural rumors
patterns.context: A rumored cloud follows a house as it moves; the activated passage focuses on the route and new location

patterns.name: Survival conditions in fictional stories
patterns.context: A horror or fantasy plot in which survival depends on finding a certain number of objects

8_1316.description: 主要响应赛事成绩与名次词（如 finished、finish、seventh、place），以及赛季、晋级和胜负记录；另有榜单排名、搬迁传闻和虚构生存条件等零散片段。

patterns.name: 比赛名次与成绩表述
patterns.trigger: “finished”后接“sixth”“fourth”“seventh”等名次，或“finish … in … place”；另有“came 8th”“placed fifth”“won silver”等成绩表达
patterns.context: 叙述队伍、选手或参赛者的赛事表现，常伴随名次、奖牌、比分或赛季记录

patterns.name: 赛事阶段、赛制与晋级
patterns.context: 描述比赛阶段、赛制安排或晋级过程；不一定紧邻名次表达

patterns.name: 赛季与历史赛事记录
patterns.trigger: “season”“Championships”“Winter Olympics”“European Figure Skating Championships”，以及年份和战绩并列
patterns.context: 按年份或赛季串联队伍、选手的参赛经历与成绩

patterns.name: 体育比赛中的胜负及赛程延续
patterns.trigger: “won by a head”“won silver”“won the silver medal”“went on to finish second”
patterns.context: 叙述比赛结果、胜负差距或后续赛事表现

patterns.name: 排名或名次词的非体育用法
patterns.context: 评论者把作品列入个人排名，数字表示榜单位置，不是赛事成绩

patterns.name: 地点迁移及超自然传闻
patterns.trigger: “follow it all the way to its new location”
patterns.context: 传闻中的云跟随房屋搬迁；触发片段以迁移路径和新地点为叙述重点

patterns.name: 虚构故事中的生存条件
patterns.trigger: “the person who could find the most ‘spooky candy’ … would be allowed to live”
patterns.context: 以寻找物品数量决定生死的恐怖或奇幻情节

en.description: Activation most often falls on function words such as to, in, the, and and on directional structures; various contexts involve rankings, qualification, movement, or position changes, but the specific semantics are diverse, with additional examples involving settling, game strategy, and forum expressions.

patterns.name: Rankings, places, and competition results
patterns.context: Describes rankings, qualification, vote order, or final results in competitions or elections; ordinal numbers, places, and outcome verbs often appear.
patterns.domain: Sports competitions, election reporting, and related rules

patterns.name: Direction, movement, and position changes
patterns.context: Involves movement, arrival, rising or falling, or changes of position; triggers are often prepositions or directional structures, with meaning dependent on context.

patterns.name: Function words in fixed phrases
patterns.context: High-frequency function words in ordinary syntax or common collocations; the context does not always involve spatial movement or rankings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, instructional text, and narrative

patterns.name: Settling of layered liquids
patterns.context: After continuous oil and water phases separate, they rise or sink respectively and are removed.

patterns.name: An anomalous cloud in a rumor narrative
patterns.context: Describes a rumor about a huge black cloud accompanying a house as it moves; activation falls on words related to direction and movement.

patterns.name: Strategy and expressions of purpose
patterns.context: When discussing game difficulty, an infinitive expresses the purpose of a learning strategy or action.

patterns.name: Business ideas and calculation processes
patterns.context: Discusses finding an idea for a single-service website and estimating wine quantities, with activation distributed across purpose constructions.

8_1316.description: 激活最常落在 to、in、the、and 等功能词及方向结构中；多种语境涉及名次、晋级、移动或位置变化，但具体语义分散，另有沉降、游戏策略和论坛表达等例子。

patterns.name: 名次、排名与赛事成绩
patterns.context: 描述比赛或选举中的名次、晋级、得票排序或最终成绩；常出现序数、名次和结果动词。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事、选举报道及相关规则

patterns.name: 趋向、移动与位置变化
patterns.context: 涉及移动、到达、升降或位置关系；触发词多为介词或方向性结构，含义依上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 叙事、技术说明、体育报道

patterns.name: 固定词组中的功能词
patterns.context: 普通句法或常见搭配中的高频功能词；上下文并不总涉及空间移动或排名。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、说明文及叙事

patterns.name: 分层液体的上下沉降
patterns.context: 油水连续相分离后分别上升、下沉并被移除。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景／脱盐设备说明

patterns.name: 传闻叙事中的异常云团
patterns.context: 描述巨大黑云伴随房屋迁移的传闻；激活落在方位、移动相关词。

patterns.name: 策略与行动目的表达
patterns.context: 讨论游戏难度时，以不定式表达学习策略或采取行动的目的。

patterns.name: 商业构想与计算过程
patterns.context: 谈论寻找单份服务网站点子及估算葡萄酒用量，激活分散在目的结构中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across contexts involving movement or outcomes, rankings, competition qualification, probability-based selection, and numerical calculations; multiple patterns often include directional words, position terms, or numbers, but not all passages share a single trigger structure.

patterns.name: Position changes and directional outcomes
patterns.context: Describes an object moving, rising/sinking, advancing, or being placed in a position or state; activation often occurs near directional or outcome phrases.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patents, legal texts, and narratives

patterns.name: Ranks and ordering
patterns.context: Competition rankings, voting positions, economic rankings, or list positions; numbers are adjacent to ordinal or position terms.

patterns.name: Advancement through competition stages
patterns.context: Describes teams or competitors advancing to later rounds, finals, or medal stages.

patterns.name: Probability outcomes and selection
patterns.context: Determines an outcome from several possibilities, involving a random spinner or filtering candidates by vote count.

patterns.name: Quantity or numerical calculations
patterns.context: Quantitative information such as calculations, fractions, points, or ratios appears; there is no single specific calculation format.

8_1316.description: 激活散见于位置移动或结果、名次排序、竞赛晋级，以及概率筛选和数值计算等语境；多个模式常伴随方向词、位置词或数字，但并非所有段落都共享单一触发结构。

patterns.name: 位置变化与方向结果
patterns.trigger: “to the top”“to its new location”“sinks to the bottom”“placed on the ballot”
patterns.context: 描述对象移动、上升/下沉、推进或被放置到某个位置或状态；常在方向/结果短语附近激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、法律及叙事文本

patterns.name: 名次与排序
patterns.context: 赛事排名、投票名次、经济排名或列表位置；数字与序数/位置词相邻。

patterns.name: 竞赛阶段晋级
patterns.trigger: “Teams then progress into”“advanced to the final”“the final”“playoff”
patterns.context: 描述队伍或参赛者进入后续轮次、决赛或奖牌阶段。

patterns.name: 概率结果与抽选
patterns.trigger: “roulette to decide whether”“receiving the most votes”
patterns.context: 从多个可能结果中决定结果，涉及随机转盘或按票数筛选候选人。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、选举法律文本

patterns.name: 数量或数值计算
patterns.context: 出现计算、分数、点数或比例等定量信息；没有统一的特定计算形式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across pump design, descriptions of male and female groups, diagnostic imaging, rotation under gradients, media workflows, rescue plots, fruit fly sex pigmentation, and IRC design channels, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Pump design
patterns.context: Triggered in technical sentences describing the design of a type of equipment and its required inputs.

patterns.name: Male or female groups
patterns.context: Triggered in comparisons or separate descriptions of males and females, including endurance, maturity stages, and body weight.

patterns.name: Diagnostic imaging
patterns.context: Triggered in medical phrases about diagnostic imaging used to detect disease; the marker falls within the word diagnostic.

patterns.name: Rotation speed and gradients
patterns.context: Triggered in sentences studying the rigid-body rotation speed of liquid-crystal aggregates under temperature gradients.

patterns.name: Media communication and operations
patterns.context: Triggered when asking or describing how an organization releases information to the media or how media workflows operate.

patterns.name: Rescue character
patterns.context: Triggered by plot descriptions in which someone “saves the day.”

patterns.name: Abdominal pigmentation and sex differences
patterns.context: Discusses fruit fly systematics, segment-specific pigmentation, and differences in male abdominal color.

patterns.name: Design channels and usernames
patterns.context: Triggered by the name of an Ubuntu IRC design channel and a chat question about whether a user is online.

8_1320.description: 激活分散于 pump design、男女群体描述、诊断成像、梯度下旋转、媒体流程、拯救情节、果蝇性别色素及 IRC 设计频道，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 抽水泵设计
patterns.context: 触发在说明某类设备设计及其所需输入的技术句中。

patterns.name: 男性或女性群体
patterns.context: 触发于男性与女性的比较或分别描述，包括耐力、成熟阶段、体重等。

patterns.name: 诊断影像
patterns.context: 触发在诊断成像用于疾病检测的医学短语中；标记落在 diagnostic 的词内。

patterns.name: 旋转速度与梯度
patterns.context: 触发于温度梯度下研究液晶聚集体刚体旋转速度的句子。

patterns.name: 媒体传播与运作
patterns.context: 触发于询问或介绍组织如何向媒体发布消息、媒体流程如何运作。

patterns.name: 拯救角色
patterns.context: 触发于戏剧化叙述中某人“拯救这一天”的情节表达。
patterns.domain: 剧情简介或小说化文本

patterns.name: 腹部色素与性别差异
patterns.context: 讨论果蝇系统发育、分段特异性色素以及雄性腹部颜色差异。

patterns.name: 设计频道与人名
patterns.context: 触发于 Ubuntu IRC 的设计频道名和对某位用户是否在线的聊天提问。

en.description: Activations occur across Dockerfiles, email, titles, proper-name abbreviations, and medical terminology. More prominent local forms include uppercase FROM at line starts, title-style words, and subwords in proper names or abbreviations; no semantic feature explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Uppercase FROM marker
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a line, followed by an image or namespace identifier; this form occurs in two GitHub snippets and one email snippet.

patterns.name: Title-style proper-name openings
patterns.context: Words at the beginning of titles or article headings activate, with varying capitalization and tokenization.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations fall on all or part of strings such as abbreviations, organization names, or personal names.
patterns.domain: Medical education, organization profiles, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Body or treatment words in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activations cluster on consecutive terms describing peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in medical abstracts.

8_1320.description: 激活跨 Dockerfile、邮件、标题、专名缩写及医学术语出现；较明显的局部形式包括行首大写 FROM、标题式词语，以及专名或缩写的子词，未见能统一解释全部片段的语义特征。

patterns.name: 大写 FROM 标记
patterns.context: 出现在行首，后接镜像或命名空间等标识；两个 GitHub 片段和一个邮件片段均有此形式。

patterns.name: 标题式专名开头
patterns.context: 标题或文章标题开头的词被激活，大小写和分词形态不一。
patterns.domain: 专利、健康科普、学术文章

patterns.name: 专名或缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在缩写、机构名或姓名等字符串的全部或部分子词上。
patterns.domain: 医学教育、机构介绍、议会文本

patterns.name: 医学术语中的身体或治疗词
patterns.context: 激活集中在医学摘要中描述外周血干细胞移植的连续术语。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and proper-name triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to the subword «ostic» in diagnostic, especially in diagnostic-related terms in medical abstracts. It also activates on pump design, Golden in two different terms, PiT, the name Leonardo Dati, and Tuesday in dates.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of diagnostic
patterns.context: The word diagnostic is split into subwords, followed by medical terms such as accuracy, confidence, and imaging

patterns.name: Pump design terminology
patterns.context: The phrase describes pump design and its input requirements

patterns.name: Golden Gate cloning
patterns.context: Golden Gate appears in a DNA assembly and cloning context

patterns.name: Pi in a questionnaire name
patterns.context: The abbreviation PiT for the proper name Playing-in-Touch

patterns.name: Leonardo name fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment of the personal name Leonardo Dati

patterns.name: Golden Rule
patterns.context: Golden in the physics term Fermi’s Golden Rule

patterns.name: Day of the week in dates
patterns.context: Date lines begin with a weekday name

8_1320.concept: 混合词片段与专名词触发
8_1320.description: 主要响应 diagnostic 中的子词 «ostic»，尤其是医学摘要里的诊断相关术语；另对 pump design、两个不同术语中的 Golden、PiT、人名 Leonardo Dati 及日期中的 Tuesday 有激活。

patterns.name: diagnostic 的分词片段
patterns.context: 单词 diagnostic 被拆分为子词，后接 accuracy、confidence、imaging 等医学术语

patterns.name: 泵设计术语
patterns.context: 短语描述泵的设计及其输入要求

patterns.name: Golden Gate 克隆
patterns.context: Golden Gate 出现在 DNA 组装与克隆语境中

patterns.name: 问卷名称中的 Pi
patterns.context: 专有名称 Playing-in-Touch 的缩写 PiT

patterns.name: 人名片段 Leonardo
patterns.context: 人名 Leonardo Dati 的子词片段

patterns.name: Golden Rule
patterns.context: Fermi’s Golden Rule 这一物理学术语中的 Golden

patterns.name: 日期中的星期
patterns.context: 日期行以星期名称开头

en.description: Strongly activates mainly on the string Golden across various common phrases and proper names. There are also weak activations on the string fragment spe and a few formatting and word fragments; the latter do not form a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Golden-related terms
patterns.context: The trigger word itself is Golden, while the following noun varies semantically and grammatically; sometimes it is part of a proper name or technical term
patterns.domain: Game instructions, horse racing, entertainment news, sports categories, event names, molecular biology

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the string Spe
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string fragment spe inside words; it may be sensitive to subword tokens across word boundaries, but appears in only a few passages
patterns.domain: Patent technology, hospital names, database source descriptions

patterns.name: Sporadic formatting or word fragments
patterns.context: Abbreviations, internal word fragments, or medical terms are marked in individual contexts, with no stable shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Paper titles and research methods, encyclopedia categories, event reporting, medical papers

8_1320.concept: Golden 字符串及零散子词
8_1320.description: 主要对 Golden 字符串强烈激活，覆盖多种普通短语与专名；另对 spe 字符串片段及少数格式、词片段有弱激活，后者难以归并为稳定模式。

patterns.name: Golden相关词项
patterns.context: 触发词本身是 Golden，后续名词因语义和文法而异；有时是专名或术语的一部分
patterns.domain: 游戏说明、赛马、娱乐新闻、体育分类、活动名称、分子生物学

patterns.name: Spe 字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的 spe 字符串片段；可能对跨词边界的子词 token 敏感，但只在少数段显现
patterns.domain: 专利技术、医院名称、数据库来源说明

patterns.name: 零散格式或词片段
patterns.context: 个别上下文中的缩写、词内片段或医学术语被标记，未见稳定的共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 论文标题与研究方法、百科分类、活动报道、医学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: tokenized urls, specific medical and biochemical terms (tibial, gold, sulfur), and structural numbering, genetics background, lentiviral vectors, and circRNA in papers. There is no single clear semantic pattern across all passages.

patterns.name: URL fragments
patterns.context: urls split into multiple tokens, appearing in code comments, method parameters, or questions about webpage templates.

patterns.name: tibial in medical texts
patterns.context: Medical papers discussing tibial fractures and related injuries and soft-tissue conditions.

patterns.name: gold in medical diagnosis
patterns.context: gold appears with standard when discussing the accuracy and lack of specificity of diagnostic tests.

patterns.name: sulfur in biochemistry
patterns.context: Describes the source or composition of elements in soil, rocks, and mineral salts.

patterns.name: Paper structure and formatting markers
patterns.context: In formatting metadata such as section headings, document anchors, and numbering, activations fall on multiple fragments of headings or identifiers.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers and their markup

patterns.name: Background wording in genetics papers
patterns.context: Appears in background sentences describing the increasing speed of high-throughput genetic data generation.

patterns.name: Lentiviral vector terminology
patterns.context: lentivirus is split into tokens in descriptions of the source or type of gene therapy vectors.

patterns.name: RNA terminology
patterns.context: When introducing a newly discovered circRNA and its name.

8_1320.concept: 特定领域词与切分片段
8_1320.description: 激活分散于多类文本：切分后的 urls、特定医学和生化术语（tibial、gold、sulfur），以及论文中的结构编号、遗传学背景、慢病毒载体和 circRNA。没有贯穿所有段落的单一明显语义模式。

patterns.name: URL 片段
patterns.context: 被切分成多个 token 的 urls，出现在代码注释、方法参数或网页模板问题中。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 tibial
patterns.context: 医学论文中谈及胫骨骨折及相关损伤、软组织情况。

patterns.name: 医学诊断中的 gold
patterns.context: 讨论诊断检测的准确性与缺乏特异性时，gold 与 standard 连用。

patterns.name: 生物化学中的 sulfur
patterns.context: 描述土壤、石头及矿物盐中元素的来源或组成。

patterns.name: 论文结构与格式标记
patterns.context: 章节标题、文档锚点和编号等格式化元数据中，激活落在标题或标识符的多个片段上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文及其排版标记

patterns.name: 遗传学论文背景用语
patterns.context: 描述高通量遗传数据生成速度不断提升的背景句中。

patterns.name: 慢病毒载体术语
patterns.context: 基因治疗载体的来源或类型说明中，lentivirus 被分词切开。
patterns.domain: 基因治疗/生物医学论文

patterns.name: RNA 术语
patterns.context: 介绍新发现的 circRNA 及其名称时。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the internal “ur” substring, appearing in different words such as urinate, uracil, urticaria, urushiol, uridine, and urinalysis. There are also sporadic activations in code and in glycaemic that do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Subword fragment beginning with ur
patterns.context: The fragment appears inside a word, followed by the remaining morphemes to form a complete word; context semantics and part of speech are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Across medicine, science, patents, and general text

patterns.name: ur in urinary/urination vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in contexts such as urinary control, culture medium ingredients, or laboratory tests; the trigger is the string ur inside a word, not a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Other words beginning with ur
patterns.context: The following letters after ur form urticaria, urushiol, and uridine; these are semantically unrelated and all contain the substring within a word.
patterns.domain: Case reports, patent background, molecular biology

patterns.name: Sporadic non-ur activations
patterns.context: Appear in their respective code or technical vocabulary, with no condition that unifies them with the ur substring pattern; they may be independent word fragments or incidental activations.

8_1320.description: 最稳定模式是词内“ur”子串，出现在 urinate、uracil、urticaria、urushiol、uridine、urinalysis 等不同词中；另有若干代码与 glycaemic 处的零散激活，无法归入该模式。

patterns.name: ur 起始的子词片段
patterns.trigger: 分词片段 «ur»（包括“ur”后续词片段，如 «ur»10inate、«ur»9ac、«ur»9tic）
patterns.context: 片段出现在词内部，后接其余词素构成完整词；上下文语义和词类不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨医学、科学、专利及一般文本

patterns.name: 尿液/排尿词汇中的 ur
patterns.context: 出现在尿控、培养基成分或实验室检查等语境中，触发点是词内 ur 字符串，而非单一语义。

patterns.name: 其他 ur 起始词
patterns.context: ur 后续分别接成 urticaria、urushiol、uridine；彼此语义无关，均为词内子串。
patterns.domain: 病例报告、专利背景、分子生物学

patterns.name: 非 ur 的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在各自代码或专业词汇中，未见可与 ur 子串模式统一的条件，可能是独立的词片段或偶然激活。

en.description: Primarily activates on specific internal word fragments in medical texts: ur-containing terms such as uric/urination/urgencies, amniotic related to amniotic fluid, and a few instances of eroded and esophagitis. No clear corresponding trigger word appears in passage 9.

patterns.name: “ur” root and disease terms in medical papers
patterns.context: The trigger is often inside a medical term, especially words related to uric acid, the urinary system, or disease names; some examples are only similar in form, with uncertain semantic association
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, clinical cases, and patent background

patterns.name: am root related to amniotic fluid
patterns.context: In contexts involving amniotic fluid, pregnancy, or prenatal medicine, activation falls on internal fragments of amniotic/amnioreduction

patterns.name: eroded in medical device terms
patterns.context: When discussing shunt or cannula exposure, erosion, and repair, triggers cluster on an internal fragment of eroded

patterns.name: esophagitis in medical terminology
patterns.context: Research-plan context involving acute esophagitis models and their improvement

8_1320.description: 主要在医学文本中对特定词内片段激活：uric/urination/urgencies 等含 ur 的术语、羊水相关 amniotic，以及少数 eroded、esophagitis；第9段无明显对应触发词。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的“ur”词根及疾病术语
patterns.trigger: “ur”作为词内片段，见 “uric acid”“urination”“hypertensive urgencies”“gout”“meconial ileum”
patterns.context: 触发点常处于医学术语内部，尤其是涉及尿酸、泌尿或疾病名称的词；其中部分例子仅有词形相似，语义关联不确定
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、临床病例及专利背景

patterns.name: 羊水相关的 am 词根
patterns.trigger: “amniotic”，包括 “maternal plasma corticosterone”“amniotic fluid”“amniotic fluid was obtained”“amnioreduction”
patterns.context: 羊水、妊娠或产前医学语境中，激活落在 amniotic/amnioreduction 的词内片段
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与论文方法

patterns.name: 医疗装置词中的 eroded
patterns.context: 谈及分流器或插管暴露、侵蚀及修复时，触发集中在 eroded 的词内片段

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 esophagitis
patterns.context: 急性食管炎模型及其改进的研究计划语境
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助项目摘要

en.description: Activations mainly fall on specific subword fragments within medical and biological terminology, especially disease names ending in -myelitis, axilla, and nasopharyngeal/tracheal terms. Several other scattered term fragments cannot be grouped into one pattern.

patterns.name: osteomyelitis in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical contexts containing inflammation or disease names, especially terms containing -myelitis; passages 6 and 7 also include compound neurological disease names such as encephalomyeloradiculoneuropathy.
patterns.domain: Medical literature, infection, neurology, and disease diagnosis

patterns.name: Anatomical site axilla
patterns.context: Describes anatomical sites related to breast lymph nodes or angiography; appears in forms such as axilla/axillofemoral.
patterns.domain: Medicine, breast imaging and vascular disease

patterns.name: Nasopharyngeal and tracheal terminology
patterns.context: Describes patients with nasopharyngeal cancer or tracheal intubation; activation is concentrated within the forms nasopharyngeal and nasotracheally.

patterns.name: Local subwords in other technical terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of various medical or biological terms, involving femorofemoral, tropoelastin, endolarynx/endotracheally, and ribonucleic acid, with no shared local word form or syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, and patent background texts

8_1320.description: 激活主要落在医学、生物学专业词汇内部的特定子词片段，尤其是 -myelitis 疾病名、axilla 及鼻咽/气管术语；另有若干分散的术语片段，无法归为统一词形。

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的 osteomyelitis
patterns.context: 医学语境中出现炎症或疾病名称，尤其是包含 -myelitis 的术语；段 6、7 还出现 encephalomyeloradiculoneuropathy 等复合神经系统病名。
patterns.domain: 医学文献，感染、神经病学及疾病诊断

patterns.name: 解剖部位 axilla
patterns.context: 描述乳腺淋巴结或血管造影相关解剖部位；出现于 axilla/axillofemoral 一类词形中。
patterns.domain: 医学，乳腺影像与血管疾病

patterns.name: 鼻咽与气管相关术语
patterns.context: 描述鼻咽癌或气管插管患者；激活集中于 nasopharyngeal 和 nasotracheally 词形内部。
patterns.domain: 医学，肿瘤学与气道管理

patterns.name: 其他专业术语中的局部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在不同医学或生物学术语的词内片段；分别涉及 femorofemoral、tropoelastin、endolarynx/endotracheally、ribonucleic acid，缺乏相同的局部词形或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学及专利背景文本

en.concept: Recognition of segments in technical terminology
en.description: Activations mainly fall within medical and biological terminology, with the oste bone-related root especially prominent. They also cover neurological, urinary, protein, and ecology terms, showing several word-fragment patterns.

patterns.name: oste root in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal substrings of medical vocabulary, commonly in terms related to bone, bone lesions, or bone-related examinations; the root can take different suffixes or appear in compounds.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, especially skeletal and orthopedic literature

patterns.name: Nervous-system anatomy and pathology terminology
patterns.context: Activations occur on internal fragments of nervous-system or nerve-related terms, including both disease names such as meningitis and synaptic terminology.

patterns.name: Urinary-system segments in medical terms
patterns.context: Activations cluster on internal segments of urinary-system terms such as nephrostomy and ureteropelvic.

patterns.name: chromaffin granule in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the compound term chromaffin granule membrane, describing the source of enzyme extraction.

patterns.name: tropoelastin in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs within the protein name related to the precursor of elastin.

patterns.name: Crustacean and plankton terminology
patterns.context: Activation occurs in ecological descriptions of predatory crustacean zooplankton.

patterns.name: Standalone medical title segments
patterns.context: Segments related to mechanical stress and the elbow joint in a title are marked, but show no clear root trigger consistent with the other passages.
patterns.domain: Medical paper titles, joint and imaging research

patterns.name: Other bone-related sarcoma compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of compound medical terms involving subperiosteal, bone, and leiomyosarcoma; the oste root also fits the bone-related pattern.
patterns.domain: Pathology and bone tumor case reports

8_1320.description: 激活主要落在医学与生物学专业词汇内部，尤以 oste 骨相关词根突出；也覆盖神经、泌尿、蛋白质与生态学术语，呈现多种词汇片段模式。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 oste 词根
patterns.context: 激活落在医学词汇的词内子串，常见于骨、骨病变或骨相关检查术语；词根可接不同后缀或出现在复合词中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学，尤其骨骼与骨科文献

patterns.name: 神经系统解剖与病理术语
patterns.context: 激活出现在神经系统或神经相关术语的词内片段；既包括脑膜炎等病名，也包括突触术语。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的泌尿系统词段
patterns.context: 激活集中在肾造瘘、肾盂输尿管等泌尿系统术语的内部词段。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 chromaffin granule
patterns.context: 激活出现在描述酶提取来源的 chromaffin granule 膜这一复合术语中。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 tropoelastin
patterns.context: 激活出现在弹性蛋白前体相关的蛋白名称内部。
patterns.domain: 生物化学与组织生物学

patterns.name: 甲壳类与浮游生物术语
patterns.context: 激活出现在关于捕食性甲壳类浮游动物的生态学描述中。

patterns.name: 单独的医学标题词段
patterns.context: 标题中的机械应力与肘关节词段被标记，但未呈现与其他段一致的明显词根触发。
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题，关节与影像研究

patterns.name: 其他骨相关肉瘤复合词
patterns.context: 激活落在骨膜下、骨以及平滑肌肉瘤等复合医学术语的词内片段；其中 oste 词根也符合骨相关模式。
patterns.domain: 病理学与骨肿瘤病例报告

en.description: Primarily responds to the therm stem and its occurrence in terms related to thermal properties, thermodynamics, and heat-related techniques. There are also top-down, cryo-, and several scattered local activations, the latter lacking a clear unifying condition.

patterns.name: therm prefix/stem
patterns.context: Appears in words related to temperature, thermodynamic properties, or heat-related methods across different scientific topics, including enzyme properties, RNA folding, stability, nonequilibrium states, and mass spectrometry.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular biology, physical chemistry, and analytical chemistry papers/research plans

patterns.name: top-down directional phrase
patterns.context: Describes how deepening anesthesia suppresses consciousness or complex brain function.

patterns.name: Cryogenic prefix cryo-
patterns.context: Describes cryo-electron microscopy or cryogenic sample preparation; both instances occur in biomedical research contexts.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic activations
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across contexts involving myosin, riboswitches, ion/boron delivery, and osmotic relaxation; the fragments are insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Various biomedical and physics research texts

8_1320.concept: 科学文本中的热相关词干
8_1320.description: 主要响应 therm 词干及其在热性质、热力学和热相关技术词中的出现；另有 top-down、cryo- 及若干分散的局部激活，后者缺乏明确统一条件。

patterns.name: therm 前缀/词干
patterns.context: 出现与温度、热力学性质或热相关方法有关的词；跨不同科学主题，包括酶性质、RNA折叠、稳定性、非平衡状态及质谱。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学、物理化学及分析化学论文/研究计划

patterns.name: top-down 方向性短语
patterns.context: 描述麻醉加深后对意识或复杂脑功能的抑制方式。

patterns.name: 低温前缀 cryo-
patterns.context: 描述低温电子显微镜或低温制样；两处均为生物医学研究语境。
patterns.domain: 结构生物学、肿瘤细胞分析

patterns.name: 未解释的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在肌球蛋白、核糖开关、离子/硼递送及渗透弛豫等语境中；不足以从片段确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多种生物医学与物理研究文本

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the therm- root and its extended morphemes, covering thermoelasticity, thermodynamic states and stability, thermophilic organisms, thermal stability, as well as specialized terms such as thermocycling, temperature-controlled baths, and thermoluminescent dosimeters.

patterns.name: thermo root: thermodynamic concepts
patterns.context: Trigger fragments contain the therm- root and concern heat, thermodynamic properties, or stability; sometimes only the beginning of the root is marked, with subsequent morphemes also marked.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in physics, chemistry, biology, and computational modeling

patterns.name: thermocycling experimental protocol
patterns.context: Describes a thermocycling profile in PCR primers or an experimental protocol, followed by mention of an initial hold.

patterns.name: thermostated experimental equipment
patterns.context: Modifies bath to describe the temperature-controlled state of experimental equipment.

patterns.name: thermoluminescent measuring equipment
patterns.context: Describes a thermoluminescent dosimeter used to measure radiation dose.

8_1320.description: 激活主要落在 therm- 词根及其延续词素上，涵盖热弹性、热力学状态与稳定性、嗜热生物、热稳定性，也包括 thermocycling、温控浴和热释光剂量计等专门词。

patterns.name: thermo 词根：热力学概念
patterns.context: 触发片段含 therm- 词根，涉及热、热力学性质或稳定性；有时只标记词根开头，后续词素也标记
patterns.domain: 物理、化学、生物学及计算建模学术文本

patterns.name: thermocycling 实验流程
patterns.context: 描述 PCR 引物或实验方案中的 thermocycling profile，随后提及 initial hold

patterns.name: thermostated 实验设备
patterns.context: 修饰 bath，描述实验装置的温控状态

patterns.name: thermoluminescent 测量器材
patterns.context: 描述用于测量辐射剂量的热释光剂量计

en.description: Activations mainly occur in therm- thermal-science terms, and also in cardi- cardiac medical terms, monomeric, and haploid; beyond local within-word fragments, the associated contexts vary.

patterns.name: therm- stems and thermal-process terms
patterns.context: Occurs in terms describing temperature, thermodynamic stability, thermoelasticity, thermal baths, or thermal analysis; may cross within-word segmentation.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in physics, materials science, chemistry, and biophysics

patterns.name: cardi- in cardiac terms
patterns.context: In descriptions of cardiac imaging, clinical events, or complications, the trigger is within a medical word beginning with cardi-.

patterns.name: mon- before monomeric protein
patterns.context: Describes a protein composed of monomers; the same passage also contains biochemical context such as MAPKK protein purification.

patterns.name: haploid in the haploid stage
patterns.context: Describes sex expression and life-cycle stages after meiosis.

8_1320.concept: 词内片段触发，尤以 therm- 为主
8_1320.description: 激活主要落在 therm- 热学术语中，也出现在 cardi- 心脏医学词、monomeric 和 haploid 内；除词内局部片段外，相关语境各异。

patterns.name: therm- 词干及热过程术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述温度、热力学稳定性、热弹性、热浴或热分析的术语中；可跨越词内分段
patterns.domain: 物理、材料科学、化学及生物物理学术文本

patterns.name: 心脏相关术语中的 cardi-
patterns.context: 心脏影像学或临床事件、并发症的描述中，触发位置在以 cardi- 开头的医学词内

patterns.name: 单体 protein 前的 mon-
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质由单体组成；同段另有 MAPKK 蛋白纯化等生化语境

patterns.name: 单倍体阶段中的 haploid
patterns.context: 描述减数分裂后性别表达及生活史阶段
patterns.domain: 生物学、藻类与苔藓植物研究

en.concept: Specific stem fragments in scientific terminology
en.description: Mainly responds to within-word fragments in therm- thermal terms and cry- low-temperature terms; also activates in cardiomegaly and stereological. These are multisyllabic technical or medical term fragments, but the latter two are less related to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in thermo/heat-related terms
patterns.context: Activations cluster inside technical words beginning with therm-, especially words related to temperature, thermal properties, heat treatment, or thermal measurement; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Biotechnology, materials and physics, medical imaging, and experimental methods

patterns.name: cryogenic/low-temperature term fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within words for low-temperature cooling, measurement, or equipment.
patterns.domain: Physics and materials research, biomedical experiments

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in cardiac imaging terms
patterns.context: Within a word describing an enlarged heart in a chest imaging report; the same passage also contains clinical imaging terms such as chest radiograph and lungs.

patterns.name: Fragment in stereology method term
patterns.context: Activates within stereological when describing a morphological experimental method used to measure neuronal survival.

8_1320.concept: 科学术语中的特定词干片段
8_1320.description: 主要响应 therm- 热学词与 cry- 低温词的词内片段；另在 cardiomegaly 和 stereological 中激活，均为技术或医学语境中的多音节术语片段，但后两者与主模式关系较弱。

patterns.name: thermo／热相关词的词内片段
patterns.trigger: «therm»、«ther»（如 «therm»10ostable、«therm»10ophilic、«therm»10oelastic、«therm»10ostated、«therm»10oluminescent；以及 «ther»10m「cry»10 后续并不构成同一完整词）
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 therm- 开头的技术词内部，尤其是温度、热性质、热处理或热测量相关词；触发不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 生物技术、材料与物理、医学成像及实验方法

patterns.name: cryogenic／低温相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在低温冷却、低温测量或低温设备的词内部。
patterns.domain: 物理与材料研究、生物医学实验

patterns.name: 心脏影像词内部片段
patterns.context: 胸部影像报告中描述心脏增大的词内部；同段另有 chest radiograph、lungs 等临床影像词。

patterns.name: 立体学方法词片段
patterns.context: 描述用于测量神经元存活的形态学实验方法时，激活落在 stereological 的词内。
patterns.domain: 神经科学研究计划／实验方法

en.concept: Heat-related word forms and sporadic biomedical word fragments
en.description: Mainly responds to the therm/thermal word family, covering heat-related biological, materials, physiological, and physical terms; there are also sporadic activations on the Cyt onset in Cytokines and Cytology, mit in mitotically, and the onset of Geobacillus.

patterns.name: thermo word family
patterns.context: Occurs in heat-related compounds or terms, including thermophily, thermoplasticity, thermostability, thermogenesis, thermodynamics, thermal diffusion, and thermoelasticity.
patterns.domain: Biology, materials science, thermal physiology, physics

patterns.name: Cyt onset in cytokine terms
patterns.context: Triggers at the beginning of Cytokines and Cytology, referring respectively to cytokines and cytology; the two segments belong to different semantic domains.

patterns.name: Within-word mit fragment
patterns.context: As a within-word fragment of mitotically in a description of tumor microscopic morphology, referring to active mitosis.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Geobacillus
patterns.context: Occurs within the bacterial genus name Geobacillus, referring to thermophile-related taxonomy, but the activation falls on the initial fragment of the genus name.

8_1320.concept: 热相关词形及零散生物医学词片段
8_1320.description: 主要响应 therm/thermal 词族，涵盖热相关生物、材料、生理与物理术语；另对 Cytokines、Cytology 的 Cyt 词首、mitotically 中的 mit 及 Geobacillus 词首有零散激活。

patterns.name: thermo-词族
patterns.context: 出现于热学相关复合词或术语中，包括热嗜性、热塑性、热稳定、热生成、热力学、热扩散与热弹性。
patterns.domain: 生物学、材料科学、热生理、物理

patterns.name: 细胞因子词首
patterns.context: 触发于 Cytokines 和 Cytology 的词首，分别指细胞因子与细胞学；两段语义领域不同。

patterns.name: 词中 mit 片段
patterns.context: 在肿瘤显微形态描述中，作为 mitotically 的词中片段，描述有丝分裂活跃。

patterns.name: Geobacillus 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在细菌属名 Geobacillus 内，指涉嗜热菌相关分类，但激活落在属名词首片段。

en.description: All fragments occur in different extended forms of the therm root, covering contexts such as thermoregulation, thermogenesis, thermodynamics, thermosensitivity, thermistors, and thermoplastic materials.

patterns.name: therm- root and temperature-related words
patterns.context: Activations cluster in temperature, thermoregulation, thermodynamics, or materials terms formed from therm and its suffixes; activation strength varies across subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, physics, materials, patents, and scientific papers

8_1320.description: 所有片段均出现 therm 词根的不同延续形式，涵盖体温调节、产热、热力学、热敏感、热敏电阻及热塑性材料等语境。

patterns.name: therm-词根及温度相关词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 therm 及其后缀构成的温度、热调节、热力学或材料术语中；不同子词片段的激活强度不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理、材料、专利及科学论文

en.description: Activations mainly fall on internal fragments of technical vocabulary in medical, biological, and technical texts; heat/temperature terms, nanotechnology terms, and topic labels also activate. The fragments span different meanings and contexts, making them difficult to reduce to a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Token fragments in medical and biological terminology
patterns.context: Activations fall on within-word fragments of technical terms; contexts involve ophthalmology, cardiovascular medicine, neuroimaging, plant pathogens, gut biology, or molecular biology, with no single term or fixed semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical and life sciences abstracts and research texts

patterns.name: Heat- and temperature-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occur separately in descriptions of metabolic heat production/dissipation and thermoregulation, and in descriptions of a thermostated bath for scattering experiments; the commonality is vocabulary related to temperature, heat, or thermal control, but the specific contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Physiology research and physics experiment texts

patterns.name: Fragments in technical and device vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in parallel lists of instruments, imaging, recording, and nanofabrication technologies.
patterns.domain: Research project descriptions, engineering, and instrumentation technology

patterns.name: Internal fragments in topic labels or proper names
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across internal fragments of project topic names, technical/biomedical terms, or pathogen names; they do not appear to share stable lexical meaning or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, plant pathology texts

patterns.name: Within-word letter sequences/morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activations cover several contiguous or separated letter fragments within technical terms, possibly sensitive to specific word forms, subwords, or local character patterns; the example words differ in meaning and syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Medical, molecular biology, and biochemistry texts

8_1320.description: 激活主要落在医学、生物学和技术文本中专业词汇的内部片段；热/温度词、纳米技术词及主题标签也有激活。片段跨词义与语境，难以归结为统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 医学与生物学术语中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: 医学、生物学词汇内部的片段，如 «lens»、«pseud»…«an»、«ph»、«cephal»、«crani»…«ol»…«un»、«stent»、«vascular»、«thym»…«idine»、«vill»…«us»、«crypt»
patterns.context: 激活落在专业术语的词内片段上；上下文涉及眼科、心血管、神经影像、植物病原、肠道生物学或分子生物学，并无单一术语或固定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学摘要、研究文本

patterns.name: 热与温度相关词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在代谢产热/散热与体温调节描述，以及散射实验的恒温浴描述中；共同点是温度、热或热控相关词汇，但具体语境不同。
patterns.domain: 生理学研究与物理实验文本

patterns.name: 技术与器件词汇中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在仪器、成像、记录及纳米制造技术的并列清单中。
patterns.domain: 研究项目说明、工程与仪器技术

patterns.name: 主题标签或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在项目主题名称、技术/生物医学术语或病原体名称的内部片段；未见它们共享稳定的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目说明、植物病理学文本

patterns.name: 词内字母序列/形态片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖专业词内部的若干连续或分离字母片段，可能对特定词形、子词或局部字符模式敏感；各例词义和句法环境不一致。
patterns.domain: 医学、分子生物学及生物化学文本

en.concept: pseud(o)- word forms and scientific terminology
en.description: Mainly responds to the pseud(o)- substring and its cross-domain compounds; there are also sporadic responses to ophthalmic examinations, imaging of cranial malformations, scalar in physics, and acoustic terminology for nanoparticles.

patterns.name: pseud- prefix and its word forms
patterns.context: Trigger points are mostly the word-initial pseud(o)- prefix, covering compounds, parenthetical terms, and technical nouns; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Medicine, microbial taxonomy, programming, RNA biology, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Ophthalmic and eye examination terms
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within technical words in descriptions of vision screening and comprehensive eye examinations; some activations are not in pseud- words.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts; vision screening and ophthalmic examinations

patterns.name: Cranial imaging and cranial malformation terms
patterns.context: Medical contexts involving nervous system malformations and skull X-ray examinations at admission; activations cover multiple disease and imaging terms.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts; neuroimaging and cranial development

patterns.name: Optics and particle physics terms
patterns.context: Occurs alongside particle-physics classification terms such as scalar, vector, and axialvector; apart from the pseud(o) substring, there is no apparent shared contextual trigger.

patterns.name: Nanoparticles and acoustic problems
patterns.context: Describes gold nanospheres exposed to nanosecond pulses and acoustic problems; trigger words cluster around thermal and nanoscale-related terms.

8_1320.description: 主要响应 pseud(o)- 子串及其跨领域复合词；另对眼科检查、颅骨畸形影像、物理中的 scalar，以及纳米粒子声学术语有零散响应。

patterns.name: pseud- 前缀及其词形
patterns.context: 触发点多为单词前缀 pseud(o)-，涵盖复合词、括号中的术语及技术名词；上下文并不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 医学、微生物分类、编程、RNA 生物学及科学论文

patterns.name: 眼科与眼部检查术语
patterns.context: 眼科筛查及完整眼科检查的描述中，激活分散在专业词语内部；其中部分激活并非 pseud- 词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要；视力筛查与眼科检查

patterns.name: 颅骨影像与颅骨畸形术语
patterns.context: 神经系统畸形及入院时颅骨 X 线检查的医学语境，激活覆盖多个疾病和影像学词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要；神经影像与颅骨发育

patterns.name: 光学与粒子物理术语
patterns.context: 与 scalar、vector、axialvector 等粒子物理分类词并列；除 pseud(o) 子串外，没有明显共享的上下文触发词。

patterns.name: 纳米粒子与声学问题
patterns.context: 描述金纳米球受纳秒脉冲照射及声学问题；触发词集中于热学和纳米尺度相关词。

en.concept: Scientific term fragments and spelling patterns
en.description: Mainly responds to the nan- prefix in scientific texts; there are also sporadic responses to a fragment of the scientific name Ectoedemia, rh in rhinophores, negative error codes, and immun- experimental terms.

patterns.name: nano/nanotechnology term prefix
patterns.context: Activations fall on the nan prefix in scientific or technical terms; subsequent stems cover size, material structure, processing, and devices, without requiring specific collocations.
patterns.domain: Materials science, nanotechnology, biomedicine, and related research texts

patterns.name: Ectoedemia spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur in the spelling of the moth scientific name Ectoedemia insulata, with multiple fragments marked; the local context is a species entry and repeated scientific names.

patterns.name: rh in an anatomical term
patterns.context: Activations fall on a fragment of rhinophores in a nudibranch description; the same sentence describes body color, oral tentacles, and body shape.

patterns.name: Negative error code markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on the minus sign and ENODATA and ENOSYS error constants in C code; they occur in a conditional branch handling ACLs.

patterns.name: immun in immunology terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on the name of an immunological experimental method beginning with immun-, listed among research methods.

8_1320.concept: 科学术语片段与拼写模式
8_1320.description: 主要响应科学文本中的 nan- 纳米术语前缀；另有零散响应于 Ectoedemia 学名片段、rhinophores 中的 rh、负错误码及 immun- 实验术语。

patterns.name: nano/纳米术语前缀
patterns.context: 激活落在科学或技术术语中的 nan 前缀；后续词干涵盖尺寸、材料结构、加工与器件，并不要求特定搭配。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、纳米技术、生物医学及相关科研文本

patterns.name: Ectoedemia 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在蛾类学名 Ectoedemia insulata 的拼写中，多个片段被标记；局部上下文为物种条目及重复的学名。
patterns.domain: 维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 解剖术语中的 rh
patterns.context: 激活落在 nudibranch 描述中的 rhinophores 一词片段；同句描述体色、口触手与身体形态。

patterns.name: 负错误码标记
patterns.context: 激活落在 C 代码中的负号及 ENODATA、ENOSYS 错误常量；出现在 ACL 处理的条件分支中。

patterns.name: 免疫学术语中的 immun
patterns.context: 激活落在以 immun- 开头的免疫学实验方法名称中，列于研究方法清单。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要/资助项目描述

en.description: Mainly responds to internal word segments in medical and biological terms, covering cranio-cervical, cardiovascular, immunoassay, nanomaterials, animal morphology, and French genetic-endocrine vocabulary; it also responds to fragments of code errno constants.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Marked segments generally occur within medical or biomedical terms rather than as standalone words; the terms often concern anatomy, disease, diagnosis, surgery, or experimental methods.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, medical abstracts, and medical encyclopedias

patterns.name: Cranial and craniocervical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of brain, skull, craniocervical junction, or spinal cord diseases and surgeries, often alongside malformation, stability, compression, or surgical methods.
patterns.domain: Neurosurgery, spine surgery, and imaging abstracts

patterns.name: Vascular and cardiovascular terms
patterns.context: Marked segments are embedded in terms such as angiography, thrombosis, angioplasty, or vascular anastomosis, in clinical diagnosis or treatment narratives.
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular clinical research and case reports

patterns.name: Immunoassays and experimental methods
patterns.context: Occurs in parallel lists of experimental techniques or assay methods describing analyses at the protein, cell, or tissue level.

patterns.name: Nanomaterials and drug delivery terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of colloidal gold nanoparticles, their size, and potential biomedical applications.

patterns.name: Biological taxonomy and morphological descriptions
patterns.context: Multiple fragments occur in encyclopedic descriptions of organism color, morphology, and organ characteristics.

patterns.name: French genetic and endocrine terms
patterns.context: French sentences discuss inherited underlying disorders and multiple endocrine neoplasia.

patterns.name: Error constant fragments in code
patterns.context: In C code comparison expressions, marked segments fall inside errno constants with a minus sign; there is no apparent semantic connection to the other medical terminology patterns.

8_1320.description: 主要响应医学、生物学术语内部的词段，涵盖颅颈、心血管、免疫实验、纳米材料、动物形态及法语遗传内分泌词汇；另响应代码 errno 常量片段。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记通常出现在医学或生物医学术语内部，而非独立词；词语多涉及解剖、疾病、诊断、手术或实验方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学摘要与医学百科

patterns.name: 颅脑与颅颈术语
patterns.context: 出现在脑、颅骨、颅颈交界或脊髓疾病与手术的描述中，常与畸形、稳定性、压迫或手术方法同现。
patterns.domain: 神经外科、脊柱外科及影像学摘要

patterns.name: 血管与心血管术语
patterns.context: 标记嵌在血管造影、血栓、血管成形术或血管吻合等术语中，位于临床诊断或治疗叙述中。
patterns.domain: 心血管临床研究与病例报告

patterns.name: 免疫检测与实验方法
patterns.context: 位于实验技术或检测方法的并列列表中，描述蛋白、细胞或组织层面的分析。

patterns.name: 纳米材料与药物递送术语
patterns.context: 位于胶体金纳米颗粒、尺寸及潜在生物医学应用的描述中。
patterns.domain: 纳米生物医学材料研究

patterns.name: 生物分类与形态描述
patterns.context: 多个片段出现在对生物体颜色、形态和器官特征的百科式描述中。

patterns.name: 法语遗传与内分泌术语
patterns.context: 法语句子中讨论遗传性基础疾病及多发性内分泌肿瘤。

patterns.name: 代码中的错误常量片段
patterns.context: 在 C 代码比较表达式中，标记落在带负号的 errno 常量内部；与其他医学术语模式无明显语义联系。

en.concept: Angi- medical terms and sporadic word forms
en.description: The most consistent responses occur in cardiovascular medicine, in Angi- terms for angiography, intervention, and angiogenesis; the remaining activations occur sporadically in errno code, nanochemistry, automation links, animal morphology, and neuroscience citations, with no common semantics.

patterns.name: Angiography-related words
patterns.context: The Angi- stem occurs in medical terms, especially those related to vascular imaging, interventional treatment, and angiogenesis.
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular medicine, clinical cases, and medical papers

patterns.name: Descriptions of vascular interventions
patterns.context: Descriptions of balloon dilation, rupture, and contrast-agent extravasation; these trigger fragments occur in the same passage as angiography terms in the main pattern.

patterns.name: Linux error-code conditionals
patterns.context: C code compares return values with negative errno constants and uses them to set ACLs.

patterns.name: Nanomaterials and cyclodextrin chemistry
patterns.context: Describes a ternary colloidal system composed of nanoparticles, cyclodextrin, and related components.

patterns.name: Automation and AutoHotkey links
patterns.context: The words automation and AutoHotkey occur in webpage link titles and URLs.

patterns.name: Nudibranch morphology descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs alongside morphological features such as oral tentacles, gill cavities, rhinophores, and body color.

patterns.name: Motor cortex literature citations
patterns.context: A neuroscience reference describes primate motor cortex regions and cites a journal and volume/pages.

8_1320.concept: Angi- 医学术语及零散词形
8_1320.description: 最一致的反应出现在心血管医学中 Angi- 血管造影、介入及血管生成词；其余激活散见 errno 代码、纳米化学、自动化链接、动物形态和神经科学引文，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: 血管造影相关词
patterns.trigger: « Ang»«i»，以及 « Ang»«i»10ography、« Ang»«i»10oplasty、« Ang»«i»10ographic、« Ang»«i»10ograms、« Ang»«i»10ogenesis
patterns.context: 词干 Angi- 出现在医学术语中，尤其是血管成像、介入治疗及血管生成相关术语里。
patterns.domain: 心血管医学、临床病例与医学论文

patterns.name: 血管介入操作描述
patterns.context: 球囊扩张、破裂及造影剂外渗的操作过程描述；这些触发片段与主模式中的血管造影词同处一段。

patterns.name: Linux 错误码条件判断
patterns.context: C 代码中比较返回值与负 errno 常量，并据此设置 ACL。

patterns.name: 纳米材料与环糊精化学
patterns.context: 描述由纳米颗粒、环糊精及相关组分构成的三元胶体体系。
patterns.domain: 材料化学、生物医学应用论文

patterns.name: 自动化与 AutoHotkey 链接
patterns.context: 网页链接标题与 URL 中出现 automation 和 AutoHotkey 字样。

patterns.name: 海蛞蝓形态描述
patterns.context: 与口触手、鳃腔、嗅角及体色等形态特征并列出现。
patterns.domain: 动物学或维基百科物种描述

patterns.name: 运动皮层文献引文
patterns.context: 神经科学参考文献中，描述灵长类运动皮层区域并引用期刊和卷页。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to serum in medical texts; also activates on encyclopedia people’s names, sporadic alphanumeric fragments in mathematics or on webpages, product specifications, and the word find in email requests. The latter categories lack shared semantics.

patterns.name: Medical texts related to serum
patterns.context: In medical and biological contexts, serum appears in descriptions of cell culture, viruses/hepatitis, albumin, or test samples; activation centers on the word itself.

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: The first word, surname beginning, or a tokenized fragment of a person’s name is marked, often in biographical entries or name sequences; the marked positions vary.

patterns.name: Numbers or alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Local letters, numbers, or punctuation are activated in mathematical notation, abbreviations/brand spellings, or product model and specification strings, with no unified word meaning.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, webpage text, product listings

patterns.name: Request verb find
patterns.context: In email phrasing that asks someone to find and print an article, find receives the strongest activation; nearby words also receive weaker markings.

8_1458.concept: serum
8_1458.description: 主要对医学文本中的 serum 强烈响应；另在百科人名、数学或网页中的零碎字母数字片段、商品规格，以及邮件请求词 find 上激活，后几类缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: serum相关医学文本
patterns.context: 医学、生物学语境中，serum 出现在细胞培养、病毒/肝炎、白蛋白或检测样本的描述里；激活集中在该词本身。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 人名或专名片段
patterns.context: 人名的首词、姓氏开头或分词片段被标记，常处于人物条目或姓名序列中；各处标记位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数字或字母数字串
patterns.context: 在数学符号、缩写/品牌拼写或商品型号与规格串中，局部字母、数字或标点被激活，未见统一词义。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、网页文本、商品列表

patterns.name: 请求动作词 find
patterns.context: 请求对方查找并打印文章的邮件句式中，find 获得最强激活；其余相邻词也有较弱标记。

en.description: Activation is distributed across subword fragments, medical vocabulary (especially serum), transportation and mathematical terms, and paper-formatting markers; isolated fragments such as Sl, HT, and pl also occur, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Lowercase letter fragment “pl”
patterns.context: Activation falls on an initial fragment of a word or abbreviation; the following text shows no clear semantic connection.

patterns.name: Person’s name followed by a profession in parentheses
patterns.context: A parenthetical note immediately follows a person’s name, with activation concentrated within a fragment of the profession word.

patterns.name: Transportation-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence beginning with Two wheel vehicles that gives examples of vehicle types.

patterns.name: Uppercase string HT
patterns.context: Activated on an isolated uppercase string followed by a product-promotional phrase; the context does not clearly expand the abbreviation.

patterns.name: Biomedical noun fragments
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract about the effects of lithium on mouse mammary epithelial cells and culture conditions; activation covers serum and culture.

patterns.name: Mathematical term divisor
patterns.context: Activation is within the word divisor, in a context about divisors of m and j and subsequent mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Document-structure markers and introduction heading
patterns.context: Appears at structural boundaries such as line breaks after formulas or numbering, section headings, and equals-sign divider lines.

patterns.name: serum in a medical phrase
patterns.context: Activation is on serum in a context concerning the prevalence of GB virus C / hepatitis G.

patterns.name: Word fragment beginning with Sl
patterns.context: The initial fragment Sl is followed by “ash your power bill,” forming Slash in an advertising slogan; the fragment itself is highlighted.

patterns.name: Sl-initial fragment and proper name
patterns.context: Activation is on the initial Sl; it is first followed by Slidredomen, and the string is repeated later without a clear meaning.

8_1458.concept: 无单一明确概念
8_1458.description: 激活分散在词内片段、医学词汇（尤其 serum）、交通与数学术语，以及论文排版标记上；另有 Sl、HT 和 pl 等孤立片段，无法由单一语义规律解释。

patterns.name: 小写字母片段「pl」
patterns.context: 激活落在单词或缩写的开头片段；后续文本不显示明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 人名与括号内职业
patterns.trigger: «George»5« Oliver»7 (»1«phys»10«ician»2«,尤其是 «phys»；括号内完整职业词为 physician。
patterns.context: 人名后紧接括号注释，激活集中于职业词内部片段。

patterns.name: 交通工具相关词
patterns.context: 出现在以 Two wheel vehicles 开头、举例说明车辆类型的句子中。

patterns.name: 大写字母串 HT
patterns.context: 激活于孤立的大写字母串，后接产品宣传式短语；上下文没有明确展开该缩写。

patterns.name: 生物医学名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在锂对小鼠乳腺上皮细胞的影响及培养条件的摘要中；激活覆盖 serum 和 culture。

patterns.name: 数学术语 divisor
patterns.context: 激活位于 divisor 一词内部，语境为 m 和 j 的除数及后续数学表达。

patterns.name: 文档结构标记与引言标题
patterns.context: 出现在公式或编号之后的换行、章节标题及等号分隔线等结构边界处。

patterns.name: 医学短语中的 serum
patterns.context: 激活位于 serum，语境涉及 GB virus C / hepatitis G 的流行率。

patterns.name: Sl 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 词首片段 Sl 后接“ash your power bill”，组成广告口号中的 Slash；片段本身高亮。

patterns.name: Sl 开头的词片段及专名
patterns.context: 激活在词首 Sl；第一次接续为 Slidredomen，后续文本重复该字符串，未提供清晰语义。
patterns.domain: 百科式文本或名称列表

en.description: Activation is distributed across code identifiers, underscores, macros and declarations, registers and addresses, build and device comments, as well as academic prose, ASCII art, and JSON; no single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Underscores and code-identifier boundaries
patterns.context: In C/C++ and similar code, underscores occur within identifiers or between identifier fragments; they often co-occur with code names after tokenization.

patterns.name: C/C++ declarations and type markers
