patterns.context: Near struct types, pointers, and parameter lists in function prototypes or declarations.

patterns.name: Macro definitions and uppercase underscore constants
patterns.context: Preprocessor macro definitions and macro names composed of uppercase word segments and underscores.

patterns.name: Platform and resource descriptions in build scripts
patterns.context: Build configuration mentions platform-specific executables, resource-file titles, and packaging instructions.

patterns.name: Hardware registers and hexadecimal value tables
patterns.context: Register names and hexadecimal addresses or values are listed in aligned rows.

patterns.name: GPU flow-control table and comments
patterns.context: Variable names contain underscores; comments explain that a table receives sizes, addresses, identifiers, and other information sent by the host.

patterns.name: Contrast and argumentation words in academic prose
patterns.context: Argumentative English phrases appear in a section discussing the natural environment and statements by Benedict XVI.

patterns.name: ASCII art in comments
patterns.context: Multiline ASCII drawings appear as comment lines, mainly combinations of pipes, underscores, and slashes.

patterns.name: Audio-device listener class and callback comments
patterns.context: A Mac CoreAudio device-listener class declaration and comments explaining device-change callbacks.

patterns.name: Function return and physical-address mapping
patterns.context: A return statement follows the function body, along with a physical-address mapping function name and parameters.

patterns.name: JSON request limit fields
patterns.context: The limits array or numeric field under requests in a JSON object.

8_1458.concept: 代码与结构化文本片段
8_1458.description: 激活分布于代码标识符、下划线、宏与声明、寄存器和地址、构建及设备注释，也见学术散文、字符画和JSON；未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 下划线与代码标识符边界
patterns.context: C/C++等代码中，下划线位于标识符内部或标识符片段之间；常与 token 化后的代码名共现。

patterns.name: C/C++声明与类型标记
patterns.context: 函数原型或声明中，struct 类型、指针和参数列表附近。

patterns.name: 宏定义及大写下划线常量
patterns.context: 预处理宏定义及由大写词段和下划线组成的宏名。

patterns.name: 构建脚本中的平台与资源说明
patterns.context: 构建配置中出现平台专用可执行文件、资源文件标题及打包说明。

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器与十六进制数值表
patterns.context: 寄存器名与十六进制地址或值按行对齐列出。

patterns.name: GPU 流控表及注释
patterns.context: 变量名含下划线，注释解释表格接收主机发送的尺寸、地址和标识等信息。

patterns.name: 学术散文中的转折与论证词
patterns.context: 讨论自然环境与本笃十六世陈述的章节中，出现论证性英语短语。

patterns.name: 注释中的字符画
patterns.context: 以注释行呈现多行 ASCII 图形，主要是管道、下划线和斜线组合。

patterns.name: 音频设备监听器类与回调注释
patterns.context: Mac CoreAudio 设备监听器类声明及解释设备变化回调的注释。

patterns.name: 函数返回与物理地址映射
patterns.context: 函数体结束后出现返回语句及物理地址映射函数名和参数。

patterns.name: JSON 请求限制字段
patterns.context: JSON 对象中 requests 下的 limits 数组或数值字段。

en.description: Activation examples mainly come from code: code identifiers, punctuation, declarations, calls, and control flow all occur; there are also code comments, protocol-specification descriptions, and a news headline with a link. There is insufficient evidence to group these differences under a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and symbols in code
patterns.context: Appears in source-code declarations, function calls, control flow, and member access; activation spans multiple languages and different code purposes, rather than depending on a specific identifier.

patterns.name: Code comments and documentation
patterns.context: Comments describe variable semantics or function parameters and contain natural-language explanations and documentation markers.

patterns.name: Technical vocabulary in protocol specifications
patterns.context: Technical-documentation-style comments list protocol components and state server requirements.
patterns.domain: Protocol or API documentation on GitHub

patterns.name: News headline and link
patterns.context: A headline-style phrase describes a news topic, followed by a news website link; this is not a code context.

8_1458.concept: 代码文本与技术文本
8_1458.description: 激活例主要来自代码：代码标识符、标点、声明、调用和控制流均出现；另有代码注释、协议规范说明，以及一条新闻标题与链接。没有足够证据将这些差异归为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与符号
patterns.context: 出现在源代码的声明、函数调用、控制流和成员访问中；激活覆盖多种语言及不同代码用途，并非由某个特定标识符决定。
patterns.domain: 主要是 GitHub 源代码

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档说明
patterns.context: 注释中描述变量语义或函数参数，含自然语言说明及文档标记。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 风格代码注释与文档

patterns.name: 协议规范中的技术词汇
patterns.context: 技术文档式注释列出协议组件并陈述服务端要求。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的协议或 API 文档

patterns.name: 新闻标题与链接
patterns.context: 以标题式短语描述新闻主题，随后给出新闻网站链接；不是代码语境。

en.description: Strong responses mainly fall on code-format boundaries: preprocessor endif, comment boundaries, semicolons at declaration/block ends, and line breaks with indentation; a few heterogeneous examples include directory entries, email rating tables, and Japanese attribute documentation.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor end marker
patterns.context: At the end of a header file or conditional-compilation block, endif often has a trailing line break and occasionally a comment.
patterns.domain: C/C++ headers, drivers, and system code on GitHub

patterns.name: Code-line semicolon or compound-declaration boundary
patterns.context: At the end of declarations, struct members, or function bodies, especially adjacent to a line break or the end of a code block.

patterns.name: Comment and documentation-comment boundaries in code
patterns.context: At comment boundaries or where documentation comments adjoin code; triggering does not depend on consistent comment semantics.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in formatted text
patterns.context: Line breaks and indentation recur in multiline aligned text, tables, or code layouts.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including code, book contents, and email tables

patterns.name: Author and work entries in a bibliography
patterns.context: Author names, work titles, underscore-separated bibliographic entries, and page numbers are arranged in sequence.

patterns.name: Grade words and attendance items in a rating table
patterns.context: After grades and numeric scores, employee evaluation criteria are listed, including Attendance.

patterns.name: Japanese comments and Boolean property initialization
patterns.context: A Japanese XML summary describes a property, followed by a discount-related Boolean declaration initialized to False.
patterns.domain: C# documentation comments and code on GitHub

8_1458.concept: 结构边界与格式标记
8_1458.description: 强响应主要落在代码格式边界：预处理器 endif、注释边界、声明/块末尾分号，以及换行缩进；另有目录条目、邮件评分表和日语属性文档等少数异质内容。

patterns.name: C/C++预处理器结束标记
patterns.context: 代码头文件或条件编译块末尾，endif 常带换行，偶尔接注释。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C/C++ 头文件、驱动和系统代码

patterns.name: 代码行末分号或复合声明边界
patterns.context: 声明、结构体成员或函数体末尾，尤其紧邻换行或代码块结束。

patterns.name: 代码中的注释及文档注释边界
patterns.context: 注释起止或文档注释与代码相邻处；触发并不依赖注释语义一致。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释、XML/文档注释

patterns.name: 格式化文本中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 多行对齐文本、表格或代码格式布局中，换行和缩进反复出现。
patterns.domain: 代码与书籍目录、邮件表格等多种文体

patterns.name: 人名与作品目录条目
patterns.context: 作者名、作品名、下划线分隔的书目条目及页码排列。

patterns.name: 评分表中的等级词与出勤项
patterns.context: 等级与数字评分之后列出员工评价维度，包含 Attendance 等项目。

patterns.name: 日语注释与布尔属性初始化
patterns.context: 日语 XML summary 描述属性，随后声明折扣相关布尔值并初始化为 False。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C# 文档注释和代码

en.concept: Code structural boundaries and line endings
en.description: Mainly sensitive to source-code structural boundaries: line-ending punctuation, closing parentheses, line breaks, and preprocessor directive endings; more localized patterns also include CMake dependencies, Qt properties, macro-version branches, mathematical line breaks, and forum-text boundaries.

patterns.name: Line endings and line breaks
patterns.context: In code snippets, activation often falls on line-ending punctuation, line breaks, and closing structures; sentence-final or line-break boundaries also occur in prose.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor end directive
patterns.context: At the end of a preprocessor conditional branch, especially near endif.

patterns.name: Closing parentheses and block endings in source code
patterns.context: At the end of function calls, callbacks, classes, or blocks; often adjacent to a line break.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Dependencies and end markers in build configuration
patterns.context: A CMake configuration finds a required package and ends a conditional block.

patterns.name: Qt properties and conditional-compilation declarations
patterns.context: A class declaration wraps a property definition in conditional compilation.

patterns.name: Macro definitions and version conditions
patterns.context: Selects macro definitions based on API version and handles unsupported branches.

patterns.name: Code comments
patterns.context: Line comments in code, usually adjacent to a code block or preprocessor directive.

patterns.name: Line breaks in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Expressions and answers to a calculus problem are arranged on separate lines; line breaks and mathematical punctuation stand out.

patterns.name: Sentence boundaries in narrative text
patterns.context: A comment follows a title; sentences span lines and continue across line breaks.

8_1458.concept: 代码结构边界与行结束
8_1458.description: 主要对源码的结构边界敏感：行末标点、闭合括号、换行及预处理指令收尾；另有CMake依赖、Qt属性、宏版本分支、数学换行和论坛文本边界等较局部模式。

patterns.name: 行末结束与换行
patterns.trigger: 行末的分号、右括号或指令后接 «↵»，以及结束括号
patterns.context: 代码片段中激活常落在行末标点、换行及闭合结构上；在自然语言段落中也出现句末或换行边界

patterns.name: C/C++预处理器结束指令
patterns.context: 预处理条件分支的收尾处，尤其 endif 附近

patterns.name: 源码中的闭合括号与块结束
patterns.context: 函数调用、回调、类或块结构的结束位置；常与换行相邻

patterns.name: 构建配置中的依赖与结束标记
patterns.context: CMake配置中查找必需包并结束条件块

patterns.name: Qt属性与条件编译声明
patterns.context: 类声明中以条件编译包围属性定义

patterns.name: 宏定义与版本条件
patterns.context: 依据API版本选择宏定义并处理不支持的分支

patterns.name: 代码注释
patterns.context: 代码中的行注释，通常邻接代码块或预处理指令

patterns.name: 数学表达式换行
patterns.context: 微分题目的表达式与答案按行排列，换行及算式标点突出

patterns.name: 叙述性文本中的句子边界
patterns.context: 标题后接评论，句子跨行并以换行继续

en.description: Every passage contains a to-infinitive context, with activation often on to or the following verb; subsequent meanings include continuation, need, plans, purpose, and actions, with no stable domain or topic.

patterns.name: Verb after infinitival to
patterns.context: In constructions where to introduces a base-form verb; across multiple passages, activation falls on to itself or the adjacent verb. Common following verbs include continue, get, be, have, make, and balance.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, encyclopedias, email, parliamentary speeches, etc.

patterns.name: Continuation
patterns.context: When expressing the continuation of a state or action, activation centers on continue or the immediately following to.

patterns.name: Obligation, need, and willingness
patterns.context: When discussing someone needing, being able, or being willing to act; activation appears near to or the following verb.

patterns.name: Future or anticipated action
patterns.context: Indicates an imminent, anticipated, or planned action, especially to before verbs such as be/get.

patterns.name: Infinitives of purpose or result
patterns.context: To introduces a purpose, goal, or subsequent result; the semantic context varies, while the stable cue is mainly to followed by a base-form verb.

patterns.name: To followed by a non-verbal element
patterns.context: Still occurs in a construction introduced by to, but the activation position does not always coincide with the boundary of the complete following verb phrase.

8_1458.concept: to 不定式及其后续动作
8_1458.description: 所有段落都出现 to 不定式环境，激活多落在 to 或其后的动词上；后续涵盖继续、需要、计划、目的及行动等多种语义，未见稳定的单一领域或主题。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后的动词
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤其后接动词，如 “to continue”“to reach”“to die”“to balance”“to get”
patterns.context: to 引出动词原形的结构中；多个段落里激活落在 to 本身或紧邻的动词上，常见后续动词为 continue、get、be、have、make、balance 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、百科、邮件、议会发言等

patterns.name: 继续/延续
patterns.trigger: “continue”及其邻近的 “to”，如 “to continue to augment”“continue to be a monopoly”“continue to be the focus”
patterns.context: 表达某种状态或行动持续时，激活集中于 continue 或紧接其后的 to。

patterns.name: 义务、需要与意愿
patterns.trigger: “need to”“wouldn’t be able to”“need to be willing to”
patterns.context: 谈到某人需要、能够或愿意采取行动时；激活出现在 to 或后续动词附近。

patterns.name: 将来或预期行动
patterns.trigger: “going to be”“going to get”“will … continue to”
patterns.context: 表示即将发生、预期或计划中的行动，尤其是 be/get 等动词前的 to。

patterns.name: 目的或结果的不定式
patterns.context: to 引出目的、目标或后续结果；所需语义环境并不一致，稳定线索主要是 to 加动词原形。

patterns.name: to 后接非动词成分
patterns.trigger: “to read a whole lesson”中标记落在 to；“to”后直接接副词/名词性成分的局部情况
patterns.context: 仍处于 to 引出的结构，但激活位置与后续完整动词短语的边界不完全重合。

en.description: The most prominent response centers on to-infinitives, especially to linked to action expressions; there is also sporadic activation on object pronouns such as him/her and on several verbs, proper-name subwords, and quantity expressions. Syntactic and morphological cues overlap across examples and cannot be fully unified.

patterns.name: To in infinitive constructions
patterns.context: Mainly appears in constructions where a verb or expression is followed by “to + base-form verb,” such as “to take,” “to buy,” “to strengthen,” and “forced him to resign/stop.”
patterns.domain: News, business narratives, legal texts, personal accounts, and encyclopedias; broad range of genres

patterns.name: Object pronouns him/her
patterns.context: Pronouns function as objects of verbs or prepositions and refer to a person mentioned earlier; they may co-occur with infinitive constructions but are not required.
patterns.domain: Narratives, legal statements, and news reports

patterns.name: Verb followed by an object or complement
patterns.context: Local syntactic combinations involving an action and its object, complement, or result; some overlap with to-infinitives or object pronouns.
patterns.domain: Narratives, sports encyclopedias, and legal texts

patterns.name: Subwords within words and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized proper names or substrings, with no obvious consistent semantic trigger in the surrounding text.
patterns.domain: Names of people, places, or teams in encyclopedias and legal texts

patterns.name: Numbers and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in amounts, quantities, or statistics; activation does not consistently fall on the numeric token.
patterns.domain: News, business narratives, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Words expressing persistence or change of state
patterns.context: Describes a person or organization’s continued operation, needs, existence, or return; activation is weaker and the meanings are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Sporadic word forms without a clear correspondence
patterns.context: Word forms at fragment boundaries or not readily generalizable from the local context; no shared trigger can be confirmed.

8_1458.concept: 不定式与宾语结构
8_1458.description: 最显著的反应集中于 to 不定式，尤其是 to 与动作表达相连；另对 him/her 等宾语代词及若干动词、专名子词和数量表达有零散激活。各段句法与词形线索交错，无法完全统一。

patterns.name: 不定式结构中的 to
patterns.context: 主要出现在动词或表达后接“to + 动词原形”的结构，如“to take”“to buy”“to strengthen”“forced him to resign/stop”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业叙述、法律文本、个人叙述及百科；覆盖广泛文体

patterns.name: 人称代词宾语 him/her
patterns.context: 代词作动词或介词的宾语，指代前文人物；可与不定式结构同现，但并非必需。
patterns.domain: 叙事、法律陈述及新闻报道

patterns.name: 动词后接宾语或补语
patterns.context: 围绕动作及其宾语、补语或结果的局部句法组合；部分与 to 不定式或人称代词重叠。
patterns.domain: 叙事、体育百科及法律文本

patterns.name: 词内子词与专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的专名或词形子串上，周围没有明显一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 百科及法律文本中的人名、地名或队名

patterns.name: 数字与数量表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在金额、数量或统计数据中；激活并不稳定地落在数字 token 上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业叙述及体育报道

patterns.name: 持续或变化状态词
patterns.context: 叙述人物或组织的持续经营、需求、存续或回归状态；强度较弱且彼此语义不完全一致。

patterns.name: 未见清晰对应的零散词形
patterns.context: 位于片段边缘或不易从局部语境归纳的词形；缺少可确认的共同触发条件。

en.description: The most stable signal is common function words, especially infinitival to; pronouns, auxiliaries, and the verbs following them also feature. Other activation is distributed across legal proceedings, personal relationships, history, work, and corporate services.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Often introduces an infinitive after a verb or adjective; commonly occurs with the following verb.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal documents, personal narratives, encyclopedias, and email

patterns.name: Object pronoun him
patterns.context: Appears after a verb or preposition and refers to a male; especially noticeable in contexts involving missing someone, teaching, requests, or obligations.

patterns.name: Verb following a modal or auxiliary
patterns.context: An auxiliary is followed by a verb or complement; includes contexts of ability, possibility, past states, or perfect tense.

patterns.name: First-person pronouns and self-reference
patterns.context: The narrator describes their own feelings, actions, or thoughts; some examples are adjacent to infinitives.

patterns.name: Procedural and obligation language in legal documents
patterns.context: Accounts of judicial proceedings describe attorneys’ motions, judges’ decisions, defendants’ actions, or duties; the trigger words do not all occur together in every passage.

patterns.name: Roof repair narrative
patterns.context: Describes a leaking roof, authorizes payment, and replaces the roof on a building.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony or findings of fact

patterns.name: Longing and loss in close relationships
patterns.context: Recalls a deceased or absent male relative and lists details of shared life and companionship.

patterns.name: Family relationships and personal growth
patterns.context: Describes a woman’s relationship with her father and says it helped the narrator build confidence.

patterns.name: Historical proper names and colonial narrative
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens in a discussion of the historical relationship between Díaz and a Mormon colony.

patterns.name: Reinforcing knowledge through teaching and reading
patterns.context: The narrator teaches or reads to children and believes this also deepened their own understanding.

patterns.name: Employee roles and work assignments
patterns.context: Explains which job roles someone can perform and assigns them to do only a specified operation.

patterns.name: Corporate service commitment
patterns.context: During a crisis, a company promises to continue serving customers safely and reliably.

8_1458.concept: 不定式及常见功能词
8_1458.description: 最稳定的信号是常见功能词，尤其不定式 to；还涉及代词、助动词及其后的动词。其余激活分散于法律程序、私人关系、历史、工作与企业服务等语境。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 多见于动词或形容词后引出不定式；常与后续动词连用。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、个人叙述、百科、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 人称代词宾语 him
patterns.context: 出现在动词或介词之后，指代男性；在表达想念、教学、要求或义务等语境中尤明显。

patterns.name: 情态或助动词后接动词
patterns.context: 助动词后接动词或补语；包括能力、可能性、过去状态或完成时语境。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科、个人叙述

patterns.name: 第一人称代词与自我指涉
patterns.context: 叙述者描述自己的感受、行动或认知，部分实例紧邻不定式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与义务措辞
patterns.context: 司法案件叙述中说明律师申请、法官决定、被告行为或职责；各触发词并非在每段都同时出现。

patterns.name: roof 建筑修缮叙述
patterns.context: 陈述屋顶漏水、授权付款并为建筑更换屋顶。

patterns.name: 亲密关系中的想念与丧失
patterns.context: 回忆逝去或缺席的男性亲人，列举共同生活与相处细节。

patterns.name: 家庭关系与自我成长
patterns.context: 叙述女性与父亲相处，并称这种关系帮助叙述者建立信心。

patterns.name: 历史专名及殖民地叙述
patterns.context: 专名被拆分为多个 token，讨论 Díaz 与摩门教殖民地的历史关系。

patterns.name: 教学与阅读中的知识巩固
patterns.context: 叙述者教导或给孩子阅读，并认为此举也加深了自己的理解。

patterns.name: 雇员岗位与工作安排
patterns.context: 说明某人能胜任的工作岗位，并安排其只做指定工序。

patterns.name: 企业服务承诺
patterns.context: 公司在危机期间承诺继续安全、可靠地服务客户。

en.description: The clearest pattern is strong activation on the object pronouns “me/him” after verbs; sporadic activation also occurs on some names, team names, and ordinary word fragments across different genres, and cannot be adequately explained by a single condition.

patterns.name: Object pronoun me
patterns.context: The target pronoun is in the object position after a verb; also includes constructions such as “made him ill” and “made me question.” Triggers are not limited to a single verb or meaning.

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized proper names or word fragments, or on a pronoun following a proper name; these examples have no obvious shared syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Comic plots, sports history, and biographical/team entries

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in varied contexts such as record reviews, blog titles/diaries, and literary criticism, with no stable shared trigger.

8_1458.concept: 宾语代词及词片段
8_1458.description: 最明显模式是动词后的宾语代词“me/him”被强激活；另有若干人名、球队名及普通词片段的零散激活，跨不同文体，无法由同一条件充分解释。

patterns.name: 宾语代词 me
patterns.context: 目标代词处于动词后的宾语位置；也包括“made him ill”和“made me question”等结构。触发不限于单一动词或语义。
patterns.domain: 叙事、回忆或说明性文本

patterns.name: 人名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的专名/词片段，或专名后的代词；这些例子没有明显共同句法功能。
patterns.domain: 漫画剧情、体育史与人物/球队条目

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在唱片评论、博客标题/日记、文学评论等不同语境，未见稳定的共同触发条件。

en.concept: Expressions of relations and states in English narration
en.description: Activation is common around English narrative on phrases, to phrases in sports transfers/matches, and “made him + state”; it also appears in song chart listings, descriptions of people’s emotions, and expressions of life expectancy. The triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Time period or chart position introduced by “on”
patterns.context: “on” is followed by a chart, calendar period, or activity status, often describing duration, position, or state; activation is mainly on on and the following phrase.

patterns.name: Causing someone/something to enter a state
patterns.context: In the “made him + state/result” construction, him is followed by a descriptive result.

patterns.name: “to” phrases in sports events
patterns.context: To phrases in accounts of sports figures or teams, match results, transfers, or advancement; activation may fall on the preposition to or a nearby word.

patterns.name: Time remaining and life expectancy
patterns.context: Describes a sick person with only a certain amount of time left to live; activation is concentrated on to.
patterns.domain: Film and TV plot summaries, reviews

patterns.name: “him” constructions emphasizing personal traits or experiences
patterns.context: Descriptions of a male figure’s emotions, care, or state; the specific trigger word and syntax are inconsistent, and whether this shares a source with other patterns is uncertain.

patterns.name: Songs and chart listings in music entries
patterns.context: Song descriptions and the number of weeks or rankings on charts; activation may fall near a song title or in a sentence about chart duration.

8_1458.concept: 英语叙述中的关系与状态表达
8_1458.description: 激活较常见于英语叙述中的 on 短语、体育转会/比赛中的 to 短语，以及“made him + 状态”；另见歌曲榜单、人物情感叙述和生命期限表达。触发并不完全统一。

patterns.name: “on”引出的时段或榜单位置
patterns.trigger: «on»10« the»7« Billboard»3 Hot« 100»6« chart»5；«on»10« the»7« single»4« chart»4；«on»9« vacation»5
patterns.context: “on”后接榜单、日历时段或活动状态，常见于描述持续时间、位置或状态；触发位置主要在 on 及其后续短语。
patterns.domain: 百科音乐条目、法律叙述

patterns.name: 使某人／某物进入状态
patterns.context: “made him + 状态/结果”结构中，him 后接描述性结果。

patterns.name: 体育事件中的“to”短语
patterns.trigger: «to»7« a»1 victory；«to»9« challenge»2 for« the»1« ball；«to»6« qualify»2；«to»4 Ruch Chorzów；«to»4« the»2 Orange Ekstraklasa
patterns.context: 体育人物或球队经历、比赛结果、转会或晋级叙述中的 to 短语；触发可能落在介词 to 或邻近词上。

patterns.name: 剩余时间与生命期限
patterns.context: 描述患病人物仅剩若干时间可活，激活集中在 to。

patterns.name: 强调人物特质或经历的“him”结构
patterns.trigger: sharing with« him»3；cooking for« him»4；«him»10« human；«him»9« ill
patterns.context: 围绕男性人物的情感、照料或状态描述；具体触发词和句法并不统一，与其他模式是否同源不确定。

patterns.name: 音乐条目中的歌曲与榜单叙述
patterns.trigger: “Without You«”»3« is»3« a»2« song；«spent»4« 13»2« weeks»4« on»10；«spent»4 five« weeks»4« on»10
patterns.context: 歌曲介绍及其在榜单上的周数、排名；激活可落在歌曲标题附近或榜单时长句中。

en.concept: Sporadic English syntax and narrative words
en.description: Activation is scattered across genres. More noticeable patterns include around “was on,” infinitival to, and personal pronouns; there are also several isolated lexical items, with no stable, single trigger condition overall.

patterns.name: “on was” followed by 9
patterns.context: Local syntax often includes “was on + noun phrase,” but activation also occurs near other verbs or phrases, so no single fixed collocation can be identified.
patterns.domain: Biographies, legal narratives, and general narration

patterns.name: Verb or result after infinitival to
patterns.context: To is followed by a verb, often expressing a plan, action, deadline, or result; strong activation sometimes falls on to and sometimes on a neighboring verb.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news, narratives, legal texts, and other genres

patterns.name: Personal references in emotional narratives
patterns.context: In first- or third-person narration, personal pronouns occur near expressions of emotion, thought, or action.

patterns.name: Sporadic high-frequency words and phrases
patterns.context: These activations occur separately in musical recollections, plot summaries, and marital recollections, without a verifiable shared local condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, plot summaries, personal narratives

8_1458.concept: 零散的英语句法与叙事词
8_1458.description: 激活分散于多种文体，较明显的模式包括“was on”附近、不定式to及人物代词周边；另有若干孤立词项，整体没有稳定单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “on was”后接9
patterns.trigger: on«9»前后多次出现“was”“on”，如“Workman was on the NBA referee roster”“Janice was on vacation”；另有“what it did was practically to give”中的“did”«9»
patterns.context: 局部句法常见“was on + 名词短语”，但也出现于其他动词或短语附近，无法确定单一固定搭配
patterns.domain: 人物传记、法律叙述及一般叙事

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后的动词或结果
patterns.trigger: «to»10 live；“to go”«9»/«6»；“to”«9» consider；“to”«5» schedule；“to”«5» give；以及“to”«4» grieve
patterns.context: to 后接动词，常表达计划、行动、期限或结果；强激活有时落在 to，有时落在邻近动词
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、叙事、法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 情感叙述中的人物指称
patterns.context: 第一或第三人称叙述中，人物代词邻近情感、想法或行动表达

patterns.name: 零散高频词及短语
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在音乐回忆、剧情简介及婚姻回忆中，缺乏可确认的共同局部条件
patterns.domain: 网络文本、剧情介绍、个人叙述

en.concept: State expressions and accounts of sports achievements
en.description: Activation mainly appears in state expressions such as “on + roster, field, presence, chart, loan,” and in accounts of helping a team advance or win in sports contexts; there is also a variable and interval notation in a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: People, teams, or organizations in a state after “on”
patterns.context: “on” and what follows describe someone or something as being on a roster, at a venue, present, aboard, on a chart, or on loan; highlighting often falls on on but may extend to the next word. The specific meaning depends on the collocation.
patterns.domain: Narrative genres such as sports news, biographies, and music entries

patterns.name: Helping a team advance or achieve a result
patterns.context: In accounts of sports figures, a player or team helps their team advance, win a match, or make progress; activation is concentrated around them and the description of the result that follows.
patterns.domain: Footballer biographies and team season reports

patterns.name: Symbols and interval variables in abstract mathematics
patterns.context: A mathematical paper formula contains parameters, a time variable, and interval notation; activation is scattered around t, subscripts, and interval endpoints, with no clear correspondence to a natural-language collocation.

8_1458.concept: 状态表达及体育成就叙述
8_1458.description: 激活主要出现在“on + 名单、场地、在场、榜单、租借”等状态表达，以及体育语境中帮助球队晋级或获胜的叙述；另有一段数学公式中的变量与区间符号。

patterns.name: “on”后的人员、球队或组织状态
patterns.trigger: “was»4 on»10 the NBA referee roster”[1]；“will»4 be»2 on»9 the fields”[2]；“was»2 on»9 hand”[3]；“was»2 on»9 one of the final ships”[4]；“weeks»4 on»9 the Billboard”[7]；“was»1 on»9 loan”[10]
patterns.context: “on”及其后续成分描述某人或事物处于名单、场地、在场、船上、榜单或租借等状态；高亮常落在 on，也可延伸到其后一个词。具体含义因搭配而异。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、人物传记、音乐条目等叙述性文体

patterns.name: 帮助球队晋级或取得成绩
patterns.trigger: “helping»6 them»9 to»6 promotion”[5]；“helping»6 them»9 win”[6]；“helped»7 them»9 advance”[9]
patterns.context: 体育人物经历中，球员或队伍帮助其所在球队晋级、赢得比赛或取得进展；激活集中在 them 及其后的结果描述附近。
patterns.domain: 足球运动员简介与球队赛季报道

patterns.name: 抽象数学中的符号与区间变量
patterns.context: 数学论文公式中出现参数、时间变量和区间记号；激活分散在 t、下标及区间端点附近，没有明显对应自然语言搭配。

en.description: Activation mainly involves various collocations of the preposition on. Other patterns include went on to, the object pronoun him, a closing parenthesis in a mathematical formula, and infinitival to after a time-limit phrase; these few patterns are difficult to explain with a single semantics.

patterns.name: Prepositional uses of on
patterns.context: The preposition on is followed by a noun phrase expressing a state, trend, position, or affiliation. Examples include “on the verge of collapse,” “on the plans,” “on a par,” “on your own,” and “been on the rise.”
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, copyright notices, and other genres

patterns.name: Subsequent action after went on to
patterns.context: Indicates continuing to do something after a prior experience; activation also covers the following to and related verb.

patterns.name: him as an object pronoun
patterns.context: him follows the verb made and precedes the complement human; other instances of him in the same passage also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Closing symbol in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: In formula formatting, a right parenthesis closes an expression after a set symbol; strong activation occurs at this location alone.

patterns.name: Infinitive after a time-limit phrase
patterns.context: The time span phrase a week is followed by an infinitive describing a writing deadline.

8_1458.concept: 多模式、以 on 为主
8_1458.description: 激活以介词 on 的多种搭配为主，另见 went on to、宾语代词 him、数学公式右括号及期限短语后的不定式 to；这些少数模式难由同一语义解释。

patterns.name: on 的介词用法
patterns.context: 介词 on 后接名词短语，表达处于某种状态、趋势、位置或归属；包括“on the verge of collapse”“on the plans”“on a par”“on your own”“been on the rise”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、版权说明等多种文体

patterns.name: went on to 后续行动
patterns.context: 表示先前经历之后继续做某事；激活还覆盖其后的 to 及相关动词。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育生涯简介

patterns.name: him 作宾语代词
patterns.context: him 位于动词 made 后、补语 human 前；同段其他 him 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的闭合符号
patterns.trigger: “\mathbb{K}\right”之后的“»10”对应闭合公式结构中的右括号
patterns.context: 公式排版中，集合符号后以右括号闭合表达式；该处单独出现强激活。

patterns.name: 时间期限后的不定式
patterns.context: 时间长度短语 a week 后接不定式，说明可用于写作的期限。
patterns.domain: 文学作品序言、解释性散文

en.description: Activation most consistently occurs on on and the phrase that follows; there is also an initial capital T fragment and activation on symbols and parentheses in a mathematical formula, with no shared semantics yet explaining all patterns.

patterns.name: State or location phrase after on
patterns.context: Across different syntactic environments, the preposition on and the phrase following it stand out; the following words are plans, fields, sidelines, and hand.

patterns.name: Fragments beginning with capital T
patterns.context: Words or abbreviations starting with a capital T are activated; the visible contexts vary, and some may simply reflect subword segmentation.
patterns.domain: Philosophy titles, folklore, Q&A, encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Symbols and parentheses in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: The formula contains LaTeX symbols, parentheses, subscripts, and summation notation; activation is distributed across several adjacent formula tokens.

8_1458.concept: 局部词形与公式符号特征
8_1458.description: 激活最一致地出现在 on 及其后续短语；另有大写 T 起始片段和一段数学公式中的符号、括号激活，尚无共同语义可解释所有模式。

patterns.name: on 后接状态或位置短语
patterns.trigger: «on»10« the»3« plans»1« to»2；«on»9« the»5« fields；«on»9« the»5« s»2«idelines；«on»9« hand»3
patterns.context: 在不同语法环境中，突出介词 on 及其后续短语；后续分别是 plans、fields、sidelines、hand。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业报道、网页文本

patterns.name: 大写 T 起始片段
patterns.context: 大写字母 T 开始的词或缩写被激活；可见上下文不一致，部分可能只是子词切分。
patterns.domain: 哲学标题、民俗学、问答、百科分类

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号及括号
patterns.context: 公式中出现 LaTeX 符号、括号、下标与求和结构；激活分布于多个相邻公式 token。

en.concept: Initial capital T and sporadic word fragments
en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is an initial capital T, appearing in titles, proper nouns, and ordinary prose; there are also assorted English word fragments and line-break markers, without a unified semantics or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Capital T within or at the start of a word
patterns.context: A capital T is followed by a word or proper noun beginning with t/T; it may be word-initial, and subsequent fragments are sometimes activated too.
patterns.domain: Titles, prose, proper nouns, and technical text

patterns.name: English function words and ordinary phrases
patterns.context: These occur sporadically in titles, code, or narratives, with no consistent local semantic condition; some markers are concentrated in one sentence.
patterns.domain: Mixed: titles, code, historical narratives, forum text

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation falls on a line break, and the passage begins with a newline character.

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 词首及零散词片段
8_1458.description: 最突出的重复线索是词首大写 T，出现在标题、专名和普通正文中；另有多种分散的英语词片段及换行标记，缺少统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 词内或词首的大写 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 后接以 t/T 开头的单词或专名；可位于词首，后续片段有时也标记激活。
patterns.domain: 标题、正文、专名及技术文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词及普通词组
patterns.trigger: « on»、« the»、«'t»、« –»、« Sit»、«)»、«org»、« to»、« R»、«on»、« were»、« both»、« first»、« tested»、« it»、« hold»、« do»、« I»、« make»、« my»
patterns.context: 零散出现在标题、代码或叙述中，未见一致的局部语义条件；部分标记集中于一个句子。
patterns.domain: 混合：标题、代码、历史叙述、论坛文字

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 激活落在换行处，且该段以换行符开头。

en.concept: Capital T and its lexical continuation
en.description: All passages strongly activate the capital letter T, covering word-initial or intraword positions in Talking, The, Taken, Tribute, Tours, Turns, Taiwan, Travis, and other words. Contexts and domains vary, with no stable semantic or stylistic condition; a few adjacent characters also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Continuation within words beginning with capital T
patterns.context: The activation point falls on the capital T; sometimes the following characters within the word are also activated, as in «T»9«alking»1 and «T»10ai«wan»1«ese»1. It can occur at the beginning of a word, within a word, or inside a proper noun.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; titles, prose, code comments, mathematical answers, proper nouns, and tables

patterns.name: T in titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: A capital T appears in a book title, work title, or proper noun; adjacent context may include title case, a colon, or a possessive.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and proper nouns in narratives

patterns.name: Sentence-initial markers of contrast, continuation, or result
patterns.context: A capital T begins a sentence or sentence fragment, followed by words such as “The,” “Taken,” or “Turns”; often appears in comments, explanations, or after a preceding sentence.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code explanations, mathematical explanations, and Q&A

patterns.name: T in place names, language names, and personal names
patterns.context: A capital T occurs at the start of a place or personal name, followed by letters forming a Taiwan-related name or a person’s name.

patterns.name: Isolated or formatting-related T in structured text
patterns.context: T appears in a title fragment, code text, or mathematical text; from the given context alone, it is not possible to confirm that it is always the start of a complete word or to reduce it to a unified semantics.

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 及其词汇续接
8_1458.description: 所有段均强烈激活大写字母 T，覆盖 Talking、The、Taken、Tribute、Tours、Turns、Taiwan、Travis 等词首或词内位置。上下文和领域多样，没有稳定的语义或文体条件；少数相邻字符也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 大写 T 开头的词内续接
patterns.context: 激活点落在大写 T；有时紧跟着的词内字符也激活，如 «T»9«alking»1、«T»10ai«wan»1«ese»1。词首、词内或专名内部均可出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；标题、正文、代码注释、数学回答、专名和表格均有

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于书名、作品名或专名中；相邻上下文可能是标题大小写、冒号或所有格。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题与叙事中的专名

patterns.name: 句中转折、承接或结果标记
patterns.context: 大写 T 开始句子或句子片段，后续构成「The」「Taken」「Turns」等词；常在注释、解释或前句之后。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码说明、数学解释及问答

patterns.name: 地名、语言名及人名中的 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于地名或人名词首，后续字母组成台湾相关名称或人名。

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的孤立或格式性 T
patterns.context: T 出现在标题片段、代码文本或数学文本中；仅凭所给上下文，不能确认它总是完整单词的词首，也不能归结为统一语义。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to a capital T at the start of a word at the beginning of a sentence, after a line break, or at the start of a title, across multiple genres; weaker activation also occurs on formula backslashes, line breaks/separator lines, and several scattered word fragments, the latter without a unified condition.

patterns.name: T at sentence or paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: In most examples, a capital T occurs at the beginning of a sentence, after a line break, or at the start of a new title; the following letters are unmarked and often form a word with T, as in Takes, Toward, Titles, Tributaries, Tune, Tocking, and Twen. Activation falls on the initial single letter, not a particular complete word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; prose, encyclopedia titles, slogans, bibliographic entries, forum signatures

patterns.name: t within a word
patterns.context: A capital T begins a following word in a sentence-initial or title position; « T» in the title of passage 9 may also be a word-initial T after a space. Marker boundaries are related to spaces, line breaks, and capitalization.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia prose and titles, bibliographies/catalogs, forum text

patterns.name: Backslash in formulas
patterns.context: Occurs in LaTeX commands in mathematical formulas, adjacent to numbers, π, or i; activation is not limited to word-initial T.

patterns.name: Punctuation or formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Line-break markers and separator lines also show positive activation, often at paragraph or content boundaries; this may relate to the main pattern’s boundary sensitivity but cannot be explained by word-initial T.

patterns.name: Unexplained neighboring activations
patterns.context: These markers occur in multiple syntactic positions, with no stable shared condition involving capital T at word beginnings or paragraph boundaries; they may reflect independent weak patterns or contextual effects.

8_1458.concept: 文本边界处的大写 T
8_1458.description: 主要对大写 T 在句首、换行后或标题开头的词首位置强烈响应，跨多种文体；还对公式反斜线、换行/分隔线及若干分散的词片段有较弱激活，后者缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 句首或段落边界的 T
patterns.context: 大多数例子中大写 T 位于句首、换行后或新标题开头；后续字母未标记且常与 T 连成词，如 Takes、Toward、Titles、Tributaries、Tune、Tocking、Twen。激活落在词首单字母，而非特定完整词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；正文、百科标题、宣传语、书目条目、论坛签名

patterns.name: 词内的 t
patterns.context: 大写 T 在句首或标题位置开启后续词；第 9 段标题中的 « T» 还可能是空格后的词首 T。标记边界与空格、换行及大小写有关。
patterns.domain: 百科正文与标题、书目/目录、论坛文本

patterns.name: 公式中的反斜线
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式的 LaTeX 命令中，邻接数字、π 或 i；激活不只见于词首 T。

patterns.name: 标点或格式边界
patterns.context: 换行标记及分隔线也有正激活，常处于段落或内容边界；可能与主模式的边界敏感性有关，但不能由词首 T 解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的邻近激活
patterns.trigger: « also»、« to»、« wait»、« minutes»、«turn»、«followers»、« appears»、« been»、« turning»、« totally»、«'t»、« on»、«the»、« help»、«be»、«yt»
patterns.context: 这些标记分布在多个句法位置，与大写词首 T 或段落边界没有稳定的共同条件；可能是独立的弱模式或上下文效应。

en.description: The strongest shared trigger across all passages is a capital T at the beginning of a text fragment, followed by various words; weaker activation also covers line-break boundaries, common function words, and a lowercase t after a hyphen.

patterns.name: Capital letter T
patterns.context: The marker is adjacent to a capital T at the beginning of a text fragment, followed by characters forming various words; no particular meaning or syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; at the beginning of a paragraph, section, or entry

patterns.name: Paragraph boundary after a line break
patterns.context: A new text beginning with a capital T follows a line break or blank line; the line break itself also has weaker activation.
patterns.domain: Formatted text such as Wikipedia, forum Q&A, email, and web pages

patterns.name: Common function words within sentences
patterns.context: These words occur in ordinary syntactic contexts, with weaker activation and no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Lowercase t after a hyphen
patterns.context: A lowercase t occurs after a hyphen within a word; only one example appears, so it is unclear whether this is an independent pattern.

8_1458.concept: 文本中的大写 T
8_1458.description: 最强且跨所有片段的共同触发是文本片段开头的大写 T，后接各类不同单词；弱激活还覆盖换行边界、常见功能词及一处连字符后的 t。

patterns.name: 大写字母 T
patterns.trigger: 新段落或小节开头的 «T»10（如“«T»10ributaries”“«T»10rying”“«T»10oward”）
patterns.context: 标记紧邻文本片段开头的大写 T，后续字符组成多种不同单词；不要求特定词义或句法。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；段落、小节或条目开头

patterns.name: 换行后的段落边界
patterns.context: 换行或空行后出现以大写 T 起始的新文本；换行本身也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia、论坛问答、邮件、网页等排版文本

patterns.name: 句中常见功能词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在普通句法环境中，强度较弱，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 连字符后的小写 t
patterns.context: 单词内部连字符后出现小写 t；仅见一例，不能确定是否为独立模式。

en.description: All passages show a capital «T» near a line break or sentence/paragraph boundary; the following word forms vary widely. A few passages also mark nearby words, symbols, or semantic words, without a stable pattern; passage 9 has no discernible pattern apart from «T».

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capital T tokenization or word forms
patterns.context: A word beginning with capital T occurs after a line break, paragraph break, or new sentence; subsequent word-stem forms vary, and sometimes the following fragment is also marked.
patterns.domain: Narratives, expository prose, and encyclopedia text across domains

patterns.name: Inconsistent neighboring-word activations
patterns.context: In a few passages, nearby ordinary words or symbols are marked in addition to the T-initial word; these words differ semantically across passages, with no consistent condition.
patterns.domain: Reviews, product descriptions, technical Q&A, and other genres

patterns.name: Local semantic-word activation
patterns.context: In individual passages, words related to the sentence’s meaning are activated, but the trigger words differ and share no common context.
patterns.domain: Narratives, reviews, geography, and historical text

8_1458.concept: 段落边界处的大写T
8_1458.description: 所有片段都在换行或句段边界附近出现大写«T»；后续词形差异很大。少数片段另标记邻近词、符号或语义词，未形成稳定模式；第9段除«T»外无可辨规律。

patterns.name: 句首大写 T 的分词或词形
patterns.context: 换行、段落或新句后出现大写 T 起始的词；后续词干形态不一致，有时标记紧随的词片段
patterns.domain: 多领域叙述、说明文及百科文本

patterns.name: 不一致的邻近词激活
patterns.trigger: 如« minutes»、« turn»；« tied»、« to»、« you»；« can»、« also»、« \»、« i»、« log»
patterns.context: 少数片段中，除 T 起始词外，附近普通词或符号也被标记；这些词与各段语义各异，未见一致条件
patterns.domain: 评论、产品说明、技术问答等

patterns.name: 局部语义词激活
patterns.trigger: « made»、« sit»、« still»；« appears»、« go»；« turning»、« totally»；« been»
patterns.context: 个别片段出现与句子语义相关的词激活，但触发词彼此不同，缺乏共同上下文
patterns.domain: 叙事、评论、地理、历史文本

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to dynamical in scientific contexts, covering systems, evolution, states, correlation lengths, operators, fields, relaxation mechanisms, and processes; also includes a paper-title formatting marker and one Sjögren’s spelling fragment.

patterns.name: dynamical and its inflections
patterns.context: Primarily the word dynamical in scientific texts, covering dynamical systems, models, quantities, operators, fields, mechanisms, and processes; sometimes followed by a noun or separated by line breaks or markers.
patterns.domain: Physics, biomedical modeling, astrophysics, and other scientific papers

patterns.name: Section-title formatting
patterns.context: Numbered, marked title or section-divider lines with equals-sign rules; no apparent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Structured paper text, PubMed Central documents

patterns.name: Sjögren’s syndrome proper name
patterns.context: The disease name Sjögren’s syndrome is split across multiple tokens; this segment shows no dynamical theme shared with the others.

8_1498.concept: dynamical（动力学）相关
8_1498.description: 主要对科学语境中的 dynamical 强烈响应，覆盖系统、演化、状态、相关长度、算符、场、弛豫机制及过程；另见论文标题格式标记和一次 Sjögren’s 拼写片段。

patterns.name: dynamical及词形
patterns.trigger: «dynamical»（以及«dynamical»« evolutions»、«dynamical»« regimes»、«dynamical»« correlation length»、«dynamical»« operator»、«dynamical»« fields»、«dynamical»« relaxation mechanism»、«dynamical»« processes»）
patterns.context: 主要是在科学文本中出现 dynamical 一词，涵盖动力学系统、模型、相关量、算符、场、机制与过程；有时后接名词或被换行、标记分隔。
patterns.domain: 物理、生物医学建模、天体物理及其他科学论文

patterns.name: 章节标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或章节分隔行中，带有编号、标记及等号线；没有明显的语义触发词。
patterns.domain: 论文结构化文本、PubMed Central 文档

patterns.name: Sjögren’s syndrome专名
patterns.context: 疾病名称 Sjögren’s syndrome 的拼写被拆分为多个 token；该段未见其他段共有的动力学主题。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse formats: dynamical in academic texts, titles and line breaks, medical conditions, email greetings, and j in mathematical expressions; these patterns differ markedly.

patterns.name: dynamical-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in academic sentences describing systems, units, or states; modifies “units” and “regimes” respectively.
patterns.domain: Complex systems research, academic fluid mechanics

patterns.name: Question title
patterns.context: The title-like phrase “Key question,” followed by a section marker or divider line.

patterns.name: Football title and line breaks
patterns.context: “Football” appears repeatedly as a standalone heading, accompanied by line breaks.

patterns.name: Medical condition names
patterns.context: Medical names contain tokenization markers; includes triple-negative breast cancer and Sjögren syndrome.

patterns.name: Email greeting
patterns.context: An email opens with the greeting “Hello,” to the recipient, followed by an attachment note or personal pleasantries.

patterns.name: j in mathematical symbols or expressions
patterns.context: In a math problem or definition, the letter j appears in an equation or variable expression; surrounding markers are scattered across different tokens.

8_1498.concept: none
8_1498.description: 激活分布于多种格式：学术文本中的 dynamical、标题与换行、医学病名、邮件问候，以及数学表达式中的 j；这些模式彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: dynamical 相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述系统、单元或状态的学术句子中；分别修饰“units”和“regimes”。
patterns.domain: 复杂系统研究、流体力学学术文体

patterns.name: 问题标题
patterns.context: 标题式短语“Key question”，后接章节标记或分隔线。

patterns.name: 足球标题及换行
patterns.context: “Football”作为独立标题重复出现，并伴随换行。

patterns.name: 医学疾病名称
patterns.context: 医学名称内部被分词标记；涉及三阴性乳腺癌和 Sjögren 综合征。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或医学资料

patterns.name: 邮件问候语
patterns.context: 邮件开头以“Hello,”问候收件人，后续为附件说明或个人寒暄。

patterns.name: 数学符号或表达式中的 j
patterns.context: 数学题或定义上下文中，字母 j 出现在算式或变量表达式里；周围标记分散在不同 token 上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across treatment, screening, evidence, and behavior descriptions in medical research, as well as legal headings, email spacing and signatures, code punctuation, and identifiers; no unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Results- or treatment-related wording
patterns.context: Medical abstracts contain result markers and treatment- or screening-related terms; in [1], “treatment” is split into multiple activation fragments.

patterns.name: Evidence and research-conclusion wording
patterns.context: Describes evidence-based treatment, recent or experimental evidence, and research conclusions.

patterns.name: Precedential case heading in legal documents
patterns.context: Blank filling, line breaks, and the “PRECEDENTIAL” heading at the top of court documents; activations concentrate mainly on formatting symbols and within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Separators and proper names in email
patterns.context: Blank lines, dates/signatures in email excerpts, and names in conversational sentences.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in a behavior name
patterns.context: A behavior name in a research title concerning young Hispanic women; activations fall on initial and medial fragments and the following noun.

patterns.name: Objects and line-break formatting in code
patterns.context: Object creation, property assignment, and line-break indentation in code blocks; scattered activations on punctuation, indentation, and identifiers.

8_1498.concept: none
8_1498.description: 激活分散在医学研究的治疗、筛查、证据与行为表述，也出现在法律标题、邮件空行与署名、代码标点和标识符；尚无统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 结果或治疗相关措辞
patterns.context: 医学摘要中出现结果标记、治疗或筛查相关词语；[1] 中“treatment”被拆分为多个激活片段。

patterns.name: 证据及研究结论措辞
patterns.context: 描述循证治疗、近期证据或实验性证据及其研究结论。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书中的先例标题
patterns.context: 法院文件页首的空白填充、分行和“PRECEDENTIAL”标题；激活主要集中在格式符号及词内片段。

patterns.name: 邮件中的分隔与专名
patterns.context: 邮件片段中的空行、日期/署名，以及对话句子中的姓名。

patterns.name: 行为名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 年轻西班牙裔女性相关研究标题中的行为名称；激活落在词首、词中片段及后接名词上。

patterns.name: 代码中的对象与换行格式
patterns.context: 代码块中对象创建、属性赋值和换行缩进；呈现零散的标点、缩进及标识符激活。

en.description: In most passages, alternative denotes a substitute option in noun phrases, covering treatments, diagnoses, markers, fuels, folding, organization, and function; segment 5 strongly activates on the title word Transductive, which this pattern does not explain.

patterns.name: alternative as an option
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases to denote an option different from the primary, conventional, or previously mentioned option, diagnosis, treatment, fuel, organization, or function; sometimes preceded by an article or preposition, and sometimes appearing mid-sentence.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, patent, psychological, and academic texts

patterns.name: Recurring phrase in alternative-fuel vehicles
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph first mentions alternative fuels, then uses the fixed phrase “alternative fuel vehicles”; activation concentrates on the second occurrence of alternative.

patterns.name: Transductive in a title
patterns.context: The opening word in a title is split into subword tokens; the context is an academic title about clustering methods, with no occurrence of alternative.

8_1498.concept: 替代选项
8_1498.description: 多数段落在名词短语中以 alternative 表示替代选项，涵盖治疗、诊断、标志物、燃料、折叠、组织方式和功能；第5段则强激活于标题词 Transductive，无法由该模式解释。

patterns.name: alternative 作为选择性方案
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语中，表示与主要、常规或已提及选项不同的方案、诊断、治疗、燃料、组织方式或功能；有时前接冠词或介词，有时位于句中。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学、专利、心理学及学术文本

patterns.name: 替代燃料车辆复现短语
patterns.context: 专利背景段中先提到替代燃料，随后出现固定短语“alternative fuel vehicles”；激活集中在第二次出现的 alternative。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Transductive
patterns.context: 标题开头的单词被拆成子词标记；上下文是聚类方法的学术标题，未出现 alternative。
patterns.domain: 学术论文标题/机器学习

en.concept: evidence and sufficiency vocabulary in scientific discourse
en.description: Activations occur mainly on “evidence” in scientific texts and on “sufficiently” in two instances; other highly activated words occur respectively in immunology discussion, legal document headers, an ADA title, publication metadata, and RNA folding discussion, without a unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: “evidence” and its collocations in scientific discourse
patterns.context: Appears in scientific statements about treatment, experimental results, or research findings; in [1], evidence and based are joined as “evidence-based”
patterns.domain: Biomedical and scientific papers, research funding texts

patterns.name: “sufficiently” and judgments of sufficiency
patterns.context: Used to judge whether an interaction is common enough to matter or whether detection performance is high enough

patterns.name: Narrative of antiviral immune response
patterns.context: Describes immune responses and viral clearance during acute infection; the highly activated words are not obvious terms shared with other segments

patterns.name: Federal appellate court document header
patterns.context: Title and citation information sections of legal decisions or appellate court documents

patterns.name: ADA event title
patterns.context: A document excerpt presented with a title and structured markers

patterns.name: Paper body sections and publication metadata
patterns.context: Body headings and section markers appear alongside journal publication information
patterns.domain: Academic paper formatting or paper-corpus annotation

patterns.name: Alternative structures and supplementary discussion
patterns.context: Discusses thermodynamically stable folding of RNA sequences and adds methodological advantages

8_1498.concept: 科学论述中的证据与充分性词汇
8_1498.description: 激活主要见于科学文本中的“evidence”，以及两处“sufficiently”；其余高激活词分别出现在免疫学论述、法律文书抬头、ADA标题、出版元数据和RNA折叠论述中，缺少统一词汇模式。

patterns.name: “evidence”及其科学论述搭配
patterns.trigger: “evidence”在[1]、[5]、[8]中分别激活10、9、9；相邻搭配包括“Many evidence-based treatments”“Experimental evidence”“Recent evidence suggests”
patterns.context: 出现在关于治疗、实验结果或研究发现的科学陈述中；[1]中 evidence 与 based 连写为“evidence-based”
patterns.domain: 生物医学与科学论文、研究资助文本

patterns.name: “sufficiently”及充分性判断
patterns.context: 用于判断某种相互作用是否常见到足以重要，或检测性能是否足够高

patterns.name: 病毒免疫反应叙述
patterns.trigger: “due”激活9；附近有“acute HBV infection”“T cell responses”“clearance”
patterns.context: 描述急性感染中的免疫反应及病毒清除；高激活词并非与其他段共享的明显术语

patterns.name: 联邦上诉法院文书抬头
patterns.trigger: “United States”中“States”激活9；伴随“NON-PRECEDENTIAL DISPOSITION”“Court of Appeals”
patterns.context: 法律判决或上诉法院文件的标题、引用说明部分

patterns.name: ADA事件标题
patterns.trigger: “Events”激活9，前接“ADA”；其后是花括号编号和分隔线
patterns.context: 以标题及结构化标记呈现的文档片段
patterns.domain: 未能确定的文档或事件记录

patterns.name: 论文正文区块及出版元数据
patterns.trigger: “January”激活9、“11”激活7；片段另含“Main Text”“Structure *20*”及页码和年份
patterns.context: 正文标题、章节标记与期刊出版信息相邻
patterns.domain: 学术论文格式或论文语料标注

patterns.name: 替代结构及附加论述
patterns.trigger: “addition”激活9，“alternative”激活8；出现于“in addition”及“alternative folds”
patterns.context: 讨论RNA序列的热力学稳定折叠，并补充方法优点

en.description: Primarily responds to medical and public health texts, especially disease burden, global statistics, public health problem wording, and biomedical experimental terminology; also covers lists of project objectives. It also responds to C/C++ compilation errors and code declarations.

patterns.name: Public health problem phrasing
patterns.context: A disease or health condition is described as a major public health problem, often followed by a population or global scope.

patterns.name: Global disease burden and epidemiological figures
patterns.context: Reports disease incidence, number of people affected, or global health burden; figures are often followed by a range or time information.

patterns.name: Technical terms and methods in medical research
patterns.context: Describes experimental methods, molecular changes, or test performance related to molecular biology, virology, or clinical testing.

patterns.name: Lists and research objectives in medical texts
patterns.context: Project abstracts or research plans list objectives, samples, treatments, and experimental steps.

patterns.name: C/C++ compilation errors and code snippets
patterns.context: Compiler diagnostics, test cases, or Q&A explanations, with code interspersed with natural-language explanations.

8_1498.concept: 技术性问题与研究描述
8_1498.description: 主要响应医学与公共卫生文本，尤其是疾病负担、全球统计、公共卫生问题措辞及生物医学实验术语；也覆盖项目目标列举。另对 C/C++ 编译错误和代码声明有反应。

patterns.name: 公共卫生问题表述
patterns.trigger: “a major public health problem” / “a major public health issue”
patterns.context: 疾病或健康状况被描述为重大公共卫生问题，常接人群或全球范围。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、项目摘要

patterns.name: 全球疾病负担与流行病学数字
patterns.trigger: “annually worldwide”“worldwide”及病例、人口、百分比等数字
patterns.context: 陈述疾病发生率、患病人数或全球健康负担；数字后常接范围或时间信息。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的技术性术语与方法
patterns.trigger: “siRNA-mediated target RNA cleavage”“sequence-specific”“HCV RNA assay sensitivity”“Nonsynonymous substitutions”
patterns.context: 围绕分子生物学、病毒学或临床检测，描述实验方法、分子变化或检测性能。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的列举与研究目标
patterns.trigger: “following objectives: A)”以及“together with”“and”连接的实验材料或处理条件
patterns.context: 项目摘要或研究计划列出目标、样本、处理方式和实验步骤。

patterns.name: C/C++ 编译错误与代码片段
patterns.trigger: “expected-error”“invalid prototype”“variadic arguments are not allowed”“int printf”“int r, c, j”
patterns.context: 编译器诊断、测试用例或问答解释，代码与自然语言说明交错。

en.description: Responds to genes, genetic variation, genomes, and functional annotation terms in biomedicine and bioinformatics, and also to exposure biomarkers; these share specialized research objects and analytical terminology, but the topics are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Genetic markers and gene associations
patterns.context: Discusses associations of genotypes, genetic variants, or alleles with diseases, traits, or treatment outcomes; includes research aims, results, and association analyses.

patterns.name: Genome and sequence comparison
patterns.context: Describes microbial genome sequencing, genome or sequence comparisons between strains, and genome analysis results.

patterns.name: Functional annotation and enrichment analysis
patterns.context: Explains how analytical tools or workflows annotate, test for enrichment of, or cluster functional categories such as GO and pathways.

patterns.name: Exposure biomarkers
patterns.context: Introduces biomarkers used to measure exposure to particular chemicals and their immunological or chemical origins.

8_1498.concept: 生物医学研究术语
8_1498.description: 响应生物医学与生物信息学中的基因、遗传变异、基因组和功能注释术语，也涉及暴露生物标志物；共同呈现专业研究对象与分析术语，但主题并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 遗传标记与基因关联
patterns.trigger: “gene”“polymorphism”“genetic variant”“alleles”“genotypes”及具体基因、位点或突变名称
patterns.context: 讨论基因型、遗传变异或等位基因与疾病、性状或处理结果的关联；包括研究目的、结果和相关性分析。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 基因组与序列比较
patterns.context: 描述微生物基因组测序、菌株间基因组或序列比较，以及基因组分析结果。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 功能注释与富集分析
patterns.context: 说明分析工具或流程如何对 GO、通路等功能类别进行注释、富集检验或聚类。

patterns.name: 暴露生物标志物
patterns.context: 介绍用于测量特定化学物暴露的生物标志物及其免疫学或化学来源。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、环境健康

en.description: Activations mainly fall on ordinal markers first and second in lists; Human, two, and E. coli also appear. The first two categories are concentrated in biomedical texts, while the remaining triggers are scattered.

patterns.name: First item in a sequence
patterns.context: Marks the first item in a group, step, or sequence, often followed by nouns such as group or step

patterns.name: Second item in a sequence
patterns.context: Marks the second item in a group, sequence, or set of objects

patterns.name: Human-related object
patterns.context: Human modifies biomedical objects such as cells or red blood cells

patterns.name: Two-way classification
patterns.context: two introduces two types discussed next

patterns.name: Pathogen naming
patterns.context: Appears in the name of extraintestinal pathogenic E. coli

8_1498.concept: 序列标记与生物医学实体
8_1498.description: 激活主要落在列举结构的序数标记 first、second，另见 Human、two 和 E. coli；前两类集中于生物医学文本，其余触发词呈零散分布。

patterns.name: 序列中的首项
patterns.context: 用于标记分组、步骤或序列中的第一项，常接 group、step 等名词

patterns.name: 序列中的第二项
patterns.context: 用于标记分组、序列或对象中的第二项

patterns.name: 人类相关对象
patterns.context: Human 修饰细胞或红细胞等生物医学对象

patterns.name: 二分类型
patterns.context: two 引出后文的两种类型

patterns.name: 病原体命名
patterns.context: 出现在肠外致病性大肠杆菌的名称中

en.concept: common English function words and local word forms
en.description: The most prominent trigger is often the English quantifier one, especially in contexts such as one distinct, one described, and one-half; there are also scattered activations on you in direct address, the choice structure either, code identifiers, and biomedical vocabulary. The triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Prominent activation on the quantifier one
patterns.context: In English sentences, one indicates quantity, existence, or a choice between two; surrounding contexts vary widely. one is sometimes followed by modifiers such as distinct, described, or subcutaneous, and sometimes appears in an either...or construction.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English technical and explanatory texts

patterns.name: Prominent activation on you
patterns.context: Directly addresses a reader or software user, describing operations, functions, or actions to perform; nearby structures include allows you to.

patterns.name: Prominent activation on either
patterns.context: Appears in an either...or choice structure, followed by possible causes or options; this segment also contains low-intensity one, but the peak is on either.

patterns.name: one as part of a code identifier
patterns.context: A Go function or type name contains the number 32; the activation marker falls on the uint substring. The surrounding code parses a string slice. Here it is not the natural-language quantifier one.

patterns.name: Possible trigger within rather
patterns.context: A biological discussion of miRNA-mediated gene-expression silencing and mRNA degradation; there is no obvious one or you, and activation falls on repression.

patterns.name: Scattered activations in protein terminology and complementation experiments
patterns.context: Describes protein localization and yeast complementation experiments; activations occur within terminology and on experimental objects, with no clear trigger pattern shared with other segments.

8_1498.concept: 英文常见功能词与局部词形
8_1498.description: 最显著触发多为英文数量词 one，尤其是 one distinct、one described、one-half 等语境；另有直接面向用户的 you、选择结构 either，以及代码标识符和生物医学词汇上的零散激活。触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 量词 one 的突出激活
patterns.context: 在英文句子中，one 表示数量、存在或二选一；前后语境差异很大，one 有时后接 distinct、described、subcutaneous 等修饰语，有时位于 either...or 结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文技术与说明性文本

patterns.name: you 的突出激活
patterns.context: 直接对读者或程序使用者说话，描述操作、功能或需要执行的动作；邻近结构包括 allows you to。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 注释

patterns.name: either 的突出激活
patterns.context: 出现在 either...or 的选择结构中，后接可能原因或选项；该段也包含低强度的 one，但峰值在 either。

patterns.name: one 的代码标识符组成部分
patterns.context: Go 函数名或类型名含数字 32，激活标记落在 uint 子串；周围是解析字符串切片的代码。此处并非自然语言数量词 one。

patterns.name: rather 的一部分可能触发
patterns.context: miRNA 对基因表达的沉默及 mRNA 降解的生物学论述；没有明显的 one 或 you，激活落在 repression。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语与补偿实验中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述蛋白定位及酵母互补实验；激活分布在术语内部和实验对象上，未见与其他段共享的明确触发结构。

en.concept: words related to style and research entities
en.description: Activations span medical abstracts, NIH project abstracts, and legal headings, falling on research-aim statements, animal or yeast models, expression in human tissues, ratio expressions, and Seventh in a court heading; no single semantics covers all materials.

patterns.name: Research-aim statement
patterns.context: A sentence in a medical abstract introducing the research objective; activations fall on research, aim, and the verb it introduces.

patterns.name: Mouse animal model
patterns.context: Appears in a description of an experimental rodent glioma model.

patterns.name: Animal deficiency model
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion of testing the importance of a transporter by studying animals deficient in its expression.

patterns.name: Numerical ratio expression
patterns.context: Used to report the proportion of males in a primate study; triggers concentrate on the fractional expression.

patterns.name: Expression in human tissues
patterns.context: Appears in a statement describing E2s as widely expressed in human tissues.

patterns.name: Yeast protein research
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of yeast proteins and their complementation experiments or research background.

patterns.name: Circuit designation in a court name
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed format of the formal title of a U.S. Court of Appeals, with Circuit and line-break formatting around it.

8_1498.concept: 文体与研究实体相关词
8_1498.description: 激活跨医学摘要、NIH 项目摘要及法律标题，落在研究目的句、动物或酵母模型、人类组织表达、比例表达，以及法院标题中的 Seventh；不存在覆盖全部材料的单一语义。

patterns.name: 研究目的表述
patterns.context: 医学摘要中介绍研究目标的句式；激活落在研究、目的及其引出的动词上。

patterns.name: 小鼠动物模型
patterns.context: 出现在实验性啮齿动物胶质瘤模型的描述中。

patterns.name: 动物缺陷模型
patterns.context: 出现在通过研究转运蛋白表达缺陷动物来检验其重要性的论述中。

patterns.name: 数量比例表达
patterns.context: 用于报告灵长类研究中男性所占比例，触发范围集中在分数表达。

patterns.name: 人类组织中的表达
patterns.context: 出现在描述 E2s 广泛表达于人体组织的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学／NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 酵母蛋白研究
patterns.context: 出现在酵母蛋白及其互补实验或研究背景的描述中。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的巡回区
patterns.context: 出现在美国上诉法院正式标题的固定格式中，前后有 Circuit 和换行排版。

en.concept: Model/bacterial terms and Seventh Circuit formatting
en.description: Activations concentrate on animal experimental model phrasing, bacteria-related biomedical vocabulary, and “Seventh Circuit” in two legal docket headers. The first three categories are related by corpus and meaning, but court formatting is a clearly distinct pattern.

patterns.name: Animal/experimental model terms
patterns.context: Animal- and model-related phrasing appears when discussing diseases, genetic defects, or experimental subjects; numerical or hyphen-adjacent contexts also sometimes occur.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, NIH grant abstracts, and medical literature

patterns.name: Bacteria-related terms
patterns.context: Bacteria appear as sources of transporters, expression systems, or evolutionary origins; they may also be associated with MDR-ABC transporters, viral nucleocapsid expression, or RNA interference proteins.
patterns.domain: Microbiology, molecular biology, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: U.S. Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals docket formatting
patterns.context: The court name appears in a docket header, near U.S. court names, case numbers, dates, and line breaks.

8_1498.concept: 模型／细菌词与第七巡回法院格式
8_1498.description: 激活集中于动物实验模型表述、细菌相关生物医学词汇，以及两段法律案卷页眉中的“Seventh Circuit”；前三类虽有语料与词义关联，但法院格式是明显不同的模式。

patterns.name: 动物／实验模型相关词
patterns.context: 研究疾病、遗传缺陷或实验对象时，出现动物及模型相关表述；有时也出现数值或连字符邻近上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、NIH资助摘要及医学文献

patterns.name: 细菌相关词
patterns.context: 细菌作为转运蛋白来源、表达系统或进化来源出现；也可与MDR-ABC转运蛋白、病毒核衣壳表达或RNA干扰蛋白相关。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、分子生物学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 美国第七巡回上诉法院案卷格式
patterns.context: 法院名称出现在案卷页眉，邻近美国法院名称、案号、日期及换行符。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判例／FreeLaw案卷文本

en.description: All snippets come from the first page of Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinions. Strong responses concentrate on the split “UNPUBLISHED” and “FOURTH CIRCUIT” headings; whitespace, line breaks, and the court name also elicit weaker responses. A few include party names.

patterns.name: Unpublished opinion marker
patterns.context: In the title area of the first page of a court opinion, UNPUBLISHED is split across multiple tokens; this substring activates strongly.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: Fourth Circuit heading
patterns.context: In the court heading “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE FOURTH CIRCUIT”; «TH» is the strongest trigger token in every sample.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: Court document layout and header
patterns.context: The first-page opinion format consists of centered or indented court names, whitespace padding, and line breaks; heading words also show weaker positive activations.

patterns.name: Case number opening
patterns.context: A case number follows the court heading, but the number itself is not marked as an activation token; its format is part of the header template.

patterns.name: Party name fragments
patterns.context: A few samples also include party name fragments after the court heading.

8_1498.concept: 第四巡回法院未刊判决页眉
8_1498.description: 所有片段都来自第四巡回上诉法院判决首页；强响应集中在拆分的“UNPUBLISHED”和“FOURTH CIRCUIT”抬头，空白、换行及法院名称也有较弱响应。少数出现当事人名称。

patterns.name: 未刊判决标记
patterns.context: 法院判决首页的标题区，UNPUBLISHED 被拆分成多个 token；该子串激活显著。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 第四巡回法院标题
patterns.context: “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE FOURTH CIRCUIT” 的法院抬头中；«TH» 在全部样本中都是最强触发 token。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 法院文书版式与页眉
patterns.context: 居中或缩进的法院名称、空白填充和换行构成的判决首页格式；标题词也有较弱正激活。

patterns.name: 案件编号起始
patterns.context: 法院抬头之后出现案件编号，但编号本身未标为激活 token；其格式是页眉模板的一部分。

patterns.name: 当事人名称片段
patterns.context: 少数样本在法院抬头后还出现当事人名称片段。

en.concept: Key terms in scientific and technical text
en.description: Activations cover research hypothesis phrasing, animal model studies, crop breeding evaluation, software unexpected-error phrasing, and descriptions of mammalian gastric enzymes. Several patterns come from scientific text, while others occur in patent and code contexts.

patterns.name: Research hypothesis phrasing
patterns.context: After introducing research aims or methods, “It is hypothesized that” introduces an expected result or research hypothesis

patterns.name: Animal models
patterns.context: Describes using animal models to study disease, infection, or pathophysiology; sometimes specifically refers to a lentivirus model

patterns.name: Crop breeding evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses crossing self-pollinating crops, progeny counts, and periodic objective evaluation of breeding plans

patterns.name: Unexpected-error handling
patterns.context: When logging or throwing an exception, unexpected error describes an unforeseen software error

patterns.name: Mammalian gastric enzymes
patterns.context: Introduces isolated and validated mammalian gastric enzymes; preceding text lists related genes and other forms

8_1498.concept: 科研与技术文本中的关键术语
8_1498.description: 激活涵盖研究假设句式、动物模型研究、作物育种评估、软件异常错误表述及哺乳动物胃酶描述；其中多种模式来自科研文本，但另有专利和代码语境。

patterns.name: 研究假设句式
patterns.context: 研究目标或方法介绍后，以“It is hypothesized that”引出预期结果或研究假设
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/研究计划

patterns.name: 动物模型
patterns.context: 描述用动物模型研究疾病、感染或病理生理；有时具体限定为 lentivirus 模型
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要/项目说明

patterns.name: 作物育种评估
patterns.context: 讨论自花授粉作物的杂交、后代数量与育种计划的定期客观评估

patterns.name: 意外错误异常处理
patterns.context: 日志记录或抛出异常时，用 unexpected error 描述未预期的软件错误
patterns.domain: C# 源代码/软件错误处理

patterns.name: 哺乳动物胃酶
patterns.context: 介绍已分离并验证的哺乳动物胃酶；前文列举相关基因及其他形式

en.description: Primarily responds to derivative order, expressions, and differentiation instructions in polynomial calculus problems; also appears in code exception handling, biomedical descriptions of genetic diseases, Down syndrome epidemiology, and wrestling forum recruitment copy. No clear cross-domain shared pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation problems
patterns.context: When natural-language differentiation instructions occur alongside variables and polynomial powers, activation falls especially on derivative order, expression fragments, and nearby results; some problems also include the previous problem's result or a line break

patterns.name: Exceptions and error throwing
patterns.context: When unexpected errors are described in generated code or logs and an exception is thrown after logging the error

patterns.name: Predicted products in genetic disease research
patterns.context: In a research proposal abstract introducing Batten disease, gene deletion, and its effects

patterns.name: Down syndrome epidemiological description
patterns.context: When an abstract introduces Down syndrome and describes its incidence and associated defects

patterns.name: Forum discussion promotion
patterns.context: Recruiting members to participate in a wrestling-event-related forum discussion and specifying regular discussion times

8_1498.concept: 多领域文本局部模式
8_1498.description: 主要响应多项式求导题中的阶数、表达式及求导指令；另见代码异常处理、生物医学遗传病描述、唐氏综合征流行病学和摔角论坛招募文案，跨领域共享模式不明显。

patterns.name: 数学多项式求导题
patterns.trigger: “Find the second derivative of”“What is the third derivative of”“wrt”及多项式表达式
patterns.context: 在自然语言求导指令与变量、幂次多项式同现时，激活尤其落在导数阶数、表达式片段及结果附近；部分题目还带有前一题结果或换行

patterns.name: 异常错误与异常抛出
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error”“a bug”“throw new System.Exception”“An unexpected error occurred”
patterns.context: 生成代码或日志中描述意外错误，并记录错误后抛出异常时

patterns.name: 遗传病研究中的预测产物
patterns.context: 介绍 Batten disease、基因缺失及其影响的研究提案摘要中
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 唐氏综合征流行病学描述
patterns.context: 摘要介绍唐氏综合征及其发病率、相关缺陷时

patterns.name: 论坛讨论宣传
patterns.trigger: “Join our community”“weekly live discussion threads”“Monday night”
patterns.context: 招募成员参与摔角赛事相关论坛讨论，并说明固定讨论时间时

en.description: Nine snippets activate on the all-caps headings and nearby case numbers of unpublished Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinions; one activates on logging and exception handling for an unexpected data access error in C# code. The two contexts have no clear shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Unpublished Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinion heading
patterns.context: These tokens form the first-page court heading in uppercase, fixed layout, and line breaks; they are often followed by the case number “No.” and digits. Activation spans multiple heading words, with “TH” most prominent.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court legal documents, especially unpublished Fourth Circuit opinions

patterns.name: Unexpected-error exception in code
patterns.context: C#-style code error logging and exception-handling context, mentioning a data access error and code generator, then throwing an exception; trigger words occur in the log string and exception statement.

8_1498.concept: 无明显统一概念
8_1498.description: 九段激活于第四巡回上诉法院未刊发判决的全大写抬头及案号附近；一段激活于 C# 代码中意外数据访问错误的日志与异常处理。两类语境无明显共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 第四巡回上诉法院未刊发判决抬头
patterns.context: 这些词以大写、固定排版和换行组成法院判决首页抬头；常紧接案号“No.”及数字。激活遍及抬头中的多个词，最突出的是“TH”。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院法律文书，尤其第四巡回上诉法院未刊发意见书

patterns.name: 代码中的意外错误异常
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error accessing data”、“unexpected error occurred”、“throw new System.Exception”
patterns.context: C# 风格代码的错误日志与异常处理语境，提及数据访问错误、代码生成器，并抛出异常；触发词分布在日志字符串和异常语句中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across snippets involving error logs, math QA, biomedical variants and genes, serialized documents, paper declarations, population proportions, and Java bytecode; no clear, consistent trigger spanning domains is evident.

patterns.name: Errors and exception handling
patterns.context: In software code or logs, describes an unexpected error and logs or throws an exception.

patterns.name: Operations and answer markers in math problems
patterns.context: Math QA or calculation problems involving differentiation or determining whether a number is composite or prime; activation occurs at multiple positions in problem text and numerical expressions.

patterns.name: CYP2C19 gene and variants
patterns.context: Introduces background information on the CYP2C19 enzyme, gene polymorphisms, and known variants.

patterns.name: MIME types for serialized resources
patterns.context: Discusses how MIME types are used to restore serialized objects and whether the relevant implementation is extensible.
patterns.domain: Github, software documentation or code comments

patterns.name: Disease mutations and protein products
patterns.context: In disease research, describes an individual carrying a kb-scale deletion, frameshift, and predicted amino acid product.

patterns.name: Nil and conflict-of-interest statements in paper declarations
patterns.context: Funding source and conflict-of-interest statements at the end of a paper.

patterns.name: Population racial proportions
patterns.context: Lists population racial composition as percentages, followed by ethnic group names or categories.

patterns.name: Java string method bytecode
patterns.context: Creates a String object in a Java class or decompiled/assembly-style bytecode and displays method structure.

8_1498.concept: none
8_1498.description: 激活分布于错误日志、数学问答、生物医学变异与基因、序列化文档、论文声明、人口比例及 Java 字节码等片段；未见跨领域统一的明确触发词。

patterns.name: 错误与异常处理
patterns.context: 软件代码或日志中，描述意外错误并记录或抛出异常。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算与答案标记
patterns.trigger: «What»、« first»、« derivative»、« False»；以及负号、数字和表达式片段
patterns.context: 数学问答或计算题，涉及求导、判断合数或素数；激活落在题面词语和数值表达式的多个位置。

patterns.name: CYP2C19 基因与变异
patterns.context: 介绍 CYP2C19 酶、基因多态性及已知变异等背景信息。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、生物医学

patterns.name: 序列化资源的 MIME 类型
patterns.context: 讨论 MIME 类型如何用于序列化对象的恢复，以及相关实现是否可扩展。

patterns.name: 疾病突变与蛋白产物
patterns.context: 疾病研究中描述个体携带 kb 级缺失、移码及预测的氨基酸产物。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter、生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 论文声明栏中的 Nil 与利益冲突
patterns.context: 论文末尾的支持来源和利益冲突声明。

patterns.name: 人口种族比例统计
patterns.trigger: «%»及其附近的种族名称与比例数字，如 « white»、« black»、« Asian»
patterns.context: 以百分比列出人口种族构成，后接族群名称或类别。

patterns.name: Java 字符串方法的字节码
patterns.context: Java 类或反编译/汇编式字节码中创建 String 对象并显示方法结构。

en.description: Primarily activates strongly on ethnic group names, percentages, and “two or more races” phrasing in demographic racial-composition passages; weaker activations also occur on third/one-third, unexpected-error phrasing, theme-options documentation, and Java formatting/configuration code.

patterns.name: Census racial-composition statistics
patterns.context: A racial-composition passage lists groups by percentage, often following “racial makeup … was”; Hispanic or Latino data may follow.

patterns.name: Ordinal third
patterns.context: Appears as an ordinal; in paragraph 1 it refers to a third derivative in a math problem, and in paragraph 6 it denotes a proportion in “one-third.”

patterns.name: Exception handling in code
patterns.context: When a program logs or throws an exception, it describes an unexpected error; paragraph 3 repeats unexpected/error in the same context.

patterns.name: Theme configuration documentation
patterns.context: Introduces built-in themes and configurable options.
patterns.domain: Documentation or comments in a code repository

patterns.name: Java formatting directives and configuration methods
patterns.context: Java code uses formatter markers around configuration code, including a method declaration and exception type.
patterns.domain: Java code in StackExchange technical QA

8_1498.concept: 混合：人口统计与技术文本
8_1498.description: 主要对人口统计种族构成段落中的族群名称、百分比及“two or more races”表述强烈激活；另对 third/one-third、异常错误措辞、主题选项文档和 Java 格式化配置代码有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 人口普查种族构成统计
patterns.trigger: “% White”, “African American”, “Asian”, “from two or more races”
patterns.context: 种族构成段落中，以百分比列出各族群，常见于“racial makeup … was”之后，也可能接着列出 Hispanic or Latino 数据。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地方人口普查描述

patterns.name: 序数词 third
patterns.context: 作为序数词出现；第1段在数学题中指三阶导数，第6段在“one-third”中表示比例。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理
patterns.context: 程序记录或抛出异常时，描述意外错误；第3段同一上下文中多次出现 unexpected/error。

patterns.name: 主题配置文档
patterns.context: 介绍内置主题及其可配置选项。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的文档或注释

patterns.name: Java 格式化指令与配置方法
patterns.context: Java 代码中用格式化器标记包围配置代码，包含方法声明及异常类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 Java 代码

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific and code text, often landing on alphanumeric labels, numerical quantity expressions, and boundaries or neighboring words in structured code; trigger conditions span domains and show no single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric boundaries and digit strings
patterns.context: Biomedical text includes gene, allele, population, and quantity names or expressions; activations often fall at boundaries between uppercase/lowercase letters, digits, and word groups.

patterns.name: Separators and boundaries in structured code
patterns.context: In code, configuration files, or code-generator logs, punctuation, identifiers, and natural-language words are interleaved; this occurs across different languages and formats, with no single grammatical structure evident.

patterns.name: Common words and numbers in narrative text
patterns.context: Public-facing health/autism-related narratives involving incidence and population counts.

patterns.name: Quantities and functional descriptions in scientific text
patterns.context: Scientific descriptions of the number of known members, protein families, or experimental results and transcriptional effects.

8_1498.concept: 字母数字与结构边界
8_1498.description: 激活散布于科学与代码文本，常落在字母数字混合标记、数字数量表达及结构化代码的边界或相邻词上；触发条件跨领域，未呈现单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 字母数字边界与数字串
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中基因、等位基因、群体与数量等专名或数字表达；激活常落在大小写字母、数字及词组边界上。

patterns.name: 结构化代码中的分隔与边界
patterns.context: 代码、配置文件或代码生成器日志中，标点、标识符与自然语言词汇交错；在不同语言及格式中均出现，未见单一语法结构。

patterns.name: 叙述文本中的常见词和数词
patterns.context: 面向公众的健康／自闭症相关叙述中，涉及发生率和人数的表达。

patterns.name: 科研文本中的数量与功能表述
patterns.context: 科学说明中描述已知成员数量、蛋白家族，或实验结果及转录效应。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学文本

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across medical and code text, including except ImportError, quantity or statistical expressions, Haskell's for all, Spanish unos, and The in documentation; sporadic activations also occur in medical proper names and population descriptions.

patterns.name: except ImportError error handling
