patterns.context: Python code catches import failure with except ImportError; in both instances activation falls on except

patterns.name: Quantifier one
patterns.context: In the About one-third construction, one denotes a portion of a proportion

patterns.name: known variant alleles
patterns.context: Describes the number of known variant alleles for a gene

patterns.name: false discovery rate
patterns.context: The term false discovery rate in statistical analysis

patterns.name: for all
patterns.context: The for all quantifier structure in Haskell type signatures or generic code

patterns.name: Spanish unos
patterns.context: The plural indefinite determiner in Spanish unos mej…; activation falls on the subword os

patterns.name: three times
patterns.context: A multiple expression describing the magnitude of increased risk

patterns.name: The in documentation
patterns.context: The in project documentation comments introduces a version note

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: Sporadic tokens in gene/polymorphism and population descriptions activate, with no trigger condition consistent with the other high-activation patterns

8_1498.concept: none
8_1498.description: 强激活分散于医学与代码等文本：包括 except ImportError、数量或统计表达、Haskell 的 for all、西班牙语 unos，以及文档中的 The；另有医学专名和人群描述中的零散激活。

patterns.name: except ImportError 错误处理
patterns.context: Python 代码中以 except ImportError 捕获导入失败；两处激活都落在 except 上

patterns.name: 数量词 one
patterns.context: About one-third 结构中，one 表示比例的一部分

patterns.name: known variant alleles
patterns.context: 描述基因具有已知变体等位基因的数量

patterns.name: false discovery rate
patterns.context: 统计分析中 false discovery rate 这一术语

patterns.name: for all
patterns.context: Haskell 类型签名或泛型代码中的 for all 量化结构

patterns.name: 西班牙语 unos
patterns.context: 西班牙语中 unos mej… 的复数不定限定词，激活落在子词 os

patterns.name: three times
patterns.context: 描述风险增加幅度的倍数表达

patterns.name: 文档中的 The
patterns.context: 项目文档注释中以 The 引出版本说明

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 激活落在基因/多态性与人群描述中的零散 token，未见与其他高激活模式一致的触发条件

en.concept: Numbers and terminology in medical text
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, proportions, and statistical/genetic terminology in biomedical text, and also covers scientific proper names; one example is a subscription-promotion call to action. No single stable trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers, proportions, and orders of magnitude
patterns.context: Quantifiers, numbers, and their units or ranges form prevalence, risk, sample-size, or multiplicative expressions; activation sometimes falls on the number itself and sometimes on adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical statistics and general quantity expressions

patterns.name: Statistical significance and discovery rate
patterns.context: Contexts involving statistical tests, enrichment analysis, and false discovery rate thresholds in genomics or proteomics papers.

patterns.name: Gene variants and polymorphisms
patterns.context: Describes gene polymorphisms, variant alleles, and their association with phenotypes in disease or infection research.

patterns.name: Specific substrings in scientific names
patterns.context: Proper names such as biological taxonomic names, gene/enzyme names, and syndrome names; trigger positions vary, with no stable shared local structure.

patterns.name: Call to action in promotional copy
patterns.context: A direct promotional invitation to readers to sign up or subscribe, emphasizing a free offer.

8_1498.concept: 医学文本中的数字与术语
8_1498.description: 主要在生物医学文本中响应数字、比例及统计/遗传学术语，也覆盖科学专名；另有一例订阅促销行动号召，未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字、比例与数量级
patterns.context: 数量词、数字及其单位或范围构成的流行率、风险、样本规模或倍数表达；有时激活落在数字本身，也落在相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学统计与一般数量表达

patterns.name: 统计显著性与发现率
patterns.context: 基因组学或蛋白质组学论文中，统计检验、富集分析及假发现率阈值的语境。

patterns.name: 基因变异与多态性
patterns.context: 疾病或感染研究中描述基因多态性、变异等位基因及其与表型的关联。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与医学摘要/专利背景

patterns.name: 科学名称中的特定子串
patterns.context: 生物分类名、基因/酶名及综合征名称等专名；触发位置各异，未见稳定共同局部结构。

patterns.name: 宣传语中的行动号召
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接促销邀请，要求注册或订阅并强调免费优惠。
patterns.domain: 娱乐节目/商业宣传文案

en.description: Responds to the subword fragment processing, patent-background opening phrases, “Recent advances” research-abstract phrases, and the proper name Dale; also activates on the name fragment Alaria marginata in encyclopedia text. Triggers span word meaning, style, and proper names.

patterns.name: Word fragment or stem processing
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences containing processing; it can refer to processing materials or information, or to processing as a research topic or in a title. Explicitly triggers in paragraphs 2 and 7; paragraph 3 is not marked for this word but has a related patent-background phrase.

patterns.name: Patent-background opening phrase
patterns.context: Opens a patent-background paragraph by introducing the invention’s subject with “This invention relates to...”; activation spans the opening phrase and intensifies near the subject term.

patterns.name: “advances” collocation
patterns.context: Describes progress in a research field in the phrase “Recent advances in...”; the field noun can vary.

patterns.name: Proper name Dale
patterns.context: The name Dale appears in biographical introductions, email discussions of people, or researcher biographies; the name triggers strong activation across multiple contexts.

patterns.name: Name fragment Alaria marginata
patterns.context: The biological name Alaria marginata is split into multiple tokens in an encyclopedia entry; activation is concentrated on the name fragments and nearby repeated entry text.

8_1507.description: 响应词片段 processing、专利背景开场句式、“Recent advances”研究摘要句式及专名 Dale；另对百科中的 Alaria marginata 名称片段激活。触发因素跨词义、文体和专名。

patterns.name: 单词片段或词干 processing
patterns.context: 在句中出现 processing；既可以指对材料或信息的处理，也可以是研究主题或标题中的 processing。第2、7段明确触发，第3段虽未标记该词，但有相关的专利背景句式。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 专利背景开场句式
patterns.context: 专利背景段落开头，以“This invention relates to...”引入发明主题；激活遍及开场短语，并在主题词附近增强。

patterns.name: advances 搭配
patterns.context: “Recent advances in...”句式中，描述研究领域的进展；相关领域名词可以不同。

patterns.name: 专名 Dale
patterns.context: 姓名 Dale 出现在人物介绍、邮件中的人员讨论或研究者履历中；多个语境都对该姓名产生较强激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、电子邮件、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: Alaria marginata 名称片段
patterns.context: 百科条目中生物学名称 Alaria marginata 被拆分成多个 token；激活集中在名称片段及其附近的重复条目文本。

en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse text features: fixed openings in patents and NIH text, specific biomedical terms, the name Dale, and Wikipedia subword fragments and mathematical symbols; there is no clear unifying semantics.

patterns.name: Internal substrings margin/ata
patterns.context: Adjacent text is split into these subword fragments, followed by a newline and then repeated

patterns.name: Patent-background boilerplate
patterns.context: A fixed patent boilerplate phrase opens the sentence and introduces the invention’s subject; subsequent text describes fasteners or internal combustion engines

patterns.name: proteins in scientific titles
patterns.context: Research titles or statements of purpose concerning proteins and their assessment or safety

patterns.name: “Recent advances” opening
patterns.context: The phrase opens a sentence introducing advances in human genetics or molecular biology

patterns.name: Proper name Dale
patterns.context: Appears as a person’s name; one instance is associated with actor Dale Evans, another appears alongside Shelley

patterns.name: Y chromosome
patterns.context: Associated with fluoride exposure, genes, and expression changes in mouse testes

patterns.name: F notation in mathematics
patterns.context: A mathematical paper uses a calligraphic F to denote a map between extension intervals, with discussion of symmetric random walks nearby

8_1507.description: 激活分散在多种文本特征上：专利和 NIH 的固定开头、特定生物医学术语、Dale 人名，以及 Wikipedia 子词片段和数学符号；没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 内部子串 margin/ata
patterns.trigger: “Al”“aria”“ margin”“ata”，其中 “ margin” 最强；随后重复该序列
patterns.context: 相邻文本被切成这些子词片段，序列后接换行并再次出现

patterns.name: 专利背景套语
patterns.context: 句首以该固定专利套语引出发明主题；后续描述紧固件或内燃机

patterns.name: 科学标题中的 proteins
patterns.trigger: “proteins”，前有“homologous”或“human”，并在片段中出现两次
patterns.context: 研究标题或目的陈述，涉及蛋白质及其评估或安全性

patterns.name: Recent advances 开头
patterns.context: 句首以该短语引出人类遗传学或分子生物学进展

patterns.name: 专名 Dale
patterns.context: 作为人名出现；一处与演员 Dale Evans 相连，一处与 Shelley 并列
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 电视节目介绍；Enron 邮件

patterns.name: Y chromosome
patterns.context: 与 fluoride exposure、genes 及小鼠睾丸中的表达变化相连

patterns.name: 数学中的 F 记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中以花体 F 表示扩张区间映射，周围讨论对称随机游走

en.description: Primarily activates on variable interpolation such as `${...}` or local fragments of configuration variable names, across template strings, Shell/CMake configuration, and explanations of their syntax; LaTeX formulas and repeated Latin species names are secondary heterogeneous patterns.

patterns.name: Template interpolation opener
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated at the start of variable interpolation expressions and on their variable names in template strings or script/build configurations; includes both JavaScript backtick templates and Shell/CMake-style variable references.

patterns.name: Uppercase identifier fragments in variable names
patterns.context: Configuration or environment variable names often consist of uppercase letters and underscores; activation falls on local name fragments, often within `${...}` interpolation or build-configuration syntax.
patterns.domain: Shell, CMake, build scripts, and code snippets

patterns.name: Explanation of template interpolation syntax
patterns.context: Discusses handling of braces in Ant property expansion and uses nested `${...}` as an example; this is a prose explanation of interpolation syntax, not a code-generation fragment.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas mix LaTeX control sequences, subscripts and superscripts, and expressions enclosed by dollar signs.

patterns.name: Proper names and repeated entry-style text
patterns.context: A species name is repeated consecutively and contains fragments of a Latin scientific name; no clear code or interpolation context is present.

8_1507.concept: 变量插值与标识符片段
8_1507.description: 主要对 `${...}` 一类变量插值或配置变量名的局部片段激活，跨模板字符串、Shell/CMake 配置及其语法说明；另见 LaTeX 公式和重复的拉丁学名，属次要异质模式。

patterns.name: 模板插值起始符
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板字符串或脚本/构建配置里的变量插值表达式开头及其变量名；既包括 JavaScript 反引号模板，也包括 Shell/CMake 风格变量引用。

patterns.name: 变量名中的大写标识符片段
patterns.context: 配置变量或环境变量名常以大写字母和下划线组成；激活落在名称的局部片段上，常处于 `${...}` 插值或构建配置语法中。

patterns.name: 模板插值语法说明
patterns.context: 讨论 Ant 属性展开中花括号的处理，并以嵌套 `${...}` 作为例子；不是代码生成片段，而是对插值语法的文字解释。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学公式中混排 LaTeX 控制序列、上下标及美元符号包围的表达式。

patterns.name: 专名及条目式重复文本
patterns.context: 物种名被连续重复，包含拉丁学名的词形片段；未见明显代码或插值语境。

en.concept: Proper names and boundaries in structured text
en.description: Activation is distributed across several kinds of structured text: book titles and typography, market quotes and data tables, licenses and case citations, and code, type names, object methods, and error stacks. Common local cues include proper names/identifiers, numeric punctuation, table boundaries, and line breaks, but no single meaning accounts for all patterns.

patterns.name: Book layout and front-matter titles
patterns.context: Titles, dedications, prefaces, and other layout in book scans/OCR text; activation falls on split title words, line breaks, and whitespace, as well as bibliography.
patterns.domain: Historical books, bibliographies, and OCR text

patterns.name: Financial quote table fields and values
patterns.context: Column headings, abbreviated codes, percent signs, and decimal values occur together in stock/securities quote-style tables; includes image placeholders.

patterns.name: Proper names and line breaks in license text
patterns.context: In software license text, proper names such as foundations, license names, and project names appear within fixed legal phrasing and indented line breaks.

patterns.name: Table borders, fields, and multilingual labels
patterns.context: Fields and split Portuguese labels appear in tables formed by vertical bars, horizontal lines, and whitespace.

patterns.name: Number grids and code expressions
patterns.context: Numbers aligned in rows and columns, followed by colon-separated numeric strings and then code; activation covers numbers, timeit fragments, and pandas DataFrame expressions.

patterns.name: Object/object method calls in code
patterns.context: Code identifiers and call chains contain Object/object-related types, methods, or properties; there is also the serializer class name «SON»5«Des»4«erial»4«izer»5.

patterns.name: Type names in SQL exception stacks
patterns.context: A .NET SQL client exception stack repeatedly contains parser type names, method names, and the Object type.

patterns.name: number/undefined in type-validation code
patterns.context: JavaScript/TypeScript-style type guards or validators check input using number, undefined, typeof, and comparison operators.

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: Citations in legal opinions consist of case names, volume and page numbers, and court/year; numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation alternate.

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与边界
8_1507.description: 激活分布于多种结构化文本：书籍标题与排版、行情和数据表、许可证及判例引文，以及代码、类型名、对象方法和错误堆栈。常见局部线索是专名/标识符、数字标点、表格边界与换行，但没有单一词义能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 书籍版式与前置标题
patterns.trigger: «.»2« P»4«.»1« D»5«UT»4«TON»3 &« CO»2；«THE»4«FIRST»5« PR»5«INT»1«ED»4« TRAN»6«SL»4«ATIONS»6；«PRE»3«FACE»6；« bib»3«liography»10
patterns.context: 书籍扫描/OCR文本中的标题、题献、前言等排版内容；激活落在被拆分的标题词、换行和空白，也落在 bibliography。

patterns.name: 金融行情表格字段与数值
patterns.context: 股票/证券行情式表格中，列名、缩写代码、百分号及小数数值相邻出现；含图像占位符。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的专名与断行
patterns.trigger: « GNU»4« General»2« Public»3« License»3；« Free»4« Software»4« Foundation»5；«Fast»o«No»9«SQL»5
patterns.context: 软件许可证正文，基金会、许可证名称及项目名等专名嵌在固定法律措辞和缩进换行中。

patterns.name: 表格边框、字段及多语言标签
patterns.context: 竖线、横线、空白构成的表格中出现字段名和被切分的葡萄牙语标签。

patterns.name: 编号网格与代码表达式
patterns.context: 数字按行列对齐、带冒号的数字串之后接代码；激活同时覆盖数字、timeit 片段及 pandas DataFrame 表达式。
patterns.domain: 问答中的数据/编程片段

patterns.name: 代码中的 Object/对象方法调用
patterns.context: 代码标识符和调用链含 Object/对象相关类型、方法或属性；另有 «SON»5«Des»4«erial»4«izer»5 这一序列化器类名。

patterns.name: SQL 异常堆栈中的类型名
patterns.context: .NET SQL 客户端异常堆栈，重复出现解析器类型名、方法名及 Object 类型。

patterns.name: 类型验证代码中的 number/undefined
patterns.context: JavaScript/TypeScript风格的类型守卫或验证器，以 number、undefined、typeof 和比较运算符检查输入。

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.context: 法律意见书中以案件名、卷页、法院/年份等构成的引证，数字、缩写和标点交错。

en.description: The first three passages predominantly activate on repeated [IMAGE] placeholders and their layout on webpages; the remaining activations are distributed across code indices and column names, numeric markers in patent chemical names, and words in medical abstract titles. No unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Image placeholders in webpage templates
patterns.context: Densely repeated image placeholders appear around webpage navigation, market quotes, or news content; activation falls on IMAGE, brackets, and nearby layout tokens
patterns.domain: HTML in webpages/email or scraped page text

patterns.name: Indices or column names in program code
patterns.context: In code contexts, occurs around indexing and column-selection expressions for lists, arrays, or DataFrames; however, the specific activated tokens differ across passages

patterns.name: Numeric markers in chemical nomenclature
patterns.context: Numbers and parentheses are embedded in systematic chemical names, including substituents and ring systems

patterns.name: History/screening terms in medical titles
patterns.context: Appears in the title of an abstract about the development of cervical screening tests; inconsistent with the clear word-form patterns in other passages

8_1507.description: 前三段集中激活网页中重复的 [IMAGE] 占位符及其排版；其余激活分散在代码索引与列名、专利化学名称的数字标记，以及医学摘要标题词语，未见统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 网页模板中的图片占位符
patterns.trigger: «IMAGE»，常与方括号「[»…«]」及重复空白、换行相邻
patterns.context: 密集重复的图片占位符出现在网页导航、行情或新闻内容周围；激活落在 IMAGE、括号及附近排版 token 上
patterns.domain: 网页/邮件中的 HTML 或抓取页面文本

patterns.name: 程序代码中的索引或列名
patterns.trigger: 索引变量「i」，以及「[i]」「[i-1]」等表达式；字段名如「'total'」「'lead_id'」「'line_date'」「'rating'」
patterns.context: 在代码语境中，围绕列表、数组或 DataFrame 的索引与列选择表达式出现；但各段具体受激活的 token 不完全一致

patterns.name: 化学命名中的数字标记
patterns.context: 数字和括号嵌在取代基、环系等系统化学名称中

patterns.name: 医学标题中的历史/筛查词语
patterns.context: 出现在关于宫颈筛查测试发展的摘要标题中；与其他段落的明显词形模式不一致

en.description: Primarily responds to statements in U.S. court opinions that unpublished decisions may not be cited as precedent; also reacts to specific words in legal descriptions of necessity, finalization of judgments, and dismissal of litigation.

patterns.name: Unpublished decisions may not be cited as precedent
patterns.context: States that a decision, order, or memorandum opinion is unpublished, uncitable, or nonprecedential, often alongside court rules and exceptions.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state appellate opinions, case citation rules

patterns.name: Statements of necessity in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions such as “as long as necessary to help” or “as necessary,” indicating that something continues or facts are supplemented as needed.

patterns.name: Issuance or finalization of a judgment
patterns.context: Describes a court issuing, affirming, or making a judgment final; activation falls near judgment.

patterns.name: Dismissal in litigation proceedings
patterns.context: Describes an objection being dismissed, or a party being removed from a lawsuit with prejudice.

8_1507.description: 主要响应美国法院意见中未刊裁判不得作为先例引用的规则表述；另对必要程度、判决终局化及诉讼驳回等法律叙述中的特定词语有反应。

patterns.name: 未刊判决不得作为先例引用
patterns.trigger: “unpublished”与“precedent”附近；如 “unpublished opinion … does not serve as precedent”、“not citable as precedent”、“shall not be cited … as precedent”
patterns.context: 说明判决、命令或备忘录意见未刊、不可引用或不具先例效力，常伴随法院规则及例外说明。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州上诉法院意见、判例引用规则

patterns.name: 法律文书中的必要程度表述
patterns.context: 出现在“as long as necessary to help”或“as necessary”等表达中，表示按需要持续或补充事实。
patterns.domain: 司法事实叙述、诉讼意见

patterns.name: 裁判作出或终局化
patterns.context: 描述法院作出、确认或使判决成为终局；激活落在 judgment 附近。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序中的驳回
patterns.context: 描述异议被驳回，或一方当事人被带有 prejudice 地从诉讼中移除。

en.concept: Symbols and numeric values in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to dense numbers, indices, punctuation, and numeric structures in code and formulas; also activates on image-processing identifiers and headings/signatures and damages language in legal documents.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation structures in code
patterns.context: Numbers, indices, coordinates, hexadecimal constants, or numeric operations occur consecutively in code or formulas; activation often falls on digits and structural punctuation
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical formulas, Github code, StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Image-processing code identifiers
patterns.context: OpenCV image-processing code involving dilation, its parameters, and contour extraction

patterns.name: Headings and signatures in legal opinions
patterns.context: Legal documents contain official signatures, institutional titles, or headings for opinions and orders

patterns.name: Judgment facts and damages language
patterns.context: Judgment text describes a defendant’s conduct, fraudulent notes, vehicles, and damages calculations

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数值
8_1507.description: 主要响应代码与公式中密集的数字、索引、标点及数值结构；另对图像处理标识符和法律文书的标题署名、判决损害赔偿措辞有激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的数值与标点结构
patterns.context: 代码或公式中连续出现数值、索引、坐标、十六进制常量或数值运算；激活常落在数字和结构性标点上
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学公式、Github 代码、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 图像处理代码标识符
patterns.context: OpenCV 图像处理代码中，涉及膨胀操作及其参数、轮廓提取

patterns.name: 法律意见书标题与署名
patterns.trigger: “OPINION AND ORDER”，以及“Assistant Attorney General”“Director”等职衔和姓名
patterns.context: 法律文件中出现官员署名、机构职衔或意见与命令标题

patterns.name: 判决事实与损害赔偿表述
patterns.trigger: “defendant bank wrongfully neglected”、“measure of plaintiffs' damage”、“difference in value”
patterns.context: 叙述被告行为、欺诈票据、车辆及损害计算的判决文本

en.description: Activation covers letter variables in math problems, legal terms and judicial phrasing in legal documents, case-title formats, and C# bitmap code identifiers; the patterns are distinguished mainly by different registers and text structures.

patterns.name: Letter variables in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in equations, definitions, or instructions to solve, often adjacent to numbers, operators, and math-problem wording such as Solve/List; the activated letter is not fixed

patterns.name: Legal terms and judicial phrasing in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in judgments, appellate arguments, or procedural conclusions, often adjacent to formal legal phrasing and citations; activation occurs at different positions in the sentence

patterns.name: Party names and litigation format in case titles
patterns.context: Appears in case titles or party names, using uppercase names and class-action title formats

patterns.name: Methods, properties, and identifiers in C# bitmap code
patterns.context: Appears in an indented code block around bitmap unlocking, stream positioning, and a Bitmap constructor return statement

8_1507.concept: 文本中显著的领域专用 token
8_1507.description: 激活覆盖数学题中的字母变量、法律文书中的术语与裁判措辞、案件标题格式，以及 C# 位图代码标识符；各模式主要由不同语域和文本结构区分。

patterns.name: 数学题中的字母变量
patterns.trigger: 单字母变量，如 «g»、«f»、«i»、«j»、«v»、«r»、«w»；尤其是 «j» 后接 «10»
patterns.context: 出现在方程、定义或求解指令中，常与数字、运算符及 Solve/List 等数学题措辞相邻；被激活的字母并不固定

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的法律术语与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «benefits»、«basis»、«appeal»、«removal»、«EIR»、«overruled» 等法律词汇，以及 «Appellant»、«court»、«BIA» 等诉讼主体
patterns.context: 出现在判决、上诉论证或程序性结论中，常与正式法律句式及引证相邻；激活分布在句中不同位置
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 案件标题中的当事方名称与诉讼格式
patterns.trigger: «Appellants»、«BLUE CROSS OF LEHIGH VALLEY»、«Hospital»、«Individually»、«On Behalf»、«Similarly Situated»
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或当事方名称中，采用大写名称及集体诉讼标题格式

patterns.name: C# 位图代码中的方法、属性与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在缩进的代码块中，围绕位图解锁、流位置设定及 Bitmap 构造返回语句

en.description: Activation is distributed across code identifiers and declarations, common English words, legal-document structure and citations, and page numbers and numbering in book contents. Text types and local triggers vary, with no consistent cross-domain semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuations
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common function words or phrase components in continuous English text; contexts include “to implement improvements,” “more effectively and efficiently,” “is fully advised,” and “have been discussed,” with no consistent fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and legal texts

patterns.name: Identifiers and property chains in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript, ActionScript, and other code, activation falls on components of camelCase identifiers, properties, or method names; examples involve jQuery layout calculations, 3D rendering, amount aggregation, templates, and network connections.

patterns.name: Types and parameter names in code declarations
patterns.context: In C-style function declarations, activation occurs near function parameters, parameter types, or names; specific examples are the declarations of “decode_data” and “encode_data.”

patterns.name: Court narratives and order structure in legal text
patterns.context: In legal opinions or court orders, involves the court’s description of the scope of proceedings, case background, and ruling, as well as heading-style section structure.

patterns.name: Years and statutory citations in legal historical sources
patterns.context: Activation appears near years, statute names, and language about the continuation of statutes when describing prior administrative opinions or legal grounds.

patterns.name: Typography and numbering in contents headings
patterns.context: In tables of contents for story collections or section lists, activation appears near page numbers, lettered numbering, and underscores; the headings themselves have no clear shared meaning.

8_1507.description: 激活分布于代码标识符与声明、英文常用词、法律文书结构及引证、书籍目录的页码和编号。文本类型与局部触发形式多样，未见跨领域一致的语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 激活分散在英文连续文本中的常见功能词或短语成分；上下文包括“to implement improvements”“more effectively and efficiently”“is fully advised”“have been discussed”等，未见统一的固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及法律文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及属性链
patterns.context: 在 JavaScript、ActionScript 等代码中，激活落在驼峰式标识符的组成部分、属性或方法名上；涉及 jQuery 布局计算、3D 渲染、金额汇总、模板及网络连接。

patterns.name: 代码声明中的类型与参数名
patterns.context: C 风格函数声明中，激活出现在函数参数、参数类型或名称附近；具体例子是“decode_data”“encode_data”的声明。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院叙述与判令结构
patterns.context: 法律意见或法院命令中，涉及法院说明审理范围、案件背景和裁决，以及标题式章节结构。

patterns.name: 法律史料中的年份与法条引证
patterns.context: 叙述先前行政意见或法律依据时，年份、法规名称及法规延续措辞附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 目录标题的排版与编号
patterns.trigger: «48»、«_»«f»、«THE UNJUST KING AND THE PILGRIM PRINCE»、«53»、«_»«g»
patterns.context: 故事集目录或分节列表中，激活出现在页码、字母编号、下划线等格式字符附近；标题内容本身并无明显共同语义。

en.description: Activation is distributed across identifiers, word endings, type names, constants, punctuation, and statement boundaries in various code, as well as English prose, contents-page layout, page numbers, and comments; there is no single stable semantic or grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Plural and word-ending fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or components of code identifiers; these include ordinary plurals as well as types, properties, and constant names. There is no stable specific grammatical position or capitalization condition.
patterns.domain: Programming code (JavaScript, C/C#, C, MATLAB, etc.)

patterns.name: Programming punctuation and statement structure
patterns.context: Near the ends of code blocks, expressions, or calls, and around closing brackets, semicolons, and commas; the pattern is not always associated with the same identifier meaning.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: In continuous English prose or contents entries, activation may fall on common words, plural nouns, or parts of phrases; not a code environment.
patterns.domain: Historical religious book text and contents, code comments

patterns.name: Contents-page layout, underscores, and page numbers
patterns.context: Titles, authors, and page numbers are aligned using spaces or underscores; activation is concentrated on formatting markers, author names, or page numbers.

patterns.name: Variable-name generation fragment in template code
patterns.context: Near the construction of the variable name viewModelForTemplated; activation corresponds to an internal fragment of the name, with no evidence that it is an independent template concept.

patterns.name: Network error constants and underscore naming
patterns.context: Uppercase, underscore-separated server error constants and surrounding asynchronous-call code.

patterns.name: C language types and array declarations
patterns.context: Type qualifiers, pointers, and fixed-size array declarations in function parameter lists.

patterns.name: File-mapping-related code symbols
patterns.context: Around initialization of memory-allocation and I/O-mapping function pointers; the specific identifier meaning depends on the project code.

patterns.name: MATLAB function calls and assertions
patterns.context: Applies array operations to a file ID, closes the file, and asserts the result.

patterns.name: C# entity-state updates
patterns.context: Attaches a photo entity to an object context and sets its state to modified.

patterns.name: Ordinary English in code comments
patterns.context: Placeholder comments within brace-delimited code blocks; activation falls on ordinary English phrases, not executable syntax.

8_1507.description: 激活分散于多种代码中的标识符、词尾、类型名、常量、标点和语句边界，也出现在英语正文、目录排版、页码及注释；没有单一稳定的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的复数及词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符的词尾或组成部分；既包括普通复数，也包括类型、属性、常量名等。没有稳定的特定语法位置或大小写条件。

patterns.name: 编程标点与语句结构
patterns.context: 代码块、表达式或调用结束处，以及闭合括号、分号、逗号附近；与具体标识符词义并非总是相同。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语片段
patterns.context: 英语连续正文或目录条目中，激活可能落在常见词、复数名词或短语内部；不是代码环境。
patterns.domain: 历史宗教类书籍正文与目录、代码注释

patterns.name: 目录排版、下划线与页码
patterns.context: 作品名、作者、页码以空格或下划线对齐排列；激活集中于格式标记、作者名或页码。

patterns.name: 模板代码中的变量名生成片段
patterns.context: 变量名 viewModelForTemplated 的构造附近；激活对应名称的内部片段，缺少证据表明它是独立的模板概念。

patterns.name: 网络错误常量与下划线命名
patterns.context: 大写、下划线连接的服务端错误常量及其周边异步调用代码。
patterns.domain: Github 中的网络/API 代码

patterns.name: C 语言类型和数组声明
patterns.context: 函数参数列表中的类型限定符、指针和固定大小数组声明。

patterns.name: 文件映射相关代码符号
patterns.context: 内存分配及 I/O 映射函数指针初始化一带；标识符具体含义依赖项目代码。

patterns.name: MATLAB 函数调用与断言
patterns.context: 对文件 ID 执行数组化操作、关闭文件并断言结果。

patterns.name: C# 实体状态更新
patterns.context: 将照片实体附加到对象上下文并设置为已修改状态。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的普通英语
patterns.context: 花括号代码块中的占位注释；激活落在普通英语短语，而非可执行语法。

en.description: Activations occur across several types of structured text: code identifiers and type names, HTTP log fields, email quotations and long separator lines. They also appear in English collocations and words in paper titles; no clear semantic pattern unifies these triggers.

patterns.name: Expressions of continuation/progression in English
patterns.context: Short adverbs, degree words, or common collocations appear in English prose. Some activations fall on words within phrases or the punctuation that follows them; the semantic contexts vary.

patterns.name: Code identifier and type-name fragments
patterns.context: CamelCase or snake_case identifiers, type names, constants, and function names in code; activations often fall on subword fragments within an identifier or its final part.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in logs/network text
patterns.context: Timestamps, URLs, status codes, and structural symbols such as brackets and slashes in HTTP access logs.

patterns.name: Emotional words in article titles
patterns.context: Words in academic bibliographies or article titles; the titles discuss emotions and their relation to moral judgment.

patterns.name: Email quotation format and separator lines
patterns.context: Content quoted with > in email replies, URLs, and separator lines made of repeated equals signs; the strongest activation falls on long runs of equals signs.

8_1507.description: 激活分布于多类结构化文本：代码标识符与类型名、HTTP 日志字段、邮件引用和长分隔线，也见英语搭配及论文标题词；未见能统一这些触发因素的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语中的延续/递进表达
patterns.context: 英语散文中出现短副词、程度词或常见搭配，部分激活落在短语中的词或其后续标点；不同语义场景并不一致。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体式文字、日常散文

patterns.name: 代码标识符及类型名片段
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式或下划线式标识符、类型名、常量名和函数名；激活常落在标识符内部的子词或末尾部分。

patterns.name: 日志/网络文本中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: HTTP 访问日志中的时间、URL、状态码及方括号、斜杠等结构符号。

patterns.name: 文章标题中的情绪词
patterns.context: 学术论文书目或文章标题中的词语分段；标题谈论情绪及其与道德判断的关系。

patterns.name: 邮件引用格式与分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件回复中以 > 引用的内容、网址及由重复等号构成的分隔线；最强激活落在长等号串上。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse genres, often on word endings after tokenization, final parts of compound identifiers, or prominent words within sentences. Examples include code property names, legal titles, and semantically emphatic words; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Word endings or suffixes in tokenization
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subsequent subword fragments after a word is split; they also occur on the final parts of code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, forum prose, poetry, explanatory text, and code; broad coverage

patterns.name: Words at sentence or phrase ends
patterns.context: Several activations occur on words that are emphatic and occupy a closing position in a sentence or phrase, though not all segments fit this pattern.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, quotations, directory text, and poetry

patterns.name: Identifiers and property names in code
patterns.context: In HTML/Vue, JavaScript, or C-style code, final fragments of identifiers or property names are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Legal case names and litigation-role labels
patterns.context: Appears in case titles, party designations, and densely formatted legal headers; activations concentrate on titles and their endings.

patterns.name: Emphatic judgments and time expressions
patterns.context: In contexts discussing players and teams, words expressing importance, timing of opportunities, or late-blooming views receive strong activation.

patterns.name: Distinctive word forms in wordplay or quotations
patterns.context: Quotations contain colloquial words or spelling fragments split into subwords; activations fall on these fragments.

patterns.name: Document navigation text
patterns.context: Strong activation appears in explanatory text referring to a page range in a manual.

patterns.name: Emotional time words in poetry
patterns.context: In lyrical passages, temporal adverbs occur at an emotional turn or the focus of a sentence.

patterns.name: Price property access in code
patterns.context: A property access name receives strong activation in code that loops through gift objects and accumulates prices.

patterns.name: Macro-style names for C struct fields
patterns.context: Long field names in filesystem kernel code; activation falls on later parts of compound identifiers.

8_1507.description: 激活散布于多种文体，常落在分词后的词尾、复合标识符末段或句中突出的词；代码属性名、法律称谓和语义强调词均有例子，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词中的词尾或后缀
patterns.context: 激活常落在一个词被拆分后的后续子词片段；也包括代码标识符的末尾部分。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、论坛散文、诗歌、说明文字及代码；覆盖面广

patterns.name: 句末或短语末尾的词
patterns.context: 若干激活出现在句子或短语中有强调作用、处于收束位置的词上，但并非所有段都符合。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、引文、目录文字及诗歌

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与属性名
patterns.context: 在 HTML/Vue、JavaScript 或 C 风格代码中，标识符或属性名的末尾片段尤其突出。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 GitHub 技术代码

patterns.name: 法律案名与诉讼身份标签
patterns.context: 在案件标题、当事人称谓及排版密集的法律页眉中出现；激活集中于称谓词及其词尾。

patterns.name: 强调判断与时间表达
patterns.context: 评论球员与球队的语境中，表达重要性、机会时机或迟熟观点的词获得较强激活。

patterns.name: 文字游戏或引用中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 引文中含有被拆成子词的口语词或拼写片段，激活落在这些片段上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 非正式讨论与引文

patterns.name: 文档导航文字
patterns.context: 说明文字中指向手册页码范围时出现强激活。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的情感时间词
patterns.context: 诗歌抒情段落中，时间副词位于情绪转折或句子重心处。

patterns.name: 代码中的价格属性访问
patterns.context: 循环遍历礼物对象并累加价格的代码中，属性调用名获得强激活。

patterns.name: C 结构体字段的宏式名称
patterns.context: 文件系统内核代码中的长字段名，激活落在复合标识符后段。

en.description: Activations fall on diverse local cues: prominent words at the end of summaries or titles, Ruby names, legal party designations, Portuguese future-tense endings, and capacity adjustment in code. The examples span domains, with no unifying syntactic or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Summative expressions at sentence or phrase ends
patterns.context: Appears at the end of summary judgments, titles, or noun phrases, especially words suggesting closure, importance, or result. Some examples are not sentence-final.
patterns.domain: General narrative, book titles/headings, news text

patterns.name: Ruby identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in programming-language comparisons, in expressions such as “unlike Ruby or Bash's magic”.

patterns.name: Legal case-party designations
patterns.context: Party-role designations appear with hyphenated combinations in legal case titles or docket headers.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person plural future tense
patterns.context: A Portuguese verb form meaning “we will do” appears at the end of an exclamatory sentence in political or parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Capacity-growth logic in code
patterns.context: Branch logic checks capacity and updates a capacity variable in C/C++-style code.

8_1507.description: 激活落在多种局部线索上：总结或标题末尾的显著词、Ruby 名称、法律当事方称谓、葡语将来时词尾，以及代码中的容量调整。各例跨领域，未见统一的语法或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 句末或短语末的总结性表达
patterns.context: 出现在概括性判断、标题或名词短语的末尾；尤其是带有收束、重要性或结果意味的词语。部分例子并非句末。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、书名/标题、新闻文本

patterns.name: Ruby 标识符
patterns.context: 编程语言对比语境中，出现在“unlike Ruby or Bash's magic”一类表达里。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事方称谓
patterns.context: 法律案件标题或案卷抬头中，当事方角色称谓与连字符组合出现。

patterns.name: 葡语将来时第一人称复数
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语政治或议会发言中，表示“我们将做”的动词形式，位于句末感叹句。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡萄牙语

patterns.name: 代码中的容量增长逻辑
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中检查容量并更新容量变量的分支逻辑。

en.description: Activations are scattered across introductions of academic abbreviations, proper-name fragments, numbers and HTTP logs, title endings, legal citations, code time strings, and business-report wording; no stable semantic or syntactic trigger is evident across segments.

patterns.name: Citation definitions after abbreviations, names, or labels
patterns.context: In academic papers, authors use hereafter to introduce an abbreviation or citation label used later; activation falls on hereafter or the abbreviation fragment that follows.

patterns.name: Specific character fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activations occur within proper names, title-like names, or words split by tokenization, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and log-response fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers or HTTP status-response text, appearing respectively in a legal case number and a web request log; the shared condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in titles or newspaper layouts
patterns.context: Activation falls on final fragments of capitalized, headline-style words, surrounded by headline text about pipeline construction, natural gas, and future development.

patterns.name: Case abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation falls on a case-name fragment following In re in a legal citation; the text discusses bankruptcy rules.

patterns.name: Hour strings in array code
patterns.context: Activation appears on a quoted time value in a JavaScript array; the surrounding code discusses available hours and priorities.

patterns.name: Business-report descriptions of interest and numeric customers
patterns.context: Appears in reporting on company products and industry changes, mentioning HP, customers, and related business; no clear common trigger unifies these activation words.

8_1507.description: 激活分散在学术简称引介、专名片段、数字与HTTP日志、标题词尾、法律引证、代码时间字符串及商业报道词语中；跨段未见稳定的统一语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 缩写、名称或标签后的引用定义
patterns.context: 在学术论文中，作者用 hereafter 引入后文使用的简称或引用标签；激活落在 hereafter 或紧随其后的缩写片段上。

patterns.name: 专名或名称中的特定字符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名、标题式名称或被分词拆开的单词内部，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数字及日志响应片段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字或 HTTP 状态响应文本中，分别位于法律案号与网页请求日志；共同条件不明确。

patterns.name: 标题或报纸版面中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活位于新闻标题式大写词的末尾片段，周围是管道建设、天然气和未来发展的标题文字。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件简称
patterns.context: 激活落在法律案件引证中 In re 后的案件名片段；文本讨论破产法规则。

patterns.name: 数组代码中的小时字符串
patterns.context: 激活出现在 JavaScript 数组中的带引号时间值，周边代码谈可用小时和优先级。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的兴趣及数字客户描述
patterns.context: 出现在企业产品与行业调整的报道中，提及 HP、客户及相关业务；这些激活词之间未见明确统一触发条件。

en.concept: Formatting and citation fragments across domains
en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of text: they are most concentrated in “In re” case citations in legal opinions, and also appear in biblical formatting, patent terminology definitions, business reporting, JavaScript arrays, and polynomial calculations. No common semantic pattern covers all the text.

patterns.name: “In re” citations in case law
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions, legal opinions, or case titles/citations; sometimes spans lines or is split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Biblical narrative and chapter formatting
patterns.context: Old English Bible quotations containing dialogue, chapter markers, and place names.

patterns.name: Material terminology in technical patents
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph uses “hereinafter” to introduce an abbreviation or define a material name.

patterns.name: Company operations in business news
patterns.context: Discusses company performance, business contraction, and changes after an executive takes over.

patterns.name: JavaScript code and array contents
patterns.context: Code defines a priority array, followed by a comment that a certain time slot is absent from the array.

patterns.name: Mathematical polynomial operations
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions and the process of collecting like terms.

8_1507.concept: 多领域文本中的格式与引证片段
8_1507.description: 激活分布在多种文本中：最集中于法律判决的“In re”案件引证，也见圣经排版、专利术语定义、商业报道、JavaScript数组和多项式计算，未见能覆盖全部文本的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律判例中的“In re”引证
patterns.trigger: «In» re（后接案件名，如«Sun»ahara、« Estate»、« Le»ird）
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决、法律意见或案件标题/引证中；有时跨行或拆分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 圣经叙事与章节排版
patterns.context: 古英语圣经引文，包含对话、章节标记及地名。

patterns.name: 技术专利中的材料术语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，以“hereinafter”引入缩写或定义材料名称。

patterns.name: 商业新闻中的公司经营叙述
patterns.context: 谈论公司业绩、业务收缩及企业管理者接任后的变化。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码与数组内容
patterns.context: 代码定义优先级数组，随后评论数组中不存在某个时段。

patterns.name: 数学多项式运算
patterns.context: 代数表达式及收集同类项的计算过程。

en.concept: Legal citations and proper-name formatting, with isolated contextual responses
en.description: Activations occur most consistently on numbers, reporter abbreviations, and case-name formats in legal case citations (including “v.” and “In re”). There are also clear responses to an anecdote about refunding a POS lock, a court header, and praise for a sports championship.

patterns.name: POS lock scam narrative
patterns.context: Describes buying a POS lock, entering and leaving a store, and getting a refund, followed by a summary such as “Problem solved”.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations, activations concentrate on volume numbers, page numbers, court or reporter abbreviations, and punctuation in the citation format; paragraphs 2–8 contain similar structures.

patterns.name: Case titles and case-name formats
patterns.context: Appears in litigants' names or case names; “v.” is used for adversarial case names, and “In re” for cases titled by subject matter.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, case titles, or citations

patterns.name: Court document titles and case-number openings
patterns.context: Headers composed of capitalized court names, document labels, and case titles.

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures and championship narrative
patterns.context: First praises a player's reliable receiving and clutch performance, then recounts Saskatchewan's championship and the player's contribution.

8_1507.concept: 法律引注与专名格式，兼有孤立语境响应
8_1507.description: 激活最稳定地出现在法律判例引文的数字、报告缩写和案名格式（含“v.”、“In re”）；另对一段POS锁具退款轶事、法院页眉及体育夺冠赞誉有明显响应。

patterns.name: POS 锁具诈骗叙述
patterns.context: 描述购买 POS lock、出入商店后退款的操作，随后出现“Problem solved”等总结。
patterns.domain: 口语化轶事或网络文本

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 判例引注中，激活集中于引文格式里的卷号、页码、法院或法律报告缩写及标点；段落2–8均有类似结构。

patterns.name: 判例标题及案名格式
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼当事人或案件名称中；“v.”用于双方案名，“In re”用于以事项为题的案件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、判例标题或引注

patterns.name: 法院文件标题与案号开头
patterns.trigger: « STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA»、« SUPREME COURT OF APPEALS»、« FILED»、«In»9« re»
patterns.context: 大写法院名称、文书标记和案件标题组成的页眉。

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉与夺冠叙述
patterns.trigger: « sticky»5« hands»4；« clutch»5；« Saskatchewan»4« won»7« the»5« championship»7« this»4« year»9
patterns.context: 先称赞球员接球可靠、关键时刻表现出色，再叙述萨斯喀彻温队夺冠及其贡献。

en.concept: Review and citation of legal cases
en.description: Primarily activates on case-citation numbers, review, and appellate-review contexts in U.S. legal texts; it also covers sentencing decisions, criminal-procedure rights, bankruptcy review, and alternative litigation theories. One astrophysics passage concerns a Keplerian disk and a neutron star.

patterns.name: Page numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears after case names or legal text, often in a format consisting of a comma, reporter abbreviation, and year in parentheses; strong activations often fall on page-number digits.

patterns.name: Review and its judicial-procedure context
patterns.context: Involves appellate review, standards of review, or court reconsideration of a ruling; often adjacent to legal citations and descriptions of court procedure.

patterns.name: Judgments and sentencing dispositions
patterns.context: Describes courts modifying or upholding judgments, vacating duplicate sentences, and similar dispositions.

patterns.name: Criminal-procedure rights and prejudice
patterns.context: Discusses procedural restrictions that unfairly prejudice defendants or deprive them of substantive rights.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy court review
patterns.context: A higher court reviews a bankruptcy court decision, or the text discusses non-debtor parties in bankruptcy proceedings.

patterns.name: Alternative litigation theories
patterns.context: Discusses whether a plaintiff may present multiple alternative theories to a jury without first choosing one.

patterns.name: Texas criminal statutes and case citations
patterns.context: A criminal statute is followed by a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals case and reporter page number.

patterns.name: Rotating central object in astrophysics
patterns.context: Describes coupling between the inner region of an accretion disk and a central neutron star, and related models.

8_1507.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的判例引证数字、review及上诉审查语境激活，也覆盖刑罚判决、刑事程序权利、破产审查和替代诉讼理论；另有一段天体物理文本涉及开普勒盘与中子星。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字页码
patterns.context: 出现在案件名称或法律文本之后，常由逗号、报告集缩写和括号年份构成；强激活常落在页码数字上。
patterns.domain: 美国判例引证、法律意见书

patterns.name: review 及其司法程序语境
patterns.context: 涉及上诉审查、审查标准或法院复核裁决；常与法律引证和法院程序叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 判决与刑罚处置
patterns.trigger: 「amending the judgment」「removing the double terms of imprisonment」「affirmed」
patterns.context: 描述法院修改或维持判决、撤销重复刑期等处置。

patterns.name: 刑事程序权利与不利影响
patterns.trigger: 「embarrass or prejudice one charged with a crime」「deny him a substantial right」
patterns.context: 讨论对被告造成不当损害或剥夺实质权利的程序限制。

patterns.name: 破产法院审查
patterns.context: 上级法院审查破产法院决定，或讨论破产程序中的非债务人当事人。

patterns.name: 替代诉讼理论
patterns.trigger: 「plead and submit alternative theories to a jury」
patterns.context: 讨论原告能否向陪审团提出多个替代理论而不必先择一。

patterns.name: 德州刑法条文与判例引证
patterns.context: 刑法条文后接德州刑事上诉法院判例及报告页码。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的旋转中心天体
patterns.context: 描述吸积盘内侧区域与中心中子星的耦合及相关模型。

en.concept: Numbers and formatting in structured technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, percentages, decimals, and numeric formats in statistical results; it also responds to medical terminology, table separators and alignment whitespace, code plotting instructions, and a phrase from a cricket report. The patterns are not entirely unified.

patterns.name: Percentages and numerical statistics
patterns.context: In statistical results, numbers are often adjacent to percentages, mean ± error, sample sizes, or category names; there are also responses to consecutive digits and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Demographics, medical papers, and research results

patterns.name: Table borders and separators
patterns.context: Numbers and column headings appear near separators in tables drawn with vertical bars, plus signs, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Code and plotting instructions
patterns.context: Responses are scattered across plotting commands, code identifiers, and their formatted line breaks.

patterns.name: Cricket match narrative
patterns.context: A sports report recounts a team returning to the subcontinent and beating Sri Lanka in a Test match.

patterns.name: Medical classifications and terminology
patterns.context: In medical research text, terms or abbreviations are adjacent to cases, treatment, testing, or research subjects; this pattern partly overlaps with the statistical-number pattern.

patterns.name: Repeated spaces and formatting residue
patterns.context: In non-prose formats, responses cover whitespace, line breaks, and formatting residue used to align tables or code.
patterns.domain: Text tables, code, and formatted dumps

8_1507.concept: 结构化技术文本中的数字与格式
8_1507.description: 主要响应数字、百分比、小数及统计结果中的数值格式；也响应医学术语、表格分隔与对齐空白、代码绘图指令，以及一次板球报道中的赛事短语。不同模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 百分比与数值统计
patterns.context: 统计结果中，数字常与百分比、均值±误差、样本数或分类名称相邻；对连续数字和标点也有响应。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、医学论文及研究结果

patterns.name: 表格边框与分隔符
patterns.context: 在以竖线、加号和横线绘制的表格中，分隔符附近出现数值和列标题。

patterns.name: 代码与图形绘制指令
patterns.context: 响应散落在绘图程序指令、代码标识符及其格式化换行中。

patterns.name: 板球赛事叙述
patterns.context: 体育报道中叙述球队返回次大陆并在板球测试赛中击败斯里兰卡。

patterns.name: 医学分类与术语
patterns.context: 医学研究文本中，术语或缩写与病例、治疗、检测或研究对象相邻；此模式与统计数字模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 连续空格及排版残片
patterns.context: 非散文格式中，响应覆盖用于对齐表格或代码的空白、换行和排版残片。
patterns.domain: 文本表格、代码及格式化转储

en.concept: Structural and relational markers across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across prepositions and relational expressions, grouping and quantification in medical research, C++ templates, quantum-state notation, lattice-theory terminology, neurobiology markers, legal case citations, and open-source acknowledgments; there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Prepositions to / in and following structures
patterns.context: In English technical explanations, papers, and legal arguments, activations fall on prepositions or short relational words, often followed by a place, group, or object.

patterns.name: Grouping, classification, and group labels
patterns.context: Describes research subjects divided into groups or lists experimental groups; also appears in comparisons between groups in statistical results.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative results
patterns.context: Numbers appear in case counts, percentages, formula conditions, or legal citations; no consistent number type or fixed format is evident.

patterns.name: C++ templates and shared-pointer syntax
patterns.context: In C++ code, a template type is adjacent to a make_shared call, with angle brackets, punctuation, and an integer argument.

patterns.name: Quantum-state notation and arrow states
patterns.context: In LaTeX quantum-mechanics notation, activations concentrate around spin-state up/down arrows and ket notation.

patterns.name: Lattice-theory terms and partial-order conditions
patterns.context: A mathematical definition describes a set as upward closed under a partial order and introduces the term antichain.

patterns.name: 5-hydroxytryptamine receptors and transporters
patterns.context: A neurobiology methods section discusses in situ hybridization or immunohistochemical markers for receptors, axons, and transporters.

patterns.name: In re case names in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal text cites bankruptcy or other cases, with a case name following In re; strong activation falls on re and case-name fragments.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and open-source contexts
patterns.context: A forum post thanks someone and mentions an open-source project or software.

8_1507.concept: 跨领域结构与关系标记
8_1507.description: 激活分散在介词与关系表达、医学研究的分组和量化、C++模板、量子态记号、格论术语、神经生物学标记、法律判例引用及开源感谢语境；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 介词 to / in 及其后接结构
patterns.context: 在英语技术说明、论文和法律论述中，激活落在介词或表达关系的短词上，常跟地点、群组或对象。

patterns.name: 分组、分类与组别标记
patterns.context: 描述研究对象被分成组，或列出实验组别；也见于统计结果中的组别比较。

patterns.name: 数字与量化结果
patterns.context: 数字出现在病例数、百分比、公式条件或法律引文中；未见一致的数字类别或固定格式。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与共享指针语法
patterns.context: C++ 代码中，模板类型与 make_shared 调用相邻，包含尖括号、标点及整数参数。

patterns.name: 量子态符号及箭头态
patterns.context: LaTeX 量子力学记号中，激活集中在自旋态的上下箭头和 ket 符号附近。

patterns.name: 格论术语及偏序条件
patterns.context: 数学定义描述集合在偏序下对上闭合，并引入 antichain 术语。

patterns.name: 5-羟色胺受体与转运体

en.description: Activations span medical, legal, and code text. Local peaks include the medical group label C, Aim 3, omitted or a year in legal citations, and tree-diagram node names. Other activations mostly fall on numbers, group names, and punctuation, making them difficult to assign a unified semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Group label C
patterns.context: Appears as a patient-group label in medical research, followed by a group description or data; capitalization may vary.

patterns.name: Group label A
patterns.context: A parenthetical marker after a neurotransmitter or physiological measure abbreviation, in a form such as Aim 3; group or mechanism descriptions also appear nearby in two instances.

patterns.name: omitted in legal citations
patterns.context: After a case citation, a parenthetical note says that material such as internal quotation marks was omitted from the citation.

patterns.name: Year numbers
patterns.context: Year of decision in parentheses in a U.S. case citation.

patterns.name: Tree-diagram node coordinates
patterns.context: Node names appear alongside coordinates and label definitions in TikZ-style tree-diagram code.
patterns.domain: LaTeX/TikZ code in ArXiv technical documents

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: The context concerns grouping and follow-up of hip-fracture patients, but the marked token shows no clear shared semantic trigger; activations are concentrated on Group B.

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: A description of study groups, surgical techniques, and case counts; activations are scattered across ordinary words and numbers, with no stable local trigger.

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: Percentages and statistical results in a perioperative study; activations concentrate on numbers, group names, and punctuation, without a clear, consistent lexical pattern.

8_1507.description: 激活跨医学、法律和代码文本，局部高点包括医学分组标签 C、Aim 3、法律引文中的 omitted 或年份，以及树图节点名；其余激活多落在数字、组名和标点，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 分组标签 C
patterns.context: 医学研究中作为患者分组标签出现，后接组别说明或数据；也可能大小写不同。

patterns.name: 分组标签 A
patterns.context: 神经递质或生理指标缩写后的括号内标记，形如 Aim 3；两处附近还出现组别或机制说明。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、生理学研究文本

patterns.name: 法律引证中的 omitted
patterns.context: 判例引文后，以括号说明引文中省略了内部引号等内容。

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 法律案例引证括号内的判决年份。

patterns.name: 树图节点坐标
patterns.context: TikZ 风格的树形图代码中，节点名与坐标、标签定义相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 技术文档中的 LaTeX/TikZ 代码

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 上下文涉及髋部骨折患者分组与随访，但标记 token 未显示出明确的共同语义触发；主要激活集中在 Group B。

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 研究组别、手术技术及病例数的叙述；激活分散在普通词语和数字上，未见稳定的局部触发。

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 围术期研究的百分比与统计结果中，激活集中在数字、组名及标点，未呈现明确一致的词汇模式。

en.concept: fal string fragments and several isolated word fragments
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the word fragment fal/Fal, appearing in names, place names, email addresses, Falcon, and highfalutin. Other isolated high activations include Toledo, Day, Fal-Galerkin, and digital. These span domains and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fal-initial subword fragments
patterns.context: The fragment appears directly within a word or at a word boundary. The same fragment recurs across different styles, with widely varying surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including forums, legal citations, marketing copy, email, encyclopedias, and papers

patterns.name: Fal-initial names or place names
patterns.context: Appears on a standalone line or near a paragraph break, possibly as a name or username. The same trigger fragment also occurs within “Falcon”.

patterns.name: Fal-initial components of email addresses
patterns.context: Appears in the local part of an email address, followed by a name fragment.

patterns.name: Fal within compound words
patterns.context: Embedded in a longer word such as “highfalutin”; it is not a standalone word.

patterns.name: Other Fal-initial names or words
patterns.context: Strong activations also occur on several distinct proper names or word-internal fragments, with varied capitalization and positions within words; no single complete word explains them.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, case citations, business location descriptions, historical narratives

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in digital pill
patterns.context: In the recurring term “digital pill,” activation falls on digital; other passages show no clear related medical semantics.

8_1936.concept: fal 字符串片段及若干孤立词片段
8_1936.description: 最一致的触发是词片段 fal/Fal，出现在人名、地名、邮箱、Falcon 与 highfalutin 中；另有 Toledo、Day、Fal-Galerkin 和 digital 等孤立高激活，分布跨领域，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: Fal 开头的子词片段
patterns.context: 该片段直接出现在词内部或词边界处；同一片段在不同文体中反复出现，周围上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包含论坛、法律引文、营销文案、邮件、百科及论文

patterns.name: Fal 开头的姓名或地名
patterns.context: 出现在独立一行或段落分隔附近，可能是人名或用户名；另有“Falcon”一词内部出现相同触发片段。

patterns.name: Fal 开头的邮箱地址组成部分
patterns.context: 出现在邮件地址的本地部分中，后接姓名拼写片段。

patterns.name: Fal 出现在复合词内部
patterns.context: 嵌在“highfalutin”一类较长词语中，并非独立词。

patterns.name: 其他 fal 开头的姓名或词语
patterns.context: 强激活也落在若干不同的专名或词内部片段上，大小写及词内位置不一；无法由同一完整词解释。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、判例引文、商业地点介绍、历史叙事

patterns.name: 数字 pill 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在“digital pill”这一反复出现的术语中，激活落在 digital；但其他段落没有明显相关的医疗语义。

en.description: The activation pattern is not singular: several passages highlight the proper name Day or words containing day, while others show medical case phrasing, word-internal fragments in species names, plant light-acclimation terminology, and French parliamentary resumption language.

patterns.name: Proper name Day
patterns.context: Day appears in English as a person’s name, part of a place name, or a holiday name; it is not the ordinary use of day

patterns.name: Patient case phrasing
patterns.context: Medical text begins with Patients, followed by a disease, treatment, or condition description
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and research funding descriptions

patterns.name: Word-internal letter fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a proper name, surrounded by a species name or encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Microalgae and light acclimation
patterns.context: Discusses light acclimation in green plants and algae under natural light fluctuations

patterns.name: Word ending in a loan title
patterns.context: In title-style web text, day combines with Loans to form payday

patterns.name: French parliamentary resumption language
patterns.context: A parliamentary session resumption heading, followed by the French title for the chair

8_1936.concept: 混合的词形与专名片段
8_1936.description: 激活模式不止一种：多段突出 Day 专名或含 day 的词，另有医学病例句式、物种名内部片段、植物光适应术语及法语议会复会语。

patterns.name: Day 专名
patterns.trigger: “Day” in “Family Day,” “Christmas Day,” “Daysville,” and “Colonel Jehiel Day”
patterns.context: 英文中的 Day 作为人名、地名组成部分或节日名称出现；并非普通的 day 用法
patterns.domain: 活动标题、新闻、地名百科

patterns.name: 患者病例句式
patterns.context: 医学文本以 Patients 开头，后接疾病、治疗或病情描述
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与研究资助描述

patterns.name: 词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的字母片段，周围为物种名称或百科条目

patterns.name: 微藻与光适应
patterns.context: 讨论自然光照波动下绿植和藻类的光适应

patterns.name: 贷款标题中的词尾
patterns.context: 标题式网页文字中，day 与 Loans 连成 payday

patterns.name: 法语议会复会语
patterns.context: 议会会议复会标题，后接法语主席称谓

en.description: Activations span diverse corpora, highlighting whitespace, line breaks, indentation, and formatting boundaries. They also appear on the, quoted fragments, code comments/identifiers, legal documents, mathematical Q&A, philosophical lists, and research abstracts, with no single stable theme.

patterns.name: The article and following elements
patterns.context: Appears before a noun or phrase in ordinary sentences. However, this token also occurs across varied styles, including code comments and legal texts, so it cannot explain all activations by itself.

patterns.name: Line breaks and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Dense line breaks, indentation, or tabular layout, especially legal document headers and code comments; whitespace tokens themselves have high activation.

patterns.name: Quoted fragments and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Quotation marks and word fragments split within them; so far, observed in only one fragment, so the specific semantic condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Party designations and header formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Case titles, party identities, and court information arranged with fixed indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: Footers and contact information in generated documents
patterns.context: Footer notes, copyright lines, and prompts to contact support, accompanied by many blank lines and filler whitespace.
patterns.domain: Output from legal document generation systems

patterns.name: Code comment or documentation markers
patterns.context: Comment openers and line-by-line documentation comment formatting; activations also occur around identifiers, register definitions, and comment text.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and numeric constants
patterns.context: Underscore-separated identifiers, hexadecimal or numeric constants, types, function parameters, and other code structures.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and requests for proof help
patterns.context: Formulas embedded in natural language using LaTeX, asking about uniform convergence and limits of a sequence of functions.

patterns.name: Plotting parameters and notes on overlapping edges
patterns.context: After R plotting code, explains that edge curvature settings cause edges in the graph to overlap.

patterns.name: Lists and tab-separated formatting in philosophical text
patterns.context: A list of phrases separated by tabs, followed by prose introducing metaphysical premises.

patterns.name: Descriptions of relationships between measures in research abstracts
patterns.context: Preliminary data report a relationship between two measured metrics; the sentence is cut off in the abstract.

8_1936.concept: 格式边界与结构化文本
8_1936.description: 激活跨越多种语料，突出空白、换行、缩进和格式边界；另见于英语中的 the、引号片段，以及代码注释/标识符、法律文书、数学问答、哲学列表和科研摘要，未呈现单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 冠词“the”及其后续成分
patterns.context: 在普通句子中出现在名词或短语之前；但该 token 也散见于代码注释、法律文本等不同文体，不能单独解释所有激活。

patterns.name: 换行与排版空白
patterns.context: 密集换行、缩进或表格式排版，特别是法律文书页眉及代码注释；空白 token 本身有较高激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、代码、问答排版

patterns.name: 引号内的片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 引号及其内部被拆分的词片段；目前仅见于一个片段，无法确认具体语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的当事人称谓与页眉格式
patterns.context: 诉讼标题、当事人身份和法院信息，以固定缩进和换行排列。

patterns.name: 生成文书的页脚与联系信息
patterns.context: 页脚说明、版权行及技术问题联系提示，伴随大量空行和填充空白。
patterns.domain: 法律文书生成系统输出

patterns.name: 代码注释或文档注释标记
patterns.context: 注释开头及逐行文档注释格式；激活还出现在标识符、寄存器定义和注释正文周围。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与数字常量
patterns.context: 下划线连接的标识符、十六进制或数字常量、类型和函数参数等代码结构。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与证明求助
patterns.context: 公式以 LaTeX 形式嵌入自然语言，询问函数列一致收敛及极限。

patterns.name: 图形绘制参数及边重叠说明
patterns.context: R 绘图代码之后解释边的曲率设置导致图中边重叠。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的列表与制表符排版
patterns.context: 以制表符分隔的短语列表，随后用散文介绍形而上学前提。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的指标关系表述
patterns.trigger: «relationship»« between»…« PAT index»« and»« IR»« signal»
patterns.context: 初步数据报告两个测量指标之间的关系，句子在摘要中截断。

en.concept: Formula notation and fixed phrases across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of mathematics and physics papers, mathematical Q&A, and approval reminder emails. Local triggers include cosine, integrals, limits, and the phi formula symbol, as well as specific terminology and email reminder phrasing; no single theme covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Cosine symbol
patterns.context: Cosine appears in mathematical expressions or formulas, often next to variables, angles, or integral expressions.

patterns.name: Integral symbol
patterns.context: The integral operator appears in mathematical formulas, often with differentials, functions, or integration domains.

patterns.name: Limit notation in formulas
patterns.context: The limit operator is used in a derivation of a sequence limit, followed by the subscript n→∞.

patterns.name: Jensen's inequality and integrability
patterns.context: Discusses conditions for applying the inequality and mentions an integrable random variable and E|X|<∞.

patterns.name: Approval reminder email
patterns.context: An email reminds the recipient that an approval request has been pending for several days and asks them to click a link.

patterns.name: Regge–Teitelboim equation
patterns.context: A paper names and introduces an equation and related citations.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and proof notation
patterns.context: A setup involving a variable belonging to a set introduces an inequality proof, including inner products, norms, and angles.

patterns.name: Neutrino energy reconstruction
patterns.context: Discusses uncertainty due to the Fermi momentum constraint and lists kinematic variables.

patterns.name: Symbol fragments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A formula contains a test function or an indexed phase variable; there is insufficient context to assign it to a more specific topic.

8_1936.concept: 多领域公式与固定措辞片段
8_1936.description: 激活分布在多类数学与物理论文、数学问答及审批提醒邮件中。可见局部触发包括余弦、积分、极限、phi 等公式符号，也包括特定术语和邮件提醒措辞；没有单一主题覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 余弦符号
patterns.context: 余弦出现在数学表达式或公式中；常与变量、角度或积分表达式相邻。

patterns.name: 积分符号
patterns.context: 积分算子出现在数学公式中，常伴随微分、函数或积分域。

patterns.name: 公式中的极限符号
patterns.context: 极限算子用于数列极限推导，后接下标 n→∞。

patterns.name: Jensen 不等式与可积性
patterns.context: 讨论不等式适用条件，并提到随机变量可积及 E|X|<∞。

patterns.name: 待审批提醒邮件
patterns.trigger: request has been pending your approval
patterns.context: 邮件提醒收件人审批请求已等待若干天，并要求点击链接。

patterns.name: Regge–Teitelboim 方程
patterns.context: 论文中命名并介绍方程及相关引用。

patterns.name: 数学定义与证明记号
patterns.context: 以变量属于集合的设定引出不等式证明，含内积、范数及角度。

patterns.name: 中微子能量重建
patterns.context: 讨论费米动量限制带来的不确定性，并列出运动学变量。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号片段
patterns.context: 公式中出现测试函数或带指标的相位变量；缺少足够上下文归入更具体主题。

en.description: Primarily responds to the digit “0” in scientific and mathematical contexts, especially subscripts, superscripts, values, and lower bounds of sums in formula parameters, across many fields; a few activations fall on line breaks.

patterns.name: Zero in mathematical and scientific notation
patterns.context: Zero is embedded in mathematical formulas, variable parameters, experimental values, or scientific measurements; it often appears next to subscripts, superscripts, operators, or units.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain arXiv scientific papers and mathematical text, also StackExchange algebra discussions; includes ultracold atoms, cosmology, astrophysics, particle physics, probability, topology, and semiconductors

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: A line break after a paragraph or formula; activation is weaker, with insufficient evidence that the line break itself is the primary trigger.

8_1936.description: 主要对科学与数学语境中的数字“0”有反应，尤其是公式参数的下标、上标、数值和求和下限，跨越多种学科；少量激活落在换行符上。

patterns.name: 数学与科学记号中的零
patterns.context: 零嵌在数学公式、变量参数、实验数值或科学测量数据中；常与下标、上标、运算符或单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的 ArXiv 科学论文及数学文本，也见于 StackExchange 代数讨论；包括冷原子、宇宙学、天体物理、粒子物理、概率、拓扑和半导体等。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 段落或公式后的换行位置；激活较弱，未见足够证据表明换行本身是主触发条件。

en.description: High activations often occur in mathematical physics text, especially the letter M and its subscripts, superscripts, braces, and operator notation in formulas. Other activations occur on manifold notation, particle physics amplitudes, and LaTeX formatting and technical terms without an obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: M in mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: The trigger is mainly within mathematical formulas or LaTeX markup; nearby elements often include subscripts, superscripts, braces, operators, or formula formatting symbols. The `C`, `T`, and other symbols in passage 4 do not fit this pattern.
patterns.domain: Primarily arXiv mathematics and physics formulas; also mathematical text on StackExchange

patterns.name: M for manifold
patterns.context: M is part of a manifold or moduli space notation in mathematical exposition; passage 2 also defines the map `\mathbf{f}`.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, geometry, and moduli spaces

patterns.name: M notation in particle physics
patterns.context: M appears in transition amplitude or matrix element notation; the same passage discusses charmonium, resonances, and production cross sections.

patterns.name: The letter M in names or labels
patterns.context: Appears in a specific theoretical object or named symbol, not in a consistent manifold context; the fragments do not establish whether they share a specific mathematical meaning.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and StackExchange mathematical discussions

patterns.name: Non-M LaTeX and formula-formatting noise
patterns.context: Dense formulas and their LaTeX formatting markers; these examples show no clear M trigger and may be unrelated to the main pattern.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical formulas and technical text

patterns.name: Occasional ordinary words in mathematical text
patterns.context: These words appear in their respective technical narratives, but the fragments do not show that they share a trigger with other activations.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, physics, algebra, and other styles

8_1936.concept: 数学公式中的 M 记号
8_1936.description: 高激活常见于数学物理文本，尤其是公式中的 M 字母及其上下标、花括号和算子记号；另有流形记号、粒子物理振幅，以及无明显共同触发的 LaTeX 格式和专业词语。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式中的 M
patterns.trigger: 数学标记中出现的 `M`，如 `\mathcal{M}`、`\tilde{M}`、`\mathbb{E}_{\tilde{M}(i)}`、`\mathcal{M}_{if}`；亦见 `M` 的字母化身
patterns.context: 触发点主要在数学公式或 LaTeX 标记内；多处附近还有上下标、花括号、算子或公式排版符号。第 4 段的 `C`、`T` 等符号并不符合该模式。
patterns.domain: 以 ArXiv 数学、物理公式为主；也出现于 StackExchange 的数学文本

patterns.name: manifold 的 M
patterns.context: M 是流形或模空间记号的一部分，位于数学论述中；第 2 段还出现映射 `\mathbf{f}` 的定义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学，几何与模空间

patterns.name: 粒子物理中的 M 记号
patterns.context: M 出现在跃迁振幅或矩阵元记号中；同段邻近 charmonium、共振及产生截面等讨论。

patterns.name: 字母 M 出现在专名或标记中
patterns.trigger: `\hat{M}`、`{M}`；以及 `\tilde{M}`（同时符合数学符号模式）
patterns.context: 出现于特定理论对象或命名符号中，并非统一的流形语境；无法从片段确定它们是否共享具体数学含义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学及 StackExchange 数学讨论

patterns.name: 非 M 的 LaTeX 与公式格式噪声
patterns.context: 公式及其 LaTeX 排版标记密集；这些例子没有明显的 M 触发，可能与主模式无关。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学公式与技术文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的偶发普通词语
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自专业叙述中，但片段无法表明它们本身与其他激活共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 分属技术说明、物理、代数等文体

en.description: Activations are concentrated on explicit binary sets/value spaces and nearby symbols, covering function codomains, classification labels, and set partitions. Other sporadic symbols and word fragments include integer node sets, the physical dimension D, Z groups or partition functions, and equation operators D; they do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Binary sets and value spaces
patterns.context: In mathematical or machine-learning descriptions, a set explicitly lists two discrete values, often used as a vector space, function codomain, classification labels, or partition results; it may also be a power set formed from these values.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, theoretical computer science, and machine learning

patterns.name: Discrete index sets

patterns.name: Z group notation

patterns.name: Specific English word fragments

patterns.name: Mixed formula and label fragments

8_1936.description: 激活最集中于显式的二元集合/取值空间及其附近符号，涵盖函数值域、分类标签和集合划分；另有整数节点集、物理维数D、Z群或配分函数、方程算子D等零散符号和词片段，未形成统一语义。

patterns.name: 特定英文词片段

en.description: Activations are concentrated in scientific mathematical text with LaTeX markers, especially parentheses, sets, numbers, variables, and formula structure; they also cover paper terminology. Other passages include broadcast promotions and game reviews, while common English words are insufficient to provide a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Parentheses in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Parentheses delimit mathematical expressions, sets, or coordinate components; they often occur near variables, operators, or formula markers.
patterns.domain: Mathematical and scientific/technical text, also general narrative

patterns.name: Braces for sets and vectors
patterns.context: Represent sets, discrete value spaces, or vector ranges, often near subscripts, powers, or set symbols.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantities
patterns.context: Numbers occur in formula parameters, interval endpoints, counts, measurements, or scientific data; sometimes adjacent to punctuation or units.

patterns.name: Variables and their subscripts and superscripts
patterns.context: Letter variables occur in formulas, summands, sequences, or coordinate notation, often with subscripts or superscripts; this is not limited to a specific variable.

patterns.name: Formulas and formatting markers
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical content and its boundaries, commands, or grouping markers; activation spans both markers and formula components.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and statistics papers

patterns.name: Common phrase elements such as prepositions and articles
patterns.context: Occur in ordinary English syntax in scientific explanations or general narratives; these words are widespread, and evidence is insufficient to establish a distinct semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Discourse on academic introductions and discrete mathematics
patterns.context: Introduces discrete spaces and functions in theorem background or a paper introduction.

patterns.name: Colloquial radio promotion
patterns.context: A radio program promotion uses a colloquial metaphor to introduce a person or program content.

patterns.context: Describes a stochastic process and its values or independence.

patterns.name: Evaluative narrative in game reviews

patterns.name: Spacetime coordinates and metric
patterns.context: Gives coordinate components and a diagonal metric tensor.

patterns.name: Possible cross-domain preference for structural symbols
patterns.context: Symbols occur near equations, differences, lists, or formula boundaries; this is only a candidate pattern based on cross-passage co-occurrence and cannot explain activations by itself.

8_1936.description: 激活集中于带LaTeX标记的科学数学文本，尤其括号、集合、数字、变量和公式结构；也覆盖论文术语。另有广播宣传与游戏评论等非数学语段，常见英语词不足以构成统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的括号

patterns.name: 集合与向量的花括号

patterns.name: 数字与数量表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在公式参数、区间端点、计数、测量值或科学数据中；有时紧邻标点或单位。

patterns.name: 变量及其下标、上标

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated mainly in LaTeX mathematical notation in ArXiv papers: variables, operators, parentheses, equals signs, sets, and discrete indices. A few occur at formula/prose boundaries, notation explanations, text about robotics symmetry, and line-break/formatting markers.

patterns.name: Variables/operators in mathematical symbols and formulas

patterns.name: Discrete sets and index notation

patterns.name: Word boundaries or function words in mathematical text
patterns.context: Ordinary English words at formula/prose boundaries or in paper body text and notation explanations; triggers are weak and scattered, with no identifiable unified lexical condition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper body text and sections such as Notations/Introduction

patterns.name: Words in robotics symmetry descriptions
patterns.context: An example of a robot arm and an introduction to its group symmetry; only one fragment is available, so it is unclear whether activation reflects the topic or an incidental local token.
patterns.domain: Robotics/geometry or explanatory text on group actions

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural markers around formulas

8_1936.description: 强激活主要集中于 ArXiv 论文的 LaTeX 数学记号：变量、算子、括号、等号、集合及离散索引；少量出现在公式与正文交界、记号说明、机器人对称性文字及换行/排版标记处。

patterns.name: 离散集合与索引记法

patterns.name: 数学文本中的词语边界或功能词

en.concept: Mathematical equations and notation in papers
en.description: Primarily responds to equations and structures in mathematical papers: subscripts, indices, parentheses, sets, and integer notation. Also covers heading formats and formulaic expressions in combinatorics, algebra, physics, statistics, and probability, with no single disciplinary theme.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation for sets and natural numbers
patterns.context: Numbers, parentheses, and set symbols in mathematical definitions involving finite sets, element indices, ranges of positive integers, and similar concepts; often accompanied by equation delimiters.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, especially combinatorics, algebra, and related definitions

patterns.name: Subscripts and indices in equations
patterns.context: Equations containing many variable subscripts, superscripts, or indices; activation often occurs near index letters, numbers, and equation punctuation.

patterns.name: Structural symbols in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Equations organize expressions using parentheses, equals signs, set delimiters, or mapping symbols; not specific to one mathematical object.

patterns.name: Section and heading formatting
patterns.context: Headings, separators, and line-break formatting in paper text; activation occurs near paragraph or section structure markers.

patterns.name: Summation and series expressions
patterns.context: Describes summing a sequence of integer-indexed terms and using operations such as integration.

patterns.name: Fluid-mechanics conditions and partial derivatives
patterns.context: States assumptions such as two-dimensional, inviscid, and incompressible flow, accompanied by partial-derivative conditions.

patterns.name: Set intersections and combinatorial properties of finite sets
patterns.context: Discusses families of subsets of finite sets and properties such as pairwise intersection.

patterns.name: Algebraic geometry and Gröbner bases

patterns.name: Statistical models and binary responses

patterns.name: Binary variables and detection events

patterns.name: Group actions and equivalence classes
patterns.context: Functions or objects depend only on equivalence classes under a group action, and related invariants are defined.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, possibly involving group theory or number theory

patterns.name: Stochastic processes and pushforward measures
patterns.context: Pushes a probability measure forward through a map to define the distribution of a stochastic process.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words adjacent to equations
patterns.context: These common English function words appear at activation sites in mathematical exposition, especially next to equations, definitions, or noun phrases; there is little evidence of an independent semantic category.

8_1936.description: 主要响应数学论文中的公式书写与结构：下标、索引、括号、集合和整数记号；也覆盖标题格式，以及组合数学、代数、物理、统计和概率中的多种公式化表达，未见单一学科主题。

patterns.name: 集合与自然数的数学记号

patterns.name: Mathematical notation for sets or mappings

patterns.name: Definitions and structural descriptions of mathematical objects

patterns.name: Superscript numbers and interval endpoint symbols

patterns.name: Precise qualifications and conditional statements

patterns.name: Collocations involving success, hard work, and comfort

patterns.name: 上标数字与区间端点符号
patterns.context: 无穷符号出现在集合、区间或扩展值函数表达中；强激活可落在符号本身。

patterns.name: 严谨限定与条件性陈述
patterns.context: 数学陈述中用条件引出定义约束、参数范围或模型假设。

patterns.name: 成功、辛劳与舒适的搭配
patterns.trigger: “the comforts brought by his hard work and successful business ventures”
patterns.context: 人物叙事中回顾长期服务后，描述对安逸生活的期待及事业成功；此段与数学公式模式不一致。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形与分词
patterns.trigger: “med tem ko je to veliko težje”“sistematičen pristop”“Kot veste je Svet”
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语连续文本中，若干被标记片段落在词内部或词形片段；不符合英语数学论文模式。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种口语/议事记录

patterns.name: 流体力学模型术语
patterns.context: 描述二维流动，并列出无黏、不可压等模型假设；激活分布在技术术语及其组成部分。

patterns.name: 论文结构导航与预备结果
patterns.context: 说明论文各节安排、预备结果及其后续应用。

en.concept: Local tokens in equations and structured text
en.description: Activations are scattered across equations, code markers, common function words, and diverse technical or general contexts; a few fragments show local patterns involving small, mathematical definitions, sports pressure, acknowledgments, and Go error handling. There is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Equation, mathematical, and code delimiters
patterns.context: Near mathematical symbols, equations, or structured code, especially delimiters, backslash commands, and line-break markers in LaTeX/Markdown source text

patterns.name: Small quantities and low-magnitude descriptions
patterns.context: Contexts describing small parameters, amplitudes, or physical quantities, often adjacent to equations or numerical values

patterns.name: Morphemes in technical compounds
