patterns.context: Activations occur within technical words split across tokens; meanings vary, with no clear shared semantics
patterns.domain: Academic texts in physics, fluid mechanics, and related fields

patterns.name: Common function words for coordination, connection, and prepositions
patterns.context: Words appear in ordinary syntactic positions, scattered across technical exposition and general text; no stable specific collocations are apparent

patterns.name: Expressions of thanks and continued support
patterns.context: After a list of acknowledgments, expresses gratitude for continued support, commitment, and perseverance

patterns.name: Expressions of pressure and ball games
patterns.context: A quotation describes a team putting pressure on the player with the ball; the preceding text mentions the lineup and players

patterns.name: Description of a finite group action
patterns.context: In a list of definitions involving sets, groups, and smooth actions

patterns.name: Definition of a fractional derivative
patterns.context: Defines a fractional derivative of a given order after specifying a function

patterns.name: Go error handling and empty-user check
patterns.context: Checks whether a user list is empty and then returns an error, using Go code formatting

patterns.name: Sparse networks and dynamic random coupling
patterns.context: Discusses quenched disorder being replaced by a dynamically coupled structure and the network limit
patterns.domain: Complex systems or statistical physics papers

patterns.name: Scale, particle count, and continuum discussions
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between the mesoscopic scale, particle count, and macroscopic states

patterns.name: Energy loss and pair production
patterns.context: Calculates energy loss from pair production in a simulation and handles it with a continuous-loss approximation

patterns.name: Fluid assumptions and dimensional conditions
patterns.context: Explicitly assumes two-dimensional, inviscid, incompressible flow

patterns.name: Modulation and static spatial lattices
patterns.context: Specifies a periodic modulation parameter and the small amplitude used in a simulation

8_1936.concept: 公式/结构化文本中的局部 token
8_1936.description: 激活分散于公式与代码标记、常见功能词及多种专业或普通语境；少数片段出现 small、数学定义、体育施压、致谢和 Go 错误处理等局部模式。没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 公式、数学及代码定界符
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或结构化代码附近；尤其 LaTeX/Markdown 源文本中的定界符、反斜杠命令和换行标记

patterns.name: 小量与低幅度表述
patterns.context: 描述参数、幅度或物理量较小的上下文，常邻近公式或数值

patterns.name: 技术性复合词中的词素
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的技术词内部，词义各异，没有明显共同语义
patterns.domain: 物理、流体力学等学术文本

patterns.name: 并列、连接及介词等常见功能词
patterns.context: 词出现在一般句法位置，分散于技术叙述和普通文本；未见稳定的特定搭配

patterns.name: 感谢与持续支持措辞
patterns.context: 感谢名单之后，表达对持续支持、投入和坚持的感谢

patterns.name: 施压与球类比赛措辞
patterns.context: 引语中描述球队对持球者施压，前文提到阵容和球员

patterns.name: 有限群作用表述
patterns.context: 集合、群与光滑作用的定义式列表中

patterns.name: 分数阶导数定义
patterns.context: 给定函数后定义某阶分数阶导数

patterns.name: Go 错误处理与空用户判断
patterns.context: 检查用户列表为空后返回错误，包含 Go 语言代码格式

patterns.name: 稀疏网络与动态随机耦合
patterns.context: 讨论 quenched disorder 被动态耦合结构替代及网络极限
patterns.domain: 复杂系统或统计物理论文

patterns.name: 量级、粒子数及连续介质讨论
patterns.context: 描述介观层次、粒子数与宏观状态的关联
patterns.domain: 物理或多尺度建模论文

patterns.name: 能量损失与成对产生
patterns.trigger: “pair production losses”“continuous energy loss approximation”“inelasticity in pair production”
patterns.context: 模拟中计算成对产生造成的能量损失，并以连续损失近似处理
patterns.domain: 天体物理或粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 流体假设与维度条件
patterns.context: 明确假定二维、无黏、不可压流动

patterns.name: 调制与静态空间晶格
patterns.context: 说明周期调制参数及模拟所用的小振幅

en.concept: Document formatting, conversational phrases, and equation numerals
en.description: Activations cluster around email and formal-letter formatting, polite contact or inquiry phrases, and symbols and numbers in paper equations, especially zero; expressions such as “hard work” also appear in biographies. The groups do not share a fully consistent trigger.

patterns.name: Email or formal-letter formatting and closing
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks, polite phrases, signatures, or legal-document headings in emails or formal letters; often adjacent to paragraph boundaries and whitespace

patterns.name: Inquiry and contact instructions
patterns.context: Invites recipients to ask questions, contact someone or a help desk, or request further assistance; not every trigger word necessarily appears alone

patterns.name: The numeral zero in equations
patterns.context: Zero appears in scientific paper values, percentages, or mathematical expressions; other symbols or words near equations may also activate
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers in physics, quantum computing, and mathematics

patterns.name: Paper equations and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: In complex mathematical typesetting or equation text, activations occur on symbols, variables, numbers, and nearby prose; overlaps with the numerical-zero pattern, but not all activations are explained by zero

patterns.name: Success and hard work
patterns.context: A biographical account describes hard work, a successful career, and the comfortable life it brings

8_1936.concept: 文档格式、交际语句与公式数字
8_1936.description: 激活集中在邮件与公函的格式、礼貌联系或提问语句，以及论文公式中的符号和数字（尤其零）；另见传记中“hard work”等表达。各组触发并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 邮件或公函的格式与收尾
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«↵↵»、称呼或署名（如«Sincerely,»、«Thank you.»、«--»、«Kay»），以及«ATT»、«ORNEYS FOR APPELLEE»
patterns.context: 激活出现在邮件/公函的换行、礼貌用语、署名或法律文书标题附近；常与段落边界和留白相邻

patterns.name: 询问与联系指引
patterns.trigger: «Any» questions、«Please ask»、«call»、«contact»、«Let» me know、«if» you have
patterns.context: 面向收件人邀请提问、要求联系某人或服务台，或提供后续协助；未必每个触发词单独出现

patterns.name: 公式中的数字零
patterns.context: 数字零出现在科学论文的数值、百分比或数学表达式中；同时激活常落在公式周边的其他符号或词上
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文，物理、量子计算与数学

patterns.name: 论文公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 复杂数学排版或公式文本中，激活分布在符号、变量、数字及紧邻正文上；与零的数值模式有重叠，但并非所有激活都由零解释

patterns.name: 成功与辛勤工作
patterns.context: 人物叙述中描述辛勤付出、成功事业及其带来的舒适生活

en.concept: Document boundaries and heterogeneous local patterns
en.description: Activations mainly fall on document line breaks, blank lines, and paragraph boundaries, especially separators in emails or legal texts; other patterns include the notation O, C^∞, Slovenian in-word fragments, and isolated occurrences such as its in historical narratives.

patterns.name: Paragraph or email boundaries after line breaks
patterns.context: Strong activations cluster on line-break markers, especially blank lines or paragraph breaks formed by consecutive line breaks; often occur around the end of the body, signatures, or the start of a new paragraph.
patterns.domain: Emails, legal texts, and other documents

patterns.name: Capital O in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Appears in the complexity notation “$O(k)$” and “$O(\”, adjacent to equation symbols and parentheses.

patterns.name: Superscript boundary in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Appears in the formulaic representation “C^\infty-” of a smoothness condition.

patterns.name: In-word substring in Slovenian
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword fragments; the fragment occurs in a context involving energy consumption, optimization, and reducing burdens.

patterns.name: Imagery of burning in historical narratives
patterns.context: In “set its smouldering fires into a consuming flame,” its refers to the preceding war fervor or spirit, within a metaphorical narrative of escalating war.

8_1936.concept: 文档边界及异质局部模式
8_1936.description: 激活主要落在文档换行、空行和段落边界，尤其邮件或法律文本的分隔处；另有公式记号O、C^∞、斯洛文尼亚语词内片段，以及历史叙述中的its等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 换行后的段落/邮件边界
patterns.context: 强激活集中在换行标记，尤其连续换行形成的空行或段落分隔；常出现在正文结尾、签名或新段落前后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文本及其他文档

patterns.name: 数学公式中的大写 O
patterns.context: 出现在复杂度记号“$O(k)$”及“$O(\”中，紧邻公式符号与括号。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学论文、算法理论

patterns.name: 数学公式中的上标边界
patterns.context: 出现在“C^\infty-”这一光滑性条件的公式表示中。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内子串
patterns.context: 词被分成多个子词片段；该片段处于能源消耗、优化及减少负担的语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、斯洛文尼亚语

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的燃烧意象
patterns.context: “set its smouldering fires into a consuming flame”中，its 指代前文战争情绪/精神，处在战争升温的比喻叙述里。

en.description: Activations show several local patterns: the word hard occurs in several contexts; a stronger shared cue is line breaks, indentation, and formatting boundaries in legal documents and code; a normal-distribution equation also appears.

patterns.name: The word form hard
patterns.context: The word hard itself is a high-activation position; semantic and syntactic environments vary, including the phrases hard enough, hard rawk, hard sell.
patterns.domain: Pop-culture commentary, music reviews, sports recruiting discussions

patterns.name: Court-document heading and line-break formatting
patterns.context: The first-page heading of a U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals document, with many line breaks, indents, and spaces around the date and court name; activation falls especially on formatting whitespace and line breaks.

patterns.name: Line breaks and signature block in legal documents
patterns.context: The appellant's father and attorney information is separated by line breaks and indentation; activations cluster on groups of line breaks and spaces, rather than on specific legal concepts.

patterns.name: Normal-distribution notation in mathematical equations
patterns.context: A probability theory equation describes a variable following a Gaussian/normal distribution with zero mean and a specified variance.

patterns.name: Code indentation and line breaks
patterns.context: In Go code or configuration snippets, fields are separated by line breaks and tabs, followed by comments.

8_1936.description: 激活呈多种局部模式：hard 一词出现在数种语境；更强的共同线索是法律文书及代码中的换行、缩进和格式边界；另有正态分布公式。

patterns.name: 词形 hard
patterns.context: 单词 hard 本身成为高激活位置；语义和句法环境不一致：包括短语 hard enough、hard rawk、hard sell。
patterns.domain: 流行文化评论、音乐评论、体育招募讨论

patterns.name: 法院文件页眉与换行排版
patterns.trigger: “↵↵↵↵↵”以及“IN THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”“FOR THE FIFTH CIRCUIT”“FILED”附近
patterns.context: 美国第五巡回上诉法院文书的首页页眉，日期与法院名称周围有大量换行、缩进和空格；激活尤其落在格式空白与换行上。

patterns.name: 法律文书换行与署名栏
patterns.trigger: “↵↵”及律师姓名、职务和当事人身份之间的排版
patterns.context: 上诉人父亲及律师信息以换行、缩进分隔；激活集中在成组换行和空格，而非特定法律概念。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的正态分布符号
patterns.context: 概率论公式中描述变量服从零均值、特定方差的高斯/正态分布。

patterns.name: 代码缩进与换行
patterns.trigger: “↵”和制表符缩进；邻近字符串含“k8s.io/client-go”
patterns.context: Go 代码或配置片段中以换行、制表符分隔字段，后接注释。

en.concept: Mixed word forms and formatting features
en.description: Activations mainly occur on hard and its derived or compound forms; other patterns include line breaks, indentation, and string structure in Go code, as well as Slovenian parliamentary-text subword fragments. The latter two differ from the hard word-form pattern.

patterns.name: hard word forms
patterns.context: hard and its compounds or derivatives occur; [1] is “hard enough,” while the others are different collocations involving hard work, music styles, or hardship
patterns.domain: Promotional copy, recruitment descriptions, music reviews, corporate emails, legal texts

patterns.name: Strings and line breaks in Go code
patterns.context: In Go source snippets, strong activations occur near line breaks, indentation, quotation marks, and code identifiers; the two code snippets have similar structure

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in Slovenian parliamentary text
patterns.context: In Slovenian headings or parliamentary documents, words are split into multiple subword fragments; local activations occur within words and on adjacent formatting markers

8_1936.description: 激活主要落在 hard 及其派生或复合形式；另见 Go 代码中的换行、缩进与字符串结构，以及斯洛文尼亚语议会文本的子词片段，后两类与 hard 词形模式不同。

patterns.name: hard 词形
patterns.context: 出现 hard 及其复合词或派生词；[1] 为“hard enough”，其余为努力工作、音乐风格或困苦等不同搭配
patterns.domain: 宣传文案、招聘介绍、音乐评论、企业邮件、法律文本

patterns.name: Go 代码中的字符串与换行
patterns.trigger: [2] «↵»«	»、带引号的导入路径；[5] «↵»«	»、带引号的导入路径及 «type»
patterns.context: Go 源码片段中，换行、缩进、引号和代码标识符附近出现强激活；两段代码结构相似

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本的分词片段
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语标题或议会文件中，词语被拆成多个子词片段；局部激活分布在词内及相邻排版标记
patterns.domain: EuroParl / 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across hard- compounds, its toll, and a lot less, and often occur on line breaks: email signatures or code file headers, and before function definitions. Both cross-token fragments and formatting boundaries may trigger activation.

patterns.name: hard- compounds
patterns.context: Compounds beginning with hard- occur, with following characters continuing across tokens; the examples describe a cowboy and an entrepreneur.

patterns.name: its toll collocation
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “take its toll,” meaning to cause damage or an impact.

patterns.name: Email signature and line breaks
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks introduce signature information after the email body ends.

patterns.name: Generated code file boundaries
patterns.context: The license comment ends and generated code begins, or Go source declarations are followed by imports; activations occur on line breaks.
patterns.domain: Github Go code and file headers

patterns.name: Code after a paragraph break
patterns.context: A line break between a code comment and a function definition.

patterns.name: less collocation
patterns.context: Compares a smaller number or degree of things, appearing in a discussion about whether to read code or documentation first.

8_1936.description: 激活分散在 hard- 复合词、its toll、a lot less 等词组，也常落在换行：邮件签名或代码文件头、函数定义前。跨 token 片段与格式边界均可能触发。

patterns.name: hard-复合词
patterns.context: 出现 hard- 开头的复合词，后续字符跨 token 延续；分别描述牛仔和企业家。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、小说或评论性叙事

patterns.name: its toll 搭配
patterns.context: 固定搭配“take its toll”，表示造成损害或影响。

patterns.name: 邮件签名与换行
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后，多个换行引出签名信息。

patterns.name: 生成代码文件边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»10，附近有「Code generated by client-gen」「DO NOT EDIT」「package」或「import」
patterns.context: 许可证注释结束、生成代码开始，或 Go 源码声明与导入部分；激活落在换行处。
patterns.domain: Github Go 代码及文件头

patterns.name: 段落换行后接代码
patterns.context: 代码注释与函数定义之间的换行。

patterns.name: less 搭配
patterns.context: 比较事物数量或程度较少，出现在关于先读代码还是先读说明的讨论中。

en.description: Activations occur in Go file headers and Patch method declarations, as well as hard- compounds, hand movements in legal texts, and mathematical function-space notation; these lexical and formatting cues are scattered and difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Package declaration and import section in Go code
patterns.context: Near the beginning of a Go source file or its import list; often accompanied by line breaks, comments, package names, or import paths.

patterns.name: Patch in a Go method declaration
patterns.context: Near a function or method declaration in Go code, preceded by the end of a function body and a comment.

patterns.name: hard- compounds
patterns.context: hard combines with a following root to form a compound or adjective; triggers occur in narratives and promotional copy.
patterns.domain: News narratives, website promotional copy, Wikipedia text

patterns.name: Descriptions of hands and actions
patterns.context: Describes the position or movement of hands, or physical contact with another person, often in legal testimony or case narratives.

patterns.name: Mathematical function spaces and mapping symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical papers define function spaces, continuous functions, and their mapping targets.

8_1936.description: 激活见于 Go 文件头部与 Patch 方法声明，也见 hard-复合词、法律文本中的手部动作，以及数学函数空间记号；这些词法和格式线索分散，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的 package 声明与导入区
patterns.trigger: «package»、«import»、导入括号中的制表符和引号；如「«package» unicode」「«import» («\n»\t«"»testing«"»」
patterns.context: Go 源文件开头或导入列表附近；常伴随换行、注释、包名或导入路径。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Go 源码

patterns.name: Go 方法声明中的 Patch
patterns.context: Go 代码中函数/方法声明附近，前文包含函数体结束和注释。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Go 源码

patterns.name: hard-复合词
patterns.context: hard 与后续词根构成复合词或形容词；触发分布在叙述和宣传文案中。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、网站宣传文案、维基百科文本

patterns.name: 手部与动作描写
patterns.trigger: 「«hands»」「«hand»」；并见「«put» his «hands» behind」「«placed» one «hand» in the air」「«hand»」
patterns.context: 描写手的位置、动作或与他人身体接触，常位于法律证词或案件叙述中。

patterns.name: 数学函数空间与映射符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中定义函数空间、连续函数及其映射目标。

en.description: The main pattern is hard-hyphen compounds, but there are also scattered activations involving outcomes or negative expressions, imperative phrases with your, and tokens in code and mathematical equations; these contexts differ noticeably on the surface.

patterns.name: hard hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: A hyphen joins hard to another word, and the following word may be split into multiple tokens; examples describe entrepreneurs, teams, merchants, and influence
patterns.domain: Narrative, commentary, religious and political discussion

patterns.name: Adverse outcomes or negative-degree words
patterns.context: Expresses loss, reduction, or an unfortunate outcome; activations fall on degree or result words, or compound fragments

patterns.name: your phrases addressing or urging the reader
patterns.context: In an imperative appeal, your is followed by a body part or personal item

patterns.name: Tokenized code and path content
patterns.context: Import paths or code structure in Go code; activations are distributed across identifiers and formatting symbols

patterns.name: Mathematical equation symbols and variables
patterns.context: Variables, operators, and LaTeX commands interspersed in mathematical expressions

8_1936.description: 主要模式是 hard-连字符复合词，但另有结果/负面表达、your 祈使短语，以及代码和数学公式中的零散 token 激活；这些语境表面上差异明显。

patterns.name: hard连字符复合词
patterns.context: 连字符连接 hard 与另一词，且后续词可能被拆成多个 token；分别描述企业家、团队、商人、影响力
patterns.domain: 叙事、评论、宗教政治讨论

patterns.name: 不利结果或负面程度词
patterns.context: 表达损失、减少或不幸结果；激活落在程度、结果或复合词片段上
patterns.domain: 体育报道、评论、新闻讨论

patterns.name: 指向或号召读者的 your 短语
patterns.context: 祈使式号召中，your 后接身体部位或随身物品

patterns.name: 标记化代码与路径内容
patterns.context: Go 代码中的导入路径或代码结构；激活分布在标识符和格式符号上

patterns.name: 数学公式符号与变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中交错出现的变量、运算符和 LaTeX 命令

en.concept: parents word forms and sporadic lexical items
en.description: The most consistent cue is the parents/parent word form, appearing across several genres. Other activations are distributed across academic title words, ecology terminology, programmes, painter, and sentence-initial she. These may reflect lexical items or local formatting, and cannot be summarized by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: parents word forms
patterns.context: Activates when parent-related words appear, especially parents in the provided fragments; may occur in sentences, quotations, or academic abstracts
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; appears in narratives, reviews, and medical and social science abstracts

patterns.name: D-initial words in academic titles
patterns.context: Activates near bracketed labels or D-initial title words at the start of PubMed titles; this appears more like a local title-format or word-form trigger

patterns.name: Woody plants and place names in academic titles
patterns.context: Activates in titles of plant community studies, especially long titles composed of place names and ecological terminology

patterns.name: programmes in academic abstracts
patterns.context: Activates near the word in the body of an abstract about support programmes for a specific group of relatives
patterns.domain: Mental health and social services abstracts

patterns.name: painter in a quotation
patterns.context: Appears in a critical quotation about student debt and an art career; activation is weak and may be coincidental co-occurrence

patterns.name: sentence-initial she
patterns.context: Weak activation occurs when a narrative fragment begins with lowercase she; the later appearance of parents may also contribute

8_2126.concept: parents 词形及零散词项触发
8_2126.description: 最一致的线索是 parents/parent 词形，见多种文体；其余激活分布于学术标题词、生态学术语、programmes、painter 和句首 she，可能是词项或局部格式触发，无法由单一语义概括。

patterns.name: parents 词形
patterns.context: 直接出现家长/父母相关词时激活，所给片段中尤以 parents 为强触发；可出现在句子、引文或学术摘要中
patterns.domain: 跨领域；见叙事、评论、医学与社会科学摘要

patterns.name: 学术标题中的 D 起始词
patterns.context: PubMed 标题开头的方括号标记或 D 起始标题词附近出现激活；更像局部标题格式及词形触发

patterns.name: 学术标题中的木本植物与地名
patterns.context: 植物群落研究标题中，尤其在地名和生态学术语组成的长标题里激活

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的 programmes
patterns.context: 关于为特定亲属群体提供支持项目的摘要正文中，该词附近激活
patterns.domain: 精神卫生与社会服务摘要

patterns.name: 引文中的 painter
patterns.context: 学生负债与艺术职业的评论性引文中出现；激活较弱，可能是偶然共现

patterns.name: 句首 she
patterns.context: 叙事片段以小写 she 开头时有弱激活，后文出现 parents 也可能贡献激活

en.description: Activations fall on several local word forms or formatting fragments: REVIEW, legal citations, ose in Dose, repeated slashes, Fif in Fifteenth, and sentence-initial According to. There is no single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: REVIEW field label
patterns.context: The uppercase word REVIEW is split into RE and VIEW, followed by a vertical bar and the field content “Last Gasp: Frank Oz”.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers, letters, and punctuation resembles a federal case citation, followed by a line break and “Lab”.

patterns.name: ose in dose
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the in-word fragment “ose” in Dose/Dose; examples include dose-response relationships, a coding issue title, and dose reconstruction.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts or medical promotional text

patterns.name: Repeated slash delimiters
patterns.context: A long run of repeated slashes is followed by a line break and copyright notice.

patterns.name: Ordinal Fifteenth
patterns.context: The ordinal is tokenized as Fif and th within the name of an international neurotoxicology conference.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial According to
patterns.context: A fixed sentence-initial attribution or evidential phrase; it introduces a government agency, an invention-related point, or research on social causes.
patterns.domain: Patent background and research project descriptions

8_2126.description: 激活落在多种局部词形或格式片段上：REVIEW、法律引注、Dose中的ose、重复斜杠、Fifteenth中的Fif，以及句首According to；没有单一清晰语义模式。

patterns.name: REVIEW 字段标签
patterns.context: 大写词 REVIEW 被拆成 RE 与 VIEW，后接竖线及字段内容“Last Gasp: Frank Oz”。
patterns.domain: 网页/目录或元数据文本

patterns.name: 法律引文格式
patterns.context: 数字、字母和标点组成类似联邦判例引注的编号，后接换行与“Lab”。

patterns.name: dose 词中的 ose
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Dose/Dose 的词内片段“ose”；分别出现在剂量效应关系、编码问题标题和剂量重建等表达中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要或医学宣传文本

patterns.name: 重复斜杠分隔符
patterns.context: 长串重复斜杠后接换行及版权声明。

patterns.name: 序数词 Fifteenth
patterns.context: 序数词被分词为 Fif 与 th，位于国际神经毒理学会议名称中。

patterns.name: According to 开头
patterns.context: 句首固定引述/依据表达；后续分别引出国家机构、发明方面和社会原因研究。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与科研项目描述

en.description: Activations cover the “3*” structure in mathematics and also occur sporadically on word fragments, line breaks, English-Chinese greetings, and repeated spaces in email. The non-mathematical triggers have no stable shared condition.

patterns.name: Digit 3 followed by an asterisk
patterns.context: The digit 3 is immediately followed by a multiplication sign/asterisk; occurs in formulas or mathematical typesetting.

patterns.name: Initial or internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on the beginning of an English word or a subsequent subword fragment; examples involve legal numbering, proper names, medical terminology, or personality disorder terminology, with no consistent condition.

patterns.name: End-of-line newline marker
patterns.context: A newline marker occurs after a short title or text line, followed by a blank line or body text.

patterns.name: Greeting and English-Chinese strings
patterns.context: An English greeting is followed by Chinese characters, with spaces or punctuation.

patterns.name: Repeated spaces
patterns.context: Email text contains many consecutive spaces, followed by a date field in parentheses.

8_2126.description: 激活覆盖数学中“3*”结构，也零散出现在词语子片段、换行、英中欢迎语和邮件连续空格处；这些非数学触发之间缺少稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 数字 3 后接星号
patterns.context: 数字 3 紧接乘号/星号；出现在公式或数学排版中。

patterns.name: 词首或词内的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的首部或后续子词片段；涉及法律编号、专名、医学术语或人格障碍术语，条件不统一。

patterns.name: 行末换行标记
patterns.context: 换行标记出现在短标题或文本行之后，且后面还有空行或正文。

patterns.name: 欢迎语及中英文字串
patterns.context: 英文欢迎语后接中文字符，含空格或标点。

patterns.name: 重复空格
patterns.context: 邮件文本中出现大量连续空格，后接括号内的日期字段。

en.description: All fragments contain the neoplasia root, and this neuron activates strongly on it. Contexts are mostly tumor-related medical research, as well as one informal online discussion. The second fragment highlights the link between tumors and abnormal membrane lipids.

patterns.name: neoplasia root
patterns.context: The trigger is neoplasia itself; various modifiers or punctuation may occur before or after it, with no apparent fixed syntactic requirement.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and medical discussions

patterns.name: Tumor-related contexts
patterns.context: Co-occurs with medical content about cancer, tissue or disease types, risk, detection, treatment, and pathological changes; the fourth fragment is an online discussion of randomly occurring tumors.
patterns.domain: Oncology and related medical research; occasional informal online discussion

patterns.name: Tumor-related membrane lipid abnormalities
patterns.context: neoplasia is associated with abnormal cell membrane lipid levels; no other fragment has the same specific trigger condition.

8_2126.description: 所有片段都出现 neoplasia 词根，且该神经元强烈激活于此；语境多为肿瘤相关医学研究，也包括一段非正式网络讨论。第2段突出肿瘤与膜脂异常的联系。

patterns.name: neoplasia 词根
patterns.context: 触发词 neoplasia（肿瘤/赘生物）本身；前后可接不同修饰语或标点，无明显固定句法要求。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、摘要及医学讨论

patterns.name: 肿瘤相关语境
patterns.trigger: 如 «cervical» … «neopl»asia、«thyroid» … «neopl»asia、«B-cell» «neopl»asia、«neopl»asia or absence of ligamentous support
patterns.context: 与癌症、组织或疾病类型、风险、检测、治疗、病理变化等医学内容共现；第4段则是谈随机出现的肿瘤的网络讨论。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学及相关医学研究；偶见非正式网络讨论

patterns.name: 肿瘤相关膜脂异常
patterns.trigger: «other» lipid levels … detected in different types of «neopl»asia
patterns.context: neoplasia 与细胞膜脂质水平异常相联系，未见其他段落具有同一具体触发条件。
patterns.domain: 微生物学/细胞生物学研究论文

en.description: Strongly responds to the uppercase “UNPUBLISHED” in legal document headers (especially the “PUBL” fragment); it also responds to nearby court names, case captions, document types, and fixed layouts.

patterns.name: Unpublished decision marker
patterns.context: The uppercase “UNPUBLISHED” marker in a court document title or header; often adjacent to “ORDER” or “OPINION”

patterns.name: Court name in header
patterns.context: A court name appears on the next line after “UNPUBLISHED”; the layout includes indentation and line breaks

patterns.name: Washington State court case caption
patterns.context: A state court case header listing the state, division, case number, and parties; followed by “UNPUBLISHED OPINION”

patterns.name: Unpublished order and notice
patterns.context: The title of an unpublished order and the document notice that follows

8_2126.description: 强烈响应法律文书页首的大写“UNPUBLISHED”（尤以“PUBL”片段为突出）；也响应其相邻的法院名称、案首、文书类型及固定版式。

patterns.name: 未刊判决标记
patterns.context: 法院文书标题或页首中，大写的“UNPUBLISHED”标记；常与“ORDER”“OPINION”相邻

patterns.name: 法院名称页首
patterns.context: “UNPUBLISHED”之后换行出现的法院名称；版式含缩进与换行
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院文书

patterns.name: 华盛顿州法院案首
patterns.context: 州法院案件标题页首，列出州名、分庭、案号及当事人；后接“UNPUBLISHED OPINION”
patterns.domain: 华盛顿州上诉法院文书

patterns.name: 未刊命令及提示语
patterns.context: 未刊命令的标题及其后的文书提示语

en.concept: derivatives and function definitions in synthetic math exercises
en.description: Strong activations are concentrated in DM Mathematics synthetic problems: polynomial differentiation questions and function definitions of the form “Let…be the…derivative of…”. Activations also occur in intervening questions about compositeness, primes, true/false judgments, and algebraic conditions.

patterns.name: Calculus differentiation
patterns.context: Asks for the first, second, or third derivative of a polynomial or function with respect to a variable; a common template is “What is the … derivative … wrt …?”, followed by the derivative result
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; synthetic symbolic calculus question-answer pairs

patterns.name: Defining a function as a derivative
patterns.context: After one calculus problem ends, the next begins with a function definition, explicitly stating that it is some order derivative of another function
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; consecutively generated calculus exercises

patterns.name: Compositeness questions and true/false answers
patterns.context: An algebraic or number-theoretic judgment question followed by a brief true/false answer; typically occurs between two calculus problems

patterns.name: Numerical polynomials and derivative results in calculus problems
patterns.context: An expression forms part of a differentiation problem or its result; it appears only in differentiation contexts, insufficient to establish a preference for any particular power or coefficient

patterns.name: Sporadic algebraic equations and relations
patterns.context: A condition in an independent true/false question; the equation itself does not show the same local pattern as the differentiation trigger

8_2126.concept: 合成数学练习中的导数与函数定义
8_2126.description: 强激活集中于DM数学合成题：多项式求导问答，以及“Let…be the…derivative of…”式函数定义；也出现在其间的复合性、质数、奇偶真假判断和代数条件中。

patterns.name: 微积分求导运算
patterns.trigger: «derivative»、«first derivative»、«second derivative»、«third derivative»、«wrt»，以及多项式中的 «*»、«**»
patterns.context: 在询问多项式或函数对某变量的一阶、二阶、三阶导数；常见模板为“What is the … derivative … wrt …?”，随后给出导数结果
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；合成的符号微积分问答

patterns.name: 定义函数为某阶导数
patterns.trigger: «Let» … «(»变量«)» «be» «the» «second derivative» / «third derivative» «of»，或«=»后接多项式
patterns.context: 一道微积分题结束后，下一题以函数定义开头，并明确说它是另一函数的某阶导数
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；连续生成的微积分练习

patterns.name: 复合性判断题及真假答案
patterns.trigger: «composite» «?» 后接 «True»；另有 «Is» … «prime» «?»、«even» «?» 后接 «True» 或 «False»
patterns.context: 代数或数论式判断题的问句与简短真假回答；通常夹在两道微积分题之间

patterns.name: 微积分题中的数值多项式与导数结果
patterns.trigger: 如«h»、«v»、«n»等变量与系数、«**»幂次及«*»相乘构成表达式，之后出现数值答案
patterns.context: 表达式是求导题的题干或结果的一部分；只在求导语境中可见，不足以确定某种特定幂次或系数偏好

patterns.name: 零散代数方程与关系式
patterns.context: 作为独立真假判断题的条件；方程本身不显示与求导触发完全相同的局部模式

en.description: Every fragment shows prominent activation at continuation points involving spaces or line breaks. Other local patterns include formula symbols, biomedical terminology, email requests, and a few domain-specific words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Text awaiting continuation after a space or line break
patterns.context: The model activates strongly at a space within a passage or at a line-ending newline, where text is about to continue; common when a sentence or phrase is truncated before the next word appears.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; appears in emails, academic papers, and biomedical text

patterns.name: English function words and continuation
patterns.context: In English contexts, activation falls on common function words or continuation positions after them; these words are scattered and are not a stable trigger shared by all fragments.
patterns.domain: Email, sports news, and other English narrative

patterns.name: Mathematical notation symbols
patterns.context: Activates on symbols, variables, and formula-structure tokens in formulas or LaTeX mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Biomedical names and numerical units
patterns.context: Activations occur around microorganism names, specialist terms, or values with units; the precise locations differ between the two examples.

patterns.name: Polite requests and action arrangements in email
patterns.context: Expressions requesting feedback, providing information, or arranging matters in email; overlaps with space/continuation activation and common function words.

patterns.name: Consulting or volunteer recruitment context
patterns.context: Promotional text describing joining a volunteer service, serving as an advisor, and becoming a role model.
patterns.domain: Organizational recruitment material in Enron email

patterns.name: Sports performance narrative
patterns.context: A narrative about a basketball player's recent performance and fantasy sports evaluation.

patterns.name: Business documents and compliance matters
patterns.context: Discusses document revisions, regulatory issues, or financial business matters; the trigger itself does not form a consistent cross-fragment pattern.

8_2126.description: 所有段都在空格或换行续接处出现突出激活；另有公式符号、生物医学术语、邮件请求及少量领域词等局部模式，缺乏统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 空格或换行后的待续文本
patterns.trigger: 空格后的 « »6、« »7、« »9、« »10 及紧随换行的续文
patterns.context: 在段内空格或行尾换行处，模型对即将继续的文本强烈激活；常见于句子或短语被截断、下一词尚未出现的位置。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；邮件、学术论文和生物医学文本均出现

patterns.name: 英语功能词及续接
patterns.context: 英语语境中，激活落在常见功能词或其后续接位置；但这些词分散且并非各段共同的稳定触发因素。
patterns.domain: 邮件、体育新闻及其他英语叙述

patterns.name: 数学公式排版符号
patterns.context: 公式或 LaTeX 数学表达式中，对符号、变量及公式结构 token 激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学名称与数字单位
patterns.context: 微生物名称、专业术语或带单位的数值周围出现激活；具体落点在两个例子中不同。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 邮件中的礼貌请求与行动安排
patterns.trigger: «Could you»、«please let me know»、«Let me know»、«Attached»
patterns.context: 邮件中请求反馈、告知或安排事项的表达；与空格/续文激活及常见功能词重叠。

patterns.name: 咨询或志愿者招募语境
patterns.context: 描述加入志愿服务、担任顾问并成为榜样的宣传性文字。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的组织招募宣传

patterns.name: 体育表现叙述
patterns.context: 篮球运动员近期表现及幻想体育评价的叙述。

patterns.name: 商务文件与合规事项
patterns.context: 讨论文件修改、监管问题或金融业务事项；触发本身不构成跨段一致模式。

en.concept: actions of preventing and restricting, alongside various formatting-word triggers
en.description: Activations mainly occur on meanings and infinitive expressions involving preventing, restricting, stopping, or removing something. Other patterns include power supply and demand figures, business email matters, biochemical research wording, LaTeX formula structures, and Dutch subword segmentation, indicating several distinct local patterns.

patterns.name: Preventing, stopping, or avoiding
patterns.context: Describes preventing something from happening, restricting behavior, or removing something; sometimes expressed as an infinitive
patterns.domain: Sports equipment reviews, anti-counterfeiting product patents, energy policy, catalyst technology, music industry discussions

patterns.name: Energy supply, demand, and capacity figures
patterns.context: Supply and demand planning information about power loads, capacity, imports, and demand, with MW values

patterns.name: Administrative wording in email
patterns.context: Lists counterparties and states that matters such as faxes are being handled

patterns.name: Biochemical research and intracellular mechanisms
patterns.context: States research aims and methods, as well as mechanisms related to intracellular calcium ions

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Alignment, fractions, integrals, and exponents in a formula environment

patterns.name: Dutch compounds and inflected forms
patterns.context: Dutch words are segmented at subword boundaries in a sentence discussing cost-benefit analysis and the establishment of a new institution

8_2126.concept: 阻止与限制动作，兼有多种格式词触发
8_2126.description: 主要激活于阻止、限制、停止或移除等语义及其不定式表达；另覆盖电力供需数字、商务邮件事务、生化研究措辞、LaTeX公式结构和荷兰语子词分段，显示出多种彼此不完全相同的局部模式。

patterns.name: 阻止、停止或防止
patterns.context: 描述阻止某事发生、限制行为，或移除某物；有时以不定式说明动作
patterns.domain: 体育用品评论、产品防伪专利、能源政策、催化剂技术、音乐产业讨论

patterns.name: 能源供需与容量数字
patterns.context: 电力负荷、容量、进口和需求等供需规划信息，带有 MW 数值

patterns.name: 邮件行政事务用语
patterns.context: 列出交易对手并说明正在处理传真等事务

patterns.name: 生化研究与细胞内机制
patterns.context: 陈述研究任务、方法及细胞内钙离子相关机制
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版
patterns.context: 公式环境中的对齐、分式、积分和指数表达式

patterns.name: 荷兰语复合词与屈折形式
patterns.context: 荷兰语词在子词边界处分段，句中讨论成本效益分析及新机构设立

en.description: Activations favor expressions of need or restriction, such as need, prevent, prohibit, and preclude, and often fall on function words such as to and the. There are also scattered medical, engineering, patent, and email technical contexts, without a single unifying theme.

patterns.name: need followed by negation/verb
patterns.context: Occurs in clauses expressing that something is no longer needed, that a factor prevents use/acceptance/prediction, or that an action is prohibited; high activation concentrates near the negation or restriction structures around need, prevent, prohibit, and preclude
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, patent backgrounds, email notices, and policy discussions

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive in expressions of goals, purposes, methods, or results; sometimes adjacent to need, but also appears in ordinary purpose constructions

patterns.name: Definite article the
patterns.context: The definite article is followed by a noun or nominalized expression; some instances overlap with need/restriction clauses, while others appear to reflect a common function-word trigger

patterns.name: Results, methods, and equipment vocabulary in technical text
patterns.context: Technical research narratives introduce prototypes, technical implementations, experimental methods, or material choices; no stable specialized vocabulary trigger is apparent

patterns.name: Medical procedure or clinical research vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves surgical procedures, patient examinations, or diagnostic tests; activation words are scattered and may relate jointly to academic style and common function words

patterns.name: Technical problems and benefits in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes difficulties with existing technology, unmet needs, or potential benefits of a solution

patterns.name: Attachment restriction in mailing list
patterns.context: A notice states that emails with attachments are prohibited from distribution on the list under emergency measures

patterns.name: Unexplained semantic or lexical instances
patterns.context: The sentences containing these words cover different topics; some overlap with other patterns, and the fragments alone cannot confirm an independent mechanism
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, theoretical physics, and technical text

8_2126.description: 激活偏向 need、prevent、prohibit、preclude 等需求或限制表达，并常落在 to、the 等功能词上；另有分散的医学、工程、专利与邮件技术语境，未形成单一主题。

patterns.name: need后接否定/动词化名词
patterns.context: 出现在表达某事不再需要、某因素阻止使用/接受/预测，或禁止某行为的句式中；高激活集中于 need、prevent、prohibit、preclude 附近的否定或限制语义结构
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、专利背景、邮件通知及政策讨论

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在目标、用途、方法或结果的表达中引出不定式；有时与 need 等词相邻，但也出现在普通目的结构中

patterns.name: 冠词 the
patterns.context: 定冠词后接名词或名词化表达；部分实例与限制/需求句式重合，其他实例似为常见功能词触发

patterns.name: 技术文本中的结果、方法与设备词汇
patterns.context: 技术研究叙述中介绍原型、技术实现、实验方法或材料选择；未见稳定统一的专门术语触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学与材料/工程研究

patterns.name: 医学操作或临床研究词汇
patterns.context: 涉及手术流程、患者检查或诊断检测；激活词分散，可能与学术文体及常见功能词共同相关

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术问题与效益
patterns.trigger: «would»« permit»« ready»« processing»；«significant» technical difficulties ... «prevented» general acceptance
patterns.context: 陈述现有技术的困难、未解决需求或某方案可能带来的效益

patterns.name: 邮件列表附件限制
patterns.context: 公告说明紧急措施下禁止带附件的邮件在列表中分发

patterns.name: 未解释的语义或词汇实例
patterns.trigger: «end»、«different»、«successful»、«facilitate»、«precludes»等局部触发不足以归入稳定共同模式
patterns.context: 这些词所在句子主题各异；部分已与其他模式重叠，不能仅凭片段确认独立机制
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、理论物理及技术文本

en.description: Most fragments activate on expressions of necessity, permission, prevention, or avoidance and their outcomes, often involving prevent, permit, prohibit, avoid, and related syntax. Other activations occur on an internal fragment in a Polish word and an isolated instance of SPSS/17.

patterns.name: Expressions of necessity, permission, or prevention
patterns.context: Triggers often occur near predicates expressing that something makes an action necessary, permits something to happen, or prevents/avoids something and its consequences; they often co-occur with negation, modal verbs, or result complements. Specific verbs and syntax vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary explanatory and argumentative text, including academic abstracts, patents, research project descriptions, and historical writing

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Polish word
patterns.context: Activation falls within a segmented word in continuous Polish text; there is insufficient context to establish a connection with other patterns.

patterns.name: Statistical software name
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a clinical study's description of examination results and statistical analysis software; other words in the same fragment also activate, so a consistent pattern cannot be confirmed.

8_2126.description: 多数段落激活于必要、允许、阻止或避免某事及其结果的表达，常见 prevent、permit、prohibit、avoid 及相关句法；另有波兰语词内片段和 SPSS/17 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 必要性、许可或阻止表达
patterns.trigger: “necessitated the realization”（1）；“prohibit closely spaced”（2）；“preventing a plant ... from”（4）；“would not permit us to be”（5）；“will prevent unnecessary”（7）；“would permit ready processing”（8）；“prevents a viewer from”（9）；“avoiding many unnecessary”（10）
patterns.context: 触发点多出现在表达使某事成为必要、允许某事发生，或阻止/避免某事及其后果的谓词附近；常与否定、情态词或结果补语同现。不同例句在具体动词和句法上并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 跨学科说明与论证文本，包括学术摘要、专利、研究项目说明和历史文体

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语连续文本中一个被拆分标记的词内，缺少足够上下文证明与其他模式有关。

patterns.name: 统计软件名称
patterns.context: 激活出现在临床研究对检查结果与统计分析软件的描述中；其余激活还落在同段其他词上，无法确认是否构成一致模式。

en.description: The most stable phenomenon is strong activation on p-initial subword fragments in Polish, Romanian, and English. A few fragments in other languages and English words also activate, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Polish word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on word-initial subword fragments beginning with p; subsequent in-word fragments sometimes activate as well. These often occur mid-word or across token boundaries and require no particular meaning.
patterns.domain: Primarily Polish parliamentary speeches and religious texts

patterns.name: Romanian word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: Romanian words contain p-initial subword fragments. Other activations in this passage include « ch» and « via», but the strongest activation remains on « p».

patterns.name: English word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: p-initial fragments occur within English words or at word boundaries; in this patent sentence, the word is the verb puddle.

patterns.name: English word-initial “fr” fragments
patterns.context: In the sentence-final phrase “refrain from going into details,” activation falls on from; nearby fragments such as going and details also activate.

patterns.name: English “the” and other fragments
patterns.context: In the sentence about limits on the perception of spatial development brought about by sorting, several English content and function words activate, with no clear semantic condition shared with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Other local in-word fragments
patterns.context: Multiple discontinuous in-word subword fragments activate in a Polish religious sentence. Apart from the p-initial fragments in segment 1, no shared trigger is apparent.

8_2126.description: 最稳定的现象是对 p 起始子词片段的强激活，见于波兰语、罗马尼亚语及英语；另有少量其他语言片段和英语词汇激活，未显示统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以字母 p 开头的词首子词片段，后续词内片段有时也激活；常见于单词中间或跨分词边界处，不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 以波兰语为主的议会演讲、宗教文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语词中出现 p 起始的子词片段；本段另有« ch»、« via»等激活，但主要强激活仍落在« p»。

patterns.name: 英语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 英语词内或词边界处出现 p 起始片段；该专利句中是动词 puddle。

patterns.name: 英语词首「fr」片段
patterns.context: 在句末短语“refrain from going into details”中，激活落在 from；周围还激活 going、details 等词片段。

patterns.name: 英语「the」等词片段
patterns.context: 排序带来的空间发展感知限制这一句中，多处英语实词和功能词均有激活，未呈现与其他段一致的明显语义条件。

patterns.name: 其他局部词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语宗教句中多个不连续词内子词片段激活，除段1的 p 起始片段外，难以归纳出共同触发条件。

en.concept: In-word p fragments and sporadic English word fragments
en.description: The main pattern is p and following fragments within words or at word boundaries in multilingual text. Two instances of the English expression “a lot of” also occur, along with several scattered English function words and in-word fragments.

patterns.name: In-word morpheme p9
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on words beginning with p or their subsequent morphemes, and may fall on different parts of a word; it is not a stable complete word or fixed phrase
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, Dutch, and English patents

patterns.name: Attention and reporting phrasing
patterns.context: English quantity expressions use “a lot of + noun”; activation falls on lot/of and nearby following words

patterns.name: Sporadic English function words and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across common function words, abbreviations, or in-word fragments in English sentences, with no shared context sufficient to establish an independent rule

8_2126.concept: 词中 p 片段及零散英语词片段
8_2126.description: 主要模式是多语种文本中词内或词边界处的 p 及后续片段；另有两例英语“a lot of”表达，以及若干分散的英语功能词和词内片段。

patterns.name: 词中词素 p9
patterns.trigger: 词内部或词边界上的 «p»、«p»后续部分，如 «p»10ółn«oc»2nej、«p»10óźno、«p»9«oci»ągającego、«p»9rawodawstwa、«p»9ijpleiding、«p»9row«ad»1zenia、«p»9uddle
patterns.context: 激活集中于以 p 开始的词或其后续词素，且可落在词的不同部分；不是稳定的完整词或固定搭配
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、荷兰语、英语专利

patterns.name: 注意力与报道措辞
patterns.context: 英语中出现“a lot of + 名词”的数量表达，激活落在 lot/of 及其后续词语附近

patterns.name: 零散英语功能词和词内片段
patterns.context: 英语句子中激活分散在常见功能词、缩写或词内片段，未见足以确立独立规则的共同上下文
patterns.domain: 网络评论、生活方式文案

en.description: Strong activation falls mainly on the letter p across languages and registers, usually word-initially or within words, with varied meanings, parts of speech, and topics; p also occurs in an encoded string. Segment 4 has no clear p trigger and remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Tokenized p fragments in sentences
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or word fragments beginning with p, while subsequent letters are often unmarked; preceding text may be a preposition, a space, or an in-word prefix. Word meaning and syntax are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts and English narration

patterns.name: In-word p in Polish
patterns.context: p occurs within Polish words or in word-initial fragments: for example, «p»10óźno, «p»10ociągającego, «p»9ółn-, «p»9rawodawcy; the surrounding context is Polish sentences.

patterns.name: In-word p in Romanian
patterns.context: Activation occurs on in-word p, with weaker activation on subsequent letters in the word; the context is Romanian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Word-initial p in Finnish
patterns.context: p occurs at the start of a word in Finnish parliamentary text; subsequent letters are unmarked.

patterns.name: In-word p in English
patterns.context: Activation falls on the p in the plasmid vector name pDIRECT in a scientific text, immediately followed by the capitalized name.

patterns.name: Word-initial or in-word p in English
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the start of the English verb panned; the rest of the context is a sports draft review.

patterns.name: p in a non-lexical encoded fragment
patterns.context: A marked p fragment occurs in a Base64-encoded string; local context does not identify a corresponding natural-language word or stable meaning.

8_2126.description: 强激活主要落在不同语言和语域中的字母 p，常处于词首或词内，词义、词性和主题多变；另见编码串中的 p。第4段没有明显 p 触发，无法解释。

patterns.name: 句内 p 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 p 开头的词或词片段中，后续字母常未标记；前面可以是介词、空格或词内前缀。具体词义和句法并不一致。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及英语叙述

patterns.name: 波兰语词内 p
patterns.context: p 位于波兰语词内部或词首片段：如 «p»10óźno、«p»10ociągającego、«p»9ółn-、«p»9rawodawcy；相邻上下文是波兰语句子。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内 p
patterns.context: 激活位于词内 p，后续词内字母也有较弱激活；语境是罗马尼亚语议会文本。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词首 p
patterns.context: p 出现在芬兰语议会文本的词首，后续字母未标记。

patterns.name: 英语词内 p
patterns.context: 激活落在科学文本中的质粒载体名称 pDIRECT 的 p 上，之后紧接大写名称。

patterns.name: 英语词首或词内 p
patterns.context: 激活位于英语动词 panned 的词首；其余语境是体育选秀评论。

patterns.name: 非词汇编码片段中的 p
patterns.context: Base64 编码字符串中出现被标记的 p 片段，无法从局部上下文确定它对应的自然语言词或稳定语义。

en.concept: Expressions of attracting attention in academic texts
en.description: Most activation centers on expressions in academic texts where “attracted” introduces attention, interest, or research effort, including fixed phrases and variants. Sporadic activations in an encoded URI, a Romanian in-word fragment, and the colloquial forum word “gets” are difficult to explain through this main pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases for attracting attention
patterns.context: Describes a study, phenomenon, or topic attracting attention, interest, or research effort; modifiers intervene in [6]

patterns.name: Romanian in-word fragment
patterns.context: An in-word subword fragment in a Romanian sentence; no clear context matching the academic phrase appears

patterns.name: Character fragment in an encoded URI
patterns.context: Occurs in a Base64-style string in the JSON-style field “EncodedRequestUri”; no stable semantic or positional pattern is apparent

patterns.name: Colloquial word in forum discourse
patterns.context: In “gets into many of the issues involved,” meaning the post discusses many related issues; unlike the academic phrase about attracting attention

8_2126.concept: 学术文本中的引起关注表达
8_2126.description: 多数激活集中于学术文本中“attracted”引出关注、兴趣或研究投入的表达，涵盖固定搭配及变体；另有编码 URI、罗马尼亚语词内片段和论坛口语“gets”等零散激活，难以由该主模式解释。

patterns.name: 吸引关注的固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “attracted”后接“a lot of attention”“considerable attention”“increased interest”或“the attention of nuclear physicists”等；[6]为“attracted a great deal of research interest”
patterns.context: 描述某项研究、现象或议题引起关注、兴趣或研究投入；[6]中间隔有修饰成分

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中的词内子词片段；未见与学术搭配相同的明显上下文

patterns.name: 编码 URI 字符片段
patterns.trigger: 编码字符串中的“XV”“G”“W”“5”“L”等被标记片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 风格字段“EncodedRequestUri”的 Base64 样式字符串中；看不出稳定的语义或位置规律

patterns.name: 论坛话语中的口语词
patterns.context: 句中“gets into many of the issues involved”，意为帖子谈及诸多相关问题；与学术文献中引发关注的搭配不同

en.description: Activation is distributed across in-word Polish subword tokens in parliamentary texts, Romanian word segmentation, common English phrases and narrative phrases, and two encoded strings; there is no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokenized Polish “pogratulować”
patterns.context: In a Polish parliamentary speech, the verb meaning “to congratulate” is split into multiple subword tokens; phrases such as “powody, by...” often appear nearby in congratulatory contexts.

patterns.name: Tokenized words in Polish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Polish words are split into multiple subword tokens, especially pronouns, titles, and common words; the markings are not limited to congratulatory topics.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation in Romanian
patterns.context: Initial or internal subword tokens in ordinary words are marked in Romanian text.

patterns.name: Common English phrases and words
patterns.context: Common words or collocations occur in continuous English text, with activation on ordinary words in sentences; semantic topics vary.

patterns.name: Phrases in an English story
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence, a continuous verb phrase and adjacent pronouns and prepositions are marked.

patterns.name: Byte fragments in encoded strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on Base64-like encoded data rather than natural-language words; fragments consist of irregular character substrings.
patterns.domain: Encoded request URIs, certificates, or key data in Github

8_2126.concept: 文本中的局部子串模式
8_2126.description: 激活分布于波兰语议会文本的词内子词元、罗马尼亚语词语切分、英语常用词组及叙事短语，也出现在两段编码字符串中；没有统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 波兰语中被切分的“pogratulować”
patterns.context: 在波兰语议会发言中，表示祝贺的动词被分成多个子词元；前后常出现“powody, by...”等祝贺语境。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会发言中的切分词元
patterns.context: 波兰语词语被拆成多个子词元，尤其在人称、职务及常用词中；标记并不限于祝贺主题。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词语内部切分
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语文本中，普通词语的词首或词内部子词元被标记。
patterns.domain: 灾害相关叙述，罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 英语常见短语与词语
patterns.trigger: « have»1« attracted»9« a»6« lot»7« of»9« attention»2；« to»9« achieve»1
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中出现常见词或搭配，标记强度落在句中普通词语上；语义主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 英语故事中的词组
patterns.context: 叙事句中，标记连续的动词短语及相邻代词、介词。

patterns.name: 编码字符串中的字节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在类似 Base64 的编码数据中，而非自然语言词汇；片段由不规则字符子串构成。
patterns.domain: Github 中的编码请求 URI、证书或密钥数据

en.description: Most segments activate on in-word Polish fragments, especially fragments in words beginning with p, commonly in parliamentary texts and also in religious texts. English infinitival to also activates. Single instances involve an encoded string and a specific Polish word fragment, so the pattern is not unified.

patterns.name: Polish in-word substring “po”
patterns.context: In continuous Polish text, activation falls within words beginning with p, commonly around word-initial po-/prz-; the specific marked fragments vary.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary speeches in EuroParl; also religious texts

patterns.name: English infinitive marker to
patterns.context: In English, to precedes an infinitive; the two examples are “to opt in” and “to read.”

patterns.name: Character fragments in a URL-encoded string
patterns.context: Alphanumeric fragments in a Base64/URL-encoded-style string in the JSON field EncodedRequestUri are marked; they are unrelated to natural-language words.

patterns.name: Local fragment “przy”
patterns.context: The continuous substring przy occurs in a Polish word, but is interspersed with in-word markings and is not fully repeated in other segments.

patterns.name: Polish word-final/in-word fragments related to -ność
patterns.context: The latter part of the Polish word “próżności” in segment 7 is marked continuously; its relation to other patterns is unclear.

8_2126.description: 多数段在波兰语词内、尤其 p 开头的词片段上激活，常见于议会文本，也见宗教文本；英语中另对不定式 to 激活。单例还涉及编码字符串和特定波兰语词片段，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子串“po”
patterns.trigger: « p»9/« p»10，尤其后接词内片段，如« p»10«ó»3źno、« p»9«og»1ratulować、« p»9«ą»3…、« p»9«omy»5śleć
patterns.context: 在波兰语连续文本中，激活落在以 p 开头的词内部，常见于词首 po-/prz- 一带；被标记的具体片段并不一致。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的波兰语议会发言；另见宗教文本

patterns.name: 英语不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 英语中 to 后接动词不定式；两例分别是“to opt in”和“to read”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、StackExchange 编程评论

patterns.name: URL 编码字符串中的字符片段
patterns.context: JSON 字段 EncodedRequestUri 内，Base64/URL 编码样式字符串中的字母数字分片被标记；与自然语言词语无关。

patterns.name: 局部词片段“przy”
patterns.context: 波兰语词中出现连续的 przy 子串，但周围还夹有词内标记，且未在其他段完整复现。

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾/词内的 -ność 相关片段
patterns.trigger: « ob»1«nox»1ious（英语中仅字形相似，不是同一词）；« pró»3«ż»1«no»2«ści»2
patterns.context: 第7段波兰语中“próżności”一词的后半部分被连续标记；与其他模式是否有关不明。

en.description: Strong activation concentrates on word-initial or stem fragments in several Polish parliamentary verbs (wprowadzić, pogratulować, wpłynęła), and also on Finnish puhua; there is also activation on mathematical decimal fragments and Base64-style encoded strings.

patterns.name: Polish “wprowadzić” stem
patterns.context: Fragments combine to form the stem of the Polish verb wprowadzić in parliamentary remarks about introducing or implementing a proposal, rule, or procedure.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal precision
patterns.context: Local fragments of number tokens, especially decimal points, digit strings, and precision digits; occurs near calculation results and rounding instructions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and decimal-place rounding exercises

patterns.name: Fragments within Base64/encoded strings
patterns.context: Tokens fall within long Base64-style text composed of alphanumeric fragments; [7] is explicitly marked in the value of the JSON field EncodedRequestUri.

patterns.name: Polish “pogratulować” stem
patterns.context: The beginning of the Polish verb pogratulować (“to congratulate”) is split and marked; occurs in parliamentary remarks about congratulating or discussing congratulations.

patterns.name: Finnish word-initial “puhua”
patterns.context: The initial part of the Finnish infinitive puhua (“to speak”), in a sentence where a speaker says they will address the plenary.

patterns.name: Polish word-initial fragment in “wpłynęła”
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment of the Polish verb wpłynęła (“affected”) occurs in a sentence describing the effects following a committee debate.

8_2126.description: 强激活集中在若干波兰语议会动词词首或词干（wprowadzić、pogratulować、wpłynęła），也见芬兰语 puhua；另对数学小数数字片段及 Base64 风格编码串有激活。

patterns.name: 波兰语「wprowadzić」词干
patterns.context: 波兰语中，片段拼接成动词 wprowadzić 的词干，出现在议会发言对提案、规则或议事程序作“引入/实施”表述的上下文。

patterns.name: 数字与小数精度
patterns.context: 数字 token 的局部片段，尤其是小数点、数字串和精度位；出现在计算结果及四舍五入指令附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，算术与小数位舍入练习

patterns.name: Base64／编码字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 由字母数字片段组成的编码数据中，token 落在长串 Base64 风格文本内部；[7] 明确标在 JSON 字段 EncodedRequestUri 的值中。
patterns.domain: Github，代码或数据序列化内容

patterns.name: 波兰语「pogratulować」词干
patterns.context: 波兰语动词 pogratulować（祝贺）开头被拆分标记；出现在议会发言中祝贺或谈及祝贺的语境。

patterns.name: 芬兰语「puhua」词首
patterns.context: 芬兰语不定式 puhua（说话）的词首部分，位于发言者表示将对全体会议讲话的句子中。

patterns.name: 波兰语「wpłynęła」词首片段
patterns.context: 波兰语动词 wpłynęła（影响了）的词首片段，处于描述委员会辩论后续影响的句子中。

en.description: Activation commonly falls on in-word substrings in multilingual text: Polish, Estonian, and Finnish parliamentary sentences, as well as a Polish prayer. It also covers short English technical words and Github encoded strings. No stable semantics or word positions capture the pattern.

patterns.name: Polish in-word substrings
patterns.context: Markings fall within words in Polish text or speeches, covering inflected words, stem fragments, and common short words, with no unified meaning or position.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary speeches in EuroParl; also a Polish prayer on Github

patterns.name: Estonian in-word substrings
patterns.context: In continuous Estonian prose, activation fragments occur within words, such as «m»ärkuse, «p»uhul, «pi»iri; other fragments are also embedded in words.

patterns.name: Finnish in-word substrings
patterns.context: In Finnish parliamentary speeches, markings are embedded in words such as «n»yt, «void»essani, «p»uhua; the sample is insufficient to determine a specific meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: Fragments in random or encoded-style strings
patterns.context: Multiple arbitrary substrings are marked in continuous uppercase alphanumeric and mixed-case strings, which lack recognizable natural-language structure.

patterns.name: Function words and common words in English technical explanations
patterns.context: English technical Q&A passages explain authentication implementation, Rails, service reuse, and Java GUI; markings are scattered across short and common words.

8_2126.description: 激活多见于多语种文本的词内子串：波兰语、爱沙尼亚语、芬兰语议会语句中均有，波兰语祷文亦有；另覆盖英语技术短词及 Github 编码串。没有稳定语义或词位可概括。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子串
patterns.trigger: 段[2]中的«m»、«i»、«mo»、«emy»、«z»、«g»、«spr»、«dz»；段[4]中的«P»、«oz»、«w»、«ę»、«so»、«bie»、«p»；段[6]中的«prz»、«ew»、«od»、«nic»、«m»、«ów»、«bi»、«b»；段[9]中的«Ci»、«spraw»、«pr»、«zy»、«cz»、«yn»、«św»、«Dz»、«by»、«ychy»
patterns.context: 波兰语正文或讲话中，标记落在词内；覆盖屈折词、词干片段及常见短词，没有统一词义或词位。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的波兰语议会发言；另有一段 Github 上的波兰语祷文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内子串
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续散文中，激活片段出现在词内部，如«m»ärkuse、«p»uhul、«pi»iri；其他片段也嵌在词中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会发言中，标记分别嵌在«n»yt、«void»essani、«p»uhua等词内；样本不足以确定特定词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 随机或编码样式字符串中的片段
patterns.context: 连续的大写字母数字及混合大小写串中，多个任意子串被标记，缺少可辨认自然语言结构。
patterns.domain: Github 数据或代码/编码文本

patterns.name: 英语技术说明中的功能词和常用词
patterns.context: 英语技术问答段落，围绕认证实现、Rails、服务复用和 Java GUI 的说明文字；标记分散在短词及常用词中。

en.description: The main response is to English easy to + verb constructions, often evaluating how easy an operation, learning, use, or mastery is; sporadic infinitival to activations also occur, as do Estonian in-word fragment activations, which lack a clear common explanation.

patterns.name: easy to + verb
patterns.context: In English, easy is followed by to and a verb to describe something that is easy to do; often accompanied by additional advantages joined with and.
patterns.domain: Forums, medical papers, product or method descriptions

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on infinitival to
patterns.context: to occurs in an infinitive or prepositional construction but is not necessarily preceded by easy and does not always mean “easy.”

patterns.name: Estonian in-word fragments
patterns.context: Markings fall on fragments within Estonian words, not the English easy-to construction; no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

8_2126.description: 主要响应英语 easy to + 动词，常用于评价操作、学习、使用或掌握的难易；另有零散不定式 to 激活，以及爱沙尼亚语词内片段激活，后者缺乏清晰共同解释。

patterns.name: easy to + 动词
patterns.trigger: “easy to pick”“easy to run”“easy to operate”“easy to use”“easy to master”
patterns.context: 英语中 easy 后接 to 和动词，描述某事容易完成；常伴随 and 连接的补充优点。
patterns.domain: 论坛、医疗论文、产品或方法说明

patterns.name: 不定式 to 的零散激活
patterns.context: to 处于不定式或介词结构中，但不一定跟 easy，也不总是表示容易。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在爱沙尼亚语单词的词内片段，而非英语 easy-to 结构；无明显共同句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

en.concept: English infinitival to and adjacent constructions
en.description: The main response is to English easy to + verb constructions, especially to. It also covers other to-infinitives (read, copy, hit), as well as Dutch and Finnish in-word subword fragments; the latter are difficult to reconcile with the English pattern.

patterns.name: easy to + verb
patterns.context: The English “easy to + verb” construction; activation often falls on to, but easy or the following verb can also be marked.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, technical discussions, forums, and medical research texts

patterns.name: to hit in an expression of difficulty or impossibility
patterns.context: to is followed by hit, but the meaning is that the feeling of hitting a shot is unimaginable; this is not an easy-to construction.

patterns.name: English infinitive to read
patterns.context: In a code-style comment, the preceding text says inconsistent naming makes the code hard to read; to introduces read.

patterns.name: English infinitive to copy
patterns.context: In a discussion of protectionism and innovation, to introduces copy; difficult and without being also occur nearby, but this is not an easy-to construction.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word substrings
patterns.context: Marked fragments are embedded in complete Dutch words, appearing as token or subword fragments; no clear English syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Finnish in-word substrings
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Finnish words rather than an English infinitival construction.

8_2126.concept: 英语不定式 to 及邻近结构
8_2126.description: 主要响应英语 easy to + 动词结构，尤其 to；也覆盖其他 to 不定式（read、copy、hit），以及荷兰语、芬兰语词内子词片段，后两者与英语模式难以统一解释。

patterns.name: easy to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «easy» 后接 «to»，再接动词，如 «easy»2« to»10« implement»、«easy»1« to»10« pick»、«easy»2« to»9 use/run
patterns.context: 英语中“easy to + 动词”结构；激活常落在 to，也有 easy 或后续动词被标记。
patterns.domain: 科技论文、技术讨论、论坛及医学研究文本

patterns.name: 难以/不能想象的 to hit
patterns.context: to 后接 hit，但句意是无法想象打出一杆的感受，并非 easy-to 结构。

patterns.name: 英文不定式 to read
patterns.context: 代码风格评论中，前文说命名风格不一致、使代码难读；to 引出 read。

patterns.name: 英文不定式 to copy
patterns.context: 讨论保护主义与创新，to 引出 copy；附近还有 difficult 和 without being，但并非 easy-to 结构。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 标记部分嵌在荷兰语完整词内部，呈现分词或子词片段；无明显英语句法触发。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在芬兰语词内部的子词片段，而非英语不定式结构。

en.description: Strongly activates on science, disciplinary terms, and science-related terminology, especially educational curricula and science sections; also shows sporadic activation in structured fields, line breaks, web links, forum comments, and philosophical arguments, which cannot be explained by a single contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Science terms
patterns.context: Science appears as a discipline name or science-related technical term; in [8], the trigger is a technical term in a medical paper, not the literal word Science.
patterns.domain: Data science, science and technology, educational curricula, medical papers

patterns.name: Education and course entries
patterns.context: Educational histories, school courses, or program catalogs list disciplines as headings, fields, or items; mostly structured text.

patterns.name: Structured page fields and line breaks
patterns.context: In multiline records or web content, field labels, values, and line breaks alternate repeatedly; activation covers field values and some boundary tokens.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic metadata, biographical profiles, web lists

patterns.name: Website links and category navigation
patterns.context: Website directories or link lists place URLs alongside category names.
patterns.domain: Web navigation or link lists in email

patterns.name: Forum comment format and signatures
patterns.context: Usernames, comment separators, and comment text in forum posts; activation in this segment is unusually strong and, except for the final Science, is difficult to match consistently to other segments.

patterns.name: Philosophical argumentation
patterns.context: Continuous discussion of premises and natural law theory, with activation on several ordinary words and phrases.

patterns.name: Occupation and location descriptions
patterns.context: Profile cards give occupations and locations as labels, with names repeated.

8_2381.description: 常在科学、学科及科学相关术语上强激活，尤其是教育课程和科学栏目；另见结构化字段、换行、网页链接、论坛评论和哲学论述中的零散激活，无法由单一上下文模式解释。

patterns.name: Science 词项
patterns.context: Science/科学作为学科名称或科学相关专业术语出现；在[8]中触发点是医学论文里的专业术语，而非字面上的 Science。
patterns.domain: 数据科学、科学技术、教育课程、医学论文

patterns.name: 教育与课程条目
patterns.trigger: «Education»、«Mathematics»、«Political Science»、«Triple Science»，以及«(Major)»后的课程名称列表
patterns.context: 教育经历、学校课程或专业目录中，以标题、字段或清单列出学科；多为结构化文本。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、课程目录

patterns.name: 结构化页面字段与换行
patterns.context: 多行记录或网页内容中，字段标签、值和换行反复交替；激活覆盖字段值及部分边界 token。
patterns.domain: 书目元数据、人物资料、网页列表

patterns.name: 网站链接与分类导航
patterns.context: 网站目录或链接列表，URL 与栏目名并列出现。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页导航或链接清单

patterns.name: 论坛评论格式与署名
patterns.context: 论坛帖中的用户名、留言分隔和评论文字；该段激活强度异常高，除末尾 Science 外难与其他段稳定对应。

patterns.name: 哲学论证用语
patterns.context: 连续论述推理前提及自然法理论，激活落在若干普通词与短语上。

patterns.name: 职业与地点简介
patterns.context: 人物资料卡以标签给出职业和地点，名字重复出现。

en.concept: Science disciplinary terms and entry-style proper-name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to Science and combinations involving disciplines, data science, and academic publishing; also occurs in the place name Victoria, biographical education and biography formats, and medical texts about endothelial mechanisms. Segment 8 also contains a forum username and Data Science, with no confirmed independent trigger.

patterns.name: Terms preceding Science
patterns.context: Part of a compound or course/discipline name before various field names; also appears in field-style bibliographic entries.
patterns.domain: Data science, educational curricula, academic publishing and research texts

patterns.name: Victoria Forest Park proper name
patterns.context: A place name in an entry title or body; activation is distributed across subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Victoria electoral district proper name
patterns.context: Victoria followed by a parenthetical regional qualifier, forming an electoral district entry title.

patterns.name: Education and field of study in biographies
patterns.context: Appears in biographical descriptions of a person's university and degree field, with the sentence continuing to describe their experience.

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis mechanism description
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes the pathological process of monocytes crossing the endothelium and differentiating into macrophages.

patterns.name: Name and birth/death dates biography format
patterns.context: A person's name is repeated in an entry title or body, followed by birth and death dates in parentheses.

8_2381.concept: Science 学科词及条目式专名片段
8_2381.description: 主要响应 Science 及其学科、数据科学和学术出版等组合；另见于 Victoria 地名、人物学历与传记格式、医学内皮机制文本。第8段另有论坛用户名及 Data Science，无法确认其独立触发点。

patterns.name: Science 前的词项
patterns.context: 在多种领域名词前作为复合词或课程/学科名称的一部分；也出现在字段式书目条目中。
patterns.domain: 数据科学、教育课程、学术出版与科研文本

patterns.name: Victoria Forest Park 专名
patterns.context: 地名条目标题或条目正文中的地名；激活分布在分词后的名称片段。

patterns.name: Victoria electoral district 专名
patterns.context: Victoria 后接括号中的地区限定语，构成选区条目标题。

patterns.name: 个人简介中的学历与专业
patterns.context: 人物简介叙述毕业院校及学位专业时出现，且句子继续介绍其经历。
patterns.domain: 人物传记/地方新闻资料

patterns.name: 动脉粥样硬化机制叙述
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述单核细胞穿过内皮并分化为巨噬细胞的病理过程。

patterns.name: 姓名与生卒年传记格式
patterns.context: 条目标题或正文重复人名，随后以括号列出出生与逝世日期。

en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse text: English function-word collocations, names, uppercase labels and formatting in legal documents, the present-perfect construction have (been) in research and patent texts, and quoted titles. No single theme explains all segments.

patterns.name: English function words and contiguous collocations
patterns.context: Common function words form grammatically coherent English phrases; this segment also has strong activation on “As”.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on personal names and their components; another name, “Carl Braun”, follows in this segment.

patterns.name: Legal document headings and formatted fields
patterns.context: Uppercase legal status labels and uppercase, aligned document-format fields in court documents.

patterns.name: Present-perfect auxiliary sequence
patterns.context: English present-perfect constructions in technical or explanatory text, especially have followed by been or a past participle.

patterns.name: Short quoted titles and dates
patterns.context: A phrase is enclosed in single quotation marks, followed by a year-style “2012/”.

patterns.name: Film titles, quotation marks, and punctuation
patterns.context: A quoted work title follows a possessive name; the sentence also contains several commas and terminal punctuation.

8_2381.description: 激活分散于多种文本：英文虚词搭配、姓名、法律文书的大写标签与格式、科研及专利文本的 have（been）完成时，以及引号括起的标题。没有单一主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 英文功能词及连续搭配
patterns.trigger: “not conditioned by or dependent upon any relation or relatedness to anything else”
patterns.context: 句中较多常见虚词组成语法连贯的英文短语；这一段也有 “As” 的强激活。

patterns.name: 人名与姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名及其姓名组成部分上；该段随后还有另一个人名 “Carl Braun”。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与格式字段
patterns.context: 法院文件中全大写的法律状态标签，以及大写、对齐的文书格式字段。

patterns.name: 现在完成时助动词序列
patterns.trigger: “have been developed”“have been carried out”“have enabled”“have been known”
patterns.context: 科技或说明性文字中的英文完成时结构，尤其是 have 后接 been 或过去分词。

patterns.name: 引号中的短标题及日期
patterns.context: 短语被单引号括起，后接年份样式的“2012/”。

patterns.name: 电影标题、引号与标点
patterns.context: 所有格人名后出现带引号的作品标题，句中还包含多个逗号及句末标点。

en.description: Activation spans legal boilerplate, drug and medical vocabulary, French morphemes, date headings, and IRC colloquial and technical discussion; it also includes a protein description and a sentence about causes of lower back pain. No clear shared lexical or semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: accordance in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in legal judgments or statutes, usually in the phrase “in accordance with”; the word itself is marked as strongly activating.

patterns.name: Drug name fragments
patterns.context: Lists drugs or chemotherapy agents in medical abstracts; activation is distributed across drug names and punctuation and number fragments.

patterns.name: French morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Words in French sentences are split into multiple subword fragments; activation concentrates on several French morphemes.

patterns.name: Date and news headline format
patterns.context: Date formats in uppercase headlines or document headers; both date words and numbers activate.

patterns.name: IRC conversation and chat style
patterns.context: Online chat with username markers, line breaks, and colloquial replies; activation is spread across chat phrases and some usernames.

patterns.name: Linux distribution discussion on IRC
patterns.context: Chat about Linux distributions, software, and related websites; activation includes ordinary words such as “About” and username fragments.

patterns.name: Device support and Android analogy on IRC
patterns.context: Chat about device support, Ubuntu, and manufacturer decisions, with IRC usernames and channel-style formatting.

patterns.name: Unclear biomedical protein description
patterns.context: A scientific sentence mentions Band 3, glycoproteins, and red blood cell components; the specific trigger is difficult to identify from the fragment alone.

patterns.name: Unclear description of lower back pain causes
patterns.context: A patent background uses an explanatory sentence to introduce lower back pain and lumbar-related causes; activation is distributed across the opening phrase.

8_2381.description: 激活模式横跨法律套语、药物与医学词汇、法语词素、日期标题及 IRC 口语和技术讨论；还包括蛋白描述和腰痛成因句。没有明显共同的词汇或语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 accordance
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决或法规条文中，通常位于“in accordance with”短语内；该词本身标注为强激活。

patterns.name: 药物名称片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中列举药物或化疗药物；激活分布在药物名及标点、数字片段上。

patterns.name: 法语词素片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中的词被切分为多个子词片段；激活集中于若干法语词素。

patterns.name: 日期与新闻标题格式
patterns.context: 大写标题或文档头部中的日期格式，日期词和数字均有激活。

patterns.name: IRC 对话及聊天语气
patterns.context: 带用户名标记、换行和口语回应的网络聊天；激活遍布聊天短语和部分用户名。

patterns.name: IRC 中的 Linux 发行版讨论
patterns.context: 聊天中讨论 Linux 发行版、软件及相关网站；激活包括“About”等普通词及用户名片段。

patterns.name: IRC 中的设备与 Android 类比
patterns.context: 聊天讨论设备支持、Ubuntu 和制造商决策，带 IRC 用户名与频道式格式。

patterns.name: 未明的生物医学蛋白描述
patterns.trigger: “Band 3, the major intrinsic glycoprotein constituent of the eryth...”
patterns.context: 科学句子提及 Band 3、糖蛋白及红细胞相关成分；仅凭片段难以判断具体触发点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 未明的腰痛成因表述
patterns.trigger: “A leading cause of lower back pain arises from lumbar...”
patterns.context: 专利背景部分以说明性句式引出腰痛及腰椎相关成因；激活分散在句首短语。

en.concept: April string and heterogeneous formatting features
en.description: The most prominent shared clue is April: it appears as a name and in dates and email subjects. Other segments involve system code, C++ type definitions, uppercase academic titles, and concert history, with no apparent shared trigger form.

patterns.name: Month name in a list of people
patterns.context: April is used as a person's name in a list of names or an email recipient field; no date context is required.

patterns.name: April in dates
patterns.context: The month April appears with a day, weekday, or year in dates or email timestamps.

patterns.name: April deal email subject
patterns.context: April modifies deal in an email Subject field, followed by a body discussing a request for details; it may relate to the date usage, but is not an unambiguous date string.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and assignment lines
patterns.context: Groups of structurally similar field names and hexadecimal values appear across multiple lines in kernel or system code.

patterns.name: C++ type definitions and complex identifiers
patterns.context: Type alias definitions in template or numerical algorithm code, including compound underscore names.

patterns.name: All-caps academic title phrase
patterns.context: An academic title is set in all caps and concerns Catholics in Catholic universities, awards, and politics.

patterns.name: Reggae concert name and historical account
patterns.context: The title is repeated, followed by an account of the concert's date and location.

8_2381.concept: April 字符串及异质格式特征
8_2381.description: 激活最突出的共同线索是 April：既作人名，也出现在日期和邮件主题中。其余片段分别涉及系统代码、C++ 类型定义、全大写学术标题及音乐会史，未见明显共同触发形式。

patterns.name: 人名列表中的月份名
patterns.trigger: 多个姓名用“, ”或“; ”分隔时，名字或姓氏中出现“April”，如“April”及“April 10”；姓名条目紧邻该词也会激活
patterns.context: 人名名单或邮件收件人字段中，April 被用作人名；不要求日期语境

patterns.name: 日期中的 April
patterns.trigger: “April”后接日期，如“Friday, 11 April 2014”“April 3, 2001”“April 22, 2002”，以及带年份的日期
patterns.context: 日期或邮件时间戳中月份 April 与日、星期或年份共同出现
patterns.domain: 文档元数据、邮件、活动史

patterns.name: April deal 邮件主题
patterns.context: 邮件 Subject 字段中 April 修饰 deal，且正文接着谈索要细节；可能与日期用法有关，但不是明确日期串

patterns.name: 代码标识符与赋值行
patterns.context: 内核或系统代码中，多行结构相似的字段名与十六进制值成组出现

patterns.name: C++ 类型定义与复杂标识符
patterns.context: 模板或数值算法代码中的类型别名定义，包含复合下划线名称

patterns.name: 全大写学术标题词串
patterns.trigger: “UNIVERSITIES, AND THE GIVING OF AWARDS, HONORS, OR PLATFORMS BY CATHOLIC UNIVERSITIES”及标题中的全大写词
patterns.context: 学术标题以全大写排版，围绕天主教大学、奖项和政治中的天主教徒

patterns.name: 雷鬼音乐会名称与历史叙述
patterns.trigger: “One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”及“One Love Reggae Peace Concert”
patterns.context: 标题重复出现，随后转入音乐会举办日期和地点的说明

en.description: Activation is distributed across texts with distinctive formatting, including headings, catalogs, title pages, signatures, and legal documents; it also occurs in academic titles, commemorative language, product condition descriptions, and code identifiers. No single meaning runs through all samples.

patterns.name: Book contents/chapter headings
patterns.context: A chapter number is followed by an uppercase chapter title, often indented or separated by a line break; the title may span multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Bibliographic catalogs/category lists
patterns.context: Multiple book titles or subject categories are listed line by line, with spaces, numbering, or publisher series markers.

patterns.name: Book title pages, titles, and publication information
patterns.context: Book title, subtitle, author/publisher/location, and other details are formatted in uppercase or centered indentation.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book title pages and bibliographic pages

patterns.name: Formal addresses or commemorative text
patterns.context: Formal praise of someone's learning, character, or contributions using solemn, commemorative language.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg commemorative text or biographical profiles

patterns.name: Legal document headings and standard declarations
patterns.context: Court documents use formal agency names, case-type headings, and declarations of legal effect.

patterns.name: Legal document or academic paper title pages
patterns.context: An academic title introduced by title: follows author, institution, address, and other byline information.

patterns.name: Names and institutional abbreviations in academic papers or conference materials
patterns.context: Philosophical paper titles, author names, institutional abbreviations, and Portuguese content appear together.

patterns.name: Minor defects in quantitative product reviews
patterns.context: Descriptions of an item's condition mention remaining proportion, usage, or localized minor damage; activation falls on “small” and related evaluation fragments.
patterns.domain: Informal product descriptions/reviews in FreeLaw corpus

patterns.name: Numeric constants and C struct initialization
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers is followed by C identifiers, an array declaration, and initialization; activation involves identifier fragments such as «FREE»«LIST».

8_2381.description: 激活分布在格式鲜明的标题、目录、扉页、署名和法律文书等文本，也见学术题名、纪念语、产品状况描述及代码标识符；没有单一词义贯穿所有样本。

patterns.name: 书籍目录／章节标题
patterns.trigger: 罗马数字章节号如«XI»«.»«XII»；«THE»、«A»等标题词，以及标题式排版
patterns.context: 章节号后接大写章节标题，常有缩进或换行；标题可能跨多个 token。

patterns.name: 书目目录／分类清单
patterns.context: 多项书名或主题分类按行排列，伴随空格、编号或出版社系列标记。

patterns.name: 书籍扉页、题名与出版信息
patterns.trigger: «BIBLE IN SPAIN»、«THE JOURNEYS, ADVENTURES, AND»、«New York»、«THE MACMILLAN COMPANY»
patterns.context: 书名、副标题、作者／出版地／出版社等信息以大写或居中缩进形式排版。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍扉页与书目页

patterns.name: 正式致辞或纪念性文字
patterns.trigger: «IN RECOGNITION OF HIS LEARNING, TALENTS AND PIETY»、«TESTIMONIAL»
patterns.context: 正式褒扬某人的学识、品格或贡献，采用庄重、纪念性措辞。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 纪念文字或人物介绍

patterns.name: 法律文件标题与固定声明
patterns.trigger: «UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS»、«SUMMARY ORDER»、«DO NOT HAVE PRECEDENTIAL EFFECT»
patterns.context: 法院文件使用正式机关名称、裁判类型标题及法律效力声明。

patterns.name: 法律文书或学术论文标题页
patterns.trigger: «A NEW APPROACH TO UNBIASED ESTIMATION FOR»
patterns.context: 作者、机构、地址等署名信息后出现以 title: 引出的论文标题；标题为正式学术题名。

patterns.name: 学术论文或会议材料中的姓名与机构缩写
patterns.context: 哲学论文题名、作者姓名、机构缩写及葡萄牙语内容混排。

patterns.name: 量化产品评价语句中的小缺陷
