patterns.trigger: «20-30% RUBBER LEFT ON IT»、«IT’S HAD SOME»、«ONE SMALL TEAR»
patterns.context: 评价物品状况时描述剩余比例、使用情况或局部小损坏；激活落在“小”及相关评价片段。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 语料中的非正式产品描述／评论文本

patterns.name: 数字常量与 C 结构体初始化
patterns.context: 数字序列后出现 C 语言标识符、数组声明及初始化；激活涉及«FREE»«LIST»等标识符片段。

en.description: Activation occurs in several local lexical patterns, especially the conjunction and (connecting legal parties or research components), as well as that-clauses, media ranking language, and descriptions of dormancy after cancer treatment; these contexts have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: AND in legal case captions
patterns.context: A conjunction between names of parties, companies, government agencies, or other litigants, often in case captions separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: and in academic text
patterns.context: Connects coordinated items such as measurements, study subjects, or genetic data in abstracts.

patterns.name: that-clauses in expository writing
patterns.context: Introduces a statement about pollutants or reported information about leave arrangements.

patterns.name: ranked in ranking reports
patterns.context: Describes media rankings or evaluations of people or characters.

patterns.name: Persistent state of dormant tumors
patterns.context: Describes prostate cancer tumors remaining dormant after treatment and potentially growing again.

8_2381.description: 激活出现在多种局部词法模式中：尤其是并列连词 and（连接法律当事方或科研成分），另有 that 从句、媒体排名用语及肿瘤治疗后休眠表述；这些场景没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的 AND
patterns.context: 作为当事人、公司、政府机构或其他诉讼方名称之间的连接词，常出现在换行分隔的案件标题中。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的 and
patterns.context: 连接摘要中的测量项目、研究对象或遗传数据等并列成分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 说明文中的 that 从句
patterns.context: 引出关于污染物的陈述，或关于休假情况的转述。
patterns.domain: 网络健康宣传文、电子邮件

patterns.name: 排名报道中的 ranked
patterns.context: 描述媒体对人物或角色进行名次、位置评价。

patterns.name: 休眠肿瘤的持续状态
patterns.context: 描述前列腺癌肿瘤在治疗后仍保持休眠，并可能再度生长。

en.concept: Local word fragments in technical text
en.description: Activation is concentrated in code and technical text, especially SQL keywords, source-code identifiers, and declarations; it also sporadically covers English function words, parity arithmetic, biomedical and patent terminology, and adult-content promotional language, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: SQL database statements and keywords
patterns.context: Occurs in SQL DDL or query statements, often adjacent to table names, column definitions, constraints, or query conditions.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type/declaration structures in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C/C++ and other code, involving types, variable/function names, return statements, or declaration blocks; segment 1 also overlaps with the SQL pattern.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and source code; segments 2, 4, 10, and 1

patterns.name: Special comments or preprocessing markers in code
patterns.context: Located in header guards and the comments that follow them.

patterns.name: Function words such as to/that in English sentences
patterns.context: Embedded in natural-language sentences or explanatory text rather than code; triggers are scattered, without stable semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Number parity and arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Explains changing n to n−2 or n+1 based on parity.

patterns.name: Statistical results and group abbreviations in papers
patterns.context: Describes numerical comparisons and significance between groups; these triggers appear to be general words or local fragments, with no unified specialized trigger.

patterns.name: Discussion of tumor origin and naming
patterns.context: Discusses whether tumor naming is valid and the tissue of origin it may indicate.

patterns.name: Substituent descriptions of chemical structures in patents
patterns.context: Describes hydrogen or methoxy substitution at R.sup.2 and R.sup.3 using labels such as PA (g)/(h).

patterns.name: Adult-content promotional text
patterns.context: An adult website URL appears adjacent to promotional language for adult content.

8_2381.concept: 技术文本中的局部词片段
8_2381.description: 激活片段以代码和技术文本为主，尤其包含 SQL 关键字、源码标识符与声明；同时零散覆盖英文功能词、奇偶算术、生物医学与专利术语，以及成人内容宣传词，未见单一稳定触发。

patterns.name: SQL 数据库语句与关键字
patterns.context: 出现在 SQL 的 DDL 或查询语句中，常邻接表名、列定义、约束或查询条件。
patterns.domain: 数据库代码、SQL 示例；段 1、6

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及类型/声明结构
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 等代码中，涉及类型、变量/函数名、返回语句或声明块；段 1 也与 SQL 模式重叠。

patterns.name: 代码中的特殊注释或预处理标记
patterns.context: 位于头文件保护宏及其后的注释中。

patterns.name: 英文句子中的 to/that 等功能词
patterns.context: 嵌在自然语言句子或解释性文字中，而非代码；触发较分散，没有稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字奇偶与算术表达
patterns.context: 说明按奇偶性把 n 改成 n−2 或 n+1。

patterns.name: 论文中的统计结果与分组缩写
patterns.context: 描述组间数值比较及显著性；这些触发更像一般词或局部片段，未见统一专属触发。

patterns.name: 肿瘤来源与命名论述
patterns.trigger: « being»、« pro»、« adenocarcinoma»、« mammary»、« be»、« D»«unning»
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤命名是否有效及其可能组织来源。

patterns.name: 专利化学结构取代基描述
patterns.context: 以 PA (g)/(h) 等编号描述 R.sup.2、R.sup.3 的氢或甲氧基取代。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/化学专利文本；段 9

patterns.name: 成人内容宣传文本
patterns.context: 色情网站 URL 与成人内容宣传语相邻。

en.description: Activation covers literary quotations, mathematical expressions, technical terminology, fixed license wording, code structures, and discussions of machine intelligence, with varied trigger locations; no stable meaning or formatting feature runs through all the material.

patterns.name: Words in literary quotations
patterns.context: A quotation from poetry or literature, with activation on words in the quotation or split fragments of proper names; the specific trigger locations differ between the two segments.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula expressions
patterns.context: Formulas, variables, and nearby expressions in mathematical discussion or algorithm descriptions; activation is scattered around formula symbols and textual variables.

patterns.name: Local fragments of technical terms or proper names
patterns.context: Domain terminology, products, or proper names in technical or forum text; trigger locations vary, with some falling within words.

patterns.name: Software license text
patterns.context: An all-caps software license disclaimer and its standard legal wording.

patterns.name: Code comments and delimiters
patterns.context: Structural positions in source code, such as comment headings, function definitions, closing braces, or blank lines.

patterns.name: Machine in machine intelligence discussions
patterns.context: Forum text discussing robots in construction and machine intelligence capabilities; activation concentrates on machine.

8_2381.description: 激活覆盖文学引文、数学表达、专业术语、许可固定措辞、代码结构及机器智能讨论，触发位置各异；未见贯穿全部材料的稳定词义或格式特征。

patterns.name: 文学引文中的字词
patterns.context: 诗歌或文学作品引文，激活落在引文中的词或拆分的专名片段；两段的具体触发位置不同。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式表达
patterns.context: 数学论述或算法说明中的公式、变量及其邻近表达；激活分散在公式符号和文字变量附近。

patterns.name: 专业术语或专名的局部片段
patterns.context: 技术或论坛文本中的领域术语、产品或专名；触发位置并不一致，部分落在词内片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、枪支论坛、产品讨论

patterns.name: 软件许可文本
patterns.context: 全大写的软件许可免责声明及其固定法律措辞。

patterns.name: 代码注释与分隔符
patterns.context: 源码中的注释标题、函数定义、闭合花括号或空行等结构位置。

patterns.name: 机器智能讨论中的机器
patterns.context: 讨论机器人用于施工以及机器智能能力的论坛文字；激活集中在 machine。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple text types, including split or uppercase-emphasized words, 18 in statistical contexts, and formatting markers; topics range from poetry and code to demographics, sports, and popular science, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: WASD uppercase string
patterns.context: The word WASD is split into multiple tokens; appears in a sentence about mice, muscle memory, and gaming conventions.
patterns.domain: Gaming, computer input, and HackerNews comments

patterns.name: Split form of thy
patterns.context: The pronoun thine is split in an early English poem; thy, thou, self, and other words recur in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Shakespearean poetry or classical literary quotation

patterns.name: Age statistics involving the number 18
patterns.context: 18 appears as an age threshold in a demographic sentence; percentages and household-size data also occur.

patterns.name: Berkeley in place names
patterns.context: The proper name Berkeley appears in contexts involving schools, newspaper titles, and campus names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia directories, external links, or school information

patterns.name: ANY LOCK in a legal warning
patterns.context: Legal or operational instructions emphasize that a box must be locked before leaving a store; LOCK is highlighted in split tokens and uppercase.

patterns.name: Code comment separator line
patterns.context: In PowerShell code, a comment separator line surrounds a cmdlet heading, followed by a function definition.

patterns.name: Household and population vocabulary in survey statistics
patterns.context: A census-style passage describes residents, households, and households with children.

patterns.name: Sexual orientation and biological discussion
patterns.context: Discusses whether sexual orientation has a biological basis and whether related traits are innate.

patterns.name: Emphatic form in athlete evaluations
patterns.context: Comments on first-round draft picks and emphasizes that they are not great athletes, including split uppercase aren't.

patterns.name: North American forts in a title
patterns.context: A book or chapter title is set in all caps and describes ancient North American forts; the words show clear token splitting.

8_2381.description: 激活分布于多类文本，包含拆分或大写强调的词、统计语境中的18，以及格式标记；主题从诗歌、代码、人口统计到体育和科普不一，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: WASD 大写字符串
patterns.context: 单词 WASD 被拆成多个 token；出现在讨论鼠标、肌肉记忆和游戏操作惯例的句子中。
patterns.domain: 游戏、电脑输入与 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: thy 的拆分形式
patterns.context: 古英语诗句中，代词 thine 被拆分；同一诗段反复出现 thy、thou、self 等词。
patterns.domain: 莎士比亚诗歌或古典文学引文

patterns.name: 数字 18 的年龄统计
patterns.context: 人口统计句中，18 作为年龄门槛出现；另有百分比和家庭规模数据。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Berkeley
patterns.context: 学校、报纸标题及校园名称等专名语境，包含 Berkeley。
patterns.domain: 百科目录、外部链接或学校资料

patterns.name: 法律警示中的 ANY LOCK
patterns.context: 强调离开商店前须给箱子上锁的法律或操作说明，LOCK 以拆分 token 和大写形式突出。

patterns.name: 代码注释分隔线
patterns.context: PowerShell 代码中，注释分隔线包围 cmdlet 标题，随后开始函数定义。

patterns.name: 调查统计的家庭与人口词汇
patterns.context: 人口普查式段落中，描述居民构成、家庭及有孩子的住户。

patterns.name: 性取向与生物学论述
patterns.context: 讨论性取向是否具有生物基础，以及相关特征是否先天。

patterns.name: 运动员评价中的强调形式
patterns.context: 评论首轮选秀球员并强调他们并非出色运动员，含全大写拆分的 aren't。

patterns.name: 标题中的北美堡垒
patterns.context: 书籍或章节标题以全大写排版，介绍北美古堡；词语有明显分词拆分。

en.concept: Sensitive to formatting and fragment boundaries
en.description: Activations occur around typography or within word fragments, numbers and punctuation, citation numbers, and network symbols. Examples span book titles, legal, academic, sports, and business texts, with no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Letters and word endings in uppercase titles
patterns.context: Book or chapter titles are printed in all caps. Activations fall on several words and within-word fragments, without consistently corresponding to any complete word.

patterns.name: English stem AR and negative contraction
patterns.context: A colloquial sentence uses a negative contraction to emphasize that a player is “not good enough”; activations cluster on fragments within AREN'T.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations occur around case-citation page numbers, periods, and subsequent numbers; they do not form a stable legal-term trigger.

patterns.name: Legal section numbers and brace-enclosed numbers
patterns.context: Near the section headings and litigation-item numbering formats of legal documents.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: Activations occur on commas, but the contexts involve different firearm narratives, so the comma itself cannot be confirmed as a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Backticks and garbled-style tone markers
patterns.context: Informal online text interspersed with emoticons, symbols, and onomatopoeic or garbled fragments; activations cover various common words and symbols.

patterns.name: Business names and numbers
patterns.context: Activations occur near model numbers and commas in business commentary about company operations and product users.

patterns.name: First person and evaluation in recommendations
patterns.context: An app recommendation uses a first-person possessive near descriptions of why the app is popular or well-liked.

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference formatting
patterns.context: Citation markers and journal citation formats in medical papers; different citation fragments all show activations.

patterns.name: Fragments and citations in chemical terminology
patterns.context: A paper describes chromosome DNA imaging and chemical reactions, with activations also near citation numbers.

8_2381.description: 激活分布在排版或词内片段、数字和标点、引用编号及网络符号等处；涵盖古籍标题、法律、论文、体育与商业文本，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 大写标题中的字母/词尾
patterns.context: 书籍标题或章节标题以全大写排印，激活落在若干词及词内片段上，且不是一致对应某个完整词。

patterns.name: 英文词干 AR 与否定缩写
patterns.context: 口语句中强调球员“不够优秀”的缩写否定形式，激活集中于 AREN'T 内部片段。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 判例引文的页码、句点及后续编号附近出现激活；不构成稳定的法律术语触发。

patterns.name: 法律小节编号与花括号编号
patterns.context: 法律文书的章节标题和诉讼事项编号格式附近。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 激活出现在逗号上，但上下文分别涉及枪械叙述，无法确认逗号本身是稳定触发。

patterns.name: 反引号与乱码式语气标记
patterns.context: 非正式网络文字中夹有表情、符号和拟声/乱码片段；激活覆盖多种普通词和符号。

patterns.name: 商业公司名称与数字
patterns.context: 企业经营及产品用户的商业评论中，型号数字和逗号附近激活。

patterns.name: 推荐语中的第一人称与评价
patterns.context: 应用推荐句中出现第一人称所有格，邻近描述其受欢迎或喜爱的理由。

patterns.name: 引文标记与参考文献格式
patterns.context: 医学论文中的文献引用标记与期刊引文格式；不同引用片段均有激活。

patterns.name: 化学术语中的片段及引用
patterns.context: 描述染色体 DNA 成像和化学反应的论文，引用编号附近也有激活。

en.description: Activations occur across various text types and word classes. Most salient are numbers, citation numbers, and reference markers in academic texts; common words, uppercase emphasis, proper nouns, and some domain terms also appear. The examples are difficult to explain with a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Citation/reference markers
patterns.context: Numeric years or bracketed citation numbers occur next to reference anchors, often in end-of-sentence citations.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and their reference links

patterns.name: Numbers and superscript styling
patterns.context: Numbers appear in ages, years, or scientific notation, sometimes alongside HTML/typographic markup; this may overlap with the citation-number pattern.

patterns.name: Specific English words and inflections
patterns.context: These common words occur in different syntactic positions, with inconsistent meanings and contexts; there is no obvious unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic papers, legal narratives, literary texts

patterns.name: Uppercase emphasis and book-title typography
patterns.context: Uppercase or mixed-case words occur in emphatic expressions or book-title citations.

patterns.name: Individual biomedical entities
patterns.context: Terms such as antibodies, receptor repertoires, or microRNAs occur in immunology or molecular biology passages, but the activation locations do not form a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and variant spellings
patterns.context: Names or proper nouns are split, contain diacritics, or appear within hyphenated words; examples occur in isolation without a clear shared condition.

patterns.name: Ethnic and identity vocabulary
patterns.context: Identity categories and their variability are discussed together.

patterns.name: Narratives about legal obligations
patterns.context: Describes legal requirements that stores must follow and criticizes a specific person.

patterns.name: Animal breeding and competition narratives
patterns.context: Discusses horse competitions, offspring, and breeding lineage.

patterns.name: Medical risks and outcomes
patterns.context: Discusses disease, risk of death, or maternal and infant health outcomes; activations do not always fall on these words.

8_2381.concept: 学术引文/数字格式偏好
8_2381.description: 激活分布于多种文本与词类：最显眼的是学术文本中的数字、引文编号及参考文献标记；另见常见词、大写强调、专名和若干领域词汇。各例难以由单一语义条件统一解释。

patterns.name: 引文/参考文献标记
patterns.context: 数字年份或方括号引文编号紧邻参考文献锚点；多见句末引用格式。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及其参考文献链接

patterns.name: 数字与上标样式
patterns.context: 数字出现在年龄、年份或科学记号中，部分伴随 HTML/排版标记；可能与引文数字模式重叠。

patterns.name: 特定英文词及词形
patterns.context: 这些常见词在不同句法位置出现，含义和上下文并不一致；没有明显统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：学术论文、法律叙述、文学文本

patterns.name: 大写强调与书名排印
patterns.context: 大写或分段大写的词出现在强调表达或书名引文中。

patterns.name: 个别生物医学实体
patterns.context: 免疫学或分子生物学段落中出现抗体、受体库或微小RNA等术语，但触发位置不构成一致模式。

patterns.name: 专名与异形拼写
patterns.context: 姓名或专名被拆分、带变音符号或嵌在断词中；单独出现，缺乏明确共同条件。

patterns.name: 族群与身份词汇
patterns.context: 并列讨论身份类别及其可变性。

patterns.name: 法律义务叙述
patterns.context: 叙述商店必须遵守的法律规定，并对具体人物提出责备。

patterns.name: 动物繁育与赛事叙述
patterns.context: 谈及马匹赛事、后代和繁育血统。

patterns.name: 医学风险与结局
patterns.context: 讨论疾病、死亡风险或母婴健康结局；激活并不总落在这些词上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, emails, legal documents, online narratives, and book titles. Observable triggers include uppercase and split words, numbers, document fields, and some domain terms, with no unified semantic pattern covering all passages.

patterns.name: Word fragments in uppercase/formatted text
patterns.context: Responds to uppercase or mixed-case word forms split into multiple tokens by the tokenizer; this feature does not explain all activations
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, abusive uppercase text, legal documents, book titles, etc.

patterns.name: Dates and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur within ages, citation numbers, timestamps, or dates; numeric formats vary across examples
patterns.domain: Paper body text, emails, legal documents

patterns.name: High-frequency words in informal English
patterns.context: Occurs in colloquial, conversational, or personal narratives; only some words and positions activate strongly

patterns.name: Document titles and layout markers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a document or in a title area, accompanied by uppercase, indentation, or structured fields
patterns.domain: Papers, book title pages, and other documents

patterns.name: Proper nouns and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Gene/molecular identifiers or email recipient fields; no shared semantic trigger

patterns.name: Legal/court document formatting
patterns.context: Fixed document fields such as court names, case titles, locations, and dates

patterns.name: Firearm ownership narrative
patterns.context: First-person account of purchasing a firearm, completing an ownership declaration, and using a gun safe or lock

patterns.name: Email headers and name fields
patterns.context: Date, recipient, and organizational address fields in email headers

patterns.name: Product recommendation copy
patterns.context: Introduces shopping apps and their products/deals in a review or promotional tone

patterns.name: Gene terminology/cancer abbreviation list
patterns.context: List-style formatting with abbreviations as entries followed by full terms or explanations
patterns.domain: Research materials related to non-small cell lung cancer

patterns.name: Biomedical citations and results statements
patterns.context: Reports research associations and qualifies conclusions using age groups and literature citations

patterns.name: Tumor-related research statements
patterns.context: Discusses molecular expression and findings in malignant tumors, with citation markers

patterns.name: Abstract/sci-fi-style discussion
patterns.context: Shifts from contrasting reality and cartoons to general remarks about humans and technology

8_2381.description: 激活分散于论文、邮件、法律文书、网络叙述和书籍标题；可见触发包括大写及拆分词、数字、文档字段和若干领域术语，没有能覆盖全部段落的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 大写/格式化文本中的词语片段
patterns.trigger: 大写词内部的子词片段，如 «epid»«ermal»、«sar»«coma»、«PRESS»«ING»、«COURT»、«HANDLE»
patterns.context: 对大写或大小写混杂、被分词器拆成多个 token 的词形有响应；但此特征不能解释全部激活
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、辱骂性大写文本、法律文书、书名等

patterns.name: 日期与数字表达
patterns.context: 数字嵌在年龄、引文编号、时间戳或日期中；各处数字格式并不一致
patterns.domain: 论文正文、邮件、法律文书

patterns.name: 非正式英语中的高频词
patterns.context: 出现在口语化、对话或个人叙述中；仅部分词和位置强烈激活

patterns.name: 文档标题及版式标记
patterns.context: 文档开头或标题区域，伴随大写、缩进或结构化字段
patterns.domain: 论文、书籍扉页及其他文档

patterns.name: 专名与字母数字标识
patterns.context: 基因/分子标识或邮件收件人字段；没有共同的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、企业邮件

patterns.name: 法规/法院文书格式
patterns.context: 法院名称、案件标题、地点及日期等固定文书字段
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 枪支所有权叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称讲述购枪、填写所有权声明及枪柜/枪锁

patterns.name: 邮件头与人名字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部的日期、收件人和组织地址字段

patterns.name: 商品推荐文案
patterns.context: 介绍购物应用及其商品/优惠，语气偏评论或推广

patterns.name: 基因术语/癌症缩写表
patterns.context: 以缩写为词条、后接全称或解释的列表式排版
patterns.domain: 非小细胞肺癌相关科研材料

patterns.name: 生物医学引文与结果陈述
patterns.context: 报告研究关联，并用年龄分组和文献引用限定结论

patterns.name: 肿瘤相关研究表述
patterns.context: 讨论分子表达及其在恶性肿瘤中的发现，含引用标记

patterns.name: 抽象/科幻式议论
patterns.context: 从现实与卡通的对比转向人类和技术的泛论

en.description: Activations are scattered: prominent examples include individuals in a patent, you addressing readers, and also classification entries, a license address, medical terminology, citation numbers, and Estonian subword fragments. The passages lack a consistent semantic or formatting trigger.

patterns.name: Individual/personal context
patterns.context: Paired with businesses, describing how people seek new ways to process information as its value increases

patterns.name: Specific personal address
patterns.context: Directly addresses the reader and appears in a narrative about forms, legal requirements, and leaving a store

patterns.name: Recipient address and liability notice
patterns.context: In a confidential email disclaimer, a conditional statement says the reader is not the intended recipient and informs them of their responsibility

patterns.name: Ice hockey player category entries
patterns.context: Appears in successive Category entries concerning teams and categories of undrafted NHL players

patterns.name: Name-like fragment in foundation name
patterns.context: The Free Software Foundation mailing address in GNU license text

patterns.name: Human anatomy and receptor terminology
patterns.context: Paired with breast cancers and estrogen, progesterone receptor, etc., describing cancer receptor characteristics

patterns.name: Tissue development terminology
patterns.context: In gene-expression/disease-mechanism discussion, describes tissue pattern formation and related transcription factors

patterns.name: Sensor citation-number fragments
patterns.context: Bracketed references or dataset-style identifiers following a machine-learning method name
patterns.domain: Methods and citations in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Estonian expression of time
patterns.context: In an Estonian sentence, means “now” and is followed by an imperative to begin an action
patterns.domain: Estonian text from the European Parliament

8_2381.description: 激活模式分散：突出专利中的 individuals、面向读者的 you，也覆盖分类条目、许可证地址、医学术语、引文编号及爱沙尼亚语词片段；各段缺少一致的语义或格式触发因素。

patterns.name: 个体/个人语境
patterns.context: 与 businesses 并列，描述信息价值增加后人们寻求处理信息的新方式

patterns.name: 特定个人称谓
patterns.context: 直接称呼读者，并出现在关于表格、法律要求及离开商店的叙述中
patterns.domain: 消费者投诉或叙事文本

patterns.name: 受信人称呼与责任告知
patterns.context: 保密邮件免责声明中，条件句指出读者并非预期收件人，并告知其责任

patterns.name: 冰球球员分类条目
patterns.context: 出现在连续的 Category 条目中，涉及球队及未选秀 NHL 球员分类

patterns.name: 基金会名称中的人名样式片段
patterns.context: GNU 许可证文本中的 Free Software Foundation 邮寄地址

patterns.name: 人体与受体术语
patterns.context: 与 breast cancers 及 estrogen、progesterone receptor 等并列，描述癌症受体特征

patterns.name: 组织发育术语
patterns.context: 基因表达/疾病机制论述中，描述组织模式形成及相关转录因子

patterns.name: 传感器文献编号片段
patterns.context: 机器学习方法名称后出现的方括号参考文献或数据集样式标识
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的方法与引文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语时间表达
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中表示“现在”，后接开始行动的祈使表达
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会爱沙尼亚语文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across increasing numeric sequences, structured code fields, hexadecimal values, words in fixed disclaimers/confidentiality notices, and local words or numbers in patent, court, and medical texts; there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Increasing numbered sequences
patterns.context: Consecutive integers increase item by item, often alternating with commas, line breaks, or grouped fields; activations fall on numeric tokens
patterns.domain: Number lists, tables, or structured data

patterns.name: YOU in a fixed warning
patterns.context: “Small Print” copyright/disclaimer template, especially the uppercase instruction YOU; repeated samples of the same template

patterns.name: Individual or organizational subject terms
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph introduces the entities seeking new ways to process information as information use grows

patterns.name: Semicolon-separated structured code fields
patterns.context: In code or logs, multi-line records are separated by semicolons and contain field values and increasing numbers

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated email confidentiality notice and recipient address
patterns.context: A long hyphen separator precedes an attorney-client confidentiality/privilege notice in the email body, referring to the intended recipient

patterns.name: Paragraph numbers in court decisions
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, bracketed paragraph or page numbers follow case citations

patterns.name: Numbers in medical abbreviations and citation markers
patterns.context: Discusses AUD and DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, with numbers embedded in citation markers

patterns.name: Hexadecimal numbers in addresses/identifiers
patterns.context: A hexadecimal value beginning with 0x appears in a debugging identifier assignment

8_2381.concept: 局部格式与高显著 token
8_2381.description: 激活分散于递增数字序列、结构化代码字段、十六进制值、固定免责声明/保密通知中的词，以及专利、判决和医学文本的局部词或编号；没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 编号递增的数值序列
patterns.context: 连续整数逐项递增，常与逗号、换行或成组字段交替出现；激活落在数字 token 上
patterns.domain: 数字列表、表格或结构化数据

patterns.name: 固定警告语中的 YOU
patterns.context: “Small Print”版权/免责声明模板中，尤其是大写指令 YOU；同一模板的重复样本

patterns.name: 个体或组织主体词
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍信息使用增长后，列举寻求新处理方式的主体

patterns.name: 分号分隔的结构化代码字段
patterns.context: 代码或日志中，多行记录按分号分隔、字段值及编号递增

patterns.name: 横线分隔的邮件保密通知及收件人称谓
patterns.context: 邮件正文前有长横线分隔符，随后出现律师-客户保密/特权通知，并指向预期收件人
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、法律保密通知

patterns.name: 判决文本中的段落编号
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用判例后，以方括号标注段落或页码编号

patterns.name: 医学缩写及引文标识中的数字
patterns.context: 讨论 AUD、DSM-5 诊断标准时，数字嵌在文献引用标识中

patterns.name: 地址/标识符中的十六进制数字
patterns.context: 以 0x 开头的十六进制值出现在调试标识符赋值中

en.description: Activations occur in many text types: common examples include reader-directed “You are” prompts, as well as feminine possessives, comes, medical terminology, code disclaimers, email placeholders, and various biographical, statistical, and sports texts; no single semantic or stylistic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Second-person prompts
patterns.context: Direct address to readers or users, common in prompts, subscription notices, and webpage greetings; the most consistent adjacent phrase is “You are”.
patterns.domain: Email notices, medical webpage disclaimers, forum pages

patterns.name: Feminine possessive headings
patterns.context: “Women’s” is followed by a section or organization name; in [1] it is a competition subheading, and in [7] a hospital name.

patterns.name: comes
patterns.context: Appears in the disclaimer construction “software comes with…” and the biographical construction “[name] comes from…”.

patterns.name: T-cell and gene terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in medical sentences describing chromosomal translocations and related receptors and genes.

patterns.name: Software copyright and disclaimer
patterns.context: Copyright year and software warranty disclaimer in code comments.

patterns.name: Image placeholders
patterns.context: Repeated image markers interspersed in email body text or formatted content.

patterns.name: Email submission address and subscription notice
patterns.context: Lists a submission email address, then informs recipients of their current subscription status.

patterns.name: Medical assistance and adverse reaction notice
patterns.context: Tells readers to contact a doctor or 911 in emergencies and to report prescription drug side effects.

patterns.name: Specialty training in a physician biography
patterns.context: Chronologically lists medical school research, training in heart failure and transplant cardiology, and hospital experience.

patterns.name: Player biography
patterns.context: A biography subsection introduces an ice hockey player's family background.

patterns.name: Population and racial statistics
patterns.context: Ethnic proportions and statistics in a city population section.

patterns.name: Tennis results and section headings
patterns.context: Match results are followed by a women's singles heading and information about the next match.

8_2381.description: 激活分布在多种文本中：常见于面向读者的“You are”提示，也见于女性所属格、comes、医学术语、代码免责声明、邮件占位符及各类履历、统计和体育文本；没有单一语义或文体能覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 第二人称提示语
patterns.context: 面向读者或用户的直接称呼，常见于提示、订阅通知和网页欢迎语；最稳定的相邻短语是“You are”。
patterns.domain: 邮件通知、医疗网页免责声明、论坛页面

patterns.name: 女性所属格标题
patterns.context: “Women’s”后接栏目或机构名称；在[1]中是赛事小标题，在[7]中是医院名称。
patterns.domain: 体育标题、医院/医疗履历

patterns.name: comes
patterns.context: 出现在“software comes with…”的免责声明句式，以及人物简介中“[人名] comes from…”的句式。
patterns.domain: 软件许可文本、人物传记

patterns.name: T细胞与基因术语
patterns.context: 嵌在描述染色体易位及相关受体、基因的医学句子中。

patterns.name: 软件版权与免责声明

patterns.name: 图片占位符

patterns.name: 邮件投稿地址与订阅提示
patterns.context: 列出投稿邮箱后，提示收件人当前订阅状态。

patterns.name: 医疗求助与不良反应提示

patterns.domain: 医疗/药品安全网页免责声明

patterns.name: 医师履历中的专科训练
patterns.context: 按时间顺序罗列医学院研究路径、心衰及移植心脏病学培训和医院经历。

patterns.name: 球员个人简介
patterns.context: 个人简介小节中介绍冰球运动员的家庭背景。

patterns.name: 人口种族统计
patterns.context: 城市人口构成段落中的族裔比例及统计表述。

patterns.name: 网球赛果与栏目标题
patterns.context: 赛事结果文字后接女子单打标题和下一场比赛信息。

en.description: Activations are scattered across patents and confidentiality notices, reader-directed prompts, biomedical terminology, Android menu code, and ranch reminiscences; no single semantic or stylistic pattern covers all.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimer and rights statement
patterns.context: Patent background text explains how a new device differs from prior art; also includes recipient notices in confidentiality or privilege communications.
patterns.domain: Patent legal text, email confidentiality statements

patterns.name: Direct second-person notices
patterns.context: Notices, instructions, or advice directed at readers or recipients; also appears in code comments and webpage prompts.
patterns.domain: Email, medical webpage disclaimers, open-source license comments

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and research statements
patterns.context: Technical descriptions involving cells, molecular mechanisms, gene expression, or virus classes.

patterns.name: Java menu creation code

patterns.name: Australian ranch experience and animal companionship

patterns.name: Time 开头

en.description: Activation is distributed across various texts. The most salient feature is the hum substring in hummingbirds/humic; source-code identifiers and technical and conversational texts also contain sporadic high-activation terms, with no unified semantic or stable syntactic condition observed.

patterns.name: The hum character sequence within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous character sequence hum, followed by different word endings; it appears in repeated mentions of hummingbirds and in humic substances.

patterns.name: Specific source-code identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on identifiers, function names, or string fragments in source code, without unified semantics; sometimes it is a substring within an identifier.

patterns.name: Sporadic terms in technical texts
patterns.context: Multiple common words and terms in technical or promotional texts receive activation, without a stable semantic or syntactic pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Phrase triggers in dialogue
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across multiple consecutive words in a spoken question; there are no other dialogue examples to verify whether this is a fixed phrase pattern.

8_2399.description: 激活分散于多种文本：较醒目的是 hummingbirds/humic 中的 hum 子串；源码标识符和技术、对话文本也有零散高激活词项，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 字母串 hum 的词内片段

patterns.name: 技术文本中的零散词项

patterns.domain: 论文、医学摘要、编程教程

patterns.name: 对话中的短语触发

en.description: The most salient cue is a plural summary phrase introduced by sentence-initial “Various”; other high activation is distributed across formula formatting, specific place names, and citation markers, alongside several passages that do not fit a shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Various-initial collocations
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “Various” introducing a plural noun, often followed by a general category such as applications, methods, or diseases

patterns.name: Stjørdalen at a place-name boundary
patterns.context: The place name Stjørdalen appears in a description of Norwegian administrative boundaries

patterns.context: A backslash and reference number appear near a citation marker in academic text

patterns.name: circumflex formula symbol
patterns.context: In a patent noise-parameter formula, a symbol description or formatting marker includes circumflex

patterns.name: Various approaches/applications across fields
patterns.context: A plural noun phrase follows Various, introducing types of solutions or applications

8_2399.description: 最显著线索是句首“Various”引出的复数概括短语；其余高激活分散于公式排版、特定地名及引用标记，另有多段无法归入共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 跨领域的 Various approaches/applications

en.concept: The alen character sequence and other local fragments
en.description: The most stable trigger is the character sequence alen in proper names spanning tokens, found in place names, metabolites, and personal names; isolated high activation also occurs in fragments within various proper names and substrings of common words. The domains and semantics are diverse, making it difficult to identify a common rule.

patterns.name: Character sequence z-e-a-l-e-n
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the final alen sequence in proper names; a word is split into multiple subword tokens, with different prefixes.
patterns.domain: Place names and microbial metabolite names

patterns.name: The alen sound/spelling in other proper names
patterns.context: Activation also appears in proper-name fragments spanning tokens, including names and Latin mottos; some contain alen, while others only have a similar character sequence.
patterns.domain: Film, racing, classical mottos, and sports figures

patterns.name: Similar character fragments in non-proper names
patterns.context: High activation falls on local substrings or split tokens in common words, with no stable semantic or contextual condition observed.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, antenna technology papers, webpage titles

patterns.name: Fragments within other proper names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens, and activation falls on fragments within the names, but they have no obvious orthographic or semantic connection to the alen pattern.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists and American football player descriptions

8_2399.concept: alen 字母串及其他局部片段
8_2399.description: 最稳定的触发是跨 token 专名中的字母串 alen，见地名、代谢物和人名；另有多种专名内部片段及普通词子串的孤立高激活，领域和语义分散，难以归为同一规则。

patterns.name: 字母序列 z-e-a-l-e-n

patterns.name: 其他专名中的 alen 音形

patterns.name: 非专名的相似字母片段

patterns.name: 其他专名内部片段

en.description: Activation occurs in terms from various arXiv disciplines, mathematical physics phrases, paper citations, and titles; the topics of the passages differ, with no shared specific semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Coleman and N-representability
patterns.context: Activation occurs when mentioning Coleman's theorem or citations, or constraints on the physical realizability of 2DM.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and citations related to mathematical physics and quantum chemistry

patterns.name: Transverse energy and excitation
patterns.context: Activation occurs when discussing low total transverse energy, excitation energy limits, and the widths of related quantities.

patterns.name: Near-field coupling between spheres
patterns.context: Activation occurs when discussing non-radiative near-field coupling between adjacent spheres in plasma-sphere systems.
patterns.domain: Papers at the intersection of condensed matter and nuclear physics

patterns.name: Gravitational-wave detection and polarization spectra
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing gravitational-wave detectability, polarization angular power spectra, and plotted results.

patterns.name: Photonic quantum computing devices
patterns.context: Activation occurs when the nonlinear sign gate is used as an example of a linear-optical quantum computing device.

patterns.name: Application areas of ontologies
patterns.context: Activation occurs when listing ontology uses in tasks such as NLP, knowledge management, and information extraction.

patterns.name: Non-Gaussian velocity distributions and equilibrium
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing the relaxation of a non-Gaussian velocity distribution toward its final equilibrium state.

patterns.name: Nematic order parameter
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a scalar order parameter and the positive eigenvalue of the Q tensor are used to characterize order in a two-dimensional system.
patterns.domain: Soft matter and liquid crystal physics papers

patterns.name: Six-dimensional nilpotent geometry and pseudo-Kähler structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs when titles or abstracts concern six-dimensional nilpotent Lie groups, manifolds, and pseudo-Kähler structures.

8_2399.description: 激活出现在多种 ArXiv 学科术语、数学物理短语、论文引文及标题中；各段主题不同，缺少共同的具体语义触发模式。

patterns.name: Coleman 与 N-representability
patterns.context: 提到 Coleman 定理、Coleman 引文，或 2DM 的物理可实现性约束时激活。
patterns.domain: 数学物理、量子化学相关 ArXiv 论文及引用

patterns.name: 横向能量与激发
patterns.context: 讨论低横向总能量、激发能量限制及相关量宽度时激活。

patterns.name: 球体间近场耦合
patterns.context: 讨论等离子体球体系统中相邻球体的非辐射近场耦合时激活。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态与核物理交叉领域论文

patterns.name: 引力波探测与偏振谱
patterns.context: 描述引力波可探测性及偏振角功率谱、图示结果时激活。

patterns.name: 光量子计算器件
patterns.context: 以非线性符号门作为线性光学量子计算器件示例时激活。

patterns.name: 本体的应用领域
patterns.context: 列举本体在 NLP、知识管理、信息抽取等任务中的用途时激活。

patterns.name: 非高斯速度分布与平衡
patterns.context: 描述非高斯速度分布向最终平衡态弛豫时激活。

patterns.name: 向列相序参量
patterns.context: 以标量序参量及 Q 张量的正特征值刻画二维系统有序时激活。

patterns.name: 六维幂零几何与伪 Kähler 结构
patterns.context: 标题或摘要涉及六维幂零 Lie 群、流形及伪 Kähler 结构时激活。

en.concept: Proper names and quantities in technical texts
en.description: Responses are distributed across scientific materials and physics terminology, chemical formulas and quantity expressions, as well as celestial motion, radio instruments, biomedical terminology, and quantities and proper names in transportation encyclopedias; no single trigger pattern runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Crystal fields and angular-momentum quantum-state symbols
patterns.context: A theoretical physics passage lists orbital angular-momentum states and crystal-field splitting; activation occurs near mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Fullerenes and Jahn–Teller-related expressions
patterns.context: Discussion of the magnetism, electronic structure, or Jahn–Teller dynamics of C60 compounds; activation falls on related terms, material formulas, and descriptive words

patterns.name: Rare-earth and transition-metal oxide formulas
patterns.context: Stoichiometric formulas appear within discussions of magnetism, structural distortion, Mott transitions, or conductivity

patterns.name: Rotation, kinematics, and galactic astronomy terms
patterns.context: Reports of kinematics or rotation measurements of planetary nebulae at different radii from a galaxy's center

patterns.name: Radio arrays and antenna descriptions
patterns.context: Introduction to antenna design and operating frequency for a low-frequency long-wavelength array

patterns.name: Apoptosis and natural compounds
patterns.context: Description of oxide-induced apoptosis and the effects of flavonoid compounds on the process

patterns.name: Ferry counts and operations
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry describes ferry services near headings such as routes and fleet

patterns.name: Comparison of regional counts and research scope
patterns.context: Authors compare the number of regions covered by previous studies and explain the scope and details of their analysis

8_2399.concept: 技术文本中的专名与数量
8_2399.description: 反应分布于科学材料与物理术语、化学式和数量表达，也包括天体运动、射电仪器、生物医学术语及交通百科中的数量与专名；未见贯穿所有段落的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 晶体场与角动量量子态符号
patterns.context: 理论物理段落列举轨道角动量态及晶体场劈裂，数学符号紧邻处触发

patterns.name: 富勒烯及 Jahn–Teller 相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论 C60 化合物的磁性、电子结构或 Jahn–Teller 动力学；激活落在相关术语、材料式和描述词上
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 稀土与过渡金属氧化物材料式
patterns.context: 化学计量式嵌在磁性、结构畸变、Mott 转变或导电性质的讨论中
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 旋转、运动学与星系天体术语
patterns.context: 报告星系中心不同半径处行星状星云的运动学或旋转测量

patterns.name: 射电阵列与天线描述
patterns.context: 介绍低频长波阵列的天线设计及工作频率

patterns.name: 细胞凋亡与天然化合物
patterns.context: 描述氧化物诱导的细胞凋亡，以及黄酮类化合物对该过程的影响

patterns.name: 渡轮数量与运营
patterns.context: 百科条目在航线、船队等标题附近介绍渡轮服务

patterns.name: 地区数量及研究范围比较
patterns.trigger: “only four of these regions”“couple of these regions”“all six regions”
patterns.context: 作者比较先前研究覆盖的区域数，并说明本文分析范围及细节
patterns.domain: 科学论文文献综述/研究介绍

en.concept: Local phrases in English descriptions and judgments
en.description: Activation is distributed across judgment structures such as not/is, and descriptive phrases in academic, patent, and scientific texts; technical terms, symbols, numbers, and conversational email language also show local activation. The passages do not fit a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: not in negative constructions
patterns.context: A negative judgment occurs in discussion, evaluation, or comparison; it may span several tokens and need not be adjacent.

patterns.name: Copula is and subsequent judgment
patterns.context: A statement describes an object's state, attribute, or viewpoint, commonly in English expository writing; is alone is not a sufficient condition.
patterns.domain: Math questions, academic discussion, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Descriptive predicates in methods or discussion
patterns.context: Descriptions of research results, method steps, or existing technology; related activation is distributed across phrases rather than a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbol sequences
patterns.context: Professional texts contain chemical elements, engineering units, mathematical symbols, or precise numerical values; activation sometimes falls on subwords in nouns, symbols, or numbers.

patterns.name: Patent technical processes and structural components
patterns.context: Descriptions of technical constructions and processes, such as material preparation, steam/condensate systems, or track maintenance.

patterns.name: Everyday expressions in Enron email
patterns.context: Colloquial evaluations or greetings in email exchanges; activation is distributed across function words and phrases.

patterns.name: Biological classification and depth values
patterns.context: Descriptions of species, taxonomic names, and their habitats or measurement data.

patterns.name: Comparative relationships in salt-sensitive hypertension
patterns.context: Comparison of the relative importance of factors related to NaCl intake in blood pressure generation.

8_2399.concept: 英语描述与判断中的局部词组
8_2399.description: 激活分散于 not/is 等判断结构，以及学术、专利和科学文本的描述性词组；专业名词、符号、数值和邮件口语也有局部激活。各段难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 否定结构中的 not
patterns.context: 论述、评估或对比中出现否定判断；可跨越若干 token，不要求紧邻。
patterns.domain: 学术哲学、数学问答、邮件

patterns.name: 系词 is 与判断续接
patterns.trigger: «is»，尤其是 «is» 后接否定词或状态判断
patterns.context: 陈述对象的状态、属性或观点，常见于英文说明文；单独的 is 并非充分条件。
patterns.domain: 数学问答、学术讨论、专利说明

patterns.name: 方法或论述中的描述性谓词
patterns.context: 对研究结果、方法步骤或既有技术作描述；相关激活分散于词组而非单一触发词。

patterns.name: 专业名词与技术符号序列
patterns.context: 专业文本中出现化学元素、工程单位、数学符号或精确数值；激活有时落在名词、符号或数字的子词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、数学问答、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专利技术过程及结构部件
patterns.context: 描述材料制备、蒸汽/冷凝水系统或轨道维护等技术构造与过程。

patterns.name: Enron邮件中的日常表达
patterns.context: 邮件往来中的口语化评价或寒暄；激活分散在语法词和短语上。

patterns.name: 生物学分类与深度数值
patterns.context: 物种、分类学名及其栖息环境或测量数据的描述。

patterns.name: 盐敏感高血压中的比较关系
patterns.context: 比较 NaCl 摄入相关因素对血压生成的相对重要性。

en.description: Activation cues are diverse: the quantifier two stands out, along with the negation not and contrastive however; patent structural-relation words, process-description words, and local patterns involving reflection, tilt constraints, contact, and evaluation of solutions also appear. No single semantic pattern can explain them all.

patterns.name: Numerical quantities and levels
patterns.context: Describes the number of components, layers, connectors, particles, or electrodes, especially counting structures in technical texts; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: Patents, physics questions, and academic texts

patterns.name: Negation and dissatisfaction judgments
patterns.context: In contexts of negation, limitation, or contrast, “not …” and a countervailing judgment introduced by “however” are common.

patterns.name: Patent technical relations and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of component composition, connections, locations, or configurations; these words are frequent and dispersed in isolation, and may overlap with the counting pattern above.

patterns.name: Surface, reflection, and resonance processes
patterns.context: Discussion of reflected beams, loss elements, and suppression of multiple reflections in a resonator.

patterns.name: Restricted lateral tilt
patterns.context: Description of a kinematic constraint preventing lateral tilting between a robotic arm, linkage, and vehicle.

patterns.name: Process or system appearance and behavior
patterns.context: Academic or technical discussion explains how a system appears, behaves, or is regarded as something; specific trigger points may vary.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, optical patents, medical abstracts

patterns.name: “in … contact” relation
patterns.context: Explicitly denies direct physical contact between two optical components.

patterns.name: “as” introducing an analogy or explanation
patterns.context: Uses as to introduce an analogy, role, or explanatory description.

patterns.name: Patent evaluation “not satisfactory”
patterns.context: Evaluates an existing device or solution as unsatisfactory, infeasible, or not as expected.

8_2399.description: 激活线索多样：突出数量词 two，否定词 not 及转折 however；另见专利结构关系词、过程描述词，以及反射、倾斜约束、接触和方案评价等局部模式。无法由单一语义模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 数字数量与层级
patterns.context: 描述部件、层数、连接件、粒子或电极的数量，尤以技术文本中计数结构为主；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 专利、物理问答及学术文本

patterns.name: 否定与不满意判断
patterns.context: 在否定、限制或转折语境中，常见“not …”以及“however”引出的反向判断。

patterns.name: 专利技术关系与结构描述
patterns.context: 技术说明中描述部件的组成、连接、位置或配置；单独看这些词频繁且分散，可能与前述计数模式交叠。

patterns.name: 表面、反射与共振过程
patterns.context: 讨论反射光束、损耗元件及谐振器中多次反射被抑制。

patterns.name: 侧向倾斜受限
patterns.context: 描述机械臂、连杆和车辆之间不能侧向倾斜的运动学约束。

patterns.name: 过程或系统出现、表现
patterns.context: 学术或技术论述中说明系统如何出现、表现或被视作某种对象；具体触发点可能并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、光学专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: “in … contact”关系
patterns.context: 明确否定两个光学部件之间存在物理直接接触。

patterns.name: “as”引出类比或说明
patterns.context: 以 as 引入类比、角色或解释性描述。

patterns.name: 专利中的“not satisfactory”评价
patterns.context: 评价既有装置或方案不令人满意、不可行或不符合预期。

en.description: Activation in multiple passages is concentrated on not combined with entirely, necessarily, constant, affected, seem, and other words to form negative or incomplete judgments; local triggers also occur in technical motion, layered structures, scientific evaluations, and forum analogies, with no unified semantic pattern observed.

patterns.name: Negation and degree qualification
patterns.context: In legal testimony evaluations or technical descriptions, negation combines with degree adverbs to express not entirely, not necessarily, or incompletely; some passages merely contain a negation.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, patents, scientific papers, and online discussions

patterns.name: Completeness judgment in an introductory phrase
patterns.context: A judge evaluates a witness's credibility; not entirely modifies an adjective, continuing across a line break to credible.

patterns.name: Guidance and deflection in technical processes
patterns.context: Describes the direction of component movement and how it is guided or deflected into a specific area.

patterns.name: Multilayer structures and interlayer transitions
patterns.context: Describes coil conductors wound around a magnetic-field axis, using at least two layers and including an interlayer transition.

patterns.name: A physical quantity is not constant
patterns.context: Observational evidence shows that a physical quantity changes, prompting the need for a new theoretical method.

patterns.name: Introducing an evaluation or analogy
patterns.context: A forum contributor expresses agreement or an impression and calls something a typical example.

patterns.name: A phenomenon is not significantly affected
patterns.context: A scientific paper states that certain large shock fronts seem not to be significantly affected by environmental factors.

patterns.name: A relationship is not directly obvious
patterns.context: Research results show that the relationships among several changes are not simple or intuitive.

patterns.name: An expression is not insightful
patterns.context: A theoretical paper evaluates a lengthy expression as not worth elaborating on or not insightful.

patterns.name: Defects are not necessarily fully eliminated
patterns.context: A patent explains the definition of chromatic aberration or interaction chromatic aberration, emphasizing that the defect need not be fully eliminated.

8_2399.description: 多段激活集中于 not 与 entirely、necessarily、constant、affected、seem 等词构成的否定或不完全判断；另有技术运动、分层结构、科学评价及论坛类比等局部触发，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 否定与程度限定
patterns.context: 在法律证词评价或技术说明中，否定词与程度副词组合，表达并非完全、未必或不彻底；有些段落也只是出现否定词。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、专利、科学论文及网络讨论

patterns.name: 引导语中的完整性判断
patterns.context: 法官评价证人可信度时，not entirely 修饰形容词，跨换行延续到 credible。

patterns.name: 技术过程的引导与偏离
patterns.context: 描述部件运动方向及其被引导或偏转进入特定区域。

patterns.name: 多层结构与层间转换
patterns.context: 描述线圈导体围绕磁场轴、采用至少两层绕制并包含层间转换。

patterns.name: 物理量不恒定
patterns.context: 观测证据显示某物理量变化，因此需要新的理论方法。

patterns.name: 评价或类比的引出
patterns.context: 论坛发言者表达认同或感想，并把某事称为典型例子。

patterns.name: 现象不受显著影响
patterns.context: 科学论文中说明某些大型冲击波前看起来未受环境因素显著影响。

patterns.name: 关系并非直接明了
patterns.context: 研究结果显示若干变化之间的关系并不简单或直观。

patterns.name: 表述不具启发性
patterns.context: 理论论文评价某个冗长表达不值得展开或没有启发性。

patterns.name: 缺陷未必完全消除
patterns.context: 专利解释色差或相互作用色差的定义，强调缺陷不必完全消除。

en.concept: Expressions of relations and properties in technical descriptions
en.description: Activations cover negation/contrast, directional motion, geometric and spatial terms, specialized entities, and categorical comparisons in technical texts; one example is an approving response in a forum reply. Different triggers may reflect multiple local morphological and syntactic patterns.

patterns.name: Negation or contrast structures with not/non
patterns.context: Near negation or contrast expressions such as not, but, and non- in technical or academic descriptions; activation often falls on the negation word or a subword of a nonlinear term.

patterns.name: Descriptions of direction, guidance, and motion
patterns.context: Describes the direction of motion, deflection, extension, or change in posture of components, trajectories, or entities.

patterns.name: Geometric shapes and spatial structures
patterns.context: Terms for geometric configurations, shapes, planes, surfaces, or spatial arrangements; occurs across different fields.
patterns.domain: Patents, materials chemistry, architectural descriptions, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Specialized technical entities and their relations
patterns.context: A specific component, material, or process is the subject in a specialized description, which describes its properties, connections, or functions.

patterns.name: Classification, type, or similarity relations
patterns.context: Comparisons and definitions of categories, examples, degrees of similarity, or differences.

patterns.name: Evaluative responses in community discussions
patterns.context: A forum reply begins with Yes, responds to the preceding text, and offers an evaluation or example; it does not clearly match the other technical texts.

8_2399.concept: 技术描述中的关系与性质表达
8_2399.description: 激活覆盖技术文本中的否定/对比、方向运动、几何空间词、专业实体及分类比较；另有一例论坛回复的赞同评价。不同触发可能反映多种局部词形与句法模式。

patterns.name: 不/非的否定或对比结构
patterns.trigger: “not possible”“not laterally tiltable”“not the Lorenz type but rather”“non-linear”
patterns.context: 在技术说明或学术描述中，not、but、non-等否定/转折表达附近；激活常落在否定词或非线性词的子词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、物理学论文、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 方向、引导与运动描述
patterns.context: 描述部件、轨道或实体的运动方向、偏转、延伸或姿态变化。

patterns.name: 几何形状与空间结构
patterns.context: 几何构型、形状、平面、表面或空间排列的术语；在不同领域均出现。
patterns.domain: 专利、材料化学、建筑描述、理论物理

patterns.name: 专业技术实体及其关系
patterns.trigger: “arm and rotation link”“rear partial rail”“Cu chains”“impeller”“fuel-feeding passage”“doping of specific impurities”
patterns.context: 专业说明中以具体部件、材料或过程为主语，并描述它们的属性、连接或作用。

patterns.name: 分类、类型或近似关系
patterns.trigger: “such as semi-circle or a trapezium”“close to”“really very different from each other”“roughly linear”
patterns.context: 对类别、例子、相似程度或差异进行比较和界定。

patterns.name: 社区对话中的评价反应
patterns.trigger: “Yes, this struck me as a classic example”
patterns.context: 论坛回复中以 Yes 开头，回应前文并作评价或举例；与其余技术文本不明显相同。

en.concept: Fragments and relations in technical texts
en.description: Activations span technical texts from many fields and often fall on proper nouns, abbreviations, numbers, and their tokenized fragments; some passages focus on spatial arrangement, direction, alignment, or scale relations. The first passage exhibits an isolated Finnish within-word fragment and sentence-final punctuation pattern, which cannot be reliably assigned to a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Term/variable boundaries in letter–number combinations
patterns.context: Technical texts contain proper nouns, abbreviations, variables, numbers, units, or compound words; activation is often distributed across internal fragments and adjacent symbols. In the first passage, highlights fall continuously within a Finnish sentence, so these fragments alone do not establish a shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical corpora, including parliamentary texts, astrophysics, materials chemistry, measurement, patents, network science, mathematical Q&A, and Finnish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Spatial position and directional relations
patterns.context: Describes how objects are arranged, connected, oriented, aligned, or layered over one another; no fixed word form is required, and triggers occur near relational terms and their complements
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent descriptions, mathematical explanations

patterns.name: Comparison or change in quantity, scale, and distribution
patterns.context: Involves numerical changes, ranges, distribution widths, or physical scales; the specific objects and syntactic roles differ across passages
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, network science, patents, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Specific technical term fragments
patterns.context: When field-specific proper nouns, abbreviations, device/material names, code identifiers, or units appear, individual words and adjacent fragments activate; there is no evidence that these terms are semantically related
patterns.domain: Materials chemistry, astronomical observation, lock patents, vehicle patents, fiber-optic patents, mathematical Q&A, pulsar research

patterns.name: Finnish within-word fragments and sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs alone in a passage of Finnish parliamentary text. Activation spans multiple within-word subwords and covers a period and line break; the other passages use neither the same language nor clearly similar morphology

8_2399.concept: 技术文本中的片段与关系
8_2399.description: 激活跨多领域技术文本，常落在专名、缩写、数值及其分词片段；部分段落集中于空间排列、方向、对齐或尺度关系。第1段是孤立的芬兰语词内片段与句末标点模式，不能可靠归入共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 字母与数字组合中的术语/变量边界
patterns.trigger: 高亮主要落在分词后的片段或相邻子词上，如«nu»、«Δ»、«20»、«s»、«circ»、«ske»、«unit»、«times»、«10»；第1段还包括芬兰语词内片段«he»
patterns.context: 技术文本中出现专名、缩写、变量、数字、单位或复合词，激活常分散在其内部片段及相邻符号；第1段的高亮连续落在一个芬兰语句子中，不能仅凭这些片段确定同一触发条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术语料，包括议会文本、天体物理、材料化学、测量、专利、网络科学、数学问答及芬兰语议会文本

patterns.name: 空间位置与方向关系
patterns.context: 描述对象如何排列、连接、定向、对齐或相互叠置；不要求固定词形，触发分布在关系词及其补足语附近
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利说明、数学解释

patterns.name: 数量、尺度与分布的比较或变化
patterns.context: 涉及数值变化、范围、分布宽窄或物理尺度；各段中的具体对象和句法功能并不一致
patterns.domain: 天体物理、网络科学、专利及技术描述

patterns.name: 特定技术术语片段
patterns.context: 领域专名、缩写、器件/材料名、代码标识或单位出现时，个别词及其邻接片段激活；没有证据表明这些术语彼此语义相关
patterns.domain: 材料化学、天文观测、锁具专利、车辆专利、光纤专利、数学问答、脉冲星研究

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段及句末标点
patterns.context: 单独出现在一段芬兰语议会文本中，激活跨越多个词内子词，并覆盖句点和换行；其余段落没有相同的语言或明显同类形态

en.concept: Descriptions of spatial geometry and scale
en.description: Activations often occur in scientific and technical descriptions of spatial geometry: direction, angle, axis, route, distance, length, boundary, and distribution, often accompanied by numbers and units; there is also an isolated example involving an orbital parameter, a scanning configuration, and a chemical bond.

patterns.name: Direction, angle, and spatial axes
patterns.context: Describes spatial directional relations such as scan direction, an astronomical rotation axis, or the angle between a jet and the line of sight, often with angles, bearings, or a reference direction.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observations, astrophysics, and related scientific papers

patterns.name: Length, distance, and geometric scale
patterns.context: Describes the spatial scale, distance, length, depth, or extension along a direction of an object or structure; some examples involve spatial geometry rather than numerical measurement.
patterns.domain: Astronomy, urban history, mining, physics, and patent texts

patterns.name: Numerical and unitized parameters
patterns.context: Scientific texts contain measured values with units, physical parameters, errors, or angles; not all strongly activating fragments contain numbers.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, especially astronomy and physics

patterns.name: Directional extension, following, or connection
patterns.context: Uses line, route, direction, and similar terms to describe a route, axis, line of sight, or structural orientation; the word followed sometimes occurs, but its collocations and meaning are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Spatial distribution of structures or boundaries
patterns.context: Describes the geometry and spatial distribution of fields, boundaries, regions, planes, or components, rather than merely direction or size.

patterns.name: Specific chemical bond and radical descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses Na-H complexes, radicals, and the strength of a single-electron bond, with no clear spatial-scale or directional meaning.

patterns.name: Astronomical orbital parameters
patterns.context: Orbital period and semimajor-axis parameters of a binary pulsar; these are astronomical parameter descriptions, adjacent to other spatial/scale patterns but involving explicit orbital terminology.

patterns.name: Scan speed and observation configuration
patterns.context: Observation methods specify scan speed, scan direction, and scan angle.

8_2399.description: 激活多见于科学及技术文本的空间几何描述：方向、角度、轴线、路线、距离、长度、边界与分布，常伴随数值和单位；也包含轨道参数、扫描配置及化学键这一孤例。

patterns.name: 方向、角度与空间轴线
patterns.trigger: “15 long scan-maps in two orthogonal directions”“position angles (45° relative to the scan direction)”“rotation axis of 170° east of north”“angles (< 15°) to our line of sight”
patterns.context: 描述扫描方向、天体旋转轴或喷流视线夹角等空间方向关系，常伴随角度、方位或基准方向。
patterns.domain: 天文观测、天体物理及相关科学论文

patterns.name: 长度、距离与几何尺度
patterns.trigger: “90 kpc from the center”“24 kilometers long”“reasonable depth”“length ξ”“rising from the front to the”
patterns.context: 描述物体或结构的空间尺度、距离、长度、深度或沿某方向的延伸；部分例子是空间几何关系而非数值测量。
patterns.domain: 天文学、城市历史、采矿、物理及专利文本

patterns.name: 数值及单位化参数
patterns.trigger: “20 s⁻¹”“76 ± … km s⁻¹”“orbital period … hr”“a = … AU”“90°”
patterns.context: 科学文本中出现带单位的测量值、物理参数、误差或角度；并非所有强激活片段都有数值。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，尤其天文与物理

patterns.name: 方向性延伸、跟随或连接
patterns.trigger: “followed the route”“followed the line”“pointed … to our line of sight”“runs … rising from the front to the”
patterns.context: 以 line、route、direction 等描述路线、轴线、视线或结构的走向；有时出现 followed 一词，但搭配和语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、采矿、天体物理、专利

patterns.name: 结构或边界的空间分布
patterns.context: 描述场、边界、区域、平面或部件的几何形态与空间分布，而非单纯的方向或尺寸。
patterns.domain: 数值物理、科学论文、专利

patterns.name: 特定化学键与自由基表述
patterns.trigger: “Na-H forms the strongest single-electron sodium bond”
patterns.context: 讨论 Na-H 络合物、自由基及单电子键强度，没有明显空间尺度或方向语义。

patterns.name: 天体轨道参数
patterns.context: 双脉冲星的轨道周期与半长轴参数，属于天体参数描述；与其他空间/尺度模式相邻，但为明确的轨道术语。

patterns.name: 扫描速度与观测配置
patterns.context: 观测方法中交代扫描速度、扫描方向和扫描角度。

en.description: Activations often occur in descriptions of following routes, lines, arcs, or trajectories and their directions; other examples involve scan direction, physical axes, quantum projection direction, astronomical angular distance, and periodic arrangements. The Estonian passage exhibits within-word subword triggers and is difficult to unify semantically with these examples.

patterns.name: Following a route, direction, or trajectory
patterns.context: Describes an entity moving, extending, or being distributed along a route, line, arc, or spatial trajectory; also includes descriptions of trajectory direction.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patent technology, geology, and astronomical descriptions

patterns.name: Scan direction and angle
patterns.context: Scanning and measurement contexts mention scan direction, an orthogonal direction, or an angle relative to the scan direction.

patterns.name: Physical axes and order parameters
patterns.context: In physics, describes the orientation of physical quantities such as magnetization along a particular axis; activation concentrates on directional prepositions and axis symbols.

patterns.name: Estonian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within consecutive Estonian words, appearing in a sentence about a temporary coordination mechanism and its initiator; there is no clear semantic match to the spatial-motion patterns.

patterns.name: Quantum-state projection direction
patterns.context: Projection and counting of particle states along a specified basis vector or direction.

patterns.name: Spatial distribution width and angular distance
patterns.context: Describes the spatial distribution of astronomical objects or clumps in a stellar stream, using right-ascension ranges or angles.

patterns.name: Periodicity and array arrangement
patterns.context: Mathematical descriptions contain approximate periods, cyclic variables, or quasi-periodic arrangements.

8_2399.description: 激活多见于路线、线、弧或轨迹的跟随与方向描述；另见扫描方向、物理轴向、量子投影方向、天文角距，以及周期性排列。爱沙尼亚语段落表现为词内子词触发，难以与这些语义统一。

patterns.name: 跟随路线、方向或轨迹
patterns.trigger: «followed»10« the»3« route»3；«follow»9« an»3« arc»3；«followed»9« the»3« line»2；«travelling»4« from»3
patterns.context: 描述实体沿某条路线、线、弧或空间轨迹移动、延伸或分布；也包括对轨迹的方向描述。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利技术、地质及天文叙述

patterns.name: 扫描方向与角度
patterns.context: 扫描测量语境，提及扫描方向、正交方向或相对于扫描方向的角度。

patterns.name: 物理轴向与序参量
patterns.context: 物理学中描述磁化等物理量沿特定轴取向；触发集中在方向介词及轴符号。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续词内部的子词片段，出现在关于临时协调机制及其发起者的句子中；没有明显与空间运动模式相同的语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 量子态投影方向
patterns.context: 粒子态在指定基矢或方向上的投影与计数。

patterns.name: 空间分布宽度与角距
patterns.context: 天文对象或星流团块的空间分布，以赤经范围或角度描述。

patterns.name: 周期性与数组排列
patterns.context: 数学描述中出现近似周期、循环变量或准周期排列。

en.concept: Directional and structural terminology in specialized scientific texts
en.description: Activations cover z-axis/direction, two-dimensional planes, phase transitions, and ordered structures in physics and materials papers; they also involve time dynamics, oriented arrangements, and Hamiltonian formulas, as well as a semiconductor patent and biomedical membrane signals. The patterns are diverse and often fall on specialized compound terms and descriptions of direction or structure.

patterns.name: z-axis direction
patterns.context: Physics texts describe directions, axes, or magnetization/spin relative to an axis; activation concentrates on combinations of z with direction/axis.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, magnetism, and spin physics

patterns.name: Two-dimensional plane
patterns.context: Describes two-dimensional momentum space using coordinate components and geometric objects such as a Fermi circle; strong activation falls on plane.

patterns.name: Phase transitions and ordered states
patterns.context: Discusses phases of matter, structures, or ordered/disordered states of magnetic systems and their transitions; activation falls on related terms and on transition and ordered.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, materials science, and statistical physics

patterns.name: Device and transistor terminology
patterns.context: A patent background section introduces a Bi-CMOS system and an n-channel MOS transistor in its diagram.

patterns.name: Dynamic times and rates
patterns.context: Describes the decay of spin polarization or the time evolution and dynamics of biochemical signals.

patterns.name: Oriented arrangements and neighboring structures
patterns.context: Particles or molecules are arranged or move along a particular direction, edge, or neighbor; the association between along and orientation/edge is prominent.

patterns.name: Model Hamiltonian expression
patterns.context: A theoretical paper defines a Hamiltonian and gives a momentum-integral formula; occurs in a single passage.

patterns.name: Membrane binding and induced signals
patterns.context: Describes a dye moving from an aqueous phase to a membrane-binding site and a substrate-induced signal; these words activate weakly, while the strongest point is elsewhere, on follows.

patterns.name: Characterization and material polymorphs
patterns.context: Reports material phase transitions, phase labels, and unidentified polymorphs at heat-treatment temperatures.

8_2399.concept: 专业科学文本中的方向与结构术语
8_2399.description: 激活覆盖物理与材料论文中的 z 轴/方向、二维平面、相变与有序结构，也涉及时间动力学、定向排列、哈密顿量公式；另见半导体专利及生物医学膜信号。模式多样，常落在专业复合术语和方向/结构表述上。

patterns.name: z 轴方向
patterns.context: 物理文本中描述方向、轴或相对于轴的磁化/自旋等；激活集中在 z 与后续 direction/axis 的组合。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、磁学与自旋物理

patterns.name: 二维平面
patterns.context: 以坐标分量和 Fermi 圆等几何对象描述二维动量空间；强激活在 plane。

patterns.name: 相变与有序状态
patterns.context: 讨论物质相、结构或磁性系统的有序/无序状态及其转变；激活落在相关术语及 transition、ordered 上。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、材料科学与统计物理

patterns.name: 器件与晶体管术语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍 Bi-CMOS 系统及其图示中的 n-channel MOS 晶体管。

patterns.name: 动力学时间与速率
patterns.context: 描述自旋极化衰减或生化信号随时间变化及其动力学规律。
patterns.domain: 物理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 定向排列与邻近结构
patterns.trigger: «along»«9» the«4» confined«4» step«5» edges»；«along»«9» their»4« orientation»
patterns.context: 粒子或分子沿特定方向、边缘或邻居排列、运动；突出 along 与取向/边缘的关联。

patterns.name: 模型哈密顿量表达
patterns.context: 理论论文中定义哈密顿量并给出动量积分公式；单段出现。

patterns.name: 膜结合与诱导信号
patterns.context: 描述染料从水相到膜结合位点，以及底物诱导信号；这些词激活较弱，主要强点另在 follows。

patterns.name: 表征与材料多晶型
patterns.context: 报告热处理温度下的材料相变、相标记和未鉴定多晶型。

en.description: Activations span within-word inflectional fragments in Estonian, LaTeX mathematical source code, and symbols and specialized terms in scientific texts from multiple fields; geographic and hydrological vocabulary also occurs. Trigger forms differ markedly across passages, with no stable shared semantics or single word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Estonian inflected word forms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within Estonian words, often at word endings or in fragments for participles, cases, possessives, and other inflections; no fixed sentence meaning is required.

patterns.name: LaTeX math and document markup
patterns.context: Activations occur near commands, mathematical formulas, and punctuation or structural markers in LaTeX source code.
patterns.domain: LaTeX mathematical typesetting source code in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Symbolic text in physics and mathematics
patterns.context: Theoretical physics papers discuss coordinate subscripts, compactification, tori, and periodic boundary conditions; activation includes symbols and related terms.

patterns.name: Terms related to fluids, vortices, and geometry
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of geometry on vortex-matter dynamics and describes magnetic-field direction and disk geometry.

patterns.name: Geographic and hydrological vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes rivers, valleys, river-channel courses, and floodplains; activation concentrates on geographic entities and geomorphological descriptions.

patterns.name: Materials chemistry terminology and phase-transition notation
patterns.context: Describes material transformation under heating, disordered variants, and polymorphs, with chemical formulas and Greek letters.

patterns.name: XRD instruments and experimental notation
patterns.context: Introduces X-ray diffraction measurements of biochar samples, including instrument model, radiation source, wavelength, and other experimental details.

8_2399.description: 激活横跨爱沙尼亚语词内屈折片段、LaTeX 数学源码，以及多领域科学文本中的符号和专业词；另见地理水文词汇。各段触发形式差异明显，未见稳定共同语义或单一词形模式。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语屈折词形与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在爱沙尼亚语单词内部，常见于词尾或分词、格、所有格等屈折片段；不要求固定句义。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与文档标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 源码中的命令、数学公式及其标点/结构标记附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 中的 LaTeX 数学排版源码

patterns.name: 物理与数学符号化文本
patterns.context: 理论物理论文中出现坐标下标、紧化、环面与周期边界等表述；激活包含符号及相关术语。

patterns.name: 流体、涡旋与几何相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论几何对涡旋物质动力学的影响，并描述磁场方向和圆盘几何。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/流体物理论文

patterns.name: 地理水文词汇
patterns.context: 描述河流、河谷、河道走向及洪泛平原；激活集中在地理实体和地貌叙述词。

patterns.name: 材料化学术语与相变记号
patterns.context: 描述加热条件下材料转化、无序变体及多晶型，并出现化学式/希腊字母。

patterns.name: XRD 仪器与实验记法
patterns.context: 介绍生物炭样品的 X 射线衍射测量，包含仪器型号、射线源和波长等实验细节。

en.description: Activations occur mainly on Finnish and Estonian word fragments in multilingual EuroParl corpora, especially Estonian ei; they also cover terminology in a magnetism paper and a passage describing XRD experiments, with no unified trigger feature established.

patterns.name: Estonian ei in syntax
patterns.context: Activation falls on the negation word ei, often followed by a verb or other predicate, as in ei saa, ei lähe, ei suuda, ei ole.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian political and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Finnish word endings and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in fragments of Finnish parliamentary speeches; trigger positions vary across examples and may relate to Finnish morphology or common grammatical words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Baltic-language parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Activations occur in segmented fragments of different words in Estonian parliamentary texts; some passages also contain ei, but the marked fragments are not always ei.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian political and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Magnetism and spin physics terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on word or symbol fragments related to spin, magnetic fields, or z-axis direction in physics papers.

patterns.name: X-ray diffraction experimental description
patterns.context: Activations occur in a sentence describing instruments and experimental conditions for biochar XRD measurements.

patterns.name: unexplained: Turkish parliamentary fragment
patterns.context: Unlike the other examples, this passage does not clearly appear to be Estonian or Finnish; its marked fragments also show no clear shared theme.

8_2399.concept: 多语种子词与科学术语
8_2399.description: 主要在多语种 EuroParl 语料的芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语词片段上激活，尤其见于爱沙尼亚语 ei；另覆盖磁学物理论文术语及一段 XRD 实验描述，尚无统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语句法中的 ei
patterns.trigger: «ei»（各段均在爱沙尼亚语段落中）
patterns.context: 激活落在否定词 ei 上；其后常接动词或其他谓语成分，如 ei saa、ei lähe、ei suuda、ei ole。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语政治议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词尾与语法片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在芬兰语议会发言的词片段中；各例触发位置并不一致，可能与芬兰语形态或常见语法词有关。

patterns.name: 波罗的海语言议会文本中的子词片段
patterns.context: 在爱沙尼亚语议会文本中激活于不同词的切分片段；其中若干段另有 ei，但这些被标记的片段不总是 ei。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语政治议会文本

patterns.name: 磁学与自旋物理术语
patterns.context: 激活落在物理论文中自旋、磁场或 z 轴方向相关的词或符号片段。

patterns.name: X 射线衍射实验描述
patterns.context: 激活出现在描述生物炭 XRD 测量仪器与实验条件的句子中。

patterns.name: unexplained: 土耳其语议会片段
patterns.context: 这一段不像其他例子那样明显属于爱沙尼亚语或芬兰语；标记片段也未显示清楚的共享主题。

en.description: Primarily responds to Finnish words beginning with kol- that relate to three or third; it also shows sporadic activation on local structures such as is, be, and in in English technical texts, as well as crystallographic terms and formula values.

patterns.name: Finnish words related to three/third
patterns.context: Finnish words begin with kol- and refer to Wednesday, third, or the number three; activation concentrates on the kol substring.

patterns.name: English copula is
patterns.context: Introduces a property, state, or passive description in a technical description.

patterns.name: English copula be
patterns.context: Follows the modal verb can to describe the arrangement state of liquid-crystal molecules.

patterns.name: Locative preposition in
patterns.context: In describing two non-aligned axes, in introduces an alignment phrase.

patterns.name: Crystallographic space group
patterns.context: A specialized term in a description of crystal structure.

patterns.name: Numerical and formula fragments
patterns.context: A crystallography paper contains unit-cell parameters, mathematical formulas, and units; activation is distributed across numbers and formula symbols.

8_2399.description: 主要响应芬兰语 kol- 开头的三/第三相关词；此外在英语技术文本中对 is、be、in 等局部结构，以及晶体学术语和公式数值出现零散激活。

patterns.name: 芬兰语三/第三相关词
patterns.context: 芬兰语词以 kol- 开头，涉及星期三、第三或数字三；激活集中在该词的 kol 子串。

patterns.name: 英语系词 is
patterns.context: 技术说明中以 is 引出属性、状态或被动描述。

patterns.name: 英语系词 be
patterns.context: 情态动词 can 后接 be，描述液晶分子的排列状态。

patterns.name: 方位介词 in
patterns.context: 描述两个轴线不对齐时，in 引出 alignment 短语。

patterns.name: 晶体学空间群
patterns.context: 晶体结构说明中的专业术语短语。

patterns.name: 数值与公式片段
patterns.context: 晶体学论文中出现晶胞参数、数学公式与单位；触发分散在数字和公式符号上。

en.concept: Geometric and parametric expressions in specialized texts
en.description: Patterns cover crystallographic parameters, patent descriptions of winding geometry, spatial/boundary conditions/symmetry/graphene/scattering and quantum-measurement descriptions in physics papers, and one passage of Estonian parliamentary text. Commonality is weak; the main overlap is specialized texts using symbols, geometric relations, and parameterized expressions.

patterns.name: Lattice constants and crystal-structure parameters
patterns.context: In crystallographic materials descriptions, point group/space group terms occur alongside unit-cell parameters; parameters often appear as letters, equals signs, numbers, and units such as Å and °, as well as volume V.
patterns.domain: Crystallography, materials science abstracts or papers

patterns.name: Coil winding direction and geometric relations
patterns.context: Describes helical winding of strip conductors in motor stator coils and states that the conductor's width direction is parallel to the axial direction.

patterns.name: Spatial positions in figure captions and multilayer systems
patterns.context: After image filenames and formatting parameters, the text turns to system components in a physics system and describes their relative positions along the z-axis.

patterns.name: Periodic boundaries, wave numbers, and complex-plane phase
patterns.context: Discusses the wave-number range under periodic boundary conditions and describes a complex exponential as moving along the unit circle in the complex plane.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics or mathematical physics papers

patterns.name: Within-word substrings in Estonian parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within consecutive Estonian words, with fragments involving the agenda, meetings, and weekday/date expressions; no clear cross-language general trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Relative rotation and translation in twisted bilayer graphene
patterns.context: Defines the relative rotation angle and rigid translation between two graphene layers and describes rotation around a specified point.

patterns.name: Symmetry representations and vibrational coordinates
patterns.context: After state-vector notation, discusses the symmetry and representation types of normal coordinates and conjugate momenta.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, group theory, or molecular vibration papers

patterns.name: Scattering experiment equipment and measurement parameters
patterns.context: Lists experimental instruments and sampling time, then gives the scattering-vector range.
patterns.domain: Experimental physics or materials characterization papers

patterns.name: Angular parameters and equatorial plane in a quantum measurement setup
patterns.context: In a quantum framework, parameterizes a local setting with a single angle and constrains observable vectors to the equatorial plane.
patterns.domain: Quantum information or quantum physics papers

8_2399.concept: 专业文本中的几何与参数表达
8_2399.description: 模式涵盖晶体学参数、专利绕线几何、物理论文中的空间/边界条件/对称性/石墨烯/散射与量子测量描述，以及一段爱沙尼亚语议会文本；共同点较弱，主要是专业文本中的符号、几何关系和参数化表达。

patterns.name: 晶格常数与晶体结构参数
patterns.trigger: “lattice symmetry and the space group”“lattice parameters”；以及“a=”“b=”“c=”“α=”“β=”“γ=”“V=”等
patterns.context: 晶体学材料描述中，点群/空间群与晶胞参数相邻出现；参数常以字母、等号、数值及单位 Å、°、体积 V 呈现。
patterns.domain: 晶体学、材料科学摘要或论文

patterns.name: 线圈绕线方向与几何关系
patterns.context: 描述电机定子线圈中带状导线的螺旋绕制，并说明导线宽度方向与轴向平行。

patterns.name: 图注及多层系统的空间位置
patterns.context: 图像文件名和排版参数后，转入物理系统组成及其上下层在 z 轴上的位置说明。

patterns.name: 周期边界、波数与复平面相位
patterns.context: 讨论周期边界下的波数范围，并将复指数描述为沿复平面单位圆运动。
patterns.domain: 理论物理或数学物理论文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本中的词内子串
patterns.context: 激活分布在爱沙尼亚语连续词的内部，片段涉及议程、会议及星期/日期表达；未见明显的跨语言通用触发词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 扭转双层石墨烯的相对旋转与平移
patterns.trigger: “twisted graphene bilayer”“symmetry axes”“rotation”“angle θ”“rigid translation Δ”“point r₀”
patterns.context: 定义双层石墨烯两层之间的相对转角和刚性平移，并说明绕指定点旋转。

patterns.name: 对称表示与振动坐标
patterns.context: 在态矢量记号之后讨论正规坐标和共轭动量的对称性及表示类型。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、群论或分子振动论文

patterns.name: 散射实验设备与测量参数
patterns.trigger: “photomultiplier”“PC-controlled 256 channel Malvern correlator”“sample times”“scattering vector q”
patterns.context: 列举实验仪器及采样时间，随后给出散射矢量范围。
patterns.domain: 实验物理或材料表征论文

patterns.name: 量子测量设置的角参数与赤道面
patterns.context: 在量子图景下将局部设置参数化为单一角度，并限制可观测向量位于赤道面。
patterns.domain: 量子信息或量子物理论文

en.description: Activations span Finnish parliamentary texts, patents, and physics papers. Trigger points involve Finnish kol fragments, English relational words/angle phrases, and formulas, numbers, and figure-caption formatting; there is no evident unified lexical meaning or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Finnish morpheme fragment kol
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous Finnish text, especially within sentences; kol can be part of a Finnish word, but trigger positions and full word forms vary

patterns.name: is in technical English
patterns.context: In a patent background section, describes the relation between the width direction of strip material in a coil and its axial direction; adjacent words are “direction is parallel”

patterns.name: Numerical fragments in lattice parameters
patterns.context: Occurs after the numerical value of lattice parameter a in a parenthesized expression; the surrounding text contains crystallographic symbols and mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Equals sign in a geometric formula
