patterns.context: In an expression for the value of θ, an equals sign is followed by LaTeX mathematical symbols and an angle

patterns.name: Angle-value phrase
patterns.context: The angular deflection range of a MEMS optical scanner is expressed as “several tens of degrees”

patterns.name: Order-of-magnitude expression
patterns.context: The number of stations in an antenna array is given by the approximate mathematical expression “$\sim50$”

patterns.name: Coordinate transformation relation
patterns.context: Describes a layer rotating around a point and maps coordinates in a fixed layer to a position; contains vector and coordinate-transformation symbols

patterns.name: Fitting parameter values in figure captions
patterns.context: A figure caption compares δJT values for Sr-rich and Ca-rich regions, with values given in parentheses

8_2399.description: 激活横跨芬兰语议会文本、专利及物理论文，触发点分别涉及芬兰语 kol 片段、英语关系词/角度短语，以及公式、数值和图注格式；没有显然统一的词义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 芬兰语的词素片段 kol
patterns.trigger: «kol»10（1）、«kol»9（6、9）；同段还见 «pä»、«ev»、«ve»、«el» 等芬兰语片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语连续文本中，尤其在句子内部；kol 可是芬兰语词语的组成片段，但触发位置和完整词形各异

patterns.name: 技术英语中的 is
patterns.context: 处于专利背景段，对线圈中带状材料的宽度方向与轴向方向作关系说明；相邻词为 “direction is parallel”

patterns.name: 晶格参数中的数值片段
patterns.context: 括号内数值表达式中，出现在晶格参数 a 的数值之后；周围含晶体学符号和数学排版

patterns.name: 几何公式中的等号
patterns.context: 公式里 θ 的取值表达式中，等号后接 LaTeX 数学符号与角度

patterns.name: 角度数值短语
patterns.context: MEMS 光学扫描器的角偏转幅度以“several tens of degrees”表述

patterns.name: 数量级表达式
patterns.context: 天线阵列的站数以近似数学表达式“$\sim50$”给出

patterns.name: 坐标变换关系词
patterns.context: 描述一层绕某点旋转，并将固定层中的坐标映射至位置；含向量与坐标变换符号

patterns.name: 图注中的拟合参数数值
patterns.context: 图注中比较 Sr-rich 与 Ca-rich 区域的 δJT 数值，数值以括号标注

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical abstracts, emails, encyclopedia entries about people and works, and Lithuanian text. More prominent local features include personal names, medical terms, and “Other”; there is no unified, stable lexical or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: New Patient-Reported Outcome Measure
patterns.context: Introduces a new measurement tool in a medical paper abstract and mentions assessing perceived impairment.

patterns.name: Traditional Herbal Uses and Phytochemistry
patterns.context: Discusses traditional medicinal use and phytochemistry after a plant genus name.

patterns.name: Contact Name and Information
patterns.context: Email body contains a fax number, an instruction to contact someone, and information about a Singapore colleague.

patterns.name: Person-Name Entry
patterns.context: Name heading at the start of an encyclopedia entry, followed by another form of the name.

patterns.name: RHOA in a Protein Name
patterns.context: Appears in a cell biology abstract in the context of ubiquitin ligase, actin cytoskeleton, and cell migration.

patterns.name: Pelvis and Pelvic Cavity
patterns.context: Calls for careful evaluation of the pelvis in a cervical cancer imaging discussion.

patterns.name: Name and Athlete Profile
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entry heading and body introducing a Turkish middle-distance runner.

patterns.name: Name and Figure Skating Profile
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entry heading and body introducing an Italian ice dancer and their partner.

patterns.name: Other in a Film or TV Title
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entry lists a production company and works, with Other in a title.

patterns.name: Lithuanian Word Form or Name
patterns.context: Lithuanian text containing a title-like phrase, a name, and following words; the activation correspondence is unclear.

8_2644.concept: none
8_2644.description: 激活分散于医学摘要、邮件、百科人物及作品条目、立陶宛语文本；较突出的局部包括人名、医学术语和“Other”，没有统一稳定的词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: New Patient-Reported Outcome Measure
patterns.context: 医学论文摘要中介绍新测量工具，并提到评估感知障碍。

patterns.name: 草药传统用途与植物化学
patterns.context: 植物属名后讨论传统药用及 phytochemistry。

patterns.name: 联系人姓名与联络信息
patterns.context: 邮件正文含传真号码、请联系某人的指示及新加坡同事信息。

patterns.name: 人物姓名条目
patterns.context: 百科条目开头的姓名标题，后接另一姓名形式。

patterns.name: 蛋白质名称中的 RHOA
patterns.context: 细胞生物学摘要中，出现在 ubiquitin ligase、actin cytoskeleton 和 cell migration 语境。

patterns.name: 骨盆及盆腔
patterns.context: 宫颈癌影像学讨论中，要求仔细评估骨盆。

patterns.name: 姓名及体育人物简介
patterns.context: 百科人物条目标题及正文，介绍土耳其中长跑运动员。

patterns.name: 姓名及花样滑冰简介
patterns.context: 百科人物条目标题及正文，介绍意大利冰舞选手及搭档。

patterns.name: 影视作品标题中的 Other
patterns.context: 百科条目列出制作公司与作品项目，标题中含 Other。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词形或姓名
patterns.context: 立陶宛语文本，含标题式短语、姓名及后续词语；激活对应关系不明。

en.description: Activations occur across various proper names, titles, and technical word fragments: plant/species names, coined terms containing mim, outcome measures, legal titles and rule numbers, woven, Apple, and name fragments; there is no obvious unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Drim Health-Related Plant Name
patterns.context: Plant name appears in a title about traditional medicinal use and phytochemical research.

patterns.name: Biomaterial Term Containing “mim”
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “Bio-mimetically synthesized”; strong activation focuses on the intra-word fragment “mim”.

patterns.name: Patient-Reported Outcome Measure
patterns.context: In the title phrase “patient-reported outcome measure,” the outcome measure is used to assess impairment.

patterns.name: Word Ending in a Species Latin Name
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the species name “Alistipes onderdonkii”; the species name is repeated in the passage.

patterns.name: Legal Document Title and Rule Number
patterns.context: Fixed title and rule citation in an Indiana Court of Appeals memorandum decision; activation occurs at the title and rule number.

patterns.name: “woven” in an Engineering Materials Term
patterns.context: In the engineering materials name “Non-woven geotextile,” activation focuses on an intra-word fragment of woven.

patterns.name: Apple Possessive and Evaluation of Apple
patterns.context: Discusses Apple’s security responsibilities and brand position; both occurrences of Apple activate.

patterns.name: Name Spelling Fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the person’s name Dennis Drayna.

8_2644.concept: 专名与术语片段
8_2644.description: 激活分布于多种专名、标题和技术词片段：植物/物种名、含 mim 的合成术语、结局指标、法律标题与规则编号、woven、Apple 及人名片段；没有明显统一语义类别。

patterns.name: Drim 健康相关植物名
patterns.context: 植物名出现在传统医学用途、植物化学研究的标题中。

patterns.name: 含“mim”片段的生物材料术语
patterns.context: 出现在“Bio-mimetically synthesized”这一材料合成表述中；强激活集中于词内片段“mim”。

patterns.name: 患者报告结局指标
patterns.context: “patient-reported outcome measure”标题中，结局指标用于评估障碍。

patterns.name: 物种拉丁名中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在物种名“Alistipes onderdonkii”末尾，段内物种名重复。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与规则编号
patterns.context: 印第安纳州上诉法院备忘录裁决的固定标题及规则引用；标题、规则编号处激活。

patterns.name: 工程材料术语中的“woven”
patterns.context: “Non-woven geotextile”这一工程材料名称中，激活集中在 woven 的词内片段。

patterns.name: Apple 所有格及对 Apple 的评价
patterns.context: 讨论 Apple 的安全责任与品牌立场；Apple 两次出现均激活。

patterns.name: 人名拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名 Dennis Drayna 中。

en.concept: Single quotes and code line-start markers
en.description: The most stable trigger is a single quote, often at the start of a source line in 'use strict', and also in titles, proper names, and copyright comments. Other activations are scattered across code errors, Markdown links, and discussions involving face and exclusion.

patterns.name: Single Quote Followed by Code Prologue
patterns.context: A single quote appears at the start of code or a code line, followed by the JavaScript 'use strict' directive, semicolons, newlines, variable declarations, and similar code.

patterns.name: Single-Quoted Title or Name
patterns.context: A title-like text or name follows an opening quote; the quote may then close before a newline. The code directive is not required.

patterns.name: Single-Quote-Started Copyright Comment
patterns.context: A comment-style copyright notice at the start of source code, followed by a year, organization name, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Question-Mark Marker in a Swift Operator Error Example
patterns.context: Code comments or compiler-error examples discuss operator precedence and ambiguous declarations; strong activation is concentrated around “ambiguous operator declarations” in the error message.
patterns.domain: Github source code and compiler error examples

patterns.name: Markers Near Markdown Links and Newlines
patterns.context: Web discussions contain Markdown links, horizontal rules, or line breaks; the word face also appears independently later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Discussion of Exclusion and Face
patterns.context: Discusses certain groups facing similar problems and exclusion related to appearance or identity; connected to the preceding off-camera creator topic.

8_2644.concept: 单引号及代码行首标记
8_2644.description: 最稳定的触发点是单引号，常见于源码行首的'use strict'，也见于标题、专名和版权注释。其余激活分散在代码错误、Markdown链接及涉及face与排斥的讨论中。

patterns.name: 单引号及其后的代码序言
patterns.context: 单引号出现在代码开头或代码行开头，后接 JavaScript 的 'use strict' 指令及分号、换行和变量声明等。

patterns.name: 单引号包围的标题或名称
patterns.trigger: «'»，以及附近的 «'»；引号内为标题或专名
patterns.context: 引号开启后出现标题式文本或名称，之后可闭合引号并换行；不要求出现代码指令。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、医学相关文本

patterns.name: 单引号开启的版权注释
patterns.context: 源码开头的注释式版权声明，后接年份、组织名称和标点。

patterns.name: Swift 运算符错误示例中的问号标记
patterns.context: 代码注释或编译错误示例，讨论运算符优先级与歧义声明；强激活主要落在错误消息中“ambiguous operator declarations”一带。
patterns.domain: Github 源码及编译器错误示例

patterns.name: Markdown 链接与换行附近的标记
patterns.context: 网页讨论中出现 Markdown 链接、分隔线或换行；同段后部还出现独立的 face 词。

patterns.name: 关于被排斥与 face 的讨论
patterns.context: 讨论某些群体遭遇相似问题、外貌或身份相关的排斥；与前面的 off-camera creator 话题相连。

en.description: The most prominent stable cue is the string fragment “ AL”, found in different word forms such as ALDE, ALD, ALK7, and ALAN; it also responds strongly to single quotes at the start of code or quotations, alongside a few domain-specific fragments.

patterns.name: “AL” Character Fragment
patterns.context: An AL-initial string occurs at a word boundary or inside a word; it may be followed by D, DE, AN, or K7, with the activation marker on the tokenized “AL” fragment.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, medical papers, court opinions, technical documents

patterns.name: Single Quote and Following Code String
patterns.context: A single quote occurs at the beginning of a string or code fragment, followed by the use strict directive or a poem title; the following content may also be marked.

patterns.name: Program Exit Status Description
patterns.context: Appears in document fragments describing command execution results, error output, and manual cross-references.

patterns.name: Legal Opinion Signature Format
patterns.context: After the decision and court name, a judge’s name appears in all caps or in a spaced-name typographic format.

patterns.name: ALD Disease Name in Medicine
patterns.context: When discussing severe liver disease, disease progression, circadian rhythm disruption, and research protocols, the AL fragment in the abbreviation ALD is marked.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts / NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: ALK7 Receptor Abbreviation
patterns.context: ALK7 is split and marked in a medical abstract discussing diabetic cardiomyopathy and the role of the ALK7 receptor.

patterns.name: ALDE Political Group Name
patterns.context: The name ALDE Group is split and marked in a European Parliament speech, signature, or group-representation context.

patterns.name: Single Quote in a Poem Title
patterns.context: An email quotes a poem title or the beginning of a poem; the single quote is followed by Twas.

patterns.name: Single Quote in a Copyright Header
patterns.context: A source file’s copyright declaration begins with a single quote, immediately followed by Copyright and a year.

patterns.name: JavaScript Strict Mode Directive
patterns.context: A string directive at the start of a JavaScript file, often followed by a newline and variable declaration or comment.

8_2644.concept: 字符级片段与引号边界
8_2644.description: 激活最突出的稳定线索是字符串片段“ AL”，见于 ALDE、ALD、ALK7、ALAN 等不同词形；另对代码或引文开头的单引号有强响应，并出现少数领域特定片段。

patterns.name: “AL”字符片段
patterns.context: 在单词边界或词内部遇到以 AL 开始的字符串；后续可接 D、DE、AN，也可接 K7，激活标记落在分词后的“AL”片段上。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、医学论文、判决书、技术文档

patterns.name: 单引号及其后续代码字符串
patterns.context: 单引号位于字符串或代码片段起始处，后面接 use strict 指令，或诗句标题；单引号后续内容也可能被标记。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 代码、邮件中的诗句

patterns.name: 程序退出状态说明
patterns.context: 出现在描述命令执行结果、错误输出及手册交叉引用的文档片段中。
patterns.domain: 软件文档 / Unix 手册页

patterns.name: 法律判决书署名格式
patterns.context: 判决结果与法院名称之后，出现法官姓名的全大写或分词姓名排印格式。

patterns.name: 医学中的 ALD 疾病名称
patterns.context: 讨论严重肝病、疾病进展、昼夜节律紊乱及研究方案时，ALD 缩写中的 AL 片段被标记。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要 / NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: ALK7 受体缩写
patterns.context: 讨论糖尿病心肌病及 ALK7 受体作用的医学摘要中，ALK7 被拆分标记。

patterns.name: ALDE 政治团体名称
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言的署名或代表团体场景中，ALDE Group 名称被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 诗句标题中的单引号
patterns.context: 邮件正文引用诗歌标题或诗句开头，单引号后接 Twas。

patterns.name: 版权头中的单引号
patterns.context: 源码文件的版权声明开头，单引号后紧跟 Copyright 和年份。

patterns.name: JavaScript 严格模式指令
patterns.context: JavaScript 文件开头的字符串指令，之后常有换行及变量声明或注释。

en.description: Strong patterns center on reader-directed “You/you” instructions, modal verbs, and technical explanations, especially license terms written as // comments at the start of source files. Other contexts include research abstracts, nursing studies, brand copy, and 3D rendering.

patterns.name: License Code Comment
patterns.context: License declaration at the beginning of a source file; recurring fixed phrasing and comment lines

patterns.name: Second-Person Instructions in Code Comments
patterns.context: Comments in source code beginning with // state license terms, permissions, or operational requirements for readers

patterns.name: Code Comment Line Markers
patterns.context: Consecutive comment lines at the beginning of a source file; often adjacent to copyright or license text

patterns.name: Second-Person “You”
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a sentence or in an instruction, followed by modal or auxiliary verbs such as need, must, may, or can; need not be a code comment

patterns.name: Obligation or Advice After a Modal Verb
patterns.context: Second person addresses the reader with a requirement, permission, or recommendation
patterns.domain: Email operating instructions, source code licenses, web copy, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Data, Network, and Migration Instructions
patterns.context: Asks the recipient to save and send information, subject to network connectivity

patterns.name: Purpose and Mechanism in a Scientific Research Abstract
patterns.context: States research aims, regulatory mechanisms, and animal models

patterns.name: Perceptions and Experiences in Nursing Research
patterns.context: Summarizes a study through its participants and their perceptions and experiences of a topic

patterns.name: Trademark and Brand Protection Copy
patterns.context: Promotional question about online brand protection services and naming

patterns.name: Code Debugging Instructions in Technical Q&A
patterns.context: Explains function parameters and an array reference problem, offering advice with “You need”

patterns.name: Graphics Rendering and Reflection Description
patterns.context: Describes glass materials, light reflections, and rendering settings; no obvious primary trigger phrase

8_2644.concept: 面向读者的说明与指令
8_2644.description: 强模式集中于面向读者的“You/you”指令、情态词及技术说明，尤其是源码头部以//写出的许可证条款；另见科研摘要、护理研究、品牌文案和3D渲染等独立语境。

patterns.name: 许可证代码注释
patterns.trigger: “Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");”以及“you may not use this file except in compliance with the License”“You may obtain a copy of the License”
patterns.context: 源码文件头部的许可证声明；反复出现的固定句式和注释行
patterns.domain: Github 源码/法律许可文本

patterns.name: 代码注释中的第二人称指令
patterns.trigger: “// you may not use this file”“// You may obtain a copy”“// You can redistribute it”
patterns.context: 以 // 开头的源代码注释中，向读者陈述许可、权限或操作要求

patterns.name: 代码注释行标记
patterns.context: 源码文件头部的连续注释行；常与版权或许可证文本相邻

patterns.name: 第二人称“You”
patterns.context: 出现在句首或指令句中，后接 need、must、may、can 等情态/助动词；不要求是代码注释
patterns.domain: 操作说明、问答、许可文本

patterns.name: 情态词后的义务或建议
patterns.trigger: “You need to”“You must be”“You may not”“You may obtain”“You can”
patterns.context: 第二人称对读者提出要求、许可或建议
patterns.domain: 邮件操作说明、源码许可、网页文案、技术问答

patterns.name: 数据、网络与迁移操作说明
patterns.trigger: “Save My Data”“send us your pre-migration information”“connected to the network”
patterns.context: 要求收件人保存并发送信息，且满足联网条件
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件/系统迁移说明

patterns.name: 科学研究摘要中的目的与机制
patterns.trigger: “The primary objective of this proposal is to investigate”“mechanisms”“development”“Mice with mutations”
patterns.context: 陈述研究目标、调控机制及动物模型
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究提案

patterns.name: 护理研究中的感知与经验
patterns.trigger: “A study of practising nurses' perceptions and experiences of intimacy”
patterns.context: 以研究对象及其对某主题的感知、经验概述研究

patterns.name: 商标与品牌保护文案
patterns.context: 围绕线上品牌保护服务及命名展开的宣传式提问

patterns.name: 技术问答中的代码调试指令
patterns.trigger: “Then, your .addScores() function doesn't accept a parameter. You need some reference”
patterns.context: 解释函数参数及数组引用问题，以“You need”给出建议

patterns.name: 图形渲染与反射描述
patterns.context: 描述玻璃材质、灯光反射及渲染设置；未见明显的主要触发短语

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: cancellation fee percentages, market gain/loss comparisons, game and player narratives, Q&A answers and code, debt records, and employer inquiries. Commonality is weak; activations mostly concern local content words and numbers, labels, or structural markers.

patterns.name: Rate/Quantity Threshold
patterns.context: Numeric amounts or percentages appear alongside tier conditions to describe fee percentages based on cancellation time

patterns.name: Market Gain/Loss Comparison
patterns.context: Market or trading coverage contrasts winners and losers and reports a difference

patterns.name: Game/Player-Related Narrative
patterns.context: Text about game rules, gameplay, role-playing, or player behavior; also includes basketball free-throw terminology
patterns.domain: Gaming Q&A, game descriptions, sports game instructions

patterns.name: Answer Markers in Code Q&A
patterns.context: Q&A answers or code snippets involving programming explanations, game-over logic, and interface messages

patterns.name: Employment Records/Debt Registration
patterns.context: Discusses the consequences of a borrower’s record being registered and checked by prospective employers

8_2644.concept: none
8_2644.description: 激活散布于多类文本：取消收费比例、市场涨跌对比、游戏与玩家叙述、问答回答及代码、债务记录与雇主查询。共同点较弱，主要是局部内容词和数字、标签或结构标记。

patterns.name: 费率/数量阈值
patterns.context: 数字金额或百分比与分段条件并列，描述取消时间对应的收费比例

patterns.name: 市场输赢对比
patterns.context: 在市场或交易行情报道中，用 winners/losers 对照并报告差额

patterns.name: 游戏/玩家相关叙述
patterns.trigger: « group»2…« gab»…« game»；« game»5；« players»9；« RPG»；« Flash»；« free» throws»
patterns.context: 游戏规则、游戏体验、角色扮演或玩家行为相关文本；也包括篮球罚球术语
patterns.domain: 游戏问答、游戏介绍、体育游戏说明

patterns.name: 代码问答中的回答标记
patterns.context: 问答回答或代码片段，涉及编程解释、游戏结束逻辑与界面消息

patterns.name: 雇佣记录/债务登记
patterns.context: 讨论借款人记录被登记并由潜在雇主查询的后果

en.description: Primarily responds to formal copyright, open-source licenses, and software distribution terms, while also covering package dependency errors, code matrix examples, medical and research project descriptions, patent diagnostic discussions, and correspondence headers and republication notices; commonality is weak.

patterns.name: License and Copyright Text
patterns.context: Licenses, copyright notices, and license terms in legal or code repository files; often accompanied by fixed formal wording.
patterns.domain: Open-source software, legal texts, code comments

patterns.name: Software Distribution Disclaimer
patterns.context: A license clause stating that software is distributed under certain conditions but without warranty.

patterns.name: Package Dependency Error Report
patterns.context: Package manager output diagnosing unmet dependencies or missing packages.

patterns.name: Matrix Construction in Code
patterns.context: Code example in a StackExchange answer containing a matrix constructor and its arguments.

patterns.name: Risks During the Transition Period for Adolescent Diabetes
patterns.context: Discusses the challenges and risks of adolescents gradually taking responsibility for diabetes management and of developmental changes.

patterns.name: Undergraduate Research Training Program
patterns.context: Describes a summer research training program, student follow-up, and continued participation or applications for further study.

patterns.name: Entity Diagnosis and Associative Knowledge
patterns.context: Discusses limitations of entity diagnosis methods and knowledge of associations between faulty components and symptoms.
patterns.domain: Patent background, diagnostics and knowledge representation

patterns.name: Technical Correspondence Layout and Copyright Notice
patterns.context: Headers, sections, and copyright/republication notices in correspondence or investment publications.

8_2644.concept: 正式技术文档与声明文本
8_2644.description: 主要响应正式版权、开源许可证及软件分发条款，也覆盖包依赖错误、代码矩阵示例、医学和科研项目说明、专利诊断论述，以及通讯页眉与转载声明；共同线索较弱。

patterns.name: 许可证与版权文本
patterns.trigger: “General Public License”“GNU Affero General Public License”“Copyright”“Redistribution”
patterns.context: 法律或代码仓库文件中的许可证、版权声明及许可条款；常伴随正式固定措辞。
patterns.domain: 开源软件、法律文本、代码注释

patterns.name: 程序分发免责声明
patterns.trigger: “This program is distributed in the hope”
patterns.context: 许可证正文中说明软件按某种条件分发、但不作保证的条款。

patterns.name: 包依赖错误报告
patterns.context: 软件包管理器输出依赖未满足或包缺失等诊断信息。
patterns.domain: 技术支持、命令行错误信息

patterns.name: 代码中的矩阵构造
patterns.context: StackExchange 问答中的代码示例，包含矩阵构造函数及参数。

patterns.name: 青少年糖尿病过渡期风险
patterns.context: 讨论青少年逐步承担糖尿病管理责任及发展变化带来的挑战与风险。

patterns.name: 本科生科研培训项目
patterns.context: 描述暑期科研培训项目、学员跟踪及继续参加或申请深造。

patterns.name: 实体诊断与关联知识
patterns.trigger: “entities to be diagnosed”“associations between malfunctioning parts”“symptoms”
patterns.context: 讨论实体诊断方法及故障部件与症状之间关联知识的局限。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、诊断与知识表示

patterns.name: 技术通讯版式与版权提示
patterns.trigger: “Monthly”“February 2002 Edition”“Stock Investing Section”“Redistribution in any form”
patterns.context: 通讯或投资刊物的页眉、栏目及版权/转载声明。

en.concept: Numbers and separators in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to numeric timestamps with seconds and their punctuation, especially in emails, logs, and file metadata; other activations occur around legal document terms and citations, code identifiers, bracket-character questions, and one email containing scripture.

patterns.name: Seconds in Timestamps
patterns.context: Occurs in timestamps or log times; seconds and adjacent time punctuation activate prominently. Some date and time digits also activate
patterns.domain: Email headers, logs, web metadata, court document timestamps

patterns.name: Legal Document Formatting and Citations
patterns.context: Activates near document titles, legal terms, and citation formats in legal opinions or court documents; no complete trigger condition shared with timestamps is apparent

patterns.name: Split Word Forms in Code Identifiers
patterns.context: Activates near subword boundaries in identifiers in code or runtime logs, especially camel-case words and numeric parameters

patterns.name: Question About Brackets and Character Counts
patterns.context: A question describes conditions on brackets and the number of characters inside them in a file; activation occurs on the question format and related word fragments

patterns.name: Email Header Fields and Separators
patterns.context: In forwarded emails or email headers, sender, recipient, date/time, and separators appear together; some fields and time digits activate

patterns.name: Religious Words and Ambiguous Fragments
patterns.context: Email body mentions scripture or religious content; activations are distributed over several words and scripture numbers and cannot be explained by the timestamp pattern

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与分隔符
8_2644.description: 主要响应带秒数的数字时间戳及其标点，在邮件、日志和文件元数据中尤明显；另见法律文书术语与引文、代码标识符、括号字符问题，以及一处经文邮件内容。

patterns.name: 时间戳中的秒数
patterns.trigger: 时间字段中秒数前的冒号及秒数字段，如「:24」「:21」「:39」「:31」「:26」「:07」「:23」；常伴随小数秒或 AM/PM
patterns.context: 出现在时间戳或日志时间中，秒数及其相邻时间标点有显著激活；部分日期、时间数字也激活
patterns.domain: 邮件头、日志、网页元数据、法院文件时间戳

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与引文
patterns.trigger: 「MEMORANDUM DECISION」「Appellate Rule 65(D)」「statutory range」「abuse of discretion」「380 S.W.3d 682」
patterns.context: 法律判决正文或法院文件中，文书标题、法律术语和引证格式附近激活；未见与时间戳相同的完整触发条件

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的拆分词形
patterns.context: 代码或运行日志中，标识符的子词边界附近激活，尤其大小写拼接词与数字参数
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Android 代码/日志

patterns.name: 括号与字符数量问题
patterns.trigger: 「fewer than 5 and more than 10」「characters inside parenthesis」「pairs of ( and )」
patterns.context: 提问描述文件中括号及括号内字符数条件；激活落在提问格式和相关词片段上

patterns.name: 邮件头字段及分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件转发或邮件头中，发件人、收件人、日期时间与分隔线相邻；部分字段和时间数字激活

patterns.name: 宗教词语与含混片段
patterns.context: 邮件正文提及经文或宗教内容；激活分布在若干词和经文数字上，无法由时间戳模式解释

en.description: Activations are scattered across hostnames, build markers, code explanations, and logs; the most recurrent local cue is a date-time timestamp, especially hours, minutes, seconds, and AM/PM in email headers and error/runtime logs.

patterns.name: Hostname and Subdomain
patterns.context: When asking about or listing DNS, hostnames, or similar domain strings, activation falls on host and adjacent domain fragments

patterns.name: Generated Code File Header and Timestamp
patterns.context: A generated PHP language pack file header contains a date-time and return array

patterns.name: Flavor and Class in Build Configuration
patterns.context: Discusses whether different build variants include a class; activation focuses on flavor and Release/Debug markers

patterns.name: Timestamp in an Error Report
patterns.context: A date and time precise to the second appear after an error description, followed by a Java class name

patterns.name: General Connective in a Code Explanation
patterns.context: Explains how arrays are swapped in a loop; isolated activation occurs on natural-language demonstratives, without a specialized code trigger shared with other examples

patterns.name: Email Date-Time and Header
patterns.context: A timestamp appears in a quoted or forwarded email header, adjacent to the sender’s name, address, and To field

patterns.name: Time in a Quoted Email Header
patterns.context: A short reply is followed by the sender and date-time header of a quoted email

patterns.name: Email Sent-Time Header
patterns.context: Standard email header with hours and minutes after the date

patterns.name: Time in a Quoted Email Header
patterns.context: A quoted sender, date-time, and recipient fields appear after an email separator

patterns.name: Log Time and Server Address
patterns.context: When reporting application runtime information or an error, includes a local admin console URL and timestamp

8_2644.concept: 时间戳与技术标记
8_2644.description: 激活分散在主机名、构建标记、代码说明及日志中；最反复的局部线索是日期时间戳，尤其邮件头和错误/运行日志里的小时、分钟、秒与 AM/PM。

patterns.name: 主机名及子域名
patterns.context: 在询问或列举 DNS、主机名或类似域名字符串时，激活落在 host 及相邻的域名片段

patterns.name: 生成代码文件头与时间戳
patterns.trigger: PHP 注释头中的 «Generated»、«localization»、«missing»，以及时间字段中的 «05»«:»«24»
patterns.context: 生成的 PHP 语言包文件头包含日期时间和 return array

patterns.name: 构建配置中的 flavor 与类
patterns.context: 讨论不同构建变体是否包含某个类；激活集中于 flavor 和 Release/Debug 标记

patterns.name: 错误报告中的时间戳
patterns.context: 错误描述之后出现日期和精确到秒的时间，后接 Java 类名

patterns.name: 代码解释中的泛指连接词
patterns.context: 解释数组在循环中的交换方式；孤立激活于自然语言指示词，缺乏与其他段一致的专门代码触发模式

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间与邮件头
patterns.context: 邮件引用或转发头中出现时间戳，邻接发件人姓名、地址及 To 字段

patterns.name: 邮件引用头中的时间
patterns.context: 简短回复后附带被引用邮件的发件人和日期时间头

patterns.name: 邮件发送头时间
patterns.context: 标准邮件头，日期后包含小时与分钟

patterns.name: 邮件引用头中的时间
patterns.context: 邮件分隔线后出现引用发件人、日期时间及收件人字段

patterns.name: 日志时间与服务器地址
patterns.context: 报告应用运行信息或错误时，包含本地管理控制台 URL 和时间戳

en.description: Activations occur at field boundaries and formatting fragments across various structured texts: code identifiers and declarations, legal docket metadata and citations, medical tables, license wording, forum comparison sentences, escaped newlines, and character encoding tables. Trigger forms vary, with no single meaning spanning all examples.

patterns.name: Structured Fields of Numbers, Identifiers, and Punctuation
patterns.context: In code identifiers, case numbers, dates, page numbers, citation numbers, or character encodings, numbers and short letter strings are joined by formatting; activation often falls on numbers, letters, or punctuation within fields
patterns.domain: Code, legal documents, character tables, and structured text

patterns.name: Legal Document Layout and Metadata
patterns.context: Fixed-format fields such as titles, judge lists, docket numbers, and dates on court opinions or docket front pages

patterns.name: Category Labels and Numeric Formats in Tables
patterns.context: In table rows and columns, category labels appear alongside counts, percentages, or missing-data states

patterns.name: Code Comments and License Text
patterns.context: Fixed legal wording formatted with asterisks and newlines in license comments
patterns.domain: Github source code and license text

patterns.name: Comparative Language in Developer Discussions
patterns.context: Forum comments compare development platforms and give reasons such as freedom, openness, or ease of testing

patterns.name: Declaration and Assignment Starts in Code Blocks
patterns.context: Formal or domain-specific language code declares function inputs and outputs, then enters an algorithm block

patterns.name: String Escapes and Newline Representations
patterns.context: Escape sequences represent carriage returns and newlines in code string literals

patterns.name: Residual Triggers Not Clearly Characterized
patterns.context: Beyond identifiable code fields and escape sequences, the available examples are insufficient to determine the specific trigger conditions for these activations

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的格式片段
8_2644.description: 激活出现在多种结构化文本的字段边界与格式化片段中：代码标识符和声明、法律案卷元数据及引文、医学表格、许可证措辞、论坛比较句、转义换行和字符编码表。触发形式多样，未见单一词义贯穿所有片段。

patterns.name: 数字、编号与标点分隔的结构化字段
patterns.context: 代码标识符、案件编号、日期、页码、引文数字或字符编码中，数字和短字母串按格式拼接；激活常落在字段中的数字、字母或标点上
patterns.domain: 代码、法律文书、字符表及结构化文本

patterns.name: 法律文书的版式与元数据
patterns.context: 法院意见或案卷首页的标题、法官名单、案号和日期等固定版式字段

patterns.name: 表格中的分类标签及数值格式
patterns.context: 表格行列中，分类标签与人数、百分比或缺失状态并列

patterns.name: 代码注释与许可证文本
patterns.context: 许可证注释中以星号和换行排版的固定法律措辞
patterns.domain: Github 源码及许可证文本

patterns.name: 开发者讨论中的比较表达
patterns.context: 论坛评论中比较开发平台，并给出自由、开放或易于测试等理由

patterns.name: 程序块中的声明与赋值起始
patterns.context: 形式化或领域特定语言代码中，函数签名声明输入输出，随后进入 algorithm 块

patterns.name: 字符串转义与换行表示
patterns.context: 代码字符串字面量中以转义序列表示回车和换行

patterns.name: 未能明确归纳的残余触发
patterns.trigger: [1] 中局部标记的空格与 token 边界，以及 [2] 中 Java 字节码片段的其他标记
patterns.context: 除可识别的代码字段、转义序列外，现有片段不足以确定这些激活的具体触发条件

en.concept: Document formats and legal email text
en.description: Activations occur mainly in Enron email signatures, forwarded-message headers, and brief polite or collaborative expressions; there is also interpretive discussion and case citations in legal opinions. Fragment 1 also contains redline versions, which are difficult to clearly group with other triggers.

patterns.name: Mary Cook legal email signature
patterns.context: Polite closing and fixed signature, company address, and phone number after the Enron email body; sometimes only some signature fields are shown.

patterns.name: Email forwarding headers and fields
patterns.context: Field labels, email metadata, and adjacent names, dates, and times activate in forwarded or quoted email content; sender and recipient fields and PM timestamps are common.

patterns.name: Brief polite or collaborative email expressions
patterns.context: Brief thanks, meeting arrangements, invitations for feedback, or work-planning expressions in email bodies; activations are scattered across words in the phrases.

patterns.name: Interpretive and race-neutral discussion in legal opinions
patterns.context: Discussion in opinions of whether an explanation is credible, race-neutral, or indicative of discriminatory intent; the word explanation recurs.

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: Case citations in judicial texts, including citation abbreviations, volume and page numbers, years, and case names; activations concentrate on some numbers and citation fragments.

patterns.name: Redlines and address numbers in legal business correspondence
patterns.context: The fragment contains the phrase redline versions, an email signature, and numbers in an address and phone number. The signature may belong to a fixed email format, but the connection to redline is unclear.
patterns.domain: Corporate legal email and contact information

8_2644.concept: 文档格式与法律邮件文本
8_2644.description: 激活主要出现在 Enron 邮件的签名、转发邮件头及简短礼貌或协作表达；另有法律判决中的解释论述与判例引注。片段1还含 redline versions，难与其他触发明确归并。

patterns.name: Mary Cook 法务邮件签名
patterns.trigger: «C»ordially, «Mary» Cook «Enron» North« America» «Corp». «1400» Smith, «38»th «Floor», Legal↵Houston, Texas «77002»-«7361» «(713)» «345»-«7732»
patterns.context: Enron 邮件正文结束后的礼貌收尾及固定签名、公司地址和电话；签名有时只显示部分字段。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件/法律部门签名

patterns.name: 邮件转发头与字段
patterns.trigger: «-----Original Message-----»、«From»、«Sent»、«To»、«Subject»，以及日期、时间和收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件转发或引用内容中，字段标签、邮件元数据及相邻姓名、日期和时间被激活；常见发件人、收件人字段与 PM 时间。

patterns.name: 邮件简短礼貌或协作表达
patterns.trigger: «Thank you». «I» want to see you next time «you»'re in Houston!；«know» «if» «you» «have» «any» «comments» or «questions».；as needed.
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的简短感谢、约见、邀请反馈或工作安排表达，激活分散于短语中的词。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的解释与种族中立论述
patterns.trigger: « explanation» … “need not be persuasive or↵plausible;” … the « explanation» is deemed race neutral if there is no discriminatory intent.
patterns.context: 判决论述中讨论解释是否可信、种族中立及歧视意图，重复出现 explanation 一词。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决/法律论证

patterns.name: 判例引注格式
patterns.trigger: «99» S.Ct. 2898, «61» L.Ed.2d 608 «(»1979); State ex rel. Oregonian Pub. Co. v. Deiz, «289» Or. 277, «284», «613» P.2d 23
patterns.context: 司法文本中的判例引文，包含引注缩写、卷页码、年份及案件名称；激活集中在若干数字和引注片段。

patterns.name: 法律商务通信中的 redline 与地址数字
patterns.trigger: and redline« versions»；«14»«00» Smith, «38»th Floor … Texas «77»«002»-«7»«361» «(»«713»«)»
patterns.context: 片段同时包含 redline versions 表述、邮件签名以及地址和电话号码中的数字；其中与签名部分可能同属固定邮件格式，但 redline 的触发关系不明确。
patterns.domain: 企业法务邮件及联系信息

en.concept: U.S. legal document formats and citations
en.description: Primarily responds to the structured format of U.S. legal documents, especially volume and page numbers and reporter abbreviations in case citations; also responds to opinion headers, judge names, rule-date paragraph markers, and separator lines. Insurance-law discussion and an explanation of an email bounce command also appear.

patterns.name: Numbers and volume/page information in legal citations
patterns.context: Volume numbers, page numbers, citation reporter series, and their numbers or abbreviations occur together in case citations; focus often falls on numbers near reporter names.

patterns.name: Court opinion headers and judge names
patterns.context: Typeset headings, source of appeal, date, or panel information before the opinion text; judge names may be split into uppercase and lowercase fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers, provisions, and procedural markers in legal text
patterns.context: Structured numerical markers such as rule numbers, dates, and paragraph numbers in legal documents; adjacent to headers or citation formats.

patterns.name: Horizontal rules and whitespace in opinion layout
patterns.context: Underscored horizontal rules used to separate title areas in opinion headers, often accompanied by extensive whitespace and line breaks.

patterns.name: Email bounce explanation and command text
patterns.context: Failed-delivery explanation attached to a press-release email, instructing the recipient to send a specified command to an address.

patterns.name: Legal description of insurance risk
patterns.context: Legal discussion of the purpose of insurance coverage, followed by an insurance case citation.

8_2644.concept: 美国法律文书格式与引证
8_2644.description: 主要响应美国法律文书的结构化格式，尤其判例引证中的卷页数字与报告缩写；也响应意见书版头、法官名、规则日期段落标记及分隔线。另见保险法论述和一段邮件退信命令说明。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字与卷页信息
patterns.context: 法院判例引证中，卷号、页码、引证报告系列及其数字或缩写相邻出现；重点常落在报告名称附近的数字

patterns.name: 法院意见书版头与法官姓名
patterns.context: 判决正文前的排版式标题、上诉来源、日期或合议庭信息；法官姓名可能被拆分成大小写片段
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院意见书版头

patterns.name: 法律文本中的数字、条款及程序标记
patterns.context: 法律文书中的规则编号、日期、段落号等结构化数字标记；与版头或引证格式相邻

patterns.name: 判决排版中的横线与留白
patterns.context: 意见书版头中用于分隔标题区域的下划线横线，常伴随大量空白与换行

patterns.name: 邮件退信说明及命令文本
patterns.context: 新闻稿邮件中的错误投递说明，要求收件人向地址发送指定命令
patterns.domain: 企业新闻稿邮件/邮件自动处理说明

patterns.name: 保险风险的法律表述
patterns.trigger: insurance is intended to protect against risk that is beyond the control of the insured«.»
patterns.context: 讨论保险保障目的的法律论述，后接保险判例引证

en.concept: Proper nouns and punctuation in structured documents
en.description: Activations are distributed across citation punctuation and numbers in legal texts, email signature addresses and phone numbers, delivery failure notices, court case metadata, and a family caregiving narrative. Apart from legal citations, the patterns differ substantially in genre and content.

patterns.name: Page numbers and citation punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs next to citation page numbers, volume numbers, paragraph numbers, or abbreviations in case discussions or legal citations.

patterns.name: Company address and phone number formats
patterns.context: Consecutive company name, street address, city, ZIP code, and phone number information in email signatures.

patterns.name: Email delivery failure notice
patterns.context: A misdelivery notice attached to a press-release email, instructing the recipient to send a message or command to a specified email address.

patterns.name: Court case metadata
patterns.context: Case number, court, jurisdiction, and date metadata at the start of an opinion or case document.

patterns.name: Family and caregiving arrangements narrative
patterns.context: Email body describing someone being out of the office and their family caregiving situation.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文档中的专名与标点
8_2644.description: 激活分布于法律文本中的引证标点与数字、邮件签名地址电话、投递故障说明、法院案件元数据，以及家庭照护叙述；除法律引证外，各模式文体和内容差异明显。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的页码与引证标点
patterns.trigger: 引文中的逗号、句点及其邻近数字，如“387, 678 N.E.2”“420, 284 N.W. 183, 185”“¶ 34, 688 N.W.2d 389”；也包括“issue.”、“action,”等法律文本标点
patterns.context: 判例论述或法律引文中，标点紧邻引证页码、卷号、段落号或缩写

patterns.name: 公司地址和电话格式
patterns.trigger: “Enron North America Corp.”、“400 Smith Street”、“Houston, Texas 77002”、“Phone: (713) 853-”及相似地址、电话字段
patterns.context: 邮件签名中的公司名称、街道地址、城市邮编和电话号码等连续信息

patterns.name: 邮件投递故障说明
patterns.trigger: “received this in error”、“send a message to:”及“eMailDelivery@businesswire.com”
patterns.context: 新闻稿邮件附带的误收处理说明，要求向指定邮箱发送消息或命令
patterns.domain: 商务邮件／新闻稿自动投递通知

patterns.name: 法院案件元数据
patterns.trigger: “Civ.A. No. DKC 2000-CV-763”、“United States District Court, D. Maryland.”、“November 22, 2000.”
patterns.context: 判决或案件材料开头的案号、法院、辖区和日期等元数据

patterns.name: 家庭与照护安排叙述
patterns.trigger: “at home with his kids”、“his mother in law is taking a break”、“four kids”、“two-month old baby”
patterns.context: 邮件正文叙述某人不在办公室及其家庭照护情况

en.concept: Numbers and markers in formatted text
en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and their punctuation, legal document structure, paper figure cross-references, HTML/Javadoc markers, and several biomedical terms. Multiple text types show localized responses to formatting symbols, number strings, or specialized tokens, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Formatted values near numbers and decimal points
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and words occur together, especially number strings with decimals, hyphens, citation page numbers, or equations; activations fall on numbers or nearby formatting tokens.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, mathematical equations, general numerical text

patterns.name: Structural markers in legal opinions and citations
patterns.context: Legal terms, paragraph/citation punctuation, and layout headings in legal opinions, decisions, or notes; not all positions in legal texts activate equally.

patterns.name: Figure references and their markers
patterns.context: Figure references at the ends of paper sentences, composed of parentheses, square brackets, Fig numbers, cross-reference anchors, and ref-type metadata.

patterns.name: HTML/Javadoc page-generation markers
patterns.context: HTML tags, comments, and Javadoc descriptions of automatically generated pages in webpage source code.

patterns.name: Clinical and biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: Specialized terms relating to coronary arteries, anatomical imaging, gene expression, or molecular imaging; these activations are not fully explained by figure references.

8_2644.concept: 格式化文本中的数字与标记
8_2644.description: 激活分布在数字及其标点、法律文书结构、论文图表交叉引用、HTML/Javadoc 标记和若干生物医学术语上。多类文本均呈现对格式化符号、数字串或专业 token 的局部响应，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与小数点附近的格式化数值
patterns.context: 数字、标点和文字相邻，尤其是带小数、连字符、引文页码或算式的数字串；激活落在数字或数字附近的格式 token 上。
patterns.domain: 法律引文、数学算式、一般数字文本

patterns.name: 法律判决与引文中的结构性标记
patterns.context: 法律意见、判决或注释中的诉讼术语、段落/引文标点及版面标题；并非所有法律文本位置都同等激活。

patterns.name: 图表引用及其标记
patterns.context: 论文句末以括号、方括号、Fig 编号、交叉引用锚点和 ref-type 元数据构成图表引用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的 XML/转换后文本

patterns.name: HTML/Javadoc 页面生成标记
patterns.context: 网页源码中出现 HTML 标签、注释及自动生成页面的 Javadoc 说明。

patterns.name: 临床及生物医学术语片段
patterns.trigger: “multiple« coronary»3« rev»2ascular«izations»3”, “« the»1 left hemidi«aphragm»1”, “mRNA expression”, “small interference RNA (si«RNA»1)”
patterns.context: 涉及冠状动脉、解剖影像、基因表达或分子成像的专业术语；这些激活不完全由图表引用解释。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to dense volume numbers, page numbers, years, paragraph numbers, and punctuation in case citations; also responds to litigation document headings and some legal terms and legal word fragments.

patterns.name: Numeric citation punctuation in legal texts
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on numbers, abbreviations, and the commas, periods, hyphens, and parentheses between them in case citations; typically in court opinion text or citation sections.

patterns.name: Litigation document layout and headings
patterns.context: Activations occur in formatted elements such as case numbers, party identities, judge titles, and document headings, alongside spaces and line breaks.

patterns.name: Legal terminology in opinion language
patterns.context: Activations fall on terms in legal disputes or litigation standards, usually embedded in formal legal argument; co-occurs with the citation-number pattern.
patterns.domain: Opinion reasoning and procedural law language

patterns.name: Specific word-initial and inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activations on fragments/words in legal vocabulary or citation institution names; these examples do not establish an independent semantic condition.

8_2644.concept: 法律判决引证与格式
8_2644.description: 主要响应判例引证中密集的卷号、页码、年份、段落号与标点；也响应诉讼文书标题版式及部分法律术语和法律词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的数字化引证标点
patterns.context: 激活集中在判例引证的数字、缩写及其间的逗号、句点、连字符和括号；多为法院意见正文或引证区。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书版式及标题
patterns.context: 激活出现在案件编号、当事人身份、法官称谓及文书标题等格式化元素中，并伴随空格和换行。

patterns.name: 判决用语中的法律术语
patterns.trigger: “genuine issues”“material fact”“attorney’s fees”“due process rights”“state a claim”“manifest error of law”“natural and ordinary meaning”
patterns.context: 激活落在法律争议或诉讼标准中的术语词，通常嵌在正式的法律论证句中；与引证数字模式并存。
patterns.domain: 判决论证与程序法表述

patterns.name: 特定词首及分词片段
patterns.context: 零散激活于法律词汇或引证机构名称中的词片段/词语，无法从这些例子确认独立语义条件。

en.concept: U.S. opinion citations and legal document formats
en.description: Activations concentrate in U.S. court opinions: punctuation, numbers, and reporter formats in case citations, as well as procedural terms and fixed rule language in nonprecedential notices, case captions, and legal arguments. There are also a few parental-rights cases and layout/OCR characters.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and punctuation in case citations
patterns.context: Activations often occur at quotation boundaries or within quotations when legal arguments quote opinion text or cases; punctuation and positions vary.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal citations

patterns.name: Numbers and citation format in case citations
patterns.context: Some tokens in numbers and abbreviations activate when case names are followed by volume numbers, page numbers, paragraph numbers, years, and reporter information.

patterns.name: Nonprecedential-effect notice from a court of appeals
patterns.context: Court-rule text, rule numbers, and nearby layout characters activate when an opinion begins by indicating that it is unpublished or nonprecedential and stating the applicable rule.
patterns.domain: First page or header of a federal appellate opinion

patterns.name: Case numbers and court document layout
patterns.context: Line breaks, spaces, and remnants of scanned layout appear near opinion headers, party sections, judge signatures, or titles.
patterns.domain: Court document format and case caption page

patterns.name: Litigants and procedural legal terminology
patterns.context: Party, dispute, or procedural terms appear in discussion of litigation rights, burdens of proof, arbitration agreements, statutory interpretation, and other procedural or substantive legal issues.

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in legal rules or opinion reasoning
patterns.context: Fixed legal phrases and surrounding text activate when a court states a standard of review, rule of interpretation, fact-finding principle, or pleading standard.

patterns.name: Family relationships and termination of parental rights
patterns.context: When citing opinions about termination of parental rights and its severe consequences.

patterns.name: Scanning/OCR remnants and unusual characters
patterns.context: Near formatting noise and line-break characters caused by opinion headers, pagination, or layout conversion; these are not necessarily semantic triggers.

8_2644.concept: 美国判决引文与法律文书格式
8_2644.description: 激活集中于美国法院判决文本：判例引文中的标点、数字和报告集格式，以及非先例声明、案件抬头和法律论述中的程序术语与固定规则表述；另有少量亲权判例及版面/OCR字符。

patterns.name: 判例引文中的引号及标点
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用判决原文或引述判例时，常在引文边界或引文内部出现激活；不同的标点与位置并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律引文

patterns.name: 判例引文中的数字和引证格式
patterns.context: 判例名称后附卷号、页码、段落号、年份及报告集信息时，数字和缩写中的若干 token 激活

patterns.name: 上诉法院的非先例效力声明
patterns.context: 意见开头标示未发表、非先例判决及适用规则时，法院规则文字、规则编号和附近版面字符激活
patterns.domain: 联邦上诉法院判决首页或页眉

patterns.name: 案件编号与法院文书版面
patterns.context: 判决抬头、当事人栏、法官署名或标题附近，包含换行、空格和扫描版式残留
patterns.domain: 法院文书格式与案件标题页

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人及程序性法律用语
patterns.context: 诉讼权利、举证责任、仲裁协议、法规解释等程序或实体法律论述中出现当事人、争议或程序术语

patterns.name: 法律规则或判决理由中的固定表述
patterns.trigger: «reasonable allowances»、«no genuine issues of material fact»、«light most favorable»、«natural and ordinary meaning»、«plausible on its face»
patterns.context: 法院陈述审查标准、解释规则、事实认定原则或诉讼请求标准时，固定法律短语及其周边文字激活

patterns.name: 家庭关系与亲权终止
patterns.context: 引用关于终止父母权利及其严重后果的判决时

patterns.name: 扫描/OCR残留与非常规字符
patterns.trigger: « »、重复空格、«↵»及拆分或粘连的引证字符
patterns.context: 判决页眉、分页或排版转换产生的格式噪声与断行字符附近；不一定是语义触发因素

en.concept: Numbers and boundary markers in structured text
en.description: Activations concentrate on numbers, punctuation, and boundary markers in structured text: email header timestamps and separator lines, HTML navigation tags, numbers in mathematical equations, legal citation numbers, and code comments and conditional operators; each depends on a different formatting context.

patterns.name: Dates, times, and separators in Enron email headers
patterns.context: Structured records in exported email headers, where dates, times, AM/PM, sender/recipient fields, and line breaks occur; specific numbers, PM, separator lines, and similar elements are highlighted.

patterns.name: HTML navigation lists and anchor markers
patterns.context: Navigation bar/list source in HTML documents, containing link attributes, closing tags, and class names; triggers fall on attribute fragments, text, and nearby tags.

patterns.name: Numbers and equation structure in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Problems or solutions containing polynomials, exponents, coefficients, equations, and factoring prompts; specific highlights concentrate on numbers and operators.

patterns.name: Citation format in legal case citations
patterns.context: Case citations following legal arguments, containing years, jurisdiction abbreviations, volume and page numbers, paragraph numbers, and reporter names; activations fall near citation numbers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Length calculations and conditional branches in Go source
patterns.context: A comment describes a length field, followed by code that accumulates length in a local variable and branches based on whether n is positive.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与边界标记
8_2644.description: 激活集中于结构化文本中的数字、标点与边界标记：邮件头时间和分隔线、HTML导航标签、数学算式数字、法律引文数字，以及代码注释和条件运算符；各自依赖不同格式上下文。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件头中的日期时间及分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件导出头部，日期、时间、AM/PM、发件人/收件人及换行构成的结构化记录；高亮具体数字、PM、分隔线等

patterns.name: HTML 导航列表与锚点标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档的导航栏/列表源码，含链接属性、闭合标签及类名；触发落在属性片段、文字和标签附近

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字及算式结构
patterns.context: 题目或解答片段中出现多项式、指数、系数、等式及因式分解提示；具体高亮集中在数字和运算符

patterns.name: 法律判例引文的引证格式
patterns.context: 法律论述后附判例引文，含年份、辖区缩写、卷页码、段落号和报告集名称；激活落在引文数字及标点附近

patterns.name: Go 源码中的长度计算与条件分支
patterns.trigger: “// length is family (uint16), name, NUL.”、“«if» n «>» 0 {”“sl += _Socklen(n) + 1”
patterns.context: 注释说明长度字段，随后用局部变量累加长度并按 n 是否为正分支处理

en.description: Activations appear in fixed HTML document navigation templates, code conditionals/loops and counters, email header timestamps, and numbered paper section headings. The only shared feature is boundaries, markers, and fields in structured formats; no single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: HTML list/navigation endings
patterns.context: Repeated fixed no-frame links and top navigation templates at the end of navigation lists on pages such as Java API documentation.

patterns.name: Code control flow and loop conditions
patterns.context: Indented program code that reads and processes data in a loop, then closes resources.

patterns.name: Conditional commands and labels in scripts
patterns.context: A batch script uses `if` to check whether a file exists, calls a command file, and sets a jump label/comment.

patterns.name: Iterative lookup and counting
patterns.context: Iterates over entries, updating results and counters according to whether a filename is in the target set.

patterns.name: Email header and timestamp formats
patterns.context: Forwarded or quoted email headers in email archives, containing date/time and sender/recipient fields; formats vary somewhat across snippets.

patterns.name: Paper section headings and numbering
patterns.context: A numbered section heading follows a body paragraph, containing chemistry/biomedical terms and Markdown-like anchor markers.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本标记与边界
8_2644.description: 激活分别出现在固定 HTML 文档导航模板、代码中的条件/循环与计数、邮件头时间戳及论文编号小节标题。共同点仅是结构化格式中的边界、标记与字段，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML 列表/导航收尾
patterns.trigger:
`
  • `、`
    • `、``，随后 `
      `；相邻内容含 `target="_top"` 与 `No Frames`
patterns.context: Java API 文档一类页面的导航列表末尾，重复出现固定的无框架链接和顶部导航栏模板
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 代码控制流与循环条件
patterns.trigger: `is.read(buffer); if (numRead > 0) { ... } while (numRead != -1);` 中的 `if`、`while` 及其条件
patterns.context: 缩进的程序代码中，循环读取并处理数据，之后关闭资源

patterns.name: 脚本中的条件命令与标签
patterns.trigger: `if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call ...`、`:skipRcPost`、`@REM pause the script if ...`
patterns.context: 批处理脚本通过 `if` 判断文件是否存在、调用命令文件，并设置跳转标签/注释
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Windows 批处理脚本

patterns.name: 迭代查找与计数
patterns.trigger: `for entry in self.iter_entries():`、`if entry.filename in files:`、`files_found += 1`
patterns.context: 遍历条目，根据文件名是否在目标集合中更新结果和计数
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Python 代码

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间戳格式
patterns.context: 邮件归档中包含日期时间、发件人/收件人字段的转发或引用邮件头；不同片段格式略有差异

patterns.name: 论文小节标题与编号
patterns.trigger: `2.5 Selenocysteine β-Lyase {#sec...}`、`2.9 2.1 Biochemical Characteristics and Mechanism`
patterns.context: 正文段落后出现带编号的章节标题，含化学/生物医学术语及类似 Markdown 的锚点标记
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.concept: Code structure and formatting markers (also responds to heterogeneous text)
en.description: The strongest responses concentrate in Go systems/network source code, especially const groups, godefs generated headers, system identifiers, and struct fields; it also responds to conditionals/error paths. Other examples include road terminology, project readership, HTML navigation, and email timestamps, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Constant declarations in Go source
patterns.context: Triggers are const and parenthesized grouped declarations in Go code; commonly found in file headers, after type definitions, or in package-level constant sections.

patterns.name: godefs generated-code headers
patterns.context: A comment says generated by cgo -godefs and do not edit; followed by a package declaration and a constant section.

patterns.name: Go system interfaces and constant names
patterns.context: Package names, imports, and uppercase underscore constants in Go files related to system calls, sockets, or IP protocols.

patterns.name: Go network struct fields and size constants
patterns.context: Network address length calculations or interface message struct declarations; involves lengths, byte arrays, fields, and header sizes.

patterns.name: Conditional statements and error handling
patterns.context: Activations fall near conditional checks, script environment branches, or C-style error paths and error codes; specific semantics differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Github, Windows batch scripts and C/POSIX code

patterns.name: Line-initial indentation and code block boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near indented line beginnings, line breaks, and declaration boundaries within code blocks; this may accompany code formatting but does not explain all strong activations.

patterns.name: Million-reader phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in a project description of its expected audience size; activations concentrate on words such as audience and readers.

patterns.name: Road routes and intersection terminology
