patterns.context: 谈论买卖、购买成本、促销或交易明细，部分词后紧跟金额。
patterns.domain: 能源交易邮件、零售促销、消费讨论及交易表格

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与文件名
patterns.context: 文件扩展名、目录路径或文件名出现在代码片段、控制台输出或脚本中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、脚本与数据输出

patterns.name: 代码标点与转义符
patterns.context: 密集的标点、引号、括号或转义字符构成代码或正则表达式；未见它们在自然语言中形成稳定语义。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 GitHub 代码

patterns.name: 制表符与结构化字段
patterns.context: 换行、缩进或制表符用于分隔邮件中的交易字段或表格数据。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及结构化文本

patterns.name: 服务与网站地址
patterns.context: 网址、域名、网站路径或类 URL 的文件路径；也可能与文件扩展名混合。
patterns.domain: 网页配置讨论、脚本输出与路径文本

patterns.name: 云服务计费表达
patterns.context: 资源实例的按小时费率，金额后接时间单位。

patterns.name: 消费频率与应用价格
patterns.context: 讨论应用购买价格和购买频率，金额与每月周期出现在消费意见中。

patterns.name: 促销文案与折扣
patterns.context: 折扣标题后接购买适用范围、有效期和限制条款。

patterns.name: 代码变量及逻辑操作
patterns.context: 变量、条件、循环或布尔值出现在程序代码或代码输出中。

patterns.name: 正则表达式与密集符号序列
patterns.context: 连续的转义字符和符号形成难以从片段判定用途的模式。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code, HTML, URLs, and natural language. Prominent local patterns include periods and extensions in filenames/URLs, decimal points in numeric amounts, HTML line breaks, and syntax symbols. Sporadic activations also occur on proper names, technical identifiers, and ordinary words, with no single function tying them together.

patterns.name: HTML line-break tag
patterns.context: Appears in HTML snippets, especially the line-break marker after an error message; the tag itself is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Period or extension boundary
patterns.context: A period occurs in a filename, URL, or extension; activation often falls on the period or adjacent extension characters.

patterns.name: Decimal points and amount digits
patterns.context: The decimal point and following digits in numeric amounts or prices; a currency symbol may also precede the amount.
patterns.domain: Transaction emails, price descriptions, and news commentary

patterns.name: HTML/markup syntax symbols
patterns.context: Near angle brackets, colons, semicolons, and braces in markup languages, templates, code, or configuration syntax.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names and paths
patterns.context: Internal fragments of proper names, brands, domains, or paths are activated, with no stable shared meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Code, email, web pages, and file paths

patterns.name: Local tokens in code and technical text
patterns.context: Local fragments of variables, component names, protocol names, or code identifiers are activated to varying degrees in technical corpora.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in email and ordinary text
patterns.context: Individual ordinary words are activated in natural-language emails or comments, without stable semantic or grammatical commonality.

patterns.name: Line breaks and delimiters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at text boundaries or between code lines; some contexts include a horizontal rule or blank lines.

8_2882.description: 激活分散于代码、HTML、网址和自然语言中，较显眼的局部模式是文件名/网址的句点与扩展名、数字金额的小数点、HTML换行及语法符号；另有专名、技术标识符和普通词语的零散激活，难以归为单一功能。

patterns.name: HTML 换行标签
patterns.context: 出现于 HTML 文本片段中，尤其是错误提示后的换行标记；该标签本身被突出激活。

patterns.name: 句点或扩展名边界
patterns.context: 句点位于文件名、网址或扩展名中；激活常落在句点，或紧邻的扩展名字符。

patterns.name: 小数点及金额数字
patterns.context: 数字金额或价格中的小数点及其后数字；有时金额前还出现货币符号。
patterns.domain: 交易邮件、价格说明、新闻评论

patterns.name: HTML/标记语法符号
patterns.context: 标记语言、模板、代码或配置语法中的尖括号、冒号、分号及花括号附近。

patterns.name: 专名和路径中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 专名、品牌、域名或路径的内部片段被激活，未见稳定的共同词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、邮件、网页与文件路径

patterns.name: 代码与技术文本中的局部 token
patterns.context: 技术语料中，变量、组件名、协议名或代码标识符的局部片段有不同程度激活。

patterns.name: 邮件及普通文字中的零散词语
patterns.context: 自然语言邮件或评论里，若干普通词语单独激活，缺乏稳定的语义或语法共性。

patterns.name: 换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 多处文本边界或代码行之间出现换行激活；有的上下文伴随横线或空行。

en.description: Primarily activates on digits and decimal points in dollar amounts, commonly in product, service, and fee copy; also covers integer list prices and unit rates. A Debian installation command has sporadic activation, which does not fit the price pattern.

patterns.name: Decimal prices
patterns.context: Product or service prices written in dollars, with activation concentrated on the decimal point and following digits; often alongside amounts, monthly/hourly rates, or discounts.
patterns.domain: Ads, product catalogs, and price descriptions; passages 1–8, 10

patterns.name: List prices in product catalogs
patterns.context: List prices appear near products, versions, or specifications; overlaps with decimal prices but also includes integer prices, such as “($5)” and “($3.5)”.
patterns.domain: Retail ads, bibliographies, and consumer product descriptions; passages 5–8, 10

patterns.name: Prices and rate units
patterns.context: A price is followed by a billing period, unit, or shipping details; the price is not always a catalog list price.
patterns.domain: Cloud services, web hosting, shipping, and energy cost descriptions; passages 1–4

patterns.name: Dollar signs and digits in amounts
patterns.context: An amount is introduced with a dollar sign, commonly in product lists and promotional copy; activation falls on digits and punctuation within the amount and sometimes extends to nearby text.
patterns.domain: E-commerce and ads, product descriptions; passages 1–8, 10

patterns.name: Command-line and software repository operations
patterns.context: Terminal commands or installation instructions separated by line breaks include a Debian repository address and a key import command; no dollar prices appear.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A and Linux instructions; passage 9

8_2882.description: 主要对美元金额的数字与小数点激活，常见于商品、服务及费用文案，也覆盖整数标价、单位资费。另对一段 Debian 安装命令有零散激活，和价格模式不符。

patterns.name: 十进制小数价格
patterns.context: 商品或服务价格以美元书写，激活集中在小数点及其后数字；常与金额、每月/每小时费率或折扣并列。
patterns.domain: 广告、商品目录、价格说明；段1–8、10

patterns.name: 商品目录中的标价
patterns.trigger: 价格前后的商品名及金额，如「Rapid Travel Wall Charger … $19.99 to 24.99」「suggested price of $29.99」「Hardcover. $27.95」
patterns.context: 列表或商品介绍中，标价与商品、版本或规格相邻；与小数价格模式重叠，但也包括整数价，如「($5)」「($3.5)」。
patterns.domain: 零售广告、书目、消费品介绍；段5–8、10

patterns.name: 价格及资费单位
patterns.context: 价格后有计费周期、单位或配送说明；价格并非总是商品目录标价。
patterns.domain: 云服务、网页托管、运费及能源费用说明；段1–4

patterns.name: 金额中的美元符号与数字
patterns.context: 以美元符号引出金额，常见于商品清单和促销文案；激活落在金额内部的数字、标点，且有时延伸至邻近文本。
patterns.domain: 电商与广告、商品介绍；段1–8、10

patterns.name: 命令行与软件仓库操作
patterns.context: 在换行分隔的终端命令或安装指引中，出现 Debian 仓库地址和密钥导入命令；不见美元价格。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、Linux 操作说明；段9

en.description: Every passage contains a highlighted period, and most occur in the decimal portion of dollar amounts. They often appear with dollar signs, price digits, and hourly, monthly, or nightly billing expressions. A few periods are ordinary sentence punctuation or occur in URLs.

patterns.name: Period in decimal amounts
patterns.context: Between the integer and fractional parts of a monetary amount or price; in several examples, the period is more strongly activated than neighboring digits.
patterns.domain: Price, fee, transaction, and consumer-related text; websites, emails, and forums

patterns.name: Combination of amount markers and digits
patterns.context: In contexts involving prices, rates, and settlement amounts; dollar signs and amount digits often co-occur with the period, but activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Commercial quotes, bills, subscriptions, energy prices, camping fees, and app-purchase discussions

patterns.name: Price suffixes and billing periods
patterns.context: An amount is followed by hourly, monthly, or nightly billing details; also includes subscriptions and unit prices.
patterns.domain: Cloud computing, web hosting, music subscriptions, camping, and energy prices

patterns.name: Non-price periods
patterns.context: The period is not always a decimal point in an amount; it also appears at sentence endings, near URLs, or by abbreviations, possibly sharing only punctuation features with common price formats.
patterns.domain: Web text, emails, and forum comments

8_2882.description: 所有片段都含高亮句点，且多数出现在美元金额的小数部分；常伴随美元符号、价格数字及按小时、月或晚计费表达。少数句点是普通句末或网址标点。

patterns.name: 小数金额中的句点
patterns.context: 货币金额或价格的整数与小数部分之间；多个例子中句点激活强于邻近数字。
patterns.domain: 价格、费用、交易与消费相关文本；网页、邮件和论坛

patterns.name: 金额标记与数字组合
patterns.context: 价格、费率、结算金额等语境；美元符号和金额数字常与句点共同出现，但激活强度并不均匀。
patterns.domain: 商业报价、账单、订阅、能源价格、露营费及应用购买讨论

patterns.name: 价格后缀与计费周期
patterns.context: 金额后说明按小时、按月或按晚计费；也包括订阅和单位价格。
patterns.domain: 云计算、网站托管、音乐订阅、露营和能源价格

patterns.name: 非价格的句点
patterns.trigger: «.»，如句末标点、网址中的句点，以及 «K»«WH» 等文本附近的标点
patterns.context: 句点不总是金额小数点；也出现在普通句末、网址或缩写附近，可能只是与常见价格格式共享标点特征。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、论坛评论

en.concept: Calls to action and feature descriptions on websites
en.description: Activation is common in website copy or source code, especially reader-action invitations framed as “If you …”; other examples are scattered across feedback requests, order shipping and fitment, donations and monetization, website scripts and player controls, and job descriptions.

patterns.name: Conditional contact or call to action
patterns.context: Website copy uses If you to introduce an action, feedback, or support that readers can provide; activation spans the start of the conditional clause and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Website contact, subscriptions, donations, and service descriptions

patterns.name: Requests for opinions and feedback
patterns.context: Invites readers to provide opinions, questions, or feedback; passage 2 also uses “regarding the” to introduce the subject of feedback.
patterns.domain: Political author bios, media subscription pages, or website copy

patterns.name: Website footer and script markers
patterns.context: A copyright notice in an HTML footer is followed by JavaScript code; activation also covers tags and code snippets.

patterns.name: Order shipping information
patterns.context: Shipping methods, regions, and fees for product orders.

patterns.name: Product fitment guarantee
patterns.context: Tire or wheel orders are checked for fitment based on vehicle information and include a guarantee.

patterns.name: Volume-control markers
patterns.context: HTML button and div class names describe a media player's maximum volume and volume bar.

patterns.name: Affiliate advertising and donations
patterns.context: A website explains that it earns revenue through Amazon affiliate links and invites readers to donate.

patterns.name: Website services and funding requests
patterns.context: Describes free services provided by a website to visitors and invites donations.
patterns.domain: Music website descriptions and donation copy

patterns.name: Job-seeking and hiring description
patterns.context: A post says it is looking for developers and begins listing job requirements.

8_2882.concept: 网页中的行动引导与功能说明
8_2882.description: 激活常见于网页文案或源码中，尤其是“If you …”条件式读者行动邀请；其余分散于反馈征集、订单运输与适配、捐赠变现、网页脚本和播放器控件、招聘描述等内容。

patterns.name: 条件式联系或行动号召
patterns.trigger: «If»…« you»…，尤其 «If you have any»、«If you want to»、«If you enjoy»、«If you wish»
patterns.context: 网页文案中以 If you 引出读者可采取的行动、反馈或支持；激活分布在条件句开头及邻近词。
patterns.domain: 网站联系、订阅、捐赠及服务说明

patterns.name: 征求意见与反馈
patterns.context: 面向读者邀请提供意见、问题或反馈；其中第2段也出现“regarding the”引出反馈对象。
patterns.domain: 政治作者简介、媒体订阅页或网站文案

patterns.name: 网页页脚与脚本标记
patterns.context: HTML 页脚中版权说明后接 JavaScript 代码；触发也覆盖标签及代码片段。

patterns.name: 订单运输说明
patterns.context: 商品订单的运输方式、地区与费用说明。

patterns.name: 商品适配保证
patterns.context: 轮胎或轮毂订单依据车辆信息核验适配，并承诺保证。

patterns.name: 音量控件标记
patterns.context: HTML 按钮和 div 类名描述媒体播放器音量最大值与音量条。
patterns.domain: Github 中的网页界面代码

patterns.name: 联盟广告与捐赠
patterns.context: 网站说明通过 Amazon 联盟链接获得收入，并邀请读者捐赠。

patterns.name: 网站服务与资助请求
patterns.context: 介绍网站面向访客提供免费服务，并邀请捐助。
patterns.domain: 音乐网站简介及捐赠文案

patterns.name: 求职招聘描述
patterns.context: 帖子说明正在寻找开发者，并开始列出职位要求。

en.description: Activation spans If you conditional clauses, URLs and frontend markup, commercial guarantees and payments, reader feedback/fundraising copy, as well as email notifications and C format strings; no clear common feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Opening of an If you conditional
patterns.context: Introduces a condition, request, or follow-up explanation directed at readers or users; often occurs in marketing, help text, or feedback invitations.
patterns.domain: Website copy, email, and marketing copy

patterns.name: URL/protocol and path fragments
patterns.context: Appears in code that constructs an endpoint, webpage link, or URL path.
patterns.domain: Github code, websites, and email links

patterns.name: HTML attributes and frontend markup
patterns.context: Attributes, tags, or interactive-control markers in HTML/template code.

patterns.name: Marketing guarantees and purchase conditions
patterns.context: Emphasizes fitment or refund/satisfaction guarantees, or explains payment methods and ordering conditions.
patterns.domain: Commercial websites, ads, and product copy

patterns.name: Reader feedback or donation appeals
patterns.context: Requests opinions, feedback, or support from readers; also includes fundraising copy about sustaining a publication through donations.
patterns.domain: Email, political writing, and nonprofit promotion

patterns.name: Email and periodic publication information
patterns.context: Explains when a periodic email or publication is available online.

patterns.name: C code formatted output
patterns.context: Integer or floating-point format specifiers in printf-style format strings.

8_2882.concept: 混合的功能性文本片段
8_2882.description: 激活分布在 If you 条件句、网址与前端标记、商业保证和付款、读者反馈/募款文案，也包括邮件通知及 C 格式串；共同特征不明确。

patterns.name: If you 条件句开头
patterns.context: 在句子中引出面向读者或用户的条件、请求或后续说明；常位于营销、帮助说明或反馈邀请中。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、邮件、营销文案

patterns.name: URL／协议与路径片段
patterns.trigger: «://»、«http»、«/»，以及路径或链接相关字符串
patterns.context: 出现在程序拼接 endpoint、网页链接或网址路径的代码中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、网页与邮件链接

patterns.name: HTML 属性与前端标记
patterns.context: HTML/模板代码中的属性、标签或交互控件标记。

patterns.name: 营销保证与购买条件
patterns.context: 强调适配保证、退款/满意保证，或说明付款方式与下单条件。
patterns.domain: 商业网页、广告与产品文案

patterns.name: 读者反馈或捐赠呼吁
patterns.trigger: «If»« you»…« comments» / « feedback» / « opinions» / « questions»；«Will you join»…« donation»
patterns.context: 面向读者请求意见、反馈或支持；也包括以捐赠维持出版物的募款文案。
patterns.domain: 邮件、政治写作、非营利组织宣传

patterns.name: 邮件与定期发布信息
patterns.context: 说明定期邮件或刊物的在线可用时间。

patterns.name: C 代码格式化输出
patterns.context: printf 风格格式串中的整数或浮点格式说明符。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C 代码

en.concept: Structural markers in code and documentation
en.description: Primarily responds to structured markers and delimiters in source code and generated documentation, especially HTML tags/attributes and navigation-toggle controls; it also covers URL fragments, C format strings, Git configuration commands, and POD/groff macros and other code-documentation structures.

patterns.name: HTML tags/attributes and markup structure
patterns.context: Occurs in HTML/XML-like tags, attributes, and tag boundaries, especially in navigation bars, buttons, headings, and table-of-contents structures; no particular webpage content is required.
patterns.domain: Website source code and HTML documents

patterns.name: Navigation bars and toggle controls
patterns.context: Near navigation-bar or sidebar toggle buttons/controls, often alongside HTML attributes such as data-toggle and aria-controls.

patterns.name: URL, domain, and path fragments
patterns.context: Components of URLs or file URLs; activation is scattered across test expectations and example constants.

patterns.name: Formatting placeholders in code
patterns.context: Printf-style format specifiers in C formatted-output strings, adjacent to variables or numeric formats.

patterns.name: Command configuration key-value text
patterns.context: Git configuration commands in a YAML configuration block, setting a bot's global identity information.
patterns.domain: YAML, shell commands, and Git configuration

patterns.name: Documentation markup and section structure
patterns.context: Macros, comments, or register directives in POD/groff documentation, adjacent to ordinary explanatory text.

patterns.name: Environment path fields in shell documentation
patterns.context: Environment variable/path descriptions typeset with macros in command-line tool man pages.

patterns.name: Documentation links and anchor markers
patterns.context: Near links, named anchors, and section-navigation markers in generated HTML man pages.

8_2882.concept: 代码与文档中的结构标记
8_2882.description: 主要响应源码与生成文档中的结构化标记和分隔符，尤其是 HTML 标签/属性、导航切换控件；也覆盖 URL 片段、C 格式串、Git 配置命令及 POD/groff 宏等代码文档结构。

patterns.name: HTML 标签/属性与标记结构
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML/XML 类标签、属性及标签边界中，尤其是导航栏、按钮、标题和目录结构；不要求特定网页内容。

patterns.name: 导航栏与切换控件
patterns.context: 导航栏或侧边栏的切换按钮/控件附近，常伴随 HTML 属性，如 data-toggle、aria-controls。

patterns.name: URL、域名及路径片段
patterns.context: 网址或文件 URL 的组成部分；激活分散在测试期望值和示例常量中。

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化占位符
patterns.context: C 语言格式化输出字符串中的 printf 风格格式说明符，紧邻变量或数值格式。

patterns.name: 命令配置键值文本
patterns.context: YAML 配置块中的 Git 配置命令，设置 bot 的全局身份信息。

patterns.name: 文档标记与章节结构
patterns.context: POD/groff 文档中的宏、注释或寄存器指令，与普通说明文字相邻。

patterns.name: Shell 文档中的环境路径字段
patterns.context: 命令行工具手册页中以宏排版的环境变量/路径说明。

patterns.name: 文档链接与锚点标记
patterns.context: 生成的 HTML 手册页中，链接、命名锚点和章节导航标记附近。

en.concept: Markup and syntax symbols in structured text
en.description: Activation spans several markup languages and code: Bootstrap navigation and button HTML, page structure, tests and npm commands, YAML workflows, roff macros, source comments, and email disclaimers. It is concentrated mainly on structured source markup and special syntax tokens.

patterns.name: Navigation bar collapse/toggle HTML
patterns.context: Navigation-bar buttons, attributes, or related spans in Bootstrap-style HTML; activation is concentrated near structures such as navbar, toggle, and collapse.

patterns.name: Nested divs and page-heading structure
patterns.context: Section or page-heading areas of HTML documents, with related markup nested inside div elements.

patterns.name: SVG logo asset reference
patterns.context: Test code asserts that a logo URL points to an SVG file.

patterns.name: npm command to uninstall a development dependency
patterns.context: Explains a sass-loader version compatibility issue and gives a command to uninstall a development dependency.

patterns.name: Source comments and version-control metadata
patterns.context: Source comment lines beginning with a period, containing a corruption description, file identifier, or date.

patterns.name: YAML workflow configuration and Git commands
patterns.context: CI-workflow-like YAML configuration listing steps and run commands.

patterns.name: Email disclaimer wording
patterns.context: A statement at the end of an email prohibits distribution and copying and asks unintended recipients to notify the sender.

patterns.name: roff/groff macro directives
patterns.context: Dot-prefixed macro commands and register definitions in POD conversion or groff documentation.

patterns.name: Button and link HTML
patterns.context: Bootstrap-style buttons in a page layout, with a link to blog.html inside the button.

8_2882.concept: 结构化文本中的标记与语法符号
8_2882.description: 激活覆盖多种标记语言与代码：Bootstrap 导航和按钮 HTML、页面结构、测试及 npm 命令、YAML 工作流、roff 宏、源码注释和邮件免责声明；主要集中在结构化源码标记与特殊语法 token。

patterns.name: 导航栏折叠/切换 HTML
patterns.context: Bootstrap 风格 HTML 中的导航栏按钮、属性或相关 span；激活集中在 navbar、toggle、collapse 等结构附近。

patterns.name: 嵌套 div 与页面标题结构
patterns.context: HTML 文档的章节或页面标题区域，相关标记嵌套在 div 中。

patterns.name: SVG 标志资源引用
patterns.context: 测试代码断言 logo 的 URL 指向 SVG 文件。

patterns.name: npm 卸载开发依赖命令
patterns.context: 说明 sass-loader 版本兼容问题，并给出卸载开发依赖的命令。

patterns.name: 源码注释与版本控制元数据
patterns.context: 以点号开头的源码注释行，包含损坏描述、文件标识或日期。

patterns.name: YAML 工作流配置与 Git 命令
patterns.context: 类似 CI 工作流的 YAML 配置，列出步骤和运行命令。

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明措辞
patterns.context: 邮件末尾声明禁止传播、复制，并要求误收件者通知发件人。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件法律免责声明

patterns.name: roff/groff 宏指令
patterns.context: POD 转换或 groff 文档中的点号宏命令与寄存器定义。
patterns.domain: Unix 文档标记/排版源码

patterns.name: 按钮与链接 HTML
patterns.context: 页面布局中的 Bootstrap 样式按钮，按钮内含指向 blog.html 的链接。

en.description: Covers Bootstrap collapse-navigation markup, API routes, npm and apt commands, CI configuration, test assertions, as well as email headers, social messages, and unsubscribe copy; aside from technical text and email formatting, no unified narrow trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Bootstrap navigation-bar toggle control
patterns.context: Bootstrap navigation-bar collapse/toggle markers in HTML attributes or class names; parentheses, hyphens, and adjacent attributes may also contribute to activation.

patterns.name: API route template
patterns.context: Defines a default route and its template in a web API route configuration.

patterns.name: npm package installation and version-compatibility command
patterns.context: Discusses a version compatibility issue and gives a terminal command to uninstall a development dependency.

patterns.name: GitHub Actions configuration and git commands
patterns.context: Configures CI workflow steps, including workspace attachments and shell commands.

patterns.name: Email headers and greeting/thanks body
patterns.context: Email header information such as recipient and subject, followed by brief interpersonal communication.

patterns.name: Ubuntu/PPA installation command
patterns.context: Adds a PPA in the terminal and installs PulseAudio-related packages.

patterns.name: SVG logo path in a test assertion
patterns.context: A JavaScript test verifies that a logo field in scope equals an SVG URL.

patterns.name: Email unsubscribe notice
patterns.context: The email body or footer provides instructions and a link for recipients to stop receiving future emails.

8_2882.concept: 技术代码与邮件格式片段
8_2882.description: 覆盖 Bootstrap 折叠导航标记、API 路由、npm 与 apt 命令、CI 配置、测试断言，以及邮件头、社交正文和退订文案；除技术文本和邮件格式外，未见统一的窄触发词。

patterns.name: Bootstrap 导航栏切换控件
patterns.context: HTML 属性或类名中的 Bootstrap 导航栏折叠/切换标记；括号、连字符与相邻属性也可能参与触发。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML/前端代码

patterns.name: API 路由模板
patterns.context: Web API 路由配置中定义默认路由及其模板。

patterns.name: npm 包安装与版本兼容命令
patterns.context: 讨论版本兼容问题，并给出卸载开发依赖的终端命令。

patterns.name: GitHub Actions 配置与 git 命令
patterns.context: 配置 CI 工作流步骤，包括工作区附件和 shell 命令。

patterns.name: 邮件头部与问候/致谢正文
patterns.context: 带收件人、主题等邮件头信息，后接简短的人际沟通正文。

patterns.name: Ubuntu/PPA 安装命令
patterns.context: 在终端中添加 PPA 并安装 PulseAudio 相关软件包。

patterns.name: 测试断言中的 SVG 标志路径
patterns.context: JavaScript 测试验证 scope 中 logo 字段等于一个 SVG URL。

patterns.name: 邮件退订提示
patterns.trigger: `If you would prefer not to receive`、`please click here`、`unsubscribe`
patterns.context: 邮件正文或页脚向收件人提供停止接收后续邮件的说明与链接。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件/营销退订文案

en.concept: Specific word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across the place name Cluj, code labels, medical sampling and wound terms, payment product names, processor versions, medical comparative phrases, and news headline phrases; there are also drug and word-form fragments, with no unified semantic cue.

patterns.name: Cluj place name and name fragments
patterns.context: In proper names, especially Cluj and Cluj-Napoca; the letter fragment in [1] contains uj, but its full word form is unclear.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Wikipedia place-name entries

patterns.name: Scheme in code
patterns.context: After an XML declaration and before a version field, as a label name in code or configuration files.

patterns.name: Medical sampling term swabs
patterns.context: Appears in medical titles about conjunctival and intraocular sampling, referring to swabs or sampling.

patterns.name: Payment term wallet
patterns.context: Appears in contexts about Google Wallet and money transfers by text message.

patterns.name: Wound term wounds
patterns.context: Serves as the core noun in a review title about chronic wounds.

patterns.name: Extreme Edition product name
patterns.context: Follows the processor model Pentium 4 Extreme to form a product version name.

patterns.name: far-more comparative construction
patterns.context: Modifies the comparative more liable in medical discussion, describing the relative risk associated with aortic valve infection.

patterns.name: Talking About headline phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the webpage headline phrase What No One Is Talking About.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur in drug names or medical word forms, possible proper names, or tokenized word strings; although their activation locations are clear, they lack consistent, confirmable semantic conditions.

8_2995.concept: 特定词形与专名片段
8_2995.description: 激活分散于 Cluj 地名、代码标签、医学采样与伤口词、支付产品名、处理器版本、医学比较语和新闻标题短语；另有药物及词形片段，缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: Cluj 地名与名称片段
patterns.context: 在专名中，尤其是 Cluj、Cluj-Napoca；[1] 的字母片段含有 uj，但其完整词形不清楚。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、Wikipedia 地名条目

patterns.name: 代码中的 Scheme
patterns.context: XML 声明之后、版本字段之前，作为代码或配置文件中的标签名。

patterns.name: swabs 医学采样词
patterns.context: 出现在结膜和眼内取样的医学标题中，指拭子或采样。

patterns.name: wallet 支付词
patterns.context: 出现在 Google Wallet 介绍及短信转账语境中。

patterns.name: wounds 伤口词
patterns.context: 作为慢性伤口综述标题中的核心名词。

patterns.name: Extreme Edition 产品名
patterns.context: 紧跟处理器型号 Pentium 4 Extreme，构成产品版本名称。

patterns.name: far-more 比较结构
patterns.context: 在医学论述中修饰比较级 more liable，描述主动脉瓣感染带来的相对风险。

patterns.name: Talking About 标题短语
patterns.context: 出现在网页标题短语 What No One Is Talking About 中。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段分别位于药物名或医学词形、可能的专名或被切分词串中；激活位置虽明确，但缺少一致的可确认语义条件。

en.concept: Gen substring and assorted word fragments
en.description: Strongly responds to the Gen substring, especially in genetics vocabulary; there are also patent-English word fragments, Haskell keywords, Finnish and Swedish word-internal fragments, and product-name fragments, with no apparent unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Gen-initial fragment
patterns.context: The word-initial substring Gen is marked; it can be followed by different endings, such as genetics, genome, and genomic.

patterns.name: English word-internal split fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal substrings or whole words in different forms and positions, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax words
patterns.context: In Haskell code snippets, appearing near module declarations and the main entry point.

patterns.name: Finnish split fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on short substrings within Finnish words; context is insufficient to determine their meaning or shared lexical conditions.

patterns.name: Swedish split fragments
patterns.context: Different substrings within Swedish words, with no shared semantics or clear lexical rule.

patterns.name: Word fragments in product names
patterns.context: Appears in the Google Wallet name and following sentences; markings are concentrated on split fragments of the product name.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text, payment product introduction

8_2995.concept: Gen 子串及多种词片段
8_2995.description: 强烈响应 Gen 子串，尤其见于遗传学词汇；另有专利英语词片段、Haskell 关键词、芬兰语与瑞典语词内片段及产品名片段，暂看不出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Gen- 起始片段
patterns.context: 词首子串 Gen 被标记；后续可接 genetics、genome、genomic 等不同词尾。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学与科研文本

patterns.name: 英语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子串或完整词上，不同词形和位置，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法词
patterns.context: Haskell 代码片段中，出现在模块声明及主入口附近。

patterns.name: 芬兰语切分片段
patterns.context: 激活为芬兰语词中的短子串；上下文不足以确定词义或共同词法条件。

patterns.name: 瑞典语切分片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语词内的不同子串，未显示共同语义或明确词法规则。

patterns.name: 产品名中的词片段
patterns.context: Google Wallet 名称及其后续句子中出现；标记集中于产品名拆分片段。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网络文本，支付产品介绍

en.concept: Mathematical algebraic symbols and operation text
en.description: Primarily responds to operators, variables, exponents, and coefficients in mathematical algebraic text, especially differentiation prompts, expansion instructions, and simplification of powers with positive-value assumptions; it also covers minus signs. Segment 10 activates in a vulgar email phrase and cannot be unified with the mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: Operators and variables in algebraic power expressions
patterns.context: Triggers occur in polynomial, power-function, or parenthesized-product expressions, often alternating with coefficients, exponents, and variables; several fragments are also adjacent to expansion or differentiation problems.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases in differentiation prompts
patterns.context: Natural-language math problems ask for the derivative of an expression; activation is especially common on articles, differentiation terms, and some words in the prompt.

patterns.name: Expansion instructions
patterns.context: An instruction preceding a polynomial product or power expression, followed by the algebraic expression to be expanded.

patterns.name: Phrasing of positive-value conditions
patterns.context: The result of simplifying a complex power expression is accompanied by an assumption that a variable is positive; fragments also include the corresponding power expression and line-break result.

patterns.name: Minus signs and numerical terms
patterns.context: Indicate subtraction or negative terms in algebraic expressions, usually adjacent to variable powers, products, or polynomials.

patterns.name: Phrase in a vulgar email
patterns.context: Non-mathematical colloquial email text; activation falls on some words in the phrase, with no apparent connection to the mathematical symbol pattern in other segments.

8_2995.concept: 数学代数符号与操作文本
8_2995.description: 主要响应数学代数文本中的运算符、变量、幂指数和系数，尤其是求导题干、展开指令及带正数假设的幂式化简；也覆盖负号。第10段则在粗俗邮件短语中激活，无法与数学模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 幂式代数表达式中的运算符与变量
patterns.context: 触发出现在多项式、幂函数或括号乘积的代数表达式中，常与系数、指数和变量交替；多个片段还紧邻展开或求导题目。

patterns.name: 求导题干中的固定词组
patterns.trigger: “What is the derivative of”“Find the third derivative of”“What is the third derivative of”“What is the second derivative of”
patterns.context: 自然语言数学题询问某表达式的导数；激活尤见于冠词、求导术语及部分题干词。

patterns.name: 展开指令
patterns.context: 作为多项式乘积或幂式之前的指令，后接待展开的代数表达式。

patterns.name: 正数条件措辞
patterns.context: 复杂幂式化简结果附带变量为正的假设；片段中也出现对应的幂式和换行结果。

patterns.name: 负号与数值项
patterns.trigger: “-”以及紧随其后的系数或常数，如“- 4”“- 12*x”“- 135”
patterns.context: 在代数式中表示减法或负项，通常与变量幂、乘积或多项式相邻。

patterns.name: 粗俗邮件中的短语
patterns.trigger: “bitch - you have to let me see them!”
patterns.context: 非数学口语邮件文本；激活落在短语中的部分词语，与其他段的数学符号模式无明显联系。

en.description: This neuron activates consistently on algebraic polynomials and combinations of variable powers, coefficients, and operators; instructions to simplify, expand, or rewrite expressions, as well as differentiation phrasing, also frequently occur. It additionally responds to some problem-set line breaks, numbering, or answer formats.

patterns.name: Variable powers and coefficients in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in polynomials or algebraic expressions, especially those containing multiple terms, repeated variable powers, plus and minus signs, and products; different letters and exponents can trigger it.
patterns.domain: Algebra problems and symbolic expressions in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Instructions to simplify or rewrite expressions
patterns.context: Instructions appear next to or alongside algebraic expressions, requesting simplification, expansion, or rewriting the expression in a specified form.

patterns.name: Phrasing for differentiating with respect to a variable
patterns.context: When asking for a first or second derivative, the variable name follows “wrt”; it may also co-occur with algebraic expressions containing powers.

patterns.name: Answer or problem-separator markers
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a line or near a problem or answer in math text; may be list numbering, answer formatting, or dataset separation. The trigger is weak and not shared by all segments.

8_2995.concept: 数学代数表达式与操作
8_2995.description: 该神经元在代数多项式及变量幂、系数和运算符组合中持续激活；整理、展开、改写形式的指令及求导措辞也常伴随出现。另对部分题库换行、编号或答案格式有响应。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量幂与系数
patterns.trigger: 高频触发包括变量字母（如«t»、«p»、«h»、«v»、«q»）以及相邻的«**»和指数数字（如«t»«**»«3»、«p»«**»«2»）；也包括系数、运算符和项的组合。
patterns.context: 出现在多项式或代数式中，尤其是含多项、重复变量幂、正负号及乘积的表达式；不同字母和幂次均可触发。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的代数题与符号表达式

patterns.name: 整理或改写表达式的指令
patterns.context: 指令紧邻或伴随代数表达式，要求整理、展开，或将表达式写成指定形式。

patterns.name: 对变量求导的措辞
patterns.context: 在询问导数或二阶导数时，变量名出现在“wrt”之后；也可能与含幂的代数式同现。

patterns.name: 答案或题目分隔标记
patterns.trigger: 换行后的«-»及其后的数字，例如«↵»«-»«424»；另有单独的«↵»和数字串
patterns.context: 出现在数学题文本的行首或题目、答案附近，可能是列表编号、答案格式或数据集分隔；触发较弱且不是所有段共有。

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical symbolic text: alphanumeric mappings and indices, code and mathematical software syntax, physical circuit formulas, and probability problems involving sampling without replacement. The commonality is broad, with no stable single trigger word.

patterns.name: Letters and mapping entries after a left brace
patterns.context: A set or mapping comprising letter keys and values appears, or indexed nodes occur in a formula; triggers are scattered across letters, numbers, and punctuation tokens, with no single consistent trigger token

patterns.name: Code and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Code or computer algebra expressions; activations cover identifiers, formatting tokens, backslashes, and structural symbols, with different syntax across fragments

patterns.name: Alphanumeric characters and formula symbols in technical text
patterns.context: In parameters, units, and formulas in physics or circuit technical text; co-occurs with surrounding natural language

patterns.name: Sequences and counting results in math probability problems
patterns.context: Sampling without replacement from a set of letters with specified quantities, asking for the probability of a sequence or counting event; fragments 1, 6, and 9 are also in this category

8_2995.concept: 符号化技术表达
8_2995.description: 激活分布于技术符号化文本：字母数字映射与索引、代码和数学软件语法、物理电路公式，以及无放回抽样概率题。共同点较宽泛，未见稳定的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 左花括号后的字母及映射项
patterns.trigger: “{x: 3, f: 1, y: 2, h: 2, w: 3, t: 1}”等映射中的字母、冒号和值；另有“b”“c”“d”节点标记
patterns.context: 出现由字母键和数值构成的集合/映射，或公式中的索引节点；触发散布在字母、数字及标点 token 上，未见一个一致的单一触发 token

patterns.name: 代码与符号化表达式
patterns.context: 代码或计算机代数表达式，激活覆盖标识符、格式 token、反斜线和结构符号，片段之间具体语法不同

patterns.name: 技术文本中的字母数字与公式符号
patterns.context: 物理或电路技术文本的参数、单位和公式中；与周围自然语言并存

patterns.name: 数学概率题中的序列与计数结果
patterns.trigger: “prob”“sequence”“without replacement”及其后字母序列与分数答案，如“1/132”“1/242”“1/91”
patterns.context: 从带数量的字母集合中无放回抽取，询问某序列或计数事件的概率；片段1、6、9也属于此类

en.description: Activations often fall on short identifiers and field names in code and mathematical text, especially single-letter variables, indices, and object properties; several fragments also show localized patterns involving DOM/CSS, formatted iteration, ASTs, proof notation, or documentation, with no unified semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Fields or index values in code
patterns.context: Near variable names, object properties, array elements, or mathematical symbols; activations fall on short identifiers, especially single letters and common English words.

patterns.name: j in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears as a mathematical variable in algebraic expressions, rearrangement steps, or prime-number tests; it may also overlap with code identifier j.

patterns.name: Letter fields in configurations or sequences
patterns.context: Letters serve as keys, path components, or string contents in JSON/Go and other code, often alongside adjacent letter fields.

patterns.name: DOM properties and CSS selectors
patterns.context: Around element dimensions, matching body, or constructing CSS selectors based on type/disabled.

patterns.name: Formatting and iteration in language implementations
patterns.context: Go code iterates over a slice and converts its elements using a format string.

patterns.name: Compiler AST pattern matching
patterns.context: Scala-style case patterns bind AST nodes and match constants.

patterns.name: Formal mathematical proofs and product notation
patterns.context: A paper proof introduces product subscripts, integer indices, and their subscript expressions.

patterns.name: Explanation of recursive value lookup
patterns.context: English documentation explains recursively looking up a key and returning nil if it is missing.

patterns.name: Python symbolic object interaction
patterns.context: An interactive Python notebook creates a symbolic variable and specifies an integer assumption.

patterns.name: Mixing short variable names and English words in math problems
patterns.context: The problem uses short variable names to describe an expression and asks in natural language whether the resulting number is prime.

8_2995.concept: 代码与数学中的标识符
8_2995.description: 激活多落在代码、数学文本里的短标识符和字段名，尤其单字母变量、索引及对象属性；若干片段还呈现 DOM/CSS、格式化遍历、AST、证明记号或文档说明等各自局部模式，未见统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的字段或索引值
patterns.context: 变量名、对象属性、数组元素或数学符号附近；激活落在短标识符上，尤其是单字母及普通英文词。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 j
patterns.context: 出现在代数式、重排步骤或素数判断表达式中，作为数学变量；也可能与代码标识符 j 重合。

patterns.name: 配置或序列中的字母字段
patterns.context: 字母作为 JSON/Go 等代码里的键、路径成分或字符串内容，常与相邻字母字段并列。

patterns.name: DOM 属性和 CSS 选择器
patterns.context: 围绕元素尺寸、匹配 body，或按 type/disabled 构造 CSS 选择器。

patterns.name: 语言实现中的格式化与遍历
patterns.context: Go 代码中遍历切片并以格式化字符串转换元素。

patterns.name: 编译器 AST 模式匹配
patterns.context: Scala 风格的 case 模式中绑定 AST 节点并匹配常量。

patterns.name: 形式化数学证明与乘积记号
patterns.context: 论文证明里引入乘积上下标、整数索引及其下标表达式。

patterns.name: 递归取值说明
patterns.context: 英文文档解释按键递归查找并在缺失时返回 nil。

patterns.name: Python 符号对象交互
patterns.context: 交互式 Python 笔记本中创建符号变量并指定整数属性。

patterns.name: 短变量名与英文词在数学题中的混用
patterns.context: 题目以短变量名描述算式，并用自然语言询问所得数是否为素数。

en.concept: English local function words and expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across degree expressions, evaluations or objects following the, negation/opposition expressions, and isolated instances such as sutured; across varied genres, no semantic or syntactic pattern covers all segments.

patterns.name: quite modifier
patterns.context: quite immediately precedes an adjective or state description, expressing degree; the two examples are quite interactive and quite new.

patterns.name: the in superlative or evaluative contexts
patterns.context: the is followed by an evaluative superlative, a question noun under discussion, or a technical object; trigger positions and semantics are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, machine learning Q&A, biomedical modeling

patterns.name: Negation or opposition expressions
patterns.context: Appears in negation, negative correlation, or self-justifying expressions; trigger words and syntactic positions vary.

patterns.name: sutured in a medical surgical record
patterns.context: A surgical account in which a nerve is cut and then sutured; activation is concentrated on the tokenized word sutured.
patterns.domain: Medical fact narrative in legal materials

patterns.name: Unclear local strong activations
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a metaphor about a student surfacing, a validity term, and research findings; no shared explicit trigger form is apparent.
patterns.domain: Education Q&A, validity measurement, biomedical papers

8_2995.concept: 英语局部功能词与表达
8_2995.description: 激活分散于程度表达、the 后的评价或对象、否定/反对表达，以及 sutured 等孤立局部；多种文体中没有覆盖全部段落的统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: quite 修饰语
patterns.context: quite 紧邻形容词或状态描述，表达程度；两例分别为 quite interactive、quite new。

patterns.name: 最高级或评估语境中的 the
patterns.context: the 后接评价性最高级、待讨论的问题名词或技术对象；触发位置和语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、机器学习问答、生物医学建模

patterns.name: 否定或反对表达
patterns.context: 出现在否定、负相关或自我辩护式表达中；触发词及句法位置各异。

patterns.name: 医学手术记录中的 sutured
patterns.context: 神经被切断后缝合的手术叙述，激活集中在拆分成 token 的 sutured 一词。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的医学事实叙述

patterns.name: 不明的局部强激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在学生浮现的比喻、效度术语，以及研究结果中；看不出共同的明确触发形式。
patterns.domain: 教育问答、效度测量、生物医学论文

en.description: Activations in multiple segments center on first-person “I am/I'm/I was quite + adjective,” especially sure and surprised, and also excited, irritated, and new; personal-experience and uncertainty statements also appear.

patterns.name: I am quite sure
patterns.context: In the first-person present tense, “I am quite sure” occurs consecutively; the strongest trigger word is “quite,” often followed by sure.

patterns.name: I am quite surprised
patterns.context: The first-person present tense expresses surprise with “I am quite surprised.”

patterns.name: I'm quite + emotion/evaluation
patterns.context: The first-person contraction “I'm quite” is followed by an emotion or attitude adjective.

patterns.name: I was quite surprised
patterns.context: In the first-person past tense, “I was quite” is followed by “surprised” and additional details.

patterns.name: I’ve never heard / could be alone
patterns.context: First-person personal-experience statements about never having heard of an issue and possibly being an outlier; no “quite.”

patterns.name: I am not sure
patterns.context: The first person expresses uncertainty about a judgment, with a negation between “am” and “sure.”

patterns.name: I am quite new
patterns.context: The first person says they have limited experience in a technical field, using the structure “I am quite new to ...”.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称自我评述
8_2995.description: 多段激活集中于第一人称“I am/I'm/I was quite + 形容词”，尤其 sure、surprised，也见 excited、irritated、new；另有个人经验、不确定性陈述。

patterns.name: I am quite sure
patterns.context: 第一人称现在时中，连续出现“I am quite sure”，强触发词是“quite”；sure 常紧随其后。

patterns.name: I am quite surprised
patterns.context: 第一人称现在时中，表达惊讶，出现“I am quite surprised”。

patterns.name: I'm quite + 情绪/评价
patterns.context: 第一人称缩写形式“I'm quite”，后接情绪或态度形容词。

patterns.name: I was quite surprised
patterns.context: 第一人称过去时中，“I was quite”后接“surprised”及补充说明。

patterns.name: I’ve never heard / could be alone
patterns.context: 第一人称个人经验陈述，涉及未曾听闻某问题、自己可能是个例；没有“quite”。

patterns.name: I am not sure
patterns.context: 第一人称对判断表达不确定，否定词夹在“am”和“sure”之间。

patterns.name: I am quite new
patterns.context: 第一人称自述对某技术领域经验有限，采用“I am quite new to ...”结构。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in first-person self-statements and English idiomatic fragments (new, not sure, interested); there are also hypothetical constructions, statistical-analysis phrasing, legal argumentation, and statistical terminology. The domains vary widely and cannot be reduced to a single topic.

patterns.name: “I’m new to” self-introduction
patterns.context: The questioner says they are new to a topic; modifiers may be really or quite, followed by the field name

patterns.name: “I’m not sure” expression of uncertainty
patterns.context: The questioner expresses uncertainty about which syntax to use after describing a chart problem

patterns.name: “I’d be interested” expression of interest
patterns.context: In a discussion of which applications need or support ACID, expressing a desire to hear others’ views

patterns.name: we were to hypothetical expression
patterns.context: A hypothetical position is raised in legal argumentation, using the construction “if we were to ...”

patterns.name: were doing hypothetical process
patterns.context: An explanation of probability theory uses coin tossing as an example to describe an ongoing procedure

patterns.name: Analytical-method phrases
patterns.context: Describes the statistical test, analysis method, or stratification used in a study

patterns.name: Legal evidence and jury assessment
patterns.context: Explains that the court does not replace the jury’s assessment of witness credibility or the weight of evidence

patterns.name: Local collocational activation of the
patterns.context: The definite article appears in noun phrases followed by a field-specific term, function, or chart-related noun; this alone is insufficient to explain strong activation

patterns.name: Specialized statistical terminology
patterns.context: The term occurs in a statistical analysis context involving variable types or BMI groupings

8_2995.concept: 英语短语与句式片段
8_2995.description: 激活最集中于第一人称的自我陈述及英语习语片段（new、not sure、interested），另见假设句式、统计分析措辞、法律论证和统计术语；领域跨度大，不能归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: “I’m new to”自我介绍
patterns.trigger: «I»…« am»…« really/quite»…« new» to；«I»…« am»…« quite»…« new» to
patterns.context: 提问者说明自己刚接触某个主题；修饰词可为 really 或 quite，后接领域名称

patterns.name: “I’m not sure”不确定表达
patterns.context: 提问者在描述图表问题后表示不确定该用什么语法

patterns.name: “I’d be interested”兴趣表达
patterns.context: 讨论哪些应用需要或支持 ACID 时，表达希望了解他人看法

patterns.name: we were to 假设表达
patterns.context: 法律论证中提出假设性立场，句式为“假如我们采取……”

patterns.name: were doing 假设性过程
patterns.context: 概率论解释中以抛硬币为例描述正在进行的操作

patterns.name: 分析方法短语
patterns.context: 描述研究采用的统计检验、分析方法或分层方式

patterns.name: 法律证据与陪审团判断
patterns.context: 说明法院不替代陪审团评估证人可信度或证据分量

patterns.name: the 的局部搭配激活
patterns.trigger: «the»1« theory»2；«the»2« probability»3« function»3；«the»1« actual»2« plot»；«the»2« x»-«axis»
patterns.context: 定冠词出现在名词短语中，后接学科术语、函数或图表相关名词；单独不足以解释强激活

patterns.name: 统计学专门术语
patterns.context: 术语处于变量类型或 BMI 分组的统计分析语境
patterns.domain: 统计学问答及生物医学论文

en.description: Activations are most concentrated on the tokenized styleUrls in Angular @Component configurations; there are also activations in legal-document function words, academic transitions, paper section headings, map-code properties, and colloquial Portuguese, with no unified trigger form.

patterns.name: styleUrls in Angular components
patterns.context: In an Angular @Component configuration object, after fields such as selector and templateUrl, the styleUrls property and an array appear; activations center on token fragments of styleUrls.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words in legal text
patterns.context: Common function words and legal terms appear within legal argumentation or judicial opinions; specific trigger words vary by segment, with no shared fixed phrase.

patterns.name: English step-transition expression
patterns.context: Academic philosophical discussion introduces the structure of an article, using a transitional expression such as “proceed as follows.”

patterns.name: Scientific paper section headings and numbering
patterns.context: Markdown-style headings and subsection anchors or numbers following the body of a paper.

patterns.name: Path properties in map-drawing code
patterns.context: JavaScript map code creates a Polyline object and configures its path and style.

patterns.name: First-person colloquial Portuguese
patterns.context: A colloquial Portuguese sentence appears after a code snippet, expressing “I can’t ... maybe you ...”.

8_2995.concept: 混合代码与文本模式
8_2995.description: 激活最集中于 Angular @Component 配置中的 styleUrls 分词；另在法律文书功能词、学术篇章衔接、论文小节标题、地图代码属性及葡萄牙语口语中也有激活，彼此缺少统一触发形式。

patterns.name: Angular 组件的 styleUrls
patterns.context: Angular 的 @Component 配置对象中，紧随 selector、templateUrl 等字段，出现 styleUrls 属性及数组；触发集中在 styleUrls 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的高频功能词
patterns.context: 法律论证或司法意见中，普通功能词和法律术语出现在句中；各段具体触发词不同，未见共同的固定短语。

patterns.name: 英文步骤衔接表达
patterns.context: 学术哲学论述中介绍文章结构，出现“proceed as follows”一类过渡表达。

patterns.name: 科学论文的小节标题与编号
patterns.context: 论文正文后的 Markdown 风格标题及小节锚点、编号。

patterns.name: 地图绘制代码中的路径属性
patterns.context: JavaScript 地图代码创建 Polyline 对象，并配置路径及样式。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语第一人称口语
patterns.context: 代码片段之后出现葡萄牙语口语句子，表达“我无法……也许你……”。

en.description: High activation is distributed across different contexts: being in medical passive constructions, steps introducing a paper’s argument, legal opinions, and colloquial self-questioning; there are also code punctuation, import paths, and component attributes. The instances share no clear lexical meaning.

patterns.name: being as the English copula be
patterns.context: being is followed by enrolled to form a passive construction; the preceding text describes subject enrollment in a medical study

patterns.name: as in the as follows construction
patterns.context: Introduces a subsequent argument or set of steps, followed by First I outline…

patterns.name: are in we are of opinion
patterns.context: Expresses the court’s opinion in legal argument, followed by of opinion

patterns.name: being in a self-questioning interrogative
patterns.context: In I'm just being too obsessive?, being occurs with the degree adverb too and the adjective obsessive

patterns.name: Separators and attribute-name fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in code structures such as PHP/Java import paths or JavaScript attributes and class declarations; activation is distributed across punctuation, path segments, and code identifiers

8_2995.concept: none
8_2995.description: 高激活分散在不同语境：医学被动结构、论文引述步骤、法律意见和口语自问中的 being；另有代码标点、导入路径及组件属性。各处缺少明显共同词义。

patterns.name: 英语系动词 be 的 being
patterns.context: being 后接 enrolled，构成被动结构；前文是受试者入组的医学研究叙述

patterns.name: as follows 结构中的 as
patterns.context: 用于引出后续论述或步骤，后接 First I outline…

patterns.name: we are of opinion 中的 are
patterns.context: 法律论述中表达法院意见，后接 of opinion

patterns.name: 疑问句中进行自我质疑的 being
patterns.context: I'm just being too obsessive? 中，being 与程度副词 too、形容词 obsessive 连用

patterns.name: 代码中的分隔符与属性名片段
patterns.context: PHP/Java 导入路径或 JavaScript 属性、类声明等代码结构中；激活分布于标点、路径分段及代码标识符

en.concept: Possibly biased toward local word-form fragments
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the col fragment within Portuguese words (including colocado, colunas, and escolhido); other sporadic patterns include we are, I, the legal words look/persuaded, and the statistical term log-transformed, spanning different domains and contexts.

patterns.name: The col fragment within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter fragment col within Portuguese words; contexts involve different meanings such as being placed, table columns, and selection, without requiring a particular syntax or meaning

patterns.name: English sequence we are
patterns.context: The contiguous phrase we are appears in English; one instance discusses steady state, another introduces a position or judgment in a legal opinion

patterns.name: I in English questions
patterns.context: The first-person singular pronoun appears in a user question, usually near am or cannot; activation focuses on I

patterns.name: look in English legal phrasing
patterns.context: In legal interpretation, look to is followed by statute’s purpose, describing an interpretive approach the court should not take

patterns.name: persuaded in English legal phrasing
patterns.context: The court states that it is not persuaded to accept the question presented; activation falls within the word

patterns.name: log- in statistical analysis terminology
patterns.context: A skewed variable is log-transformed in a logistic analysis; logistic also occurs in the same passage, but the marked activation is on log within log-transformed

8_2995.concept: 可能偏向局部词形片段
8_2995.description: 激活最一致地落在葡语词内的 col 片段（含 colocado、colunas、escolhido）；另有 we are、I、法律词 look/persuaded 和统计术语 log-transformed 等零散模式，跨越不同领域与语境。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语分词内部片段「col」
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部的 col 字母片段；语境分别涉及被放置、表格列和选定等不同含义，不要求特定句法或词义
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语技术问答、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语条件词「we are」
patterns.context: 英文连续出现 we are；一处讨论稳态，一处法律意见中引出立场或判断

patterns.name: 英语问句中的「I」
patterns.context: 第一人称单数代词处在用户提问中，通常邻近 am 或 cannot；激活重点在 I

patterns.name: 英语法律措辞中的「look」
patterns.context: 法律解释文本中 look to 后接 statute’s purpose，描述法院不应采取的解释方式

patterns.name: 英语法律措辞中的「persuaded」
patterns.context: 法院表示未被说服接受所提问题；激活落在单词内部

patterns.name: 统计分析术语中的「log-」
patterns.context: 偏态变量在 logistic analysis 中经对数转换；同段 logistic 也出现，但标记激活的是 log-transformed 内的 log

en.description: Activation is distributed across English copular/passive constructions, first-person questions, Portuguese subwords, and formulaic legal opinions; there are also descriptions of physics calculations and litigation terminology, with no uniform trigger form.

patterns.name: English copular and passive constructions
patterns.context: Appears in declarative, passive, or judgment constructions; strong instances include “we are required”, “being enrolled”, and “court is not required”.

patterns.name: First-person questions
patterns.context: A first-person subject occurs in a question or self-reflective expression, such as “I’m just being…” and “am I wasting…”; also appears as “we” in legal opinions.

patterns.name: Fragments within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Words are segmented into subwords in Portuguese sentences; high activation falls on fragments of “testar”, “como”, and “colocado”.

patterns.name: Procedural boilerplate in legal opinions
patterns.context: Introduces analysis, explains why oral argument is unnecessary, or summarizes that the record is sufficiently developed; several formulations recur across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Explanations of calculations in physics papers
patterns.context: A theoretical calculation explains that a contribution or constant need not be included; this does not clearly align with legal boilerplate or Q&A triggers.

patterns.name: Litigation terminology in legal judgments
patterns.context: Appears in a standard of review describing the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmoving party; no clear similar instances occur elsewhere.

8_2995.concept: 混合的句法与文体线索
8_2995.description: 激活分布于英语系词/被动结构、第一人称问句、葡萄牙语子词及法律意见书套语；另见物理计算说明和诉讼术语，触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 英语系词与被动结构
patterns.context: 出现在陈述、被动或判断结构中；较强实例包括“we are required”“being enrolled”“court is not required”。

patterns.name: 第一人称问句
patterns.context: 第一人称主语位于疑问或自我反思表达中，如“I’m just being…”和“am I wasting…”；也见于法律意见中的“we”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中词被切分为子词；高激活落在“testar”“como”“colocado”等词的片段上。

patterns.name: 法律意见书的程序性套语
patterns.context: 法院意见中引出分析、说明免于口头辩论或总结记录已充分呈现；其中若干句式在不同段落重复。

patterns.name: 物理学论文的计算说明
patterns.context: 理论计算中说明某项贡献或常数无需纳入；与法律套语及问答中的触发点不明显一致。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的诉讼事项术语
patterns.context: 出现在审查标准中描述有利于非动议方的证据视角；除此处外没有明显同类实例。

en.concept: First-person help-seeking expressions and the Portuguese col fragment
en.description: Primarily responds to “I/am I/I’m” and adjacent expressions in first-person contexts of help-seeking, uncertainty, or verification; it also responds strongly to the initial “col” in “colocado/colocada/colunas” in Portuguese technical texts, apparently as an independent word-fragment pattern.

patterns.name: First-person uncertainty or verification in questions
patterns.context: A first-person questioner describes being unable to decide, encountering a problem, or asking for confirmation; activation mainly falls on I or I’m and following words, usually in an interrogative
patterns.domain: StackExchange/HackerNews technical Q&A and forum help requests

patterns.name: The col fragment within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese technical explanations or database-table text, referring respectively to placement and columns; activation falls on the initial fragment rather than a clear semantic concept

patterns.name: Other I-related triggers within English text
patterns.context: The first-person singular pronoun appears in a statement or question, not necessarily expressing verification; this overlaps with the main pattern but does not explain a specific meaning

8_2995.concept: 第一人称求助表达与葡语 col 片段
8_2995.description: 主要响应第一人称求助、疑惑或求证语境中的“I/am I/I’m”及其相邻表达；另对葡语技术文本中“colocado/colocada/colunas”的词首“col”强烈响应，似为独立词片段模式。

patterns.name: 疑问中的第一人称不确定/求证
patterns.trigger: “am I”/“I am”后接疑问、困难或不确定表达；如 “am I missing”“am I wasting my time”“I am unable”“I’m kinda confused”“I get the wrong result”“I’m going to have to”
patterns.context: 第一人称提问者在描述自己无法判断、遇到问题或请求确认；触发主要落在 I 或 I’m 及其后续词上，通常位于疑问句中
patterns.domain: StackExchange/HackerNews 技术问答及论坛求助

patterns.name: 葡语词内 col 片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语技术说明或数据库表格文本中，分别指放置、列；激活落在词首片段而非明确的语义概念
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 回答、数据库表格

patterns.name: 其他英语词内的 I 相关触发
patterns.trigger: “I”在 “I have never seen”“I am unable”“I am in the US”等句中；另有 “I’m”
patterns.context: 第一人称单数代词出现在陈述或提问中，不一定表达求证；与主模式有重叠，但不足以解释特定语义

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the initial col in Portuguese coloc- word forms and on English first-person I (especially I am/I'm); there is also one Portuguese instruction, Coloque, possibly related to the coloc- word form.

patterns.name: coloc- word forms in Portuguese code examples
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences or text around code/tables contain inflected or derived forms of colocar, especially when discussing placing, generating, or labeling something; activation concentrates on the initial col.

patterns.name: I’m in English questions
patterns.context: The first-person I is followed by the auxiliary am (including I'm) and continues with an expression of uncertainty, conjecture, or self-assessment; in several examples it is near the sentence end or question content.
patterns.domain: English forum Q&A and colloquial posts

patterns.name: colo- in a one-off execution or override context
patterns.context: A Portuguese answer gives an operational instruction and mentions placing a control variable; it resembles the col-initial forms in [1–3], but appears only once and in a different context.

8_2995.concept: 词形片段与第一人称 I
8_2995.description: 激活主要落在葡语 coloc- 词形的词首 col，以及英语第一人称 I（尤其 I am/I'm）上；另有一次葡语 Coloque 指令，可能与 coloc- 词形相关。

patterns.name: 葡语代码示例中的 coloc- 词形
patterns.context: 葡语句子或代码/表格周围出现 colocar 的变位或派生形式，尤其谈到放置、生成或标注某物；激活集中在词首 col。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 英语疑问句中的 I’m
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后接助动词 am（包括 I'm）并继续表达疑惑、推测或自我判断；若干例子中紧邻句尾或问题内容。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛问答及口语帖子

patterns.name: 单次、执行或重载语境中的 colo-
patterns.context: 葡语回答给出操作指令，提到放置一个控制变量；与 [1–3] 的 col 词首形式相似，但只出现一次且语境不同。

en.concept: First-person self-description and local text fragments
en.description: Most passages highlight first-person I/Eu and nearby words, especially when questioners describe their own actions, confusion, negation, or omissions; a few fall on code identifiers, Portuguese word fragments, and mathematical formula symbols, which are difficult to explain together.

patterns.name: First-person subject I
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the first-person pronoun and following words; it often appears when a questioner describes their confusion, intention, or constraints
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, technical discussions; also Portuguese answers

patterns.name: I am not
patterns.context: The first-person subject is followed by am not, especially to negate or qualify what one is doing

patterns.name: I am seeking / lack of confidence
patterns.context: First-person phrasing expresses confusion, omission of something, or an intended next action

patterns.name: Code identifiers in first-person narration
patterns.context: In code examples or technical explanations, activation falls on identifier fragments or first-person narration

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Multiple words in Portuguese sentences are segmented into subword fragments, including first-person, syntactic, and word-form elements

patterns.name: Structural symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across formula variables, punctuation, subscripts/superscripts, and interval endpoints; no clear first-person syntactic condition is apparent

8_2995.concept: 第一人称自述及局部文本片段
8_2995.description: 多数片段突出第一人称 I/Eu 及其邻近词，尤其是提问者陈述自身行动、困惑、否定或遗漏；少数落在代码标识符、葡语词片段和数学公式符号上，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 第一人称主语 I
patterns.context: 激活集中在第一人称代词及其后续词；常出现在提问者描述自己的疑惑、意图或限制时
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、技术讨论；也有葡语回答

patterns.name: I am not
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后接 am not，尤其是否定或限定自己在做什么

patterns.name: I am seeking/缺少把握
patterns.trigger: «I»«'m»« just»« confused»、«I»« am»« missing»；以及«I»« am»« going»
patterns.context: 第一人称句式表达困惑、遗漏某事或接下来要采取的行动

patterns.name: 第一人称叙述中的代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码示例或技术说明中，激活落在标识符片段或第一人称叙述上

patterns.name: 葡语词形片段
patterns.context: 葡语句子中多个词被拆成子词片段激活，包含第一人称及句法、词形成分

patterns.name: 数学公式结构符号
patterns.context: 激活分布于公式的变量、标点、上下标及区间端点；未见明显的第一人称句式条件

en.description: Primarily responds to functional-word combinations in first-person self-description, questions, and negative constructions, especially “I am/I’m being/not…”; it also covers statements of consent, code identifiers, technical titles, anonymous phrasing in news, and comments, making the pattern dispersed.

patterns.name: First-person questions and self-explanation
patterns.context: Colloquial expressions in which a first-person pronoun is followed by a question, negation, or description of one’s own behavior or difficulty; especially structures such as “I am not…”, “I'm being…”, and “I'm having trouble…”.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and HackerNews comments

patterns.name: Consent and commitment phrasing
patterns.context: A formal consent statement uses the first person to express agreement to receive text messages, followed by content such as “I understand that I am opting in”.

patterns.name: Common identifiers and syntax in code
patterns.context: Methods, attributes, keywords, or punctuation in code snippets; activation is distributed across identifiers and code structures.

patterns.name: Functional words and question forms in technical questions
patterns.context: Asks whether a mechanism exists or whether a particular action is required; often accompanied by technical contexts such as user permissions and arrays.

patterns.name: External-program execution error title
patterns.context: A title-style question describes a Python executable failing when called by an external program.

patterns.name: Configuration state and conditional phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses whether editing a configuration file after uncommenting a line takes effect, and poses a condition or asks for confirmation.

patterns.name: Question phrasing in a mathematical summation problem
patterns.context: Uses a first-person question to ask whether a summation expression can be transformed or a variable moved outside the sum.

patterns.name: Negation and anonymous phrasing in news narration
patterns.context: Reports local officials’ involvement in workers’ wage arrangements and says the source requested anonymity.

patterns.name: Frustration in an online comment
patterns.context: A commenter complains about receiving downvotes and then defends an earlier comment.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称陈述与疑问表达
8_2995.description: 主要对第一人称自述、疑问及否定句式中的功能词组合有反应，尤其是“I am/I’m being/not…”；也覆盖同意声明、代码标识符、技术标题、新闻匿名措辞和评论表达，模式较分散。

patterns.name: 第一人称提问与自我说明
patterns.context: 第一人称代词后接疑问、否定或描述自身行为/困难的口语化表达；尤见于“I am not…”, “I'm being…”, “I'm having trouble…”等结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 同意与承诺措辞
patterns.context: 正式同意声明中，以第一人称表达同意接收短信，后续出现“I understand that I am opting in”等内容。
patterns.domain: 表单、短信营销同意文本

patterns.name: 代码中的常见标识符和语法
patterns.context: 代码片段中的方法、属性、关键字或标点；激活分散在标识符及代码结构中。

patterns.name: 技术问题中的功能词与问题句式
patterns.context: 询问是否存在某种机制，或是否必须采取某种做法；常伴随用户权限、数组等技术上下文。

patterns.name: 外部程序运行错误标题
patterns.context: 标题式提问，描述 Python 可执行文件在外部程序调用时出错。

patterns.name: 配置状态与条件表达
patterns.context: 讨论取消注释后修改配置文件是否生效，并提出条件或确认语气。

patterns.name: 数学求和问题中的疑问表达
patterns.context: 在询问求和式能否变形或将变量移出求和时，以第一人称提出疑问。

patterns.name: 新闻叙述中的否定与匿名表达
patterns.context: 报道地方官员参与工人薪资安排，并说明消息来源要求匿名。

patterns.name: 网络评论中的受挫陈述
patterns.context: 评论者抱怨自己遭到反对票，并接着为此前评论辩解。

en.concept: English local syntactic and word-form cues
en.description: Activation samples show varied local triggers: being and its syntactic environments, first-person self-description/contractions of auxiliaries, and code identifiers, technical questions, and several mathematical, legal, and biomedical terms; no single theme covers all passages.

patterns.name: be + ing progressive construction
patterns.context: be/are is followed by being, or being is followed by an adjective/participle; some occur in questions or narration, others in formal legal phrasing

patterns.name: I + be/have contractions
patterns.context: The first-person I is followed by a contracted auxiliary, usually in a questioner’s self-description, expression of uncertainty, or statement of intent

patterns.name: Cognitive/state words following I
patterns.context: I know is followed by an explanation of ability, degree of understanding, or a plan; often includes a repeated I or a subsequent qualification

patterns.name: Mathematical summation and limit
patterns.context: Contains a summation symbol, series terms, and a limit expression with n→∞

patterns.name: Table results and self-doubt
patterns.context: Comments on a research results table and rhetorically questions whether the author overlooked data

patterns.name: Route details and preference questions
patterns.context: Asks what details a route display should include and wonders whether the author is overthinking preferences

patterns.name: Network commands and bidirectional transfer
patterns.context: Discusses a telnet connection, a listening service, and unaltered bidirectional transfer

patterns.name: Code, configuration, and API identifiers
patterns.context: Camel-case/compound identifiers and API names appear in code or configuration snippets

patterns.name: Goals and approaches in development questions
patterns.context: Describes software under development, required features, or questions about architecture/implementation

patterns.name: Formulaic language in legal rulings
patterns.context: After listing the evidence and parties’ stipulations reviewed, the court uses hereby to issue a ruling

patterns.name: Physiological mechanisms and homeostasis modeling
patterns.context: Discusses steady state in a blood component under assumptions such as a constant production rate and half-life

8_2995.concept: 英语局部句法与词形线索
8_2995.description: 激活样本呈多种局部触发：being 及其句法环境、第一人称自述/缩略助动词，以及代码标识符、技术问题和若干数学、法律、生物医学术语；没有单一主题覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: be + ing 进行时结构
patterns.context: be/are 后接 being，或 being 后接形容词/分词；有的出现在疑问或叙述中，有的出现在正式判决措辞中
patterns.domain: 问答、普通叙述、法律文书

patterns.name: I + be/have 缩略式
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后出现缩略助动词，通常处于提问者自述、表达不确定或说明意图的句子中

patterns.name: I 后接认知/状态词
patterns.context: 第一人称 I know 后继续说明能力、理解程度或计划；常有重复 I 或后续补充

patterns.name: 数学求和与趋于极限
patterns.context: 含求和符号、级数项和 n→∞ 的极限表达式

patterns.name: 表格结果与自我怀疑
patterns.context: 评论研究结果表格，并以反问质疑自己是否看漏数据

patterns.name: 路线细节与偏好疑问
patterns.context: 询问路线展示应包含哪些细节，并反思是否过度纠结偏好

patterns.name: 网络命令及双向传输
patterns.context: 讨论 telnet 连接、监听端服务及原样双向传输

patterns.name: 代码、配置与 API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段中出现驼峰式/复合标识符和 API 名称

patterns.name: 开发问题中的目标与方案
patterns.context: 描述正在开发的软件、所需功能或对架构/实现方式的疑问

patterns.name: 法律裁判固定措辞
patterns.context: 法院列举审阅的证据与当事人约定后，使用 hereby 作出裁定

patterns.name: 生理机制与稳态建模
patterns.context: 以恒定生成率、半衰期等假设讨论血液成分的稳态

en.description: Primarily responds to the subject-plus-copula structure we are, commonly found in explanatory academic prose; it also responds to self-descriptive I’m being and am I being in colloquial Q&A. Configuration code and deployment-log passages have no visible common trigger pattern.

patterns.name: we are construction
patterns.context: The first-person plural subject is followed by the copula are, possibly continuing with a state, interest, or passive/progressive construction; no fixed following word is required
patterns.domain: Explanatory prose in academic papers, mathematics texts, and online Q&A

patterns.name: Self-assessment questions with being
patterns.context: being is followed by a negative evaluation of one’s own behavior or ability, in a colloquial question or self-doubting expression

patterns.name: Explicit explanation with being
patterns.context: being is followed by an adjective describing the speaker’s current manner of expression, as a parenthetical explanation

patterns.name: being / absence of nearby being in server configuration
patterns.context: Nginx configuration code is mixed with a natural-language question; marked activation does not fall on visible being/we are constructions

patterns.name: Deployment-log paths and error fragments
patterns.context: A code/log fragment consisting of paths, filenames, and error logs, with no clear we are or being construction

8_2995.concept: 英语系动词结构
8_2995.description: 主要响应 we are 这一主语加系动词结构，常见于说明性学术文字；也响应口语问答中 I’m being、am I being 的自我描述。另有配置代码和部署日志段缺乏可见的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: we are 结构
patterns.trigger: “we” + “are”，常接 interested / given / done / integrating 等
patterns.context: 第一人称复数主语后接系动词 are，可能继续接状态、兴趣或被动/进行结构；不要求固定下一个词
patterns.domain: 学术论文、数学文本及网络问答中的说明性文字

patterns.name: being 的自我评价问句
patterns.trigger: “I’m just being too obsessive?”、“am I being dim?”
patterns.context: being 后接对自身行为或能力的负面评价，置于口语化疑问或自我怀疑表达中

patterns.name: being 的显式说明
patterns.context: being 后接描述说话者当前表达方式的形容词，作为插入性解释

patterns.name: 服务器配置中的 being/being 近邻缺失
patterns.trigger: 未见明确对应触发词；上下文含 “server {”、“listen 443”
patterns.context: Nginx 配置代码与自然语言问题混排，标记激活未落在可见的 being/we are 结构上
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、配置代码

patterns.name: 部署日志路径与报错片段
patterns.trigger: 未见明确对应触发词；如 “load_dependency”、“error.log”
patterns.context: 路径、文件名和错误日志组成的代码/日志片段，没有明显的 we are 或 being 结构
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、部署日志

en.concept: English first-person state expressions and varied local format cues
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: common instances occur in English first-person progressive states or self-assessment; other local patterns include code punctuation/member access, mathematical symbols and terminology, table references, questions, and statements of failure.

patterns.name: English first-person ongoing states or self-assessment
patterns.context: A first-person subject is followed by are/being constructions describing interest, doubt, failure, or self-judgment; phrases need not be contiguous and often occur mid-sentence
patterns.domain: Papers, forum Q&A, and conversational texts

patterns.name: Local punctuation or attribute access in code
patterns.context: A period appears in a code expression, followed by a member or method name; the trigger is a local code token, not natural-language semantics
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, JavaScript/Ruby and other code

patterns.name: Unclear mathematical symbols/separators
patterns.context: In a typeset mathematical formula, activation falls on formula commands, symbols, or formula boundaries; a consistent semantic condition is difficult to infer from the excerpt

patterns.name: Low-concentration phrase
patterns.context: Appears in “at low plasma 5-HT concentrations”, modifying plasma concentration; its relation to other patterns is unclear

patterns.name: Table reference
patterns.context: A clinical research text references a table number and later discusses the table data

patterns.name: Bidirectional relation terminology
patterns.context: A mathematics paper describes two objects as dual to each other; “each other” appears nearby

patterns.name: Deictic phrasing at the start of a question
patterns.context: A forum questioner evaluates an approach or preference in an interrogative

patterns.name: Code fragment starts and object names
patterns.context: A usage example, assignment, or class/object identifier appears after a line break

patterns.name: Markov chain terminology
patterns.context: A mathematical context introducing a family of Markov chains and their probability transitions

patterns.name: Negative self-description
patterns.context: A forum author says they have not shown certain materials

patterns.name: Reporting an unsuccessful attempt
patterns.context: A forum author reports that a previous attempt failed, then continues looking for a solution

8_2995.concept: 英语第一人称状态表达及多种局部格式线索
8_2995.description: 激活模式多样：常见于英语第一人称的进行状态或自我评估；另有代码标点/成员访问、数学符号与术语、表格引用、提问及失败自述等局部模式。

patterns.name: 英语第一人称进行中的状态或自我评估
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后接 are/being 等结构，描述兴趣、疑虑、失败或自我判断；短语不一定连续，常位于句中
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛问答及对话式文本

patterns.name: 代码中的局部标点或属性访问
patterns.context: 句点出现在代码表达式中，后接成员名或方法名；触发局部代码 token，而非自然语言语义
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、JavaScript/Ruby 等代码

patterns.name: 不明的数学符号/分隔符
patterns.context: 数学排版公式中，激活落在公式命令、符号或公式边界附近；难以从截取上下文确认一致的语义条件

patterns.name: 低浓度相关短语
patterns.context: 出现在“at low plasma 5-HT concentrations”中，修饰血浆浓度；是否与其他模式相关不明

patterns.name: 表格引用
patterns.context: 临床研究文本中引用表格编号，后文讨论表格数据
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或研究讨论

patterns.name: 双向关系术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中描述两个对象彼此对偶，附近含“each other”

patterns.name: 提问开头的指示语
patterns.context: 论坛提问者以疑问句评估方案或偏好

patterns.name: 代码片段起始及对象名
patterns.context: 换行后出现用法示例、赋值或类/对象标识符

patterns.name: 马尔可夫链术语
patterns.context: 介绍马尔可夫链族及其概率转移的数学语境

patterns.name: 否定式自述
patterns.context: 论坛作者说明自己没有展示某些材料

patterns.name: 表达未成功
patterns.context: 论坛作者报告先前尝试未成功，随后继续寻找解决办法
